title: Vanilla Max
description: Boost your Minecraft experience while staying true to vanilla-style mechanics and systems.
body:
### What is Vanilla Max?

**It is my vision of what Minecraft could be without Microsoft and Mojang limiting what enters into the game**, without losing the sandbox aspect and remaining simple, using the vanilla crafting systems as much as possible and only introducing systems that are simple and intuitive to understand for any player. 

What motivated me to create this was that even though there are mods and modpacks that add many layers to the game, they are often overly complex making it difficult even for veteran Minecraft players to understand its mechanics, which causes them not to engage with those systems. **Vanilla Max brings its many features in a natural, seamless way into the game for any player to enjoy as they like**, and has something in it for all kinds of players!

![Splash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2107d63f3fe3cdfcd3cc5cca13703ad6fef122a4_0.webp)

## Features

- **One-click multiplayer** with **proximity-based voice chat**!
- **Airships and aircraft** that can be crafted comprehensibly through the crafting table and have intuitive controls
- **Ships** - you no longer will be able to traverse oceans with simple boats though!
- **Carts** for you to transport stuff on land by yourself or with a friendly help from horses, mules, donkeys or camels
- **Backpacks and sleeping bags** to enable you to explore further away from home without fear of going back to spawn or filling your inventory
- **Vinery** and winemaking
- **Several new mobs** - passive and hostile - including the ones that lost all mob votes!
- **Lots of new food**
- **New cooking system** for more complex recipes
- **Many new crops**
- **Improved fishing** and various new kinds of fish
- **Trinkets** with some pretty interesting effects
- **Several new small and larger structures**
- **Many revamped structures from vanilla**
- **Revamped Minecarts** that can be linked and go much faster
- **Elytra has a trinket slot** instead of taking up the chest slot
- **Revamped archeology** - and a new villager job with it!
- **Cameras** and photography!
- **Guard villagers** that can assist the player during raids and zombie attacks - and also attack misbehaving players
- **Gunpowder weaponry**: cannons for land, ships and airships, as well as flintlock guns - but they can also be in Pillager's and (rarely) Skeleton's hands!
- **Completely revamped End and Nether dimensions**
- **Backported wolves, tuff building blocks, crafter and bundles from 1.21**
- **Copper hoppers and pipes** for better storage arrays and redstone machinery
- **Lots of brand new decorations and furniture**
- **Many new wood types**
- **Several quality-of-life improvements and features**

title: Vanilla And Sprinkles
description: Vanilla+ modpack focussed on adding little things without changing the core gameplay
body:
# Vanilla and Sprinkles
**Vanilla and Sprinkles** is a **Vanilla+** Style modpack that focuses on expending the vanilla minecraft experience with more content and quality of life additions while doing as little changes to the core gameplay experience as possible and staying balanced.

In this modpack you can expect : 
- A totally new **auditory experience** thanks to mods like [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound), [AmbientSounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) and [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered).
- Comfy seasonal vibes with [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons), [Winterly](https://modrinth.com/mod/winterly) and [Tropicraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/tropicraft).
- New agricultural adventures with [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
- **Automate** your world with [Railcraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/railcraft-reborn) and [ComputerCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked).
- **Shaders**.
- New **tools** and **enchantments**.
- New **convenient** recipes.
- A more **streamlined enchanting system**.
- New **structures** and **dimensions** to explore.
- Tasteful vanilla-like **biome additions**.
- **Cosmetic Armors** to look the way you want. Source is available [here](https://github.com/zlainsama/CosmeticArmorReworked).
- **Train** your **fluffy companion** with [Doggy Talents](https://modrinth.com/mod/doggy-talents-next).
- A lot more to discover !

# Known issues
- Paintings cannot be placed manually **please use fancy paintings or commands while I investigate this issue.**

title: Chorus Juice
description: Chorus juice and chorus juice accessories! Includes two potion effects and the means to access said potions.
body:
Hello there!
This mod adds Chorus Juice and its' "juiced up" status effect.
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Which attempts to teleport the entity with the effect between 1-10 blocks away if it takes damage. Think endermen.

</details>

Now also adds Chorus Cola, a powerful multi-buff potion with downsides...

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Chorus Cola is strong stuff, so a mild-ish set of debuffs will be applied once the sugar rush is over.
If you drink Chorus Cola while still on or recovering from another dose, you may find yourself saddled with far stronger debuffs!

</details>

Also adds the ability to squeeze juice from Chorus fruits in the brewing stand. Let me know if you have issues with the potion effects. I tested them and so far, so good.
Note that you need _EMPTY_ bottles to fill them with juice!
Chorus Cola is made by adding sugar to juice.

Made with MCreator.

title: clientgive
description: A simple clientside utility for spawning in any item within Creative mode.
body:
# clientgive
A simple clientside utility for spawning in any item within Creative mode.

## Installation
1. Download and run the [Fabric installer](https://fabricmc.net/use).
   - Click the "vanilla" button, leave the other settings as they are,
     and click "download installer".
   - Note: this step may vary if you aren't using the vanilla launcher
     or an old version of Minecraft.
2. Download the [Fabric API](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/fabric)
   and move it to the mods folder (`.minecraft/mods`).
3. Download clientgive from the [releases page](https://github.com/PyPylia/clientgive/releases)
   and move it to the mods folder (`.minecraft/mods`).
   

## Usage
- Without any arguments
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick
  ```
  - This doesn't stack items, if there are no empty slots in the hotbar it will return an error.

- With a specified amount
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick 16
  ```
  - Limited to between 1 and 64.

- With NBT data
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:sharpness", lvl:10s}]}
  ```

- With the SlotID
  ```
  /clientgive minecraft:stick 1 36
  ```
  - This can bypass the empty slot restriction.
  - Note: this uses the slot system in line with `CreativeInventoryActionC2SPacket`, many slots have different IDs than normal.


## More Info
More info can be found on our [README](https://github.com/PyPylia/clientgive/blob/main/README.md).

title: ToolNovation
description: The simple and handy mod that allows renovating a broken tool along with its enchantments.
body:
# _**ToolNovation**_

**Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge**

---

**_ToolNovation_** changes how broken gear works in Minecraft. Your tools, weapons and armor **won't disappear** when they hit 0 durability - instead they enter a **broken** state and stay in your inventory until you repair them. This works with **all vanilla and modded gear** automatically, with no custom items to replace what you already use.

## Features

### Broken Gear Stays With You
When a tool, weapon, or piece of armor reaches 0 durability, it doesn't vanish. It becomes **broken** - unusable until repaired, but never lost. Broken armor still provides 25% of its protection (configurable).

### Repair Forge
A dedicated block for restoring broken and damaged gear. Place an item in it together with the matching repair material, and each material restores **25% durability** (up to 4 materials per repair by default - enough for a full restore). The required material is whatever the item normally repairs with, so it works for vanilla and modded gear alike.

By default, broken items can **only** be repaired at the Repair Forge - anvil and grindstone repair are blocked so the broken mechanic can't be bypassed. You can re-enable vanilla repair in the config if you prefer.

### Enchantments
Five enchantments, each with a real trade-off:

- **Eternal Binding** - preserves all enchantments through a repair. Without it, repairing a broken item strips its enchantments. The enchantment shatters when used, so plan ahead.
- **Vampire's Touch** - heals 20% of damage dealt, but doubles durability loss. Incompatible with Mending.
- **Featherweight** - +50% attack speed, but you take 30% more damage while wielding it.
- **Reinforced** - keeps working at 50% power when broken instead of locking up, at the cost of -15% mining speed while intact.
- **Tempered Edge** - +2 attack damage, but the item wears out twice as fast. Incompatible with Mending.

### Charm System
The same effects are also available as **charms** - an alternative way to apply Vampire's Touch, Featherweight, Reinforced and Tempered Edge, each with a clearly listed upside and downside.

### Quality of Life
- **Wear penalty** - worn-out tools (10% durability or less) mine slower, warning you before they break.
- **Break feedback** - an action-bar message and particles when an item finally breaks.
- **Advancements** - for breaking and repairing your first item.
- **In-game config** - a settings screen via Cloth Config (optional), with optional Modern UI support for a nicer-looking interface.

## Configuration
Repair % per material, max materials per repair, whether repairs keep enchantments, whether anvil/grindstone repair is blocked, broken-armor protection level, break messages, and the wear-penalty thresholds are all configurable.

## Installation

Drop the JAR into your `mods` folder. Requires:
- **NeoForge** 21+ for Minecraft 1.21.1

Optional:
- **Cloth Config** - adds the in-game settings screen
- **Modern UI** - improves the look of the interface

## License

Apache 2.0

body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f4964491b98538b5019b7d28be1a10d91ad4734.png)


This is a mod that removes The shop and in game purchase features from essentials, only keeping the social features like world hosting and chat.


the mod is fully configurable through the config using cloth config


Dependencies:
[Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
[Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)








# Essential Shop Remover

A client-side NeoForge mod that disables the shop, cosmetics, and emote features from the [Essential mod](https://essential.gg). All features are toggleable via config.

## Features

- **Blocks all purchase flows** -- Cosmetic, emote, bundle, and gift purchases are intercepted and cancelled.
- **Blocks coin purchases** -- Coin bundle purchases and welcome coin claims are prevented.
- **Blocks checkout packets** -- Monetization-related network packets are dropped before they leave the client.
- **Disables cosmetic rendering** -- Shop cosmetics are not rendered on player models.
- **Blocks emote equipping** -- The emote wheel and emote playback are disabled.
- **Removes sale/promo notices** -- Sale banners, cosmetic "new" dots, and promotional toasts are suppressed.
- **Blocks wardrobe nag modals** -- The "unowned items equipped" warning is removed.
- **Coins purchase modal** -- The coin purchase dialog is blocked from opening.
- **Removes menu buttons** -- Essential's buttons are removed from the main menu and pause menu.

## Configuration

All features are controlled via `config/essentialshopremover.json`. Set any option to `false` to re-enable that feature.

```json
{
  "blockCosmetics": true,
  "blockEmotes": true,
  "blockPurchases": true,
  "blockCoins": true,
  "blockCheckoutPackets": true,
  "blockNotices": true,
  "blockWardrobeNag": true,
  "removeMainMenuButtons": true,
  "removePauseMenuButtons": true
}
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `blockCosmetics` | `true` | Disables cosmetic rendering on player models |
| `blockEmotes` | `true` | Blocks the emote wheel and emote playback |
| `blockPurchases` | `true` | Blocks all cosmetic/emote/bundle purchase flows |
| `blockCoins` | `true` | Blocks coin purchases and welcome coin claims |
| `blockCheckoutPackets` | `true` | Drops monetization network packets |
| `blockNotices` | `true` | Removes sale banners, promo toasts, cosmetic dots |
| `blockWardrobeNag` | `true` | Removes the "unowned items" wardrobe warning |
| `removeMainMenuButtons` | `true` | Removes Essential buttons from the title screen |
| `removePauseMenuButtons` | `true` | Removes Essential buttons from the pause menu |

## How It Works

This mod uses [SpongePowered Mixin](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin) to intercept Essential's methods at runtime. It does **not** modify Essential's JAR file or redistribute any Essential code. All changes are local and client-side only.

## Keybinds

Essential's keybinds (Wardrobe, Emote Wheel, Toggle Cosmetics, etc.) still appear in the Controls menu but have no effect when the corresponding feature is blocked. You can safely unbind them in Minecraft's Controls settings if desired.

## Dependencies

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x
- [Essential mod](https://essential.gg) (required at runtime)

## Legal Disclaimer

### Essential Mod

Essential is a closed-source mod by Spark Universe / ModCore Inc. This mod does **not**:
- Include, bundle, or redistribute Essential's code, assets, or JAR
- Modify Essential's JAR file
- Access or alter Essential's servers or account data
- Forge purchases or bypass account entitlements

This mod interacts with Essential solely through Mixin, a standard Minecraft modding mechanism that intercepts method calls at runtime. All modifications are local and client-side. This approach is consistent with standard Minecraft modding practices and fair use principles. No Essential intellectual property is reproduced or distributed.

Corroxin’s Optimizations is a PvP-focused performance modpack built to maximize FPS, reduce input delay, and deliver the smoothest possible Minecraft experience.
It combines essential optimization and visual enhancement mods to improve overall responsiveness, reduce stuttering, and create smoother combat gameplay.
This modpack is currently in active development, which means frequent updates, ongoing improvements, and occasional fixes as new optimizations are added.
Whether you're playing competitive PvP or simply want better performance, Corroxin’s Optimizations is designed to make Minecraft feel faster, smoother, and more responsive.

Here is a quick rundown of a few features.
- Animation, visual, sound and mod customizations (Edit animations, visuals, sounds how you like)

- HUD settings (Customize your HUD how you like)

# ⚡ Key Features
- 🚀 Insane fps boost
- 💻 Works with any launcher
- 🌐 Stable in single/multiplayer
- 💡 Extra ingame settings

1. Download the .mrpack from Modrinth
2. Convert it to .zip using: [Conventer 1](https://jamie.codeberg.page/mrpack-to-zip/) or [Converter 2](https://fabulously-optimized.github.io/mrpack-to-zip/)
3. Install the required loader in your launcher (Fabric)
4. Open the .zip archive (which you downloaded earlier) and copy everything inside (mods and config) into your created instance folder
  
###   **⭐ Recommended**
  
   Use **Modrinth Launcher** since its the easiest to use, highly recommended!

This modpack will be allways for free, this modpack is still in early development so there still might be bugs, ill be updating and fixing this modpack everyday!

<details>
<summary>Is it allowed on servers?
</summary>

Yes, it is allowed on most major servers, including PvPClub and MineMen. However, please check your specific server's rules before joining, as some strict networks may prohibit certain optimization or PvP modifications.


</details>






<details>
<summary>Will more mods be added?</summary>

Yes. New modifications will be added over time. Conversely, some current mods may be removed in future updates to resolve incompatibilities or performance issues.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Will your modpack be only on Fabric?</summary>

Yes. Recreating the modpack for other loaders would require a significant amount of time. Since these modifications are natively built for Fabric, you will experience optimal performance. Fabric is highly recommended for this setup.

</details>



<details>
<summary>Will you develop your modpack on CurseForge or somewhere else?</summary>

Most likely, no. I will definitely never develop my modpack on CurseForge and abandoned it because of the stupid moderation system that does not allow adding mods from other sites, requires a moderator to check every action and imposes a bunch of other useless restrictions. I do not want to spend so much time reworking my modpack for CurseForge, because users end up downloading mods separately. 

</details>


<details>
<summary>Are there/will there be mods that everyone needs (like iris)</summary>


Not in this specific release. This pack focuses strictly on core optimization, PvP performance, and resource pack compatibility. Features like Iris shaders can significantly lower your FPS. To provide the best experience, I will be releasing two distinct versions: one for pure game optimization, and another combining PvP enhancements with performance tweaks.

title: Pipes
description: pipes for transferring items. fully configurable, nice visuals
body:
# Pipes

Pipes for transferring items between containers.

![Some pipes in a factory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/Pipes/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/demo-1.png)

# Features

Pipes transfer items from a container to other containers, or spit them out like a dropper.

**Regular Pipes** pull items from the container behind them and push items forward. They face away from the block you place them against.

**Corner Pipes** only relay items - they don't pull. Use them to change the direction of item flow. They face toward the block you place them against.

Pipes can be chained together to create complex item transport networks.

Pipes come in different material variants (oxidized copper, copper, iron, gold) that affect transfer speed and visual appearance. Textures, variants, crafting recipes, and transfer settings are all configurable.

![Various pipe materials and variants.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/Pipes/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/demo-2.png)

## Crafting

|                     Regular Pipe                      |                         Corner Pipe                         |
| :---------------------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------: |
| ![Regular Pipe Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/Pipes/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting_pipe.png) | ![Corner Pipe Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/def9a2a4/Pipes/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/crafting_corner_pipe.png) |

Other pipe variants are crafted with their respective ingots. Oxidized copper pipes are made by throwing regular copper pipes into water cauldrons, or by crafting with a water bucket. Recipes are fully configurable.


## Commands

| Command                 | Description                       | Permission         |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| `/pipes give <variant>` | Give a pipe item                  | `pipes.give`       |
| `/pipes reload`         | Reload configuration              | `pipes.reload`     |
| `/pipes recipes`        | Unlock all pipe recipes           | `pipes.recipes`    |
| `/pipes info`           | Info about currently loaded pipes | `pipes.info`       |
| `/pipes delete_all`     | Delete all pipes **(dangerous)**  | `pipes.delete_all` |
| `/pipes cleanup`        | (debug) Remove orphaned entities  | `pipes.cleanup`    |

## Configuration

The plugin is configured via `config.yml`. Each pipe variant can have custom settings:

```yaml
variants:
  copper_pipe:
    behavior: REGULAR
    display-name: "Copper Pipe"
    texture-set: copper
    transfer:
      interval-ticks: 10    # Transfer every 0.5 seconds
      items-per-transfer: 1 # Move 1 item at a time
```

title: Id Ban Mod
description: This Mod Allows Server Owners to ban Client Sided Mods Fully Server Sided
body:
### Introduction
IdBan is a server-side moderation mod for Minecraft that detects and blocks specific client-side mods by identifying their translation keys.

It allows server owners to enforce mod restrictions without requiring client installation or intrusive scanning — detection is performed using built-in game UI translation behavior.

### Features:-

- Detects client-side mods using translation key probing

- Automatically kicks players running disallowed mods

- Fully configurable detection and ban system

- Supports mod ID bans, keyword detection, and translation probes

- Works with any mod that has custom translations

- Server-side only (no client install required)


### How It Works

Minecraft allows UI text (chat, signs, bossbars, item names, etc.) to be defined using: Translation keys Keybind placeholders The client replaces these placeholders with localized or configured values before sending data back to the server. Detection Method The server sends the player an interface element (such as a sign or anvil rename field) containing a translation key.

Example: `sodium.option_impact.low`

If the player has the corresponding mod installed:

`sodium.option_impact.low → Low`

If the mod is not installed:

`sodium.option_impact.low` → `sodium.option_impact.low`

By checking whether the placeholder was replaced, the server can determine whether the mod exists on the client.

This works because:

- Mods register their own translation keys
- The client automatically resolves them
- The server receives the resolved value

description: VillagerShop is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets server admins create a custom player shop using Minecraft's native villager trade UI.
body:
**VillagerShop** is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets server admins create a custom player shop using Minecraft's native villager trade UI — no economy plugin required.

Players open the shop with `/shop` and browse trades in a familiar, vanilla-style merchant interface. Admins manage trades in-game through intuitive chest GUIs: `/vs create` opens a trade builder where you drag items into input/output slots and confirm, and `/vs delete` opens a paginated list of all trades with one-click removal. All trades persist across restarts via YAML.

**Features:**
- Vanilla merchant GUI — no custom UI, feels completely native
- In-game trade creation and deletion — no config file editing required
- Paginated delete GUI for easy trade management
- Permission-gated admin commands (`villagershop.admin`) — LuckPerms compatible
- Smart tab completion — only shows subcommands to admins
- Physical items only — no economy plugin dependency
- Trades never lock or expire (`maxUses = unlimited`, discounts disabled)

**Commands:**
- `/shop` — open the shop (all players)
- `/vs create` — add a trade
- `/vs delete` — remove a trade
- `/vs info` — command help

**Requirements:** Paper 1.21.4+

title: NewSuperWoodenSword
description: This is destructive effect mod,added some items and commands that may not suitable for generation and use.
body:
# English
This Mod is an artifact mod.This mod does not have a composition table, and the weapons inside are very excessive and not suitable for generation and use. The weapon inside is very high damage, can kill almost any creature what you want to kill. This weapon also has a disarming weapon, which, as the name suggests, once in your hands you can't throw away,and other mods can't modify the weapons,too,it won't be cleared in the inventory.
There are weapons, cool fonts, right click kills, cool colored lightning in this mod.
There are some useful commands too:

1. /super-kill <target(s)>

This command will kill entities through the code inside the weapons that this mod provided,and not use the weapons itself.



2.zero-player-items <player(s)>

This command will drop player(s)'s inventory(s) through the code inside the weapons that this mod provided,and not use the weapons itself.



3.sws-lighting (enable|rainbow <value>:alpha)

This command can set whether the weapons if summon lighting bolts or not and if enable the rainbow effect for lighting bolts.

This command can set the lighting bolts's render alpha when the rainbow effect is enabled.



4.sws-clear-mode (true|false|toggle)

This command can set whether the weapons enables the clear mode or not.

When the clear mode was enabled,the weapons' lighting bolts won't be summoned, and all the entities what were attacked by the weapons will cast to the dead (living) entity,the worlds will be casted to the clear world that all entities without the weapons thiat this mod provided will be removed.



5.sws-clear-debug

This command is used for debugging.

This command will force send clear signal to all the players and cast the client and server worlds to the clear world that all entities without the weapons thiat this mod provided will be removed.



6.sws-item-hue

(item_hue_enable|item_hue_base|item_hue_step|item_hue_offsetX|item_hue_offsetY|item_hue_saturation) (value)

Notice: This command is CLIENT SIDE ONLY.

This command can set whether the weapons' deseribe enables the custom font or not and some configuration about the font's render.



# 简体中文
此模组为一件神器模组。此模组没有合成表，其中的武器数量过多，不适合生成和使用。内部的武器威力极高，几乎可以杀死任何你想要击杀的生物。此外，该武器还配备有防缴械功能，顾名思义，一旦握在手中就无法丢弃，而且其他模组也无法修改这些武器，也不会从物品栏中清除掉。
此模组中有武器、酷炫的字体、右键攻击、酷炫的彩色闪电。
此外还有一些有用的指令：

1. /super-kill <target(s)>

此指令将通过本模组所提供的武器内部的代码来摧毁实体，而非直接使用这些武器本身。



2.zero-player-item <players（s）>

此指令会通过本模组所提供的武器内部的代码来删除玩家的装备栏内容，而非直接使用这些武器本身。



3.sws-lighting（enable|rainbow <value>：alpha）

此命令可以设定是否让武器发射闪电，以及是否开启闪电的彩虹效果。

此命令可在彩虹效果启用时设置光柱的渲染透明度。



4.sws-clear-mode（true|false|toggle）

此命令可设置武器是否启用清除模式。

当清除模式启用时，武器的闪电将不会被召唤，所有被武器攻击的实体将被转换为死亡（存活的）实体，世界将转换为清除世界，即所有未使用此模组提供的武器的实体都将被移除。



5.sws-clear-debug

此命令用于调试。

此命令会强制向所有玩家发送清除信号，并将客户端和服务器世界转换为清除世界，即所有未使用此模组提供的武器的实体都将被移除。



6.sws-item-hue
（item_hue_enable|item_hue_base|item_hue_step|item_hue_offsetX|item_hue_offsetY|item_hue_saturation）（value）

注意：此命令仅限客户端使用。

此命令可决定武器描述中是否启用自定义字体，以及有关字体显示的一些设置。

description: This is the perfect low end modpack for people who both want the vanilla vibe but still able to PvP

## What is this modpack?
This modpack is for **VERY low end PCs**, and people who want to play **both survival and PvP**. It maintains the PvP Advantages (That i know of), and still has the vanilla feel that we all know and love.

## Why did I make this pack?
I made this pack because, as a low end minecraft player, i feel like it took too long to look for mods, so this pack can act like a base that you can put mods on.

## Why use this modpack?
Other modpacks like [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), and [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) optimize your minecraft by allocating computer resources to minecraft, meaning lower end pcs end up using too much resources and not leaving enough for other apps and possibly crashing your pc all together. This modpack optimizes the game while still keeping your device running with resources remaining, making it much better for low end PCs and Laptops.

## Features
### PvP
-Crosshair Indicator
-Totem Counter
-Armor Hud

### Survival

title: ChunkLoaders
description: A simple Chunk Loader datapack
body:
# ChunkLoaders
A simple datapack that creates a **chunk loader** when an **Ender Eye** is dropped onto a **Waxed Oxidized Copper Bulb**.

![Chunk Loader](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7490e527ca8341fd2c3c138e311a2a9a764d6673_0.webp)

## Features
* Drop an **Ender Eye** onto a **Waxed Oxidized Copper Bulb** to create a chunk loader.
* Toggle the chunk loader **on/off** by toggeling the copper bulb.

## How It Works
* Internally uses the `/forceload` command to keep chunks loaded.
* Check loaded chunks with `/forceload query`


## Credits
* Based on the original **Chunk Loaders** from **Vanilla Tweaks**.
* Vanilla Tweaks website: [https://vanillatweaks.net](https://vanillatweaks.net/)

title: Venturecraft
description: Get ready for a new Adventure!
body:
# Welcome to Venturecraft!
**Are you ready for a new adventure?**

> This has been a passion project of mine on and off for a while. With over 230 mods, handpicked, configured, and tested to create a cohesive modded experience. I aim to expand upon almost every part of the game, with my main focus on exploration and building, while keeping with the spirit of Minecraft. Hopefully this pack will be a great start to many modded Minecraft adventures!

**Worldgen:**
> See the sights with countless biomes spread across overhauled terrain, and discover forgotten ruins and grand structures on your travels.

**Ambience & Visuals:**
> Immerse yourself in your surroundings with ambient particles, sounds, and visual effects, including shader options ([BSL](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders) and [Complimentary](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)) to further enhance your visual experience. Witness the beauty of nature as the seasons pass in this ever changing world.

**Mobs:**
> Meet all kinds of new and exciting creatures. Study wild animals in their habitats, make helpful friends to join in your travels, and challenge dangerous foes for experience and loot.

**Combat:**
> Find your combat style with various weapons, tools, and enchantments with fun mechanics.

**Items:**
> Craft useful new tools and items to aid in your adventures. From survival essentials like backpacks and sleeping bags, to specialized adventuring gear like gliders and grapple hooks, you're bound to find something to suit your needs.

**Blocks:**
> Build and decorate your bases with a stylish selection of blocks. Whether you're looking for more wood types in a wide array of colors, more stone variants and more complete blocksets, or small decorative and functional details, you'll surely find something to inspire you!

**And so much more!**


<details>
<summary>Future Plans</summary>

With future updates, I hope to add a more personal touch and make the pack more unique.

- Eventually I might set up a Quests/Advancements/Tips system of some kind to introduce major mechanics and features ingame.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

- You may customize the pack for personal playthroughs and use the pack in videos.
- Links to mods and resource packs can be found under Dependencies for each version on the Versions tab.
- You may need to change your shader settings depending on your device's performance specs. [BSL](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders) has been tuned to have low-medium impact, while [Complimentary](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) has heavier settings enabled.
- Other shaders may not work with the [Nicer Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/nicer-skies) or [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches) mods, so you may need to disable those if you add other shaders.
- Also be sure to change the settings for your shader's clouds and the [Better Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds) mod to fit your preferences.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Thanks</summary>

- Thanks to the developers of every mod, resource, and shader in this pack for making this possible!
- Thanks to me for putting the modpack together.
- Thanks to my brother and my friends for believing in me.
- And thanks to you for reading this far and hopefully trying the pack!

</details>

A good automatic world reset plugin that allows you to automatically reset your worlds

## ✨ Features

| Server Type            | Supported            |

| Paper            | ✅              |

```
# FarmWorldReset Configuration

world-groups:
  farmworld:
    enabled: true
    worlds:
      - "farmworld"
      - "farmworld_nether"
      - "farmworld_the_end"

  resourceworld:
    enabled: false
    worlds:
      - "resource"
      - "resource_nether"
      - "resource_the_end"

reset-schedule:
  timezone: "Europe/Berlin"

  time:
    hour: 4
    minute: 0

  daily: false
  weekly: true
  monthly: false

  day-of-week: 1
  day-of-month: 1

warnings:
  - 60
  - 30
  - 10
  - 5
  - 1

create-backup: true
backup-folder: "farmworld-backups"
max-backups: 5

spawn-after-reset:
  farmworld:
    x: 0
    y: 100
    z: 0
  resourceworld:
    x: 0
    y: 100
    z: 0

world-settings:
  farmworld:
    seed: ""
    environment: "NORMAL"
    generator: ""
  resourceworld:
    seed: ""
    environment: "NORMAL"
    generator: ""

teleport-players-on-reset: true
spawn-world: "world"
restart-server-after-reset: true

messages:

  reset-started: "&e[FarmWorld] &cThe reset is being performed..."
  reset-complete: "&a[FarmWorld] The farm worlds have been successfully reset!"
```

Interpret is a mod that adds announced features and drops to 1.20.1 with new additions.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Nautilus can spawn in groups in Deep Ocean biomes. They can be fed any fish and then saddled to maneuver through water. Holding the jump key with a Nautilus will charge the Nautilus through water. When ridden, the Breath of the Nautilus will freeze the rider's oxygen and increase mining speed underwater. Nautilus Armor can be crafted with Prismarine Shards and a material.

Zautilus are the hostile variant of the Nautilus. They can use a charge attack, deadly in large groups.

Spears have an extra block of reach. Spears deal damage based on the user and the target's velocity.

Broadswords have high damage but attack cooldown. Broadswords can negate a percentage of damage based on their material, decreasing attack cooldown. This allows for high-damage attacks to occur in quick succession.

Shields now block an amount of damage, with base blocking 5 damage.
Buckler - 4, no movement slowdown
Cryst - 6, +2 Armor
Scrapper - 7, +4 Armor

Horse Armor can now be enchanted with all helmet, chestplate, and leggings enchantments, as well as some brand new enchants.
Cliff Step increases the step height of horses. Accelerate disables jumping, exchanged for an unlimited increase in speed per key hold. Wind Walker disables fall damage and decreases gravity, allowing horses to jump in the air.

Horseshoes are a new item that add increased speed to Horses, Donkeys, Mules, Llamas, and Camels when equipped.

Wolf Armor has received new tiers, from Copper and Leather to Netherite.

The Husking Camel attacks all mobs not including its riders, dropping a random item from a target's loot table. They can do a charge attack and damage colliding mobs when ridden.
The Wither Skeleton Horse attacks players in groups of 3 to 4. They can be pacified with Nether Wart. When ridden, they can do a double jump!

Banners can now be attached on Horses, Minecarts, and Boats.

korean ![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/desc.jpg) ## DP-SimplePrefix 플러그인 소개 DP-SimplePrefix는 마인크래프트 서버에서 칭호를 쉽게 관리할 수 있는 플러그인입니다. GUI를 통해 칭호 목록을 직관적으로 확인하고, 간편한 칭호 쿠폰 설정이 가능하며, LuckPerms의 칭호 노드와 연동하여 칭호를 효율적으로 관리할 수 있습니다. ## 플러그인 특징 - **GUI 기반 칭호 목록**: GUI를 통해 쉽게 확인 가능. - **간편한 쿠폰 설정**: 특정 칭호 쿠폰을 간단히 설정 가능. - **LuckPerms 연동**: LuckPerms의 칭호 노드와 연동되어 칭호를 효율적으로 관리 가능. - **기본 칭호 설정**: 모든 플레이어에게 자동으로 부여되는 기본 칭호 설정 가능. - **유저 친화적 명령어**: 플레이어가 칭호를 장착, 해제, 확인할 수 있는 간단한 명령어 제공. ## 의존성 - DPP-Core - LuckPerms - Vault

![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/cmd-perm.jpg) ## 명령어 ### 관리자 명령어 | 명령어 | 설명 | |--------|------| | `/dsp create ` | 새로운 칭호를 생성합니다. | | `/dsp set ` | 채팅에 표시될 칭호를 설정합니다. | | `/dsp delete ` | 지정한 칭호를 삭제합니다. | | `/dsp coupon ` | 지정한 칭호의 쿠폰 아이템을 설정합니다. (칭호 미입력 시 글로벌 쿠폰으로 설정) | | `/dsp givecoupon [username]` | 지정한 플레이어에게 칭호 쿠폰 아이템을 지급합니다. (username 미입력 시 명령어 실행자에게 지급) | | `/dsp default ` | 모든 플레이어에게 부여될 기본 칭호를 설정합니다. | | `/dsp list` | 모든 칭호 목록을 표시합니다. | ### 유저 명령어 | 명령어 | 설명 | |--------|------| | `/dsp equip ` | 지정한 칭호를 장착합니다. | | `/dsp unequip` | 현재 장착된 칭호를 해제합니다. | | `/dsp my` | 자신이 소유한 모든 칭호를 표시합니다. | ## 사용법 예시 - 칭호 생성: `/dsp create VIP` - 채팅 칭호 설정: `/dsp set VIP` - 칭호 삭제: `/dsp delete VIP` - 칭호 쿠폰 설정: `/dsp coupon VIP` - 플레이어에게 쿠폰 지급: `/dsp givecoupon VIP Steve` - 기본 칭호 설정: `/dsp default Member` - 칭호 장착 (유저): `/dsp equip VIP` - 칭호 해제 (유저): `/dsp unequip` - 소유 칭호 확인 (유저): `/dsp my`
english ![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/desc.jpg) ## DP-SimplePrefix Plugin Introduction DP-SimplePrefix is a Minecraft plugin designed to manage prefixes in a server with ease. It provides a user-friendly GUI for prefix management, simple coupon configuration for prefixes, and integration with LuckPerms' prefix nodes for efficient prefix management. ## Plugin Features - **GUI Prefix List**: View prefixes with GUI. - **Coupon Configuration**: Easily set up coupon items for specific prefixes. - **LuckPerms Integration**: Integrates with LuckPerms' prefix nodes for efficient prefix management. - **Default Prefix Support**: Set a default prefix to be automatically assigned to all players. - **Player-Friendly Commands**: Simple commands for players to equip, unequip, or view their prefixes. ## Dependencies - DPP-Core - LuckPerms - Vault

![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/cmd-perm.jpg) ## Commands ### Admin Commands | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/dsp create ` | Creates a new prefix. | | `/dsp set ` | Sets the prefix to be displayed in chat. | | `/dsp delete ` | Deletes a specified prefix. | | `/dsp coupon ` | Sets a coupon item for the specified prefix (if no prefix is provided, sets a global coupon). | | `/dsp givecoupon [username]` | Gives the coupon item for a prefix to a specified player (or the command executor if no username is provided). | | `/dsp default ` | Sets a default prefix to be given to all players. | | `/dsp list` | Lists all available prefixes. | ### Player Commands | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/dsp equip ` | Equips a specified prefix for the player. | | `/dsp unequip` | Unequips the currently active prefix. | | `/dsp my` | Displays all prefixes owned by the player. | ## Usage Examples - Create a prefix: `/dsp create VIP` - Set a chat prefix: `/dsp set VIP` - Delete a prefix: `/dsp delete VIP` - Set a coupon for a prefix: `/dsp coupon VIP` - Give a coupon to a player: `/dsp givecoupon VIP Steve` - Set a default prefix: `/dsp default Member` - Equip a prefix (player): `/dsp equip VIP` - Unequip a prefix (player): `/dsp unequip` - View owned prefixes (player): `/dsp my`


![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/desc_card/screenshot.jpg) ![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/screenshot/DP-SimplePrefix/1.jpg) ![](https://dpnw.site/assets/img/screenshot/DP-SimplePrefix/2.jpg)

title: THE OTHER
description: Overpowered Terrific HBM Effortlessly Reimagined
body:
A revisit to the old but gold, HBM's Nuclear Tech, brought to 1.21.1! Heavy WIP, and probably won't see progress for a while

Explore nuclear physics, play with simulated RBMK reactors, and send nukes on a rocket!

Expect a massive, complicated tech tree, with many machines. 

Be careful with radiation, as you can destroy anything and everything! Items, blocks, and chunks all have their own simulated radiation levels that impact one another. Use decontaminators, Rad-X, and other resources to reduce radiation exposure

To get a guide book, install patchouli, and then in-game, craft the THE OTHER Field Guide!

Find the original mod [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hbms-nuclear-tech-mod).

title: Ashenfall
description: Turning Minecraft into a crazy RPG, where you can upgrade with skills, conquer dungeons, slay bosses and so much more
body:
# ☁️ Ashenfall – A Soulslike Sandbox RPG Modpack

> **No story. No destiny. Only ash—and the strength to rise through it.**

---

## 🧱 Overview

**Ashenfall** transforms Minecraft into a dark, punishing, and immersive RPG experience inspired by soulslike design. There’s no main quest. No hand-holding. Just a world decayed by time—and the relentless grind to survive and grow stronger.

If you’re here for lighthearted adventures, turn back now.  
If you're ready to suffer, adapt, and overcome, *welcome to Ashenfall*.

---

## ⚔️ Features

- **🗡️ Tactical, stamina-based combat**  
  Combat is slow, deliberate, and unforgiving. Learn your timing—or die learning it.

- **🌿 Skill-based progression**  
  No forced classes. Customize your build through deep skill trees and organic growth.

- **🗺️ Exploration that matters**  
  Discover lost fortresses, ancient catacombs, and corrupted lands filled with risk and reward.

- **💀 Challenging enemies & custom bosses**  
  No level-scaling. No mercy. Every fight tests your skill and patience.

- **🔎 Hidden depth, minimal direction**  
  Uncover mechanics, secrets, and systems through exploration and experimentation.

---

## 🛠️ Modpack Focus

Ashenfall leans heavily into:
- Dark fantasy aesthetics
- Soulslike combat and world design
- RPG mechanics with a sandbox structure
- Exploration-driven progression
- Intense atmosphere and immersive gameplay

This modpack is not meant to be easy.  
It's meant to be earned.

---

## 🎮 Installation

1. Install the latest version of [**<Your Chosen Launcher>**].
2. Download **Ashenfall** and import it.
3. Allocate at least **6-8 GB RAM**.
4. Launch. Suffer. Adapt. Ascend.

---

title: RandomCamera

body:
# **Русский**

**Создан по образу и подобию камеры с MineShield с личными изменениями и улучшениями.**

**По всем вопросам обращаться ко мне в [Telegram](https://web.telegram.org/k/#@TerraStadis)**

## Основные функции

### Рандомный режим

- ```/rancam create ID Пример подписи```
  - Создание ракурса
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Только игрок


- ```/rancam delete ID```
  - Удаление ракурса
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam teleport ID```
  - Телепорт к ракурсу
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Только игрок


- ```/rancam list```
  - Список, установленный для рандомного режима. 
  - Все ракурсы в списке, установленном для рандомного режима.  
  - Нужны права ```rancam.list```
  - Только игрок

- ```/rancam mode *```
  - intaractive
    - Стандартный, в котором с камерой могут взаимодействовать другие игроки.
    - Неубиваемая.
    - При её вылете плагин будет искать камеру до тех пор, пока она снова не зайдёт (в консоли будет писаться ```Камера не найдена```)
  - nonIntaractive 
    - Режим, в котором ни сама камера, ни игроки её сдвинуть не смогут.
    - Оставляет режим игры тот, что был при написании команды start.
    - При вылете плагин автоматически завершает работу камеры.

- ```/rancam start Игрок```
  - Превращает игрока в камеру, которая будет телепортироваться по заданным точкам по заданному в конфиге времени
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam stop```
  - Остановить камеру
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


- ```/rancam reload```
  - Перезагружает конфиг (иногда нужно прописать 2 раза)
  - Нужны права ```rancam.rancam```
  - Консоль и игрок


### Ручной режим

- ```/handcam set Игрок```
  - Устанавливает игрока, как камеру, которой можно управлять.
  - Нужны права ```handcam.set```.
  - Консоль и игрок.

- ```/handcam moveTo ID```
  - Телепортирует установленную камеру к указанному ракурсу.
  - Нужны права ```handcam.moveTo```.
  - Консоль и игрок.

- ```/handcam list```
  - Список, установленный для ручного режима.
  - Все ракурсы в списке, установленном для ручного режима.  
  - Только игрок.

## Конфиг
- ```cameraSwitchTime```
  - Измеряется в секундах.
  - По умолчанию 15.

## Списки ракурсов
Основная работа со списками происходит в ```/rancam lists *```:
- ```create <name>``` - создать свой список ракурсов.
- ```delete <name>``` - удалить список ракурсов.
- ```set <CurrentRanCameraList|CurrentHandCameraList> <name>``` - установить список для ручной или рандомной камеры. 

## Советы

У камеры есть такое интересное свойство - вылетать. Возможнно это связано с тем, что камера слишком далеко тепается и сервер это считает нарушением.

Для устранения этого инцидента можете скачать мод [AutoRelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/autorelog) и настройте его, чтобы камера могла переподключаться без надобности вмешательства извне.


Если вы собираетесь сворачивать окно, при этом не завершая стрим, скачайте мод [Borderless Fullscreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/borderless-fullscreen), настроив его, чтобы в полноэкранном режиме окно при переходе в другое приложение не сворачивалось.

Так же для того, чтобы камера не выходила в меню при сворачивании окна нажмите комбинацию клавишь ```F3 + P```


# **English**

**Created in the image and likeness of a MineShield camera with personal changes and improvements.**

**If you have any questions, please contact me at [Telegram](https://web.telegram.org/k/#@TerraStadis)**

## Main functions
### Random mode
- ``/rancam create ID Example title``
  - Creating a camera angle
  - You need the rights ``rancam.rancam``
  - Player only


- ``/rancam delete ID``
  - Deleting the camera angle.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam teleport ID``
  - Teleport to the camera angle.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Player only.


- ``/rancam list``
  - The list set for random mode. 
  - All camera angles are in the list set for random mode.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.list``.
  - Player only.

- ```/rancam mode *```
  - intaractive
    - A standard one in which other players can interact with the camera.
    - Unkillable.
    - When it crashes, the plugin will search for the camera until it logs in again (the console will say ```Camera not found```)
  - nonIntaractive 
    - A mode in which neither the camera itself nor the players can move it.
    - It does not change the game mode at startup.
    - Upon leaving, the plugin automatically shuts down the camera.


- ```/rancam start PLAYER```
  - Turns the player into a camera that will teleport to specified points according to the time specified in the config.
  - Requires the rights ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam stop``
  - Stop the camera.
  - Need the rights of ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Сonsole and player.


- ``/rancam reload``
  - Reloads the config (sometimes you need to register 2 times).
  - Rights are needed ``rancam.rancam``.
  - Console and player.

### Manually mode

- ``/handcam set Player``
  - Sets the player as a camera that can be controlled.
  - You need the rights of ``handcam.set`'.
  - Console and player.

- ``/handcam moveTo ID``
  - Teleports the installed camera to the specified angle.
  - You need the rights of ``handcam.moveTo`'.
  - Console and player.

- ```/handcam list```
  - The list set for manual mode.
  - All camera angles are in the list set for manual mode. 
  - Player only.

## Config
- `cameraSwitchTime`
  - Measured in seconds.
  - Default is 15.

## Lists of camera angles
The main work with lists takes place in ```/rancam lists *```:
- ```create <name>``` - create your own list of camera angles.
- ```delete <name>``` - delete the list of camera angles.
- ```set <CurrentRanCameraList|CurrentHandCameraList> <name>``` - set a list for a manual or random camera.

## Tips

The camera has such an interesting property - disconnect. This may be due to the fact that the camera is moving too far away and the server considers it a violation.

To fix this incident, you can download the [AutoRelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/autorelog) mod and set it up so that the camera can reconnect without the need for outside interference.


If you are going to minimize the window without completing the stream, download the mod [Borderless Fullscreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/borderless-fullscreen), by configuring it so that in fullscreen mode, the window does not collapse when switching to another application.

Also, to prevent the camera from entering the menu when minimizing the window, press the key combination ``F3 + P``

title: NoVoidX
description: NoVoidX is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to enhance player experience by preventing accidental deaths from falling into the void. This plugin automatically teleports players who fall into the void back to a safe location, ensuring their survival
body:
# NoVoidX - No More Void Deaths! NoVoidX is a lightweight and essential Minecraft plugin designed to prevent players from losing their progress to the dreaded void. Say goodbye to frustrating deaths and lost items from accidental falls! This plugin intelligently detects when a player enters the void and safely teleports them back to a configurable, secure location, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience for everyone on your server. ## ✨ Features * **Void Fall Protection:** Automatically teleports players falling into the void to a safe, predefined location. Never lose your precious items to the abyss again! * **Highly Configurable:** Easily customize the teleportation destination, messages, and more via a simple `config.yml` file. Tailor the plugin to perfectly fit your server's needs. * **Lightweight & Efficient:** Designed for minimal server impact, ensuring smooth performance even on busy servers. * **Auto-Update Checker:** Stay up-to-date effortlessly! NoVoidX includes an integrated update checker to notify you of new versions, so you can always run the latest and greatest. * **Simple Reload Command:** Quickly reload the plugin's configuration without needing a server restart, making on-the-fly adjustments a breeze. * **Permission-Based Control:** Granular permissions allow you to control who can use the basic command and who can reload the plugin. * **Intuitive Tab Completion:** Enjoy seamless command usage with intelligent tab completion for `/novoidx` commands. ## 🚀 How it Works When a player falls below a configurable Y-level (typically the void level), NoVoidX springs into action. Instead of plummeting to their demise, the player is instantly teleported to a safe spawn point (configurable to be the world's spawn, their bed spawn, or specific coordinates). ## 🛠️ Configuration NoVoidX is designed to be highly configurable. Here's a snippet of the `config.yml`: ```yaml # NoVoidX Configuration enabled: true # Check update on startup check-update: true worlds: world: enabled: true # Set to false to disable NoVoidX for this world void-threshold: -128 # Y-coordinate threshold for void in the Overworld target-world: world_nether target-y: 512 ration: 8 # Ratio of teleportation to Nether world world_the_end: enabled: true void-threshold: -64 target-world: world target-y: 512 ration: 1 # Ratio of teleportation to Overworld # Duration of blindness effect in seconds after teleportation blindness-duration: 5 # Cooldown in seconds before a player can be teleported again teleport-cooldown: 3 # logging settings log: true # Enable or disable logging ``` ## 📦 Commands & Permissions
Spoiler | Command | Description | Permission | Default | | :--------------- | :--------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------- | :----------- | | `/novoidx` | Displays basic plugin information. | `novoidx.use` | `true` (all) | | `/novoidx reload`| Reloads the plugin's configuration. | `novoidx.reload` | `op` | | | | `novoidx.admin` (inherits) | `op` |
**NoVoidX is the simple yet powerful solution to prevent those frustrating void deaths on your Minecraft server. Install it today and let your players explore without fear of the abyss!** ### Made with 🗿 by SkyX

Legacy Clouds is a simple resource pack that brings back the clouds texture prior to 1.21.6. This resource pack is for you if you want your gameplay to feel more nostalgic!

## Version format
Take this for example: **63.0**

**63** is the latest supported Minecraft's resource pack version. You can view it by looking at [this version.](https://misode.github.io/versions/?id=1.21.6-pre3)

**0** is the patch number where there is an update for the resource pack, but Minecraft's resource pack version doesn't change.

Usually, no matter the resource pack version, the minimum resource pack version will be **62**, equivalent to **25w21a**, the version where the clouds texture was changed.

### What does this mod do?
This mods adds two new potion effects, Stun and Dormant Stun. Only Dormant Stun is accessible without commands, and can be made by brewing a Resin Clump and water bottles in a brewing stand. This Potion of Dormant Stun can also be made into splash potions, lingering potions and tipped arrows.

### How does the stun work?
When an entity has the Dormant Stun effect, and the player who gave the effect looks at that entity they can't move until either the effect wears off or the player looks away. Note that this only works once, if the player looks away they can't be stunned again unless Dormant Stun is applied again.

### Wow, that sounds really cool! How do I get this mod?
The only requirement for this mod is [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), so just download that along with this mod and drop them both in your mods folder.

### Found a bug or want to suggest a feature?
Please head over to the [Github](https://github.com/Spyxar/CreakingPotion/issues) and make an issue.

title: Velocity Sign Link
description: An Open-source Minecraft plugin to send players to other velocity servers with signs. Made by BasisZock
body:
# Velocity Sign Link

A lightweight Paper/Spigot plugin for Velocity that allows players to use signs to connect to other servers.

## Features

- **Save Signs:** Use `/savesign <serverName>` to configure a sign with its target server.
- **Retrieve Sign Data:** Use `/getsign` to read a sign's data.
- **Delete Sign Data:** Use `/deletesign` to remove the configuration from a sign.
- **Cooldown Management:** Use `/signcooldown <milliseconds>` to set a global cooldown for sign usage.
- **Customizable Cooldown Display:** Option in `config.yml` (`display_below_one_second_as_one`) to show cooldowns less than 1 second as "1 second".
- **Conditional "No Data Found" Message:** Control the visibility of the "No Data found for this sign" message using the `VeloSign.nomessage` permission.
- **Database Integration:** Utilizes SQLite to store sign data.
- **Velocity/BungeeCord Integration:** Leverages plugin messaging to send players between servers.

## Installation

1. Download the plugin jar.
2. Place the jar in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart or reload your server.
4. Edit `plugins/VelocitySignLink/config.yml` as needed.

## Configuration

Located in `plugins/VelocitySignLink/config.yml`:

- **`display_below_one_second_as_one`**: (Default: `true`)
  If set to `true`, any cooldown that is less than 1 second (e.g., 0.2, 0.6 seconds) will be displayed to the player as "1 second". If `false`, it will display as "0 seconds".
- **`cooldown`**: (Default: `1000`)
  The cooldown between the usage of a sign.

## Commands

- **/savesign `<serverName>`**
  Saves the target server for the sign you’re looking at. Requires `VeloSign.command.savesign` or `VeloSign.admin`.

- **/getsign**
  Retrieves the data of the sign you are looking at. Requires `VeloSign.command.getsign` or `VeloSign.admin`.

- **/deletesign**
  Deletes the data of the sign you are looking at. Requires `VeloSign.command.deletesign` or `VeloSign.admin`.

- **/signcooldown `<milliseconds>`**
  Sets the global cooldown for sign usage. Requires `VeloSign.command.signcooldown` or `VeloSign.admin`.

## Permissions

- **`VeloSign.use`**
  Allows players to use the signs to teleport. (Default: all/true)
- **`VeloSign.nomessage`**
  Players with this permission will **not** see the "No Data found for this sign" message when interacting with an unconfigured sign. (Default: all/true - message is hidden by default). Revoke this permission from groups/players if you want them to see the message.
- **`VeloSign.bypass.cooldown`**
  Allows players to bypass the sign usage cooldown. (Default: op)
- **`VeloSign.admin`**
  Grants access to all `VeloSign.command.*` permissions. (Default: op)
- **`VeloSign.command.savesign`**
  Permission to use the `/savesign` command. (Default: op)
- **`VeloSign.command.getsign`**
  Permission to use the `/getsign` command. (Default: op)
- **`VeloSign.command.deletesign`**
  Permission to use the `/deletesign` command. (Default: op)
- **`VeloSign.command.signcooldown`**
  Permission to use the `/signcooldown` command. (Default: op)


## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Feel free to fork the project and submit pull requests. 

## License

This project is licensed under the GPL-3.0 License.

## Support

For issues or feature requests, please open an issue on GitHub.

body:
# VelocityTransfer

**VelocityTransfer** is a simple Velocity plugin that adds the `/transfer` command to velocity.

---
### Command

```
/transfer <host:port> [player | local | all]
```

* Transfers the sender to the specified server by default.
* `player`: Transfers the specified player (requires `proxytransfer.others` permission).
* `local`: Transfers all players on the sender’s current server.
* `all`: Transfers all players on the proxy.

---
### Permissions

* `proxytransfer.others` — Required to transfer other players.

---

title: Pebble's Portal Commands
description: A server-side mod that lets you configure your portals to run commands with ease!
body:
## 🌀 Pebbles Portal Commands 🌀

📜 **Command Guide**
Admin commands for creating and managing command portals:

- ``/portal add <name>`` - Begin creating a new portal  
  > 1. Right-click the first corner block  
  > 2. Right-click the second corner block  
  > 3. Add commands using the command below  
  > 4. Finish portal creation  

- ``/portal commands add <command>`` - Add a command to execute when players enter the portal  
  > Example: ``/portal commands add give {player_name} diamond 1``  

- ``/portal finish`` - Complete portal creation  
- ``/portal cancel`` - Cancel current portal creation  
- ``/portal list`` - Show all existing portals  
- ``/portal remove <name>`` - Delete a portal  
- ``/portal reload`` - Reload portals from disk  

💫 **Placeholders**  
- ``{player_name}`` - Replaced with the name of the player who enters the portal  
  > Example: ``say {player_name} has entered the shop portal!``  
  > Result when player "Steve" enters: ``say Steve has entered the shop portal!``  

🔰 **Usage Tips**  
- Portals can include any number of commands  
- You can create portals of any size by selecting corner blocks  
- Commands run with server permission level  
- If you make a mistake, use ``/portal cancel`` and start over  
- Portals are saved automatically and persist after server restart  
- After configuring your portal, you can also navigate to ``config/pebbles-portal-commands/portal`` to edit or delete your portal, then run ``/portal reload`` to load new configuration

# ReActions [![Snapshots](https://github.com/GlowingInk/ReActions/workflows/Java%20CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/GlowingInk/ReActions/actions)

ReActions plugin for Paper is a tool to handle server events. It gives you an ability to check for specific flags, 
and by its results, perform different actions. Syntax is unbelievable simple:
```yaml
EVENT:
  activator:
    condition-check: condition
    flags:
     - FLAG=test
     - ANOTHER_FLAG=test:value
    actions:
     - ACTION=do:something
    reactions:
     - ACTION=do:{something, but if flag wasn't successful}
     - ANOTHER_ACTION=do something else
```

title: McBorder
description: Better use of the border system provided by vanilla. Simultaneously supporting irregular boundaries.
body:
# McBorder Plugin Documentation

# Region

> Command /mb region-edit-mode can switch to region editing mode

## Usage

> In editing mode, simply input in the following format without adding /
> A region is composed of three or more points and can be configured directly in editing mode
> Region files are located in the region folder of the plugin configuration file

- add
  - Loads the current location into the last edited region node
- save
  - Saves the currently edited region as a configuration file. File name: region_id.yml
- exit
  - Exits editing mode
- tp <index>
  - Teleports to a specific node, you can use look to see all node numbers, tp number to teleport to that node
  - Note: it's a shift, teleport based on your own height, fly higher and then teleport, otherwise you might get stuck in a wall
- look
  - View the currently edited region
- region <id>
  - Switches the currently edited region to an existing one, if the specified id doesn't exist, it creates a new one. Remember to save after changes.
- id <id>
  - Sets the id of the currently edited region, affecting the file name
- display <display>
  - Sets the display name of the currently edited region
- weight <weight>
  - Sets the weight of the currently edited region. When regions overlap, the higher weight is considered the player's location
- world <world>
  - Sets the world of the currently edited region
- insert <index>
  - Inserts the current location as a node at a specific position
- flag <key> <value>
  - Adds a flag to the region
- set <index>
  - Set  the current location into region's nodes
- remove <index>
  - Remove the node from region
- clear
  - Clear now region's nodes


## Flags

- check-perm-move
  - Checks if the player has the specified permission within this node value. If not, it will prevent the player from moving within the region
- check-perm-join
  - Checks if the player has the specified permission within this node value. If not, it will prevent the player from moving into this region
- check-perm-tp-move
  - Similar to the above, but it prevents the player from teleporting within this region to another position in this region
- check-perm-tp-join
  - Similar to the above, prevents teleportation into this region
- deny-to
  - Prohibits movement from this region to other specified regions
  - Format: * indicates no movement to any other region, or specific names can be specified
  - Example: deny-to: "A,B,C,D" prohibits movement from this region to regions with IDs A, B, C, D
- deny-tp-to
  - Prohibits teleportation from this region to other regions, same format as deny-to
- deny-move-message
  - Message displayed when movement within the region is blocked
- deny-join-message
  - Message displayed when entry into this region is blocked
- deny-to-message
  - Message displayed when movement from this region to other regions is blocked
- deny-tp-join-message
  - Message displayed when teleportation into this region is blocked
- deny-tp-to-message
  - Message displayed when teleportation from this region to other regions is blocked

# Variables

- %BorderInfo_BorderSize% | Current world border size
- %BorderInfo_BorderCenterX% | X-coordinate of the current world border center
- %BorderInfo_BorderCenterZ% | Z-coordinate of the current world border center
- %BorderInfo_BorderOutDamage% | Damage value beyond the current world border
- %McBorder_Biome% | Biome of the player's current location
- %BorderInfo_Region_In_RegionID% | Returns whether the player is within the specified region name (returns: true/false)
- %BorderInfo_Region_Name% | Returns the display name of the region where the player is currently located

# Permissions

> McBorder.commandName
> {.is-success}

# Commands

- `/McBorder(mb) help`
  - View plugin help
- `/McBorder(mb) setborder <world> <size> [time]`
  - Set the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) setcenter <world> <x> <z>`
  - Set the center point of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) setplayer <player> <size> [time]`
  - Set the border size of the world the player is in and center it
- `/McBorder(mb) setplayerworld <player> [size] [world] [time]`
  - Set the border of the world the player is in, with more optional parameters
- `/McBorder(mb) reborder <world>`
  - Reset the border of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) replayer <player>`
  - Reset the border of the world the specified player is in
- `/McBorder(mb) setwarning <world> <warningDistance> <warningTime> <bufferDistance> <damageAmount>`
  - Set warning distance, warning time, buffer size, and damage amount beyond the border for a world
- `/McBorder(mb) increase <world> <increaseValue>`
  - Increase the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) reduce <world> <reduceValue>`
  - Reduce the size of the world border
- `/McBorder(mb) getcenter <world>`
  - Get the center coordinates of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) getsize <world>`
  - Get the size of the specified world's border
- `/McBorder(mb) rtp <player> <world>`
  - Randomly teleport the specified player within the border of the specified world
- `/McBorder(mb) reload`
  - Reload the plugin
- `/McBorder(mb) upsetting`
  - Update borders via the configuration file
- `/McBorder(mb) region-edit-mode`
  - Enter region editing mode, keywords for region editing can be sent directly during this mode

title: Gales&Storms
description: A mod that adds a variety of weather related features such as Tornadoes, Hail, Walkable clouds and many ways to exploit them for your own use
body:
![Gales&Storms Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24d5fb4e12eb1249094552185b2c99046cc330e7.png)

The Gales&Storms Mod is a project that adds a variety of weather related features to minecraft. It started as a petition to add destructive tornadoes to the game, but I attempted to implement them in a Vanilla friendly way, which lead to a pletora of other features being developed that makes this mod comparable to a small content drop.
# 
# **Tornadoes and Whirlwinds**
Particle effect Whirlwinds and sometimes even sky high tornadoes can spawn naturally in many suitable biomes. They are ablle to capture most types of entities, causing them to spin around in the air until crashing of being dropped. These winds will also be able to destroy and reshape some of the natural terrrain like dirt and sand, and completely strip vegetation off of the map, and as they move they will accumulate debris that will deal damage to anyone that gets hit by it.

If you prefer a less hazardous experience, the mod offers gamerules to make Tornadoes purely cosmetic, without being able to destroy blocks at all and customize if they can catch players, mods or neither. On the other hand the mod also offers options to make Tornadoes destroy basically anything they touch if you rather have something chaotic in your game.

Tornadoes can be escaped using certain items like Enderl Pearls, Rockets with Elytra, Equipping Maces with Density or using a Riptide Trident if there is water in the tornado, which brings us to the next feature...
# 
# **Elemental Types**
Tornadoes will adquire certain properties depending on the type of biome they appear in of the terrain they go over
**Fire Tornadoes**= If a tornado goes over lava, they will burn flamable objects in their path and set captured mobs ablaze
**Chill Tornadoes**= If a tornado appears in a cold enough biome or goes over snow and ice, it will be able to Freeze over water bodies and make players and entities trap feel cold like powdered snow
**Soul Tornadoes**= If a  tornado appears near soul sand it will begin to absorb the souls of the damned and use them to inflict Withering on the captured entities
# 
# **Tornado Prevention**
Bells are now able to detect strong winds nearby, which will cause them to swing frantically and let all players in the area know if there is a Tornado coming to town, by highlighting all mobs in the area that could be affected.
Not just that, we have also added the **Wind Sponge item** which will suck the air out of any incoming tornadoes, allowing you to protect yourself and your home base.

**Hail** has also been added and can occur at any moment during a rain or thunderstorm, it will damage players hit by the ice blocks and ocassionally cover the terrain it lands on with snow. Bells can also detect Hailstorms and warn players, and Mods naturally attempt to flee and take cover from both Hail and Tornadoes

#
# **Winds in a bag**
You can also use a bundle, golden blocks and a wind sponge to craft a Wing Bad, which will absorb wind from tornadoes nearby or from the fumes of furnaces drying up wind sponges. Wind Bags will allow you to summon your very own Tamed Gale, a player friendly, non destructive tornado that is perfect for trapping enemies inside of it.

#
# **Up in the Clouds**
A new structure has also been added, the Perenail Clouds. These are small formations of walkable cloud blocks placed all over the world high in the sky, ocassionally they hide loot in them, the higher they are the better the rewards!. However be careful making your way up, not only can Breezes often spawn in the clouds but the Cloud structures can fill themselves with rain and hail and ocassionally even cause lighting strikes.

**Cloud Blocks** Behave like Scafolding, allowing players to go through them and also up and down them. You could adquire some with shears and use them as you please. You could even use a bottle to adquire a **Bottled Cloud** which will allow you to deploy a temporary rising cloud platform that you can use to push mobs or yourself upwards, of will it with rain and hail to make for localized hazards and traps!.

#
# **Giant Beanstalks**
You can also get a new gift from your friendly sniffer. They might dig out some ancient beans which you can sow and grow like any other crop. But instead of giving you food, once the beans are large enough they will rapidly growh into a massive beanstalk. Beanstalks can be climbed like ladders and  they will often grow leaves on their sides which you can go through and stand on. Landing on a beanstalk leave will negate all fall damage too, making them perfect for climbing up to the Perenial Clouds


#
# **Commands**
/gales castwind tornado
/gales castwind whirlwind
**Modifiers**
- `facing` = storm travels in your look direction
- `stationary` = storm stays in place
- `duration <seconds>` = lifespan
/gales clear winds = remove all active storms
/gales clear clouds = remove all pocket clouds
/gales pocket_cloud = summon a pocket cloud entity       
/gales perennial_cloud = create a perenial cloud strucutre
- add `hail` modifier to weather commands to beign a hail storm

title: PrivacyLock
description: Locks msg, or private messages from being shown in console
body:
**
PrivacyLock: Secure Communication for Your Minecraft Server**

PrivacyLock is a lightweight yet powerful plugin designed to enhance privacy and security on your Minecraft server by preventing private messages from appearing in server console logs. When players use commands like /whisper, /msg, or /tell, the default behavior exposes these private conversations in the console, potentially compromising player privacy.

**Key Features**

🔒 **Enhanced Privacy Protection**


Completely hides sensitive commands from console logs

Works with all standard messaging commands: /msg, /whisper, /tell, /w, /r, /reply

Customizable command list - add any command you want to protect

⚙️** Flexible Configuration**

Easy setup with minimal configuration required

Fully customizable blocked command list

Permission-based bypass system for staff members

Optional admin notifications when protected commands are used

🛡️ **Security-First Approach**

Maintains server security while protecting player privacy

Optional logging system for administrative oversight

Permission-based notification system for staff monitoring

💬 **Seamless User Experience**

No change to gameplay or command behavior for players

Commands function identically - only the logging changes

No performance impact on your server
**
Why Choose PrivacyLock?**

In today's Minecraft servers, player privacy has become increasingly important. Server operators need to balance monitoring for inappropriate behavior while respecting legitimate private conversations. This plugin provides the perfect middle ground - it allows private messaging to remain truly private, while still enabling optional administrative oversight through configurable logging options.

PrivacyLock solves a common issue that many server owners face: how to protect player privacy while maintaining server security. Rather than displaying sensitive messages in console logs that might be viewed by multiple staff members or logged to files, this plugin ensures private communications remain private.

**Installation & Setup**

Download the plugin JAR file and place it in your server's plugins folder

Restart your server or use /reload (full restart recommended)

Configure the plugin by editing the config.yml file

Use /privacylock reload to apply changes

The default configuration works out-of-the-box for most servers, blocking common messaging commands from console display.

**Permissions**

privacylock.admin - Access to plugin commands and configuration

privacylock.bypass - Commands from users with this permission will show in console

privacylock.notify - Receive notifications when protected commands are used

PrivacyLock is perfect for survival servers, roleplay communities, or any Minecraft server where player privacy matters. Give your players the confidence that their private conversations stay private!

title: Complexity Analyzer
description: A powerful framework that calculates the 'true cost' of every item, enabling deep analysis and balancing for complex modpacks.
body:
# 📖 Complexity Analyzer

> A powerful framework that calculates the 'true cost' of every item, enabling deep analysis and balancing for complex modpacks.

**Complexity Analyzer** is not just another utility mod. It's a foundational platform that transforms your Minecraft world's economy from an art into a science. At its core is a sophisticated analytical engine that processes every recipe in your game to calculate an objective "complexity score" for any item, uncovering the most optimal production chains and providing deep economic insights.

### ⚠️ Project Status: Experimental Alpha

This project is currently in a very early and experimental stage of development. Expect bugs, breaking changes, and incomplete features. It is intended for modpack creators, server administrators, and developers who are not afraid of a little instability. **Use at your own risk!**

Your feedback is invaluable. Please report bugs and suggest features on the [Issues](https://github.com/dertex909/Complexity-Analyzer/issues) page.

---

## ✨ Core Features

*   **🧠 Deep Economic Analysis:** A graph-based engine calculates the "true cost" of production for every item.
*   **📊 Powerful In-Game CLI:** A rich set of `/complexity` commands for detailed analysis, crafting tree visualization, and server performance monitoring.
*   **📤 Data Export:** Export all calculated data into **CSV or JSON** for external analysis.
*   **🤖 AI-Powered Assistant (Planned):** An upcoming feature to provide in-game guidance and answer complex economic questions.
*   **⚙️ Developer API (Planned):** A future-proof API will allow other mods to integrate with the analysis engine.

---

## 📚 Documentation

For a detailed guide on all available in-game commands, please see the **[Command Documentation](https://github.com/dertex909/Complexity-Analyzer/blob/main/docs/COMMANDS.md)**.

*(Full API documentation and developer guides will be available in future releases.)*

---

## 🚀 Project's Future & Roadmap

My vision for Complexity Analyzer goes beyond a simple mod. I aim to build a comprehensive, intelligent platform for game analysis. The current roadmap includes:

1.  **Stabilizing the Core Engine:** Bug fixes, performance tuning, and ensuring maximum accuracy.
2.  **Developing a Public API:** Allowing other mod developers to build upon this platform.
3.  **Implementing the AI Assistant:** Integrating a true AI to create an interactive and intelligent in-game experience.

This is an ambitious, long-term project. Contributions and suggestions are always welcome.

---

description: Enhances tipped arrows by adding lingering potion effects when they hit the ground.
body:
**Better Tipped Arrows** improves the behavior of vanilla tipped arrows by making their effects more intuitive and useful.

When a tipped arrow hits the ground, instead of requiring players to shoot entities directly, it releases a **vanilla-style lingering potion cloud** at the impact location.  
The cloud uses the **exact potion, duration, and amplifier** of the arrow, creating a behavior consistent with lingering potions.

### Features :

*   Works with **all vanilla tipped arrows**
*   Spawns a **lingering potion effect cloud on impact**
*   Uses **original potion data** (type, duration, amplifier)
*   Fully **vanilla-balanced behavior**
*   No custom items or arrows added
*   Server-side safe and lightweight

Perfect for support gameplay, tactical combat, and utility effects without awkward self-inflicted shots.

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
