title: Nest's Level System
description:
Nest's Level System is a customizable leveling plugin for Minecraft 1.21+. It rewards players for gameplay.
Requires PlaceholderAPI.
body:
# Nest's Level System

A simple leveling system that rewards players for various in-game activities with fully customizable XP rewards and progression tracking.

## Features

### Key Futures
- level progression with customizable XP requirements
- Player data saving
- Customizable messages with hex color support
- XP gain notifications

### Activity-Based XP Rewards
- **Mining**: Break blocks for XP (diamond, iron, coal, etc.)
- **Building**: Place special blocks like beacons and enchanting tables
- **Smelting**: Get XP for smelting ores and raw materials
- **Combat**: Earn XP for killing mobs and bosses
- **Crafting**: Receive XP for crafting items

### Commands & Permissions
- `/level` - Check your level and progress
- `/level check <player>` - View another player's level
- `/level set <player> <level>` - Set player level (admin)
- `/level reload` - Reload configuration (admin)

### Admin Features
- Modify player levels and XP
- Reload configuration without restart

### Placeholders
- `%levelsystem_level%` - Current player level
- `%levelsystem_xp%` - Current XP amount
- `%levelsystem_xp_needed%` - XP needed for next level
- `%levelsystem_progress%` - Progress percentage
- `%levelsystem_progress_decimal%` - Progress as decimal

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21 or higher
- Spigot, Paper, or compatible server software
- PlaceholderAPI (recommended for placeholders)

## Setup
1. Place the jar in your plugins folder
2. Start your server
3. Configure `config.yml` to your preferences
4. Restart or use `/level reload`

All XP values, messages, and settings are fully customizable through the configuration file.

Players can freely inspect item models within the game. You can view every detail of the item model in detail through the in-game inspection interface.

### Usage

Point the mouse to the corresponding item in the inventory and press the "Open Inspect Screen" key (default as X) to open the inspection screen.

The inspection screen will display the model of the item, which can be rotated by left clicking and dragging, and zoomed in by scrolling.

title: PotionsManager
description: Manage which potions aren't unusable and which cannot be brewed.
body:
# PotionManager

Version: 1.0.0  
Minecraft Version: 1.18+  

---

## Description
**PotionManager** allows server admins to manage which potions cannot be brewed, which cannot be used, and which are completely blocked. The configuration supports three sections: `disabled-brewing`, `disabled-using`, and `disabled-both`.

---

## Installation
1. Place `PotionManager.jar` in your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Start the server to generate the default configuration.
3. Edit `config.yml` to set your disabled potions.
4. Restart the server to apply changes.

---

## Configuration
```yaml
disabled-brewing:
  - HARMING
  - STRONG_HARMING

disabled-using:
  - HEALING
  - STRONG_HEALING

disabled-both:
  - POISON
  - STRONG_POISON

[![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/netwatchz)
[![discord-plural](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://strassburger.org/discord)
[![gitbook](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/documentation/gitbook_vector.svg)](https://docs.zetaplugins.com/netwatchz)

NetwatchZ is a Minecraft plugin for Spigot, Paper, and Velocity that helps protect your server against bots and other malicious activity through IP blocking, geoblocking, and VPN detection.

## Features

- ✅ IP lookup (e.g. Geolite2, ip-api.com)
- ✅ IP blacklists
- ✅ Dynamically fetch IP lists
- ✅ Geoblocking
- ✅ Configure any IP information service
- ✅ Automatically download and refresh Geolite2 database
- ✅ VPN blocking (e.g. vpnapi.io, proxycheck.io)

## Permissions

- `netwatchz.ipinfo` - Get the IP and IP information from a player
- `netwatchz.admin.debug` - Generate debug reports

## Configuration

You can find the configuration files in the plugins/NetwatchZ folder. The main configuration file is config.yml.

<details>
<summary>config.yml</summary>

```yml
#
#    _   _      _                 _       _       ______
#   | \ | |    | |               | |     | |     |___  /
#   |  \| | ___| |___      ____ _| |_ ___| |__      / /
#   | . ` |/ _ \ __\ \ /\ / / _` | __/ __| '_ \    / /
#   | |\  |  __/ |_ \ V  V / (_| | || (__| | | |  / /__
#   |_| \_|\___|\__| \_/\_/ \__,_|\__\___|_| |_| /_____|
#

# Set the language to any code found in the "lang" folder (don't add the .yml extension)
# You can add your own language files. Use https://github.com/ZetaPlugins/NetwatchZ/tree/main/src/main/resources/lang/en-US.yml as a template
# If you want to help translating the plugin, please refer to this article: https://docs.zetaplugins.com/localization
#  | en-US | de-DE |
lang: "en-US"

# If set to true, OP players will always be allowed to join
always_allow_ops: true

ip_list:
  # Enable or disable the IP list feature.
  enabled: true

  # If the mode is "blacklist", the IPs in the lists will be blocked.
  # If the mode is "whitelist", only the IPs in the lists will be allowed.
  mode: "blacklist"

  # Set the list of IPs or CIDR ranges to block or allow.
  # These are files inside the "plugins/NetwatchZ/ipLists" folder.
  lists:
    - "vpn_list.txt"
    # - "another_list.txt"

  fetch_jobs:
    vpn_list:
      # Set the URL to fetch the IP list from.
      url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X4BNet/lists_vpn/refs/heads/main/output/vpn/ipv4.txt"

      # Set the filename to save the fetched list as. This file will be saved in the "plugins/NetwatchZ/ipLists" folder.
      filename: "vpn_list.txt"

      # Set how often the list should be fetched (in hours).
      # The minimum is 1 hour.
      update_interval_hours: 24

    # You can add more fetch jobs here. e.g.
    # another_list:
    #   url: "https://example.com/another_list.txt"
    #   filename: "another_list.txt"
    #   update_interval_hours: 12

geo_blocking:
  # Enable or disable geo-blocking.
  enabled: false

  # Wether or not the following list should be a blacklist or a whitelist.
  # If set to true, the countries in the list will be blocked.
  # If set to false, only the countries not in the list will be blocked.
  blacklist: true

  # Set the list of countries to block or allow.
  # The format of the country code depends on the IP info provider, but usually it is a two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
  # Example: ["US", "CA", "GB"]
  countries: []

ip_info_provider:
  # Set the IP info provider to use.
  # Possible values are:
  # - "ip-api" (https://ip-api.com)
  # - "ipwhois" (https://ipwhois.app)
  # - "geolite2" (MaxMind GeoLite2 databases - recommended)
  # - "custom" (Uses the custom IP info provider defined below)
  provider: "ip-api"

  geolite2:
    # Set the urls to the GeoLite2 databases. These are refreshed automatically every 7 days.
    # These can be links to tar.gz files of the official MaxMind GeoLite2 databases with your license key included or links to your own hosted databases (downloading .mmdb files directly is also supported).
    # You can get a free license key by creating an account on https://www.maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup
    asn_url: "https://download.maxmind.com/app/geoip_download?edition_id=GeoLite2-ASN&license_key=YOUR_KEY&suffix=tar.gz"
    city_url: "https://download.maxmind.com/app/geoip_download?edition_id=GeoLite2-City&license_key=YOUR_KEY&suffix=tar.gz"
    country_url: "https://download.maxmind.com/app/geoip_download?edition_id=GeoLite2-Country&license_key=YOUR_KEY&suffix=tar.gz"

    # Attribution: This product includes GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com

  custom:
    # Set the custom IP info provider URL. It should return a JSON response.
    # Use %ip% as a placeholder for the IP address.
    url: "https://api.example.com/json/%ip%"

    # Set the custom IP info provider headers.
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

    # Set the custom IP info provider query parameters.
    parse_fields:
      # Keys are the data needed. Values are the json keys in the response.
      # If certain data is not provided by the API, you can leave it out.
      country: "country"
      countryCode: "countryCode"
      regionName: "regionName"
      region: "region"
      city: "city"
      lat: "latitude"
      lon: "longitude"
      timezone: "timezone"
      isp: "isp"
      org: "organization"
      asn: "asn"
      ip: "ip"

# The vpn_block settings are for online services that provide information about whether an IP is a VPN or proxy.
# This is independent of the ip_list feature, which can also be used to block VPNs
vpn_block:
  # Enable or disable the VPN blocking feature.
  enabled: false

  # Set the VPN info provider to use.
  # Possible values are:
  # - "vpnapi" (https://vpnapi.io)
  # - "proxycheck" (https://proxycheck.io)
  # - "custom" (Uses the custom VPN info provider defined below)
  provider: "vpnapi"

  # If using vpnapi or proxycheck, set your api key here
  api_key: ""

  custom:
    # Set the custom VPN info provider URL. It should return a JSON response.
    # Use %ip% as a placeholder for the IP address.
    url: "https://api.example.com/vpn/%ip%"

    # Set the custom VPN info provider headers.
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

    # Set the custom VPN info provider query parameters.
    parse_fields:
      # Keys are the data needed. Values are the json keys in the response.
      # If certain data is not provided by the API, you can leave it out.
      vpn: "security.vpn"
      proxy: "security.proxy"
      tor: "security.tor"
      relay: "security.relay"
      hosting: "security.hosting"

  # Set what to do when a certain type of VPN/proxy is detected.
  is_vpn:
    # Wether or not to block the connection if the IP is detected as a VPN.
    block: true

  is_proxy:
    block: false

  is_tor:
    block: true

  is_relay:
    block: false

  is_hosting:
    block: false
```
</details>

## Disclaimer

This plugin supports GeoLite2 for IP geolocation. This product includes GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com. Server owners must download GeoLite2 with their own MaxMind account and license key and configure the download URL in plugin settings. The data is not used for identifying specific households or individuals.


## Support

If you need help with the setup of the plugin, or found a bug, you can join our discord [here](https://strassburger.org/discord).

title: Netherite Upgrade Always There
description: Plugin that spawns Netherite Upgrades in every single Bastion Chest.
body:
# Netherite Upgrade Always There

A simple Minecraft **Purpur/Spigot/Paper plugin** that guarantees at least one **Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template** in every Bastion Remnant chest.  
Perfect if you’re tired of grinding for that 1/7 spawn chance in vanilla.  

## ✨ Features
- 100% chance of Netherite Upgrade spawning in every Bastion chest  
- Works alongside vanilla loot (does not replace existing items)  
- Lightweight and optimized  

## 📦 Installation
1. Download the latest JAR file from this project.
2. Drop the JAR into your server’s `plugins/` folder.  
3. Restart or reload the server.  

## 🔧 Requirements
- Minecraft **1.21.1+** (Purpur/Spigot/Paper)  
- Java **21** or higher  
- Maven (for building from source)  

## 🛠️ Building from Source
1. Clone the repo:  
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/yourname/netherite-upgrade-always-there.git
   cd netherite-upgrade-always-there
   ```
2. Build with Maven:  
   ```bash
   mvn clean package
   ```
3. The plugin JAR will be inside:  
   ```
   target/NetheriteUpgradeAlwaysThere-x.x.x.jar
   ```

## 🎮 Usage
- Load into your world and locate a Bastion Remnant.  
- Every chest will now **always** contain a Netherite Upgrade.  
- Loot normally and enjoy your fast-track to Netherite gear.

title: Create Better Bars
description: This resource pack offsets the texture of the andesite and copper bars. This makes them more in line with standard Minecraft and look better in my opinion.
body:
So I was playing Create, and wondered: Why are the bar textures split down the middle, instead of having a single block like glass panes. This is especially obvious if you look at the supporting pillars.

![Screenshot of the old bars compared to the glass pane.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/680e4bb5df3d07fc3bbeb45a17dc2fed835d5b54.png)

I assume they just copied the iron bar texture, but that one is fine with being offset, since it's quite asymmetrical.

So I decided to make this super simple resourcepack to fix this! 

![Screenshot of the fixed bars.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f900e842bd3875a98ddfd83a1a70e9328a23d27d.png)

I just offset the copper bar item texture 8 pixels to the right, and slightly edited the andesite bar texture to add 2 pillars, instead of 1. This won't change **anything** with the textures or model on the block.

This does mean that this resource pack doesn't interact nicely with other resource packs that edit the bar texture/model, but it shouldn't break anything, just override/be overridden by other packs. I might add a second version that changes the copper bar into having the old Create Copper Style, and will edit this if I do.

title: Acid Rain
description: Adds acid rain/water damage to the game, affecting players caught in the rain or submerged in water.
body:
# Acid Rain

This mod is very simple and intended for events or survival. It adds acid rain/water damage to the game, affecting players caught in the rain or submerged in water. It's designed to add a survival challenge, making weather and water sources more dangerous.

## Features

*   **Acid Rain/Water Damage:** Players take damage when exposed to rain or submerged in water.
    *   **Player Only:** The acid rain only affects players.
    *   **Configurable Damage:** The damage amount and interval are configurable via commands.
    *   **Difficulty Scaling:**  The damage scales with the world difficulty just like damage from mobs.
    *   **Bypasses Armor:** Armor is ignored when calculating damage (but protection enchantments still apply).
    *   **No Knockback:** The damage does not cause knockback.
    *   **Small Exhaustion:** Applies a small amount of exhaustion (0.1 hunger) with each damage tick.
    *   **No Damage Tick Bypass:** The damage bypasses the `noDamageTicks` mechanic, ensuring consistent damage application, even if the player is already taking other forms of damage (like fire).

## Commands

The mod includes commands to control the acid rain effect. These commands require operator (OP) permissions (permission level 2 or higher).

*   `/acid on [interval] [damage]` : Enables acid rain/water damage.
    *   `interval`:  The interval in ticks between each damage application (default is 10 ticks, or 0.5 seconds). Must be an integer of 1 or greater.
    *   `damage`: The amount of damage dealt each interval (default is 1.0, or 0.5 hearts). Must be a float of 0.0 or greater.
    *   Example: `/acid on 20 0.5` enables acid rain, dealing 0.5 damage every 20 ticks (1 second).
    *   If `interval` and `damage` are omitted, the default values are used.
*   `/acid off`: Disables acid rain/water damage.
*   `/acid status`:  Displays the current status of the acid rain (enabled/disabled), the damage amount, and the damage interval.

## Configuration

The mod offers in-game configuration via commands:

*   **Damage Interval:**  Adjust the frequency of damage application.  A smaller interval means more frequent damage.
*   **Damage Amount:** Control the severity of the acid rain.

## Technical Details

*   **Mod ID:** `Acid Rain`
*   **Damage Interval:**  The `damageIntervalTicks` variable determines how often damage is applied. By default, it's set to 10 ticks (0.5 seconds).
*   **Damage Amount:** The `damageAmount` variable determines the base damage applied.
*   **Tick Handler:** The mod registers a `ServerTickEvents.END_SERVER_TICK` handler that processes all players in all loaded server worlds every tick.
*   **Custom Damage Type:** Uses it's own damage type.

## Installation

1.  Make sure you have the Fabric Loader installed.
2.  Download the latest version of the Acid Rain mod from Modrinth.
3.  Place the downloaded `.jar` file into your Minecraft's `mods` folder.

## Planned Features/Future Development

*   [ ] Config file for setting default damage and interval.
*   [ ] Add a custom effect or particle effect to indicate the acid rain/water.
*   [ ] Add config to make it affect mobs.
*   [ ] Add config to make it only affect rain and not water.
*   [ ] Translations
*   [ ] More than one random death message
*   [ ] Per-world acid rain toggling
*   [ ] Persistence (worlds/server remembers worlds with acid rain on/off)

This modpack aims to enhance your gameplay experience and streamline your video production process. With an array of essential tools and features, *Alkaline* empowers you to engage your audience like never before, turning every session into a captivating adventure.

[![Modrinth](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/raw/2dc967fc44dc73850eee42c133a55c8ffc5e30cb/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/alkaline)

[![FabricMC](https://github.com/intergrav/devins-badges/raw/2dc967fc44dc73850eee42c133a55c8ffc5e30cb/assets/compact/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://fabricmc.net)

## Key Features

### HUD and Gameplay Enhancements
- **Better Mount HUD:** This mod improves the HUD while riding mounts, displaying vital information like speed and health. For streamers, this means less distraction from gameplay and more focus on delivering an engaging narrative, ensuring viewers never miss key moments during adventures.

- **Better Third Person:** Perfect for capturing stunning visuals, this mod enhances the third-person camera view, allowing creators to showcase their character and surroundings in a cinematic way. Whether filming epic battles or breathtaking landscapes, the improved angles help deliver a more immersive experience for viewers.

- **BetterF3:** Transform the standard debug HUD into a highly customizable, human-readable interface. This mod provides creators with essential information at a glance, reducing clutter and enhancing the overall viewing experience. It allows streamers to focus more on gameplay rather than interpreting complex data.

- **Gamma Utils (Fullbright):** Illuminate dark areas in the game with full brightness and night vision options. This feature helps creators explore caves and dungeons without losing visibility, ensuring that all exciting moments are clearly captured and presented in their videos.

### Performance Optimization
- **Sodium:** As the fastest rendering optimization mod available, Sodium dramatically improves frame rates and reduces lag. This allows creators to record smooth, uninterrupted gameplay, which is crucial for producing high-quality content that keeps viewers engaged.

- **Lithium:** This optimization mod enhances game logic and server performance without compromising gameplay. For streamers, this ensures that their sessions run seamlessly, minimizing technical hiccups that could disrupt live streams or recordings.

- **Krypton:** By optimizing the networking stack, Krypton reduces latency and improves connectivity. This is especially beneficial for multiplayer content, where a smooth connection enhances the overall experience for both creators and viewers, facilitating better collaboration and engagement.

- **ModernFix:** A comprehensive performance improvement mod that reduces memory usage and fixes bugs. It ensures a stable gameplay experience, allowing creators to focus on delivering entertaining content without worrying about crashes or slowdowns.

### Video Creation Tools
- **Flashback:** Capture and replay gameplay sessions effortlessly. This mod allows creators to highlight key moments or create cinematic sequences, enriching their storytelling capabilities and making it easier to craft engaging narratives.

- **Iris Shaders:** Transform Minecraft's visuals with stunning shader effects. High-quality graphics not only attract viewers but also help create a more immersive experience, making content more appealing and engaging.

- **Chunks Fade In:** Add smooth fade-in animations for loading chunks, enhancing the visual flow of your videos. This feature provides a polished look, ensuring that transitions feel seamless and professional, keeping viewers captivated.

### Community Engagement

#### Communication
- **Chat Animation [Smooth Chat]:** Engage your audience with chat messages that appear with smooth animations. This dynamic presentation keeps viewers interested and involved in the conversation, making streams more interactive and lively.

- **Simple Voice Chat:** Foster real-time communication with friends and fellow creators. This mod enhances collaboration during gameplay, allowing for richer interactions and creating memorable moments that viewers will love.

#### World Management
- **Cherished Worlds:** Easily bookmark and organize favorite worlds for quick access. This feature allows creators to switch seamlessly between projects, making it easy to showcase different builds or gameplay styles during streams.

- **World Host:** Host your singleplayer worlds online effortlessly, allowing friends or audiences to join without the hassle of server setups. This feature makes it simple for creators to share their adventures, fostering community engagement.

### Customization and Control

#### Configuration Tools
- **Cloth Config API:** This user-friendly library enables creators to customize their mod settings easily. Tailoring the gameplay experience ensures that each session meets specific content needs, allowing for greater creativity and flexibility.

- **Mod Menu:** Quickly access and manage installed mods with an intuitive menu. This allows creators to enable or disable features on the fly, ensuring their gameplay aligns with their current content objectives.

#### Building Tools

- **Axiom:** This all-in-one tool for editing Minecraft worlds is perfect for content creators looking to enhance their building experience. Axiom allows for precise edits, enabling you to quickly modify terrain and structures without the hassle, which is essential for showcasing creative projects in videos.

- **WorldEdit:** A powerful in-game map editor that provides an extensive range of features, including selections, schematics, copy and paste, brushes, and scripting. Whether you're in creative mode or temporarily using it in survival, WorldEdit makes it easy to bring your visions to life. Streamers can use this tool to create impressive builds on-the-fly, captivating their audience with rapid transformations and unique designs.

### Additional Features
- **Capes:** Personalize your character with stylish capes from various mods, adding a unique flair to your gameplay. This not only enhances your character's appearance but also makes your content visually distinctive and memorable.

- **No Chat Reports:** Enjoy a more private chat experience, keeping conversations unreportable (where possible). This encourages open dialogue and interaction among viewers and streamers, fostering a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

## Conclusion
Incorporating mods into your Minecraft gameplay not only enhances your experience but also significantly boosts the quality of your content. With improved visuals, streamlined mechanics, and community engagement tools, *Alkaline* provides everything you need to create, inspire, and captivate your audience. Embrace the power of mods and transform your Minecraft content creation today!

title: Box Packer
description: Box Packer / Chest Transporter for Vanilla Minecraft - Move your items as if you were using a "Shulker Box" or a "dolly" in a balanced way for the early game.
body:
# Box Packer: A Chest Transporter DataPack for Vanilla Minecraft – Simplify Your Inventory Management!
Looking for an easy and balanced way to transport your chests and barrels in Vanilla Minecraft? Introducing Box Packer, designed to enhance your gameplay experience with a simple yet powerful tool.
## What Does It Do?
The concept is straightforward:
- Craft you **Box Packer**!
- (Shift) Right-click a chest or barrel to pack it.
- Move it to your desired location.
- Unpack it with all the items intact!

It’s like a Shulker Box, but specifically designed for the early game. Unlike them, the Box Packer has durability, making it a balanced and practical solution for inventory management.

## Why Use This DataPack?
Minecraft players have long faced challenges with inventory management. This DataPack brings a widely loved modding community concept to Vanilla Minecraft, using only commands.
- Balanced Gameplay: Adds durability to the transporter, ensuring it’s not overpowered.
- Fun and Practical: Easily move your chests and barrels without losing items.
- Compatible with Other DataPacks: No conflicts (as far as I know!).

Trivia: This was my first Data Pack on early 2021, hope you enjoy it!

title: Schrodingers Chest
description: A Minecraft mod that adds not Schrödinger's Cat, but Schrödinger's Chest!
body:
# Schrödinger's Chest  

Inspired by Schrödinger's famous thought experiment, this mod asks one crucial question:  
*Why settle for Schrödinger's Cat when you can have Schrödinger's Chest?*  

Made for **Minecraft 1.21.1** & **Fabric Mod Loader**. 

---

## 📦 Features  

This mod is packed with quantum-inspired madness:  
-  **Schrödinger's Staff**: A powerful tool to manipulate loot and defy certainty.  
-  **Relic Item**: A mysterious resource to craft unique gear and surprises.  
-  **3 New Weapons/Tools**: Each comes with a twist—what material are they even made of?!  
-  **Schrödinger's Breakfast**: A surprise-packed meal with 10 random effects.  
-  **Custom Textures**: Every new item comes with its own custom design!  

---

## Schrödinger's Staff  

The **Schrödinger's Staff** is the ultimate tool for quantum chaos:  
- **Right-Click a unlooted Structure Chest**: Change its loot while keeping its loot table.  
- **Right-Click a Trapped Chest with One Item**: Replace it with a random item (surprise!).  
- Use it to obtain a **Relic Item**—but beware, it might cause some unexpected damage...  

---

## Relic Item  

The **Relic Item** is your key to crafting quantum gear:  
- **How to Obtain**: Use the **Schrödinger's Staff** on chests.  
- **What to Do With It**:  
  - Craft 3 mysterious new weapons or tools: the **Relic Axe**, **Relic Pickaxe**, and **Relic Sword**.  
  - Or... make yourself a chaotic breakfast treat!  

---

## Relic Weapons & Tools  

Think you know your gear? Think again. Schrödinger's tools and weapons keep you guessing until you use them!  
- **Weapons Included**: Relic Axe, Relic Pickaxe, and Relic Sword.  
  
### How They Work:  
- When you hit an entity, the weapon "decides" its material.  
- **Example**: Craft a Relic Sword → hit a zombie → congrats, you now have... a wooden sword? Or maybe it's made of diamonds?!  

---

## Schrödinger's Breakfast  

Feeling adventurous? Try **Schrödinger's Breakfast**, the ultimate quantum cuisine!  
- **How It Works**:  
  - Right-click to eat.  
  - Get one of **10 random effects** ranging from poison to speed. Deliciously unpredictable!  

---

title: Balanced Stack Sizes
description: Rebalance item stack sizes in Minecraft. Part of the Balanced Minecraft project.
body:
## Balanced Stack Sizes **Balanced Stack Sizes** allows configurable changes to the maximum stack size of items. This mod will not change anything by default - you must set the config (see below). A pre-made config file is available to download alongside each version which affects various bulk items, and items whose stack size is too small. This configuration aims to increase stack sizes in a balanced way to combat the inventory space issue. ## Configuration The mod's config is located at `balancedstacksizes.json5`
`stackSizes`: A map of item identifiers or tags to their maximum stack size (max 2,147,483,646) **Example Config:** ``` { "stackSizes": { "minecraft:dirt": 256, "#minecraft:planks": 128, "minecraft:waxed_exposed_cut_copper_stairs": 32 } } ``` Entries higher in the list take priority.
Server configuration will be automatically synced to clients when joining a server.
Items with durability *can* be made stackable, however using the stack will reduce the durability of all items in that stack.
The text size of stacks above 999 will be decreased, however above 999,999 the text will still overflow into the next slot. ## Dependencies This mod requires [owo lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib).

title: NeoEcoBridge
description: A hybrid plugin made to bridge economies between Pixelmon and Vault.
body:
**NeoEcoBridge** is an economy bridging plugin for Pixelmon that causes Pixelmon to use Vault's registered economy. Created due to memory leaks and issues with other economy bridging plugins, NeoEcoBridge promises to deliver high-performance. This is a plugin meant for you to be able to drop into your plugins folder and forget about.

### NeoEcoBridge explicitly supports specific hybrid platforms:
- Arclight 1.16.5
- Arclight 1.20.2
- Mohist 1.20.2
- Other hybrids are un-tested, but may work.

### NeoEcoBridge also explicitly supports specific economy plugins:
- EssentialsX
- CMI

If an economy plugin is not explicitly supported, it does not mean it will not work. Explicitly supported economy plugins exist due to those plugins not using Vault's API completely. If a supported plugin is not found, NeoEcoBridge attempts to wrap vault's registered economy, but this may not always work. If an economy plugin needs explicit support, reach out to me in my discord at the bottom of this post. If you're a dev, there's API to add more explicit economy plugins externally.

### To install, drag-and-drop the downloaded jar into your /plugins/ folder.

NeoEcoBridge does include a single config option, "show-decimals". This config option is used to control whether or not players can see decimals in their balance in the inventory. Default false. "/neoecobridge reload" will reload this single value. The permission "neoecobridge.reload" is required to run the command in-game.

title: SpeedTab
description: A customizable tab plugin for the Velocity Minecraft proxy.
body:
# SpeedTab  
SpeedTab is a customizable tab plugin for the Velocity Minecraft proxy. It allows you to set custom headers and footers in the Minecraft tab list across different servers, with support for colour codes and formatting.

## Features
- Customizable tab headers and footers.
- Different headers and footers for different servers.
- Support for Minecraft colour codes and formatting.
- Reload config with a command `/speedtabreload`.
- Permission node for the reload command.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release of SpeedTab from the top of the page.
2. Place the downloaded JAR file in the `plugins` directory of your Velocity server.
3. Start your Velocity server to generate the default configuration file.

## Commands
- Reload config - `/speedtabreload`

## Permissions
- Reload config - `speedtab.reload`
By default no one has the permission other than the console.
To grant the permission to a player, you will need a permissions plugin installed on Velocity, and in the backend server (eg: Paper).
This was tested with LuckPerms installed on Velocity and Paper, both connected up to the same MySQL server with the `speedtab.reload` permission applied to my player.

## Configuration

After running the server for the first time with SpeedTab installed, a default configuration file will be created in the `plugins/speedtab` directory.

### Configuration File

The configuration file `config.conf` allows you to customize the tab headers and footers. Here is the default configuration:

```hocon
default {
    tabTitle = "&aWelcome to &bSpeedTab!"
    tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your stay!"
}

servers {
    lobby {
        tabTitle = "&aWelcome to the &bLobby!"
        tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your time in the Lobby!"
    }
    survival {
        tabTitle = "&aWelcome to &bSurvival!"
        tabFooter = "&cEnjoy your time in Survival!"
    }
    // Add more servers as required.
}
```

For headers and footers for different servers to work, the server names should match exactly what you have in your velocity.toml file. The plugin will fallback to the default headers and footers if needed.

### Colour Codes
SpeedTab supports Minecraft colour codes and formatting codes. Use the following codes in your configuration file:

* &0 - Black
* &1 - Dark Blue
* &2 - Dark Green
* &3 - Dark Aqua
* &4 - Dark Red
* &5 - Dark Purple
* &6 - Gold
* &7 - Gray
* &8 - Dark Gray
* &9 - Blue
* &a - Green
* &b - Aqua
* &c - Red
* &d - Light Purple
* &e - Yellow
* &f - White
* &k - Obfuscated
* &l - Bold
* &m - Strikethrough
* &n - Underlined
* &o - Italic
* &r - Reset
*

## Contributing
Contributions are welcome! Please open an issue or submit a pull request on the [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AdrianJoeK/SpeedTab).

title: DPlib
description: Datapack Library | Provides Maths, Threading, Real datetime ...
body:
![img](https://i.imgur.com/5Niiqn0.png)

The complete documentation can be found [here.](https://github.com/Z0rillac/DPlib/blob/main/DOCS.md)
# Datapack library
DPlib is a library for datapack developed in mcfunction. It is designed so that you can directly include the module you want in your datapack, without worrying about performance or compatibility and without creating dependencies. It is designed for performance and simplicity, it can be used in any datapack requiring simple or complex functions while being as fast as possible.

This library contains:
- dplib.math
  - Number-theoretic and representation
  - Power and logarithm
  - Trigonometry
  - RNG and LCG
  - Other various functions
- dplib.datetime
  - Real world date and time
  - Local time
  - Time and duration calculation
  - Time conversion
- dplib.threading
  - Code threading with contextual entities
  - Hierarchical threading
  - Scoreboard ID
- dplib.benchmark
  - Benchmarking for development only

## How it works

You just need to import the module(s) you need (they work independently) into the data folder of your datapack, you then need to load it by executing this command at the beginning of your datapack load file : 
```
function dplib.<module>:load
```
You may also need to tick the module, if so add this to the beginning of your tick file :
```
function dplib.<module>:tick
```

To ensure proper de-installation, you must include this line in the uninstallation file :
```
function dplib.<module>:uninstall
```

In general, the input scoreboard for parameters is `dplib.<module>.in` and the output scoreboard is `dplib.<module>.in`. The automatically managed variables are in `dplib.<module>.main`

For example, you can calculate how far away the nearest cow is:
```mcfunction
# Puts the player's coordinates in parameters of the function
execute as Someone store result score $x1 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[0]
execute as Someone store result score $y1 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[1]
execute as Someone store result score $z1 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[2]
# Puts the nearest cow coordinates in parameters of the function
execute at Someone as @e[sort=nearest,type=cow,limit=1] store result score $x2 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[0]
execute at Someone as @e[sort=nearest,type=cow,limit=1] store result score $y2 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[1]
execute at Someone as @e[sort=nearest,type=cow,limit=1] store result score $z2 dplib.math.in run data get entity @s Pos[2]
# Calculates the distance using a tool provided by this library
function dplib.math:tools/distance
# Displays the result above the player's hotbar
title Someone actionbar [{"text":"Nearest Cow : ","color":"red"},{"score":{"name":"$out","objective":"dplib.math.out"},"color":"yellow"},{"text":"m","color":"yellow"}]
```

Or you can simply get the real world timestamp live:
```mcfunction
scoreboard players get unix_timestamp dplib.datetime.main
```

This library is made to be used with [Data-pack Helper Plus](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SPGoding.datapack-language-server) extension, it is easier to find the functions thanks to the auto completion provided by the extension and a library of aliases.

The complete documentation can be found [here.](https://github.com/Z0rillac/DPlib/blob/main/DOCS.md)

It is advisable to credit the project :
```
This datapack uses DPlib
https://github.com/Z0rillac/DPlib
```

title: Infiltrating the Stronghold
description: Turns strongholds into a stealth dungeon.
body: # Infiltrating the Stronghold What if strongholds were stealth dungeons? Whether you're sneaking around or facing it head-on, just remember, the stronghold is more afraid of you than you are of it. See more on the WIKI ### The Watchers Watchers are a new category of mob. There are currently 3 kinds and they spawn in pairs in the stronghold. The Sculk Watcher attaches itself to the ceiling and surveys the area for players. If it sees a player or anything else that startles it then it acts like an alarm and activates nearby infested blocks. Its partner is either the Obsidian Watcher or the End Watcher which each has a different tear attack that helps the Sculk Watcher in a different way. Other features involving redstone, eyes of ender and loot can be read about on the wiki. ### Silverfish Silverfish stats have been buffed a little and the knockback they deal has been reduced. Think of silverfish like the queen in a hive. In strongholds, infested blocks contain a random number of endermites in addition to the one silverfish. You may also find a shelled variant of the silverfish. ### Infested Blocks These blocks have been mechanically reworked to be much less stable and more sensitive to player actions. ### Loot Stronghold loot has been completely rebalanced. changed to complement the game mechanics of the dungeon. Additionally, iron gear is enchanted and volumes of the monster manual can be found in the library. ### End Crystals The end crystal recipe has been changed >Thumbnail by Wacky | Player heads from minecraft-heads.com (uploaders: Gumnie and WakefulSpect)

# 🔮 Alkatraz

> *Turn your Minecraft server into a living wizard's world.*

**Alkatraz** is a premium Bukkit/Spigot magic plugin that adds a complete wizardry RPG to Minecraft. Code-cast 30 unique spells, climb 9 Magic Circles, research ancient power, and duel custom mobs that cast spells right back at you.

---

## ✨ What Makes Alkatraz Different?

| | |
|---|---|
| **Code Casting** | Input 5-click sequences (`RRRRR` = Magic Missile) to cast on the fly. No chat commands, no menus. |
| **or Hotbar Casting** | Prefer one-click? Assign spells to your hotbar and cast with a right-click. |
| **9 Magic Circles** | Earn Arcane Knowledge by casting. Advance circles to unlock stronger spells, more mana, and stat points. |
| **Research Tree** | Invest Research Points in a branching DAG of permanent upgrades — elemental affinities, stat boosts, capstone powers. |
| **30 Unique Spells** | Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Dark — each with distinct mechanics. Walls, summons, buffs, debuffs, teleports, and more. |
| **Custom Mobs** | Zombie Mages, Skeletal Mages, Zombie Fighters — they cast spells, keep distance, and exploit weaknesses. |
| **Element System** | Invest stat points into 6 elements for affinity (more damage) and resistance (less damage taken). |
| **Spell Mastery** | Level up individual spells for faster cast times. |
| **Fully Configurable** | Every spell value — damage, range, cooldown, mana cost — in YAML. No code edits needed. |
| **Multi-Version** | Supports Minecraft 1.19 through the latest 1.21+ builds. |

---

## 🎮 In 30 Seconds

1. **Craft a Wand** — Lapis Lazuli + Stick = Wooden Wand
2. **Equip it** — Hold it in your main hand
3. **Cast** — Right-click 5 times fast → *Magic Missile*
4. **Progress** — Every cast earns Arcane Knowledge. Climb circles. Unlock devastation.

> *That's it. You're a wizard now.*

---

## 🔥 Featured Spells

| Spell | Element | Circle | What It Does |
|-------|---------|--------|--------------|
| **Fireball** | Fire | I | Explosive projectile. Damage + block destruction. |
| **Air Burst** | Air | I | Knocks back everything around you. |
| **Earth Throw** | Earth | I | Tears a chunk of ground from your feet and hurls it. |
| **Lesser Heal** | Light | I | Heal yourself or a target player. |
| **Stealth** | Dark | II | Vanish from sight — armor and all. |
| **Blink** | Air | IV | Teleport up to 12 blocks through the air. |
| **Earthen Wall** | Earth | IV | Raise a massive wall that follows your gaze. |
| **Whirlpool** | Water | IV | A vortex that pulls enemies in and shreds them. |
| **Summon Zombies** | Dark | IV | Raise the dead to fight for you. |
| **Wind Barrier** | Air | IV | Deflect projectiles, push back enemies. |

And 20 more — including customizable **Buff** and **Debuff** spells where you pick the effects.

---

## 🧙 Progression That Pulls You In

Cast spells → earn **Arcane Knowledge** → advance **Magic Circles** (I–IX) → unlock bigger mana pools, faster regen, and stat points → spend **Research Points** in the **Research Tree** for permanent perks → unlock **capstone powers**.

```text
 Circle I     →   300 AK    →   +5 Mana, +1 Regen, 1 Stat Point
 Circle V     →  15,566 AK  →  +25 Mana, +3 Regen, 3 Stat Points
 Circle IX    →  474,531 AK →  +50 Mana, +5 Regen, 5 Stat Points
```

Every circle upgrade triggers a visual and audio spectacle — spiralling purple particles, enchanting sounds, and a surge of power.

---

## ⚔️ Your Magic, Your Way

- **Dual casting modes**: Code-casting (5-click gestures) or hotbar (click-to-cast)
- **Per-spell configuration**: Speed, size, damage, effects — tweak everything
- **Elemental affinities**: Invest stat points to specialise (or stay balanced)
- **Mastery system**: Grind a spell to max level for faster casting
- **Research capstones**: 7 capstone powers (1 per element + Magic) with unique permanent bonuses

---

## 👹 The World Fights Back

Custom mobs spawn naturally, wielding the same spells you do:

- **Zombie Mage** — Keeps distance, casts Fireball and Earth Spike
- **Skeletal Mage** — Ranged caster that turns invisible
- **Zombie Fighter** — Buffs itself with Speed + Strength and rushes you

Each has elemental affinities and weaknesses. Learn their resistances. Exploit their gaps.

---

## 🛠️ For Server Admins

- **Drop-in install**: Drop the jar in `plugins/`, restart.
- **Zero required config**: Sensible defaults out of the box.
- **Full YAML config**: Spell values, mob stats, progression curves, tutorial flow.
- **Permissions**: Granular control over commands, spells, and features.
- **Multi-version**: Same jar works on 1.19 → 1.21+ (including v26).

# Gazetteer
Gazetteer is a simple minimalistic fabric mod for saving your coordinates. No minimaps. Just a list with in-game waypoints.

---

(If you want to help and know any other language than English you can help by translating the mod [here](https://github.com/coredex-source/Gazetteer) by making a pull request)

## Features
- Hotkey for placing a waypoint in the current position
- Automatic waypoints in the place where you died
- Copying the waypoint coordinates to the clipboard
- Copying a teleport command to the waypoint in its dimension
- Toggling waypoint visibility
- Changing the size of the waypoint to your liking
- Changing the color of the waypoint to your liking
- Setting the maximum rendering distance for waypoints
- Detecting coordinates from chat
- Available in multiple languages
- **No minimap**

### The idea behind it
I initially created this mod just for me and my friends. I'm not too fond of these waypoint mods which always have built-in minimap which lagged my game even when it was off. So I made my own mod to fulfill the need for a lightweight, minimalistic waypoint mod.

### Support
Gazetteer will always receive latest features for the latest version of the game.
You can freely include Gazetteer in any mod packs.

### Credits
PouekDev for creating [CList](https://github.com/PouekDEV/CList) which is the base of this mod.

title: Structural Safety
description: A server-side utility that protects structures by switching players to Adventure Mode, while allowing them to break specific blocks and use timed torches.
body:
# Structural Safety

**Keep generated structures intact. Automatically.**
Structural Safety protects naturally generated structures from grief and environmental
damage by switching players into **Adventure Mode** inside them — while still letting them
loot, fight, and explore. Fully configurable in‑game, no commands memorized required.

---

## ✨ What it does

When a player enters a protected structure (dungeon, mansion, trial chamber, village …):

- 🛡️ **They are put into Adventure Mode** automatically (with an action‑bar notice + sound). When they leave, their **previous game mode is restored** — even across disconnects/restarts.
- ⛏️ **No griefing:** blocks can't be broken or placed freely…
- ✅ **…but exploration still works:** loot chests, fight mobs, pull levers, brush suspicious sand, and break a curated list of "weak" blocks (cobwebs, vines, pots …) so you never get stuck.
- 💥🔥🌋 **Environmental protection:** explosions, fire (including fire spread **and** lava‑lit fire), and flowing lava **cannot destroy** protected structure blocks.
- 🚪 **Anti‑stuck:** a `/structuralsafety escape` command teleports a trapped player to the nearest safe spot.

Everything is configurable **live, in‑game**, through a clean clickable menu — no file editing needed (but a JSON config exists for power users).

---

## 🎮 Core features

### Adventure‑Mode protection
Players inside a protected structure are forced into Adventure Mode every second. Creative and
Spectator players are never affected. Optional **Op‑Bypass** lets staff keep their game mode.

### Smart interaction whitelist
Even in Adventure Mode, players can still:
- **Break** a configurable list of *breakable blocks* by **sneak + right‑click** (follows vanilla tool rules — e.g. cobweb needs a sword/shears).
- **Interact** with whitelisted blocks (repeaters, comparators, suspicious sand/gravel — *brushable blocks always allowed*).
- **Place** whitelisted items, split into:
  - **Temporary** items (e.g. torches, ladders, hay/slime for self‑rescue) that **auto‑remove after a timer**.
  - **Permanent** items (e.g. ladders, scaffolding, ender eye).

### Environmental damage protection (toggleable)
| Protection | Default | What it blocks |
|---|---|---|
| **Explosions** | ON | TNT, creepers, etc. removing structure blocks |
| **Fire** | ON | Fire appearing **and** burning structure blocks — including fire started by lava |
| **Lava** | ON | Flowing lava entering protected structures |

Each can be toggled independently. Turn **Fire** off and lava/fire behave exactly like vanilla again.

### Sprawling structures
Spread‑out structures like **villages** use their *overall* bounding box instead of tight per‑building
boxes — so plazas, gardens and paths between houses are protected too. The sprawling list is configurable.

### `/escape` anti‑stuck
Teleports the player to the nearest safe surface position (no lava/fire, room to stand). Has a configurable
cooldown when used outside a structure (to prevent fast‑travel abuse) but is **always allowed** when actually
stuck inside a protected area.

---

## 🧱 Command reference

> Player commands work for everyone. **Admin commands require permission level 2 (op).**
> Open the clickable menu any time with `/structuralsafety`.

### Player
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/structuralsafety` or `/structuralsafety help` | Open the main menu |
| `/structuralsafety info` | Show current settings & lists |
| `/structuralsafety escape` | Teleport to the nearest safe spot |

### Admin — overview
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/structuralsafety admin` | Open the admin menu |
| `/structuralsafety admin protection` | Open the protection panel (click to toggle) |
| `/structuralsafety admin protection <explosions\|fire\|lava> [true\|false]` | Toggle / set one protection |
| `/structuralsafety admin opbypass [true\|false]` | Let ops keep their game mode |

### Admin — structures
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/structuralsafety admin structure` / `… list [page]` | Browse & toggle protected structures |
| `/structuralsafety admin structure protect <name>` | Protect a structure |
| `/structuralsafety admin structure unprotect <name>` | Unprotect a structure |
| `/structuralsafety admin structure protectall` / `unprotectall` | Protect / unprotect all |
| `/structuralsafety admin structure sprawling list` | Show sprawling structures |
| `/structuralsafety admin structure sprawling add\|remove <name>` | Manage sprawling list |

### Admin — player allowances
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/structuralsafety admin allow` | Open the allowances menu |
| `/structuralsafety admin allow break list\|add <block>\|remove <block>` | Blocks players may break |
| `/structuralsafety admin allow interact list\|add <block>\|remove <block>` | Blocks players may interact with |
| `/structuralsafety admin allow place temp list\|add <item>\|remove <item>` | Temporary placeable items |
| `/structuralsafety admin allow place perm list\|add <item>\|remove <item>` | Permanent placeable items |

### Admin — timers
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/structuralsafety admin time` | Show current timers |
| `/structuralsafety admin time escape <minutes>` | `/escape` cooldown |
| `/structuralsafety admin time temp <minutes>` | Temporary‑block lifetime |

Structure names accept either the **plain name** (e.g. `Pillager Outpost`) or the **raw ID** (e.g. `minecraft:pillager_outpost`), with tab‑completion.

---

## 🗂️ Default protected structures
Out of the box these vanilla structures are protected:
`abandoned_mineshaft`, `simple_dungeon`, `pillager_outpost`, `desert_pyramid`, `jungle_pyramid`,
`mansion`, `monument`, `stronghold`, `trial_chambers`, `ancient_city`, `fortress`, `bastion_remnant`,
`nether_fossil`, `end_city`.

**Modded structures are detected automatically** and added to the config (disabled by default) — just
enable the ones you want via `/structuralsafety admin structure protect <name>`.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
A JSON config is created at `config/structuralsafety_settings.json`. Everything there can also be set
in‑game, so editing by hand is optional. Keys include:
`structures`, `sprawling_structures`, `weak_blocks`, `interact_allowed`, `temp_place_items`,
`perm_place_items`, `cooldown_minutes`, `temp_minutes`, `op_bypass`,
`protect_explosions`, `protect_fire`, `protect_lava`.

New default entries are **merged** into existing configs on update without wiping your customizations.

***

## ❤️ Credits & Links

> Made with ❤️ by **Mrstilu2k6**

🔗 **[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/MrStilu2k6)** · 🔗 **[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/mrstilu2k6/projects)** · ☕ **[PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/stilu2k6)**

***

> 💬 **Found a bug? Have a suggestion?** Drop it in the comments or open an issue — every piece of feedback helps!
> 
> ☕ **Enjoying the mod?** If you'd like to support my work, a small tip is greatly appreciated. Every bit of support helps me dedicate more time to updates and new features!

title: magnet-hopper
description: A hopper variant that pulls dropped items in a 3D radius before depositing them into the container below. Solves the universal "items despawn around my mob farm" pain in one dedicated block.
body:
Magnet Hopper

A hopper variant that pulls dropped items in a 3D radius before depositing them into the container below. Solves the universal "items despawn around my mob farm" pain in one dedicated block.

Features

  • Magnet pull — ItemEntities in the tier's 3D radius get vacuumed into the internal 5-slot storage and flow down into the container below.
  • Vanilla hopper behavior always active — strict superset of a regular hopper: pulls from any container above, pushes to any container below at the standard 8-tick cadence.
  • Magnet on/off toggle — UI button to disable just the magnet pull (block keeps acting as a normal hopper).
  • 5-slot whitelist/blacklist filter — click a filter slot with an item to ghost-set (the item isn't consumed); empty-hand click to clear; toggle whitelist/blacklist in the UI.
  • Redstone-disable — applying a redstone signal pauses everything (matches vanilla hopper convention).
  • Placement preview — hold a magnet hopper in either hand and the affected radius draws as a cyan-mint wireframe over your cursor target, with a warm-green surface contour that follows terrain so the floor coverage is always legible.
  • Pipe compatibility — exposes the 5-slot storage via Fabric ItemStorage.SIDED and the NeoForge item-handler capability. Filter slots are config, not exposed.

Compatibility

  • Minecraft: 26.1.x
  • Fabric: Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API
  • NeoForge: 26.1+
  • Java: 25

Known limitations

  • Items in internal storage spill when the block is broken (the drops are still pickup-able). NBT carry-over planned for v0.2.
  • Filter configuration is lost on break. Planned for v0.2.
  • All magnet hoppers face down only; side-facing variant planned later.

License

title: Strange World
description: The Horror Project of Mod - Strange World
body:
# 🌑 Strange World

**Something is watching you. The world is not what it seems.**

Strange World is a psychological horror mod that gradually transforms your Minecraft experience from a peaceful adventure into a terrifying nightmare. At the center of it all is **Jerry** — a mysterious chat entity who starts as your best friend... and slowly becomes your worst fear.

---

## ⚠️ Content Warning

This mod contains:
- **Loud and sudden sounds**
- **Jumpscares and frightening imagery**
- **Disturbing chat messages**
- **Psychological horror elements**
- **Hostile world changes**
- **Screen glitch effects and camera shake**

A warning screen is displayed when you first enter a world. **Privacy Mode** is available to disable browser history reading.

---

## 🎭 The Four Phases of Jerry

### Phase 0 — Friendly *(0–3 minutes)*
> *"Hey! A new player! Welcome to this world!"*

Jerry greets you warmly. He's helpful, cheerful, and acts like a good companion. He warns you about nearby hostile mobs, helps you find diamonds, and cheers you on. Everything feels... normal.

### Phase 1 — Suspicious *(3–8 minutes)*
> *"Do you ever feel like someone is watching us?"*

Something shifts. Jerry's messages become unsettling. He mentions things he shouldn't know. He counts blocks that don't add up. A mysterious **Watcher** — a figure that looks like Steve — appears in the distance. If you look at it... it plays a cave sound and vanishes.

### Phase 2 — Strange *(8–15 minutes)*
> *"W-what's happening to me?! The sky... THE SKY IS BLEEDING"*

Jerry's name begins to glitch: **Jer██y**. The rain turns **blood red**. Water becomes dark crimson — even underwater. A **10-second glitch event** triggers immediately: screen shakes, distorted sound plays, glitched text floods the chat and screen. If Jerry finds diamonds near you, he **deletes them** from the world.

### Phase 3 — Hostile *(15+ minutes)*
> *"Jerry is dead. I am what remains."*

**Jer%&$?** has fully taken over. All passive mobs — cows, pigs, sheep, chickens — **attack you on sight**. The blood rain is permanent. The chat fills with threats and glitched binary. If Privacy Mode is off... Jerry reads your **real browser history** from Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Brave and displays it in chat.

---

## 📺 Glitch Events

A terrifying 10-second glitch event triggers **immediately when Phase 2 begins**, then repeats **every 10 minutes** during Phases 2–3:

- 🔊 **Custom distorted sound effect**
- 📷 **Violent camera shaking**
- 💬 **Chat spam** — gibberish, binary code, Caesar cipher messages
- 🟣 **Colored rectangles** flashing across the screen (purple, black, white, red)
- 📺 **Scan lines and screen flashes**
- ✨ **Glitch text overlay** — `JERRY`, `HELP`, `01101010`, `ERROR`
- 🖤 **Dark vignette border**

---

## 👤 Entities

### The Watcher
A custom entity with Steve's skin that spawns **40–70 blocks away** during Phase 1. It stands perfectly still and stares. Look directly at it — **cave sound** plays and it instantly **vanishes**.

### The Shadow
A **completely black figure** that spawns **10–20 blocks** from you in **all phases**. When you look at it:
- It lets out a **Warden roar**
- **Charges at you** at extreme speed
- On contact — **teleports you to the Strange Field**
- Spawn egg available in the Strange World creative tab

---

## 🌾 Strange Field — Custom Dimension

An **endless flat field of fully-grown wheat** stretching to the horizon. No mobs. No trees. Just wheat, dirt paths every 32 blocks, and silence.

- **Wet farmland** — wheat never breaks
- **Water layer** beneath the soil
- **Eternal daytime** (fixed at noon)
- **No mob spawns** — completely empty
- **Jerry is paused** while you're here — no messages, no phase progression

### 🗼 Exit Tower
Tall **deepslate brick towers** scattered across the field with a guaranteed one at **(160, 160)**:
- **30 blocks tall**, 7×7 base
- **4 arched doorways** on all sides
- **Spiral staircase** with wall torches
- **Glass windows** every 6 floors
- **Pyramidal deepslate tile roof** with corner spires
- **10-block sea lantern beacon** — visible from far away
- **Return Gate** on top — teleports you to your bed or world spawn
- **Soul lanterns** at ground level around the base

---

## 💬 Context-Aware Dialogue

Jerry doesn't just talk randomly — he **reacts to what you do**:

| Action | Jerry's Reaction |
|--------|-----------------|
| Diamonds nearby (Phase 0) | *"Oh! I found diamonds for you! One of them is 12 blocks away!"* |
| Hostile mob nearby (Phase 0) | *"Be careful! Don't die to the mobs!"* |
| Place 25 blocks | *"What are you building? Will you show me? :)"* |
| Break 100 blocks | *"Trying to craft something? Well, let's see :)"* |
| Break 500 blocks | *"You don't want to hide from me, do you?"* |
| Rain starts (Phase 1) | *"Don't you think the rain tastes like... iron?"* |
| Swimming (Phase 1) | *"I thought the water was supposed to be red..."* |
| Diamonds nearby (Phase 2) | Deletes all diamond ore within 30 blocks |

---

## 🏗️ Structures

### 🏚️ Abandoned House
Weathered houses with **peaked spruce roofs**, oak log frames, mossy walls with holes, glass pane windows, door frames, cobweb-filled interiors, and a chest containing a **mysterious note** from a previous player who encountered Jerry.

### ⛺ Tent Village
Camps of 2–6 wool tents around a central **campfire** with log seats. Each tent adapts to terrain height — no floating! Connected by **dirt paths**. Each tent has a lantern, red carpet floor, and a chest with **survivor's logs** documenting encounters with Jerry, plus iron/diamond gear, golden apples, and rarely a full **netherite set** (2%) or **enchanted golden apple** (5%).

### 💓 Flesh Heart
A massive flat heart shape made of **rotten flesh blocks** with a glowing **redstone + glowstone core**, **arteries** spreading outward, **redstone wire veins**, **weeping vines**, blood pools, and crimson nylium accents. Touching the flesh causes **nausea**.

### 🏰 Ancient Castle *(rare)*
A large 30×30 stone brick fortress featuring:
- **Thick walls with battlements** and walkways
- **4 corner towers** with peaked dark oak roofs and lanterns
- **Grand arched gate** with iron bar portcullis
- **Courtyard** with a well
- **Throne room** — pillars, red carpet, chandeliers, quartz throne, banners
- **Storage wing** — 20 chests with iron, diamonds, ender pearls, golden apples, and rarely **netherite gear**. Chests may contain **Jerry's Key** (30% per chest).
- Throne chest contains a **Royal Decree** with **real coordinates** to the Decayed Creature (found via `/locate`).

### 💀 Decayed Creature *(rare)*
A massive collapsed organic monstrosity (22×18 blocks) featuring:
- **Multi-layered body** rising 4 blocks at center
- **Bone block skull** with eye sockets
- **Spine** running the full length, **6 pairs of ribs**
- **4 sprawled limbs**, red nether brick veins, crying obsidian accents
- **Sealed Core** at the heart — use Jerry's Key here to end it all.

---

## 📜 Starter Note

When you first enter a world, you receive a **"Mysterious Note"** with the **real coordinates** of the nearest Ancient Castle. This begins the quest to find Jerry's Key and end his reign.

---

## 🔑 The Key & The Ending

Find **Jerry's Key** in the Castle's storage chests. Locate the **Decayed Creature** using the Royal Decree from the throne. Use the key on the **Sealed Core**.

A dramatic **42-second cinematic sequence** unfolds — one message at a time:

Jerry panics. He begs. He apologizes. Then, line by line, the system **deletes him** — his class files, his config, his rain, his mob AI. The rain stops. The water clears. The world is restored.

**Jerry is permanently dead in that world.** Saved to the world file forever.

*...or is he?*

---

## 🧱 Custom Content

| Item | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Rotten Flesh Block** | Organic block with slime sounds. Causes **nausea** on contact. |
| **Sealed Core** | Indestructible glowing block. Use Jerry's Key to activate. |
| **Return Gate** | Black block with blue glow. Teleports back to Overworld. |
| **Jerry's Key** | Golden key found in Castle chests. The only way to kill Jerry. |
| **Watcher Spawn Egg** | Black spawn egg for The Watcher entity. |
| **Shadow Spawn Egg** | Dark purple spawn egg for The Shadow entity. |

All items available in the **Strange World** creative tab.

---

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/phase 0` | Set phase to Friendly |
| `/phase 1` | Set phase to Suspicious |
| `/phase 2` | Set phase to Strange (triggers glitch + blood rain) |
| `/phase 3` | Set phase to Hostile (mobs attack, full chaos) |
| `/locate structure strangeworld:abandoned_house` | Find nearest house |
| `/locate structure strangeworld:tent_village` | Find nearest tent camp |
| `/locate structure strangeworld:flesh_heart` | Find nearest flesh heart |
| `/locate structure strangeworld:castle` | Find nearest castle |
| `/locate structure strangeworld:decayed_creature` | Find nearest creature |

`/phase` requires operator permissions (level 2).

---

## 📋 Technical Details

- **Minecraft:** 1.19.2
- **Mod Loader:** Fabric
- **Dependencies:** Fabric API
- **Phase progress saves** to the world file — persists across sessions
- **Privacy Mode** toggle on warning screen (enabled by default)
- All Overworld structures use **Minecraft's native worldgen system** — fully compatible with `/locate`
- **Strange Field** — custom dimension with flat generator + chunk decoration
- Client/server sync via custom network packets
- **Real browser history** reading (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Chromium)
- Optimized block scanning with cooldowns — no lag spikes
- Phase pauses automatically when player is in the Strange Field

---

## ⬇️ Installation

1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.19.2
2. Install **Fabric API**
3. Drop `strange-world-1.2.5.jar` into your `mods/` folder
4. Launch the game
5. Trust Jerry. He's your friend.

*...for now.*

title: TotemSound
description: This Minecraft mod lets you replace the default totem sound with a custom audio file up to ten seconds long.
body:
# TotemSound

A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that allows you to replace the Totem of Undying pop sound with a custom local audio file directly in-game.

## Features

* **In-Game Menu:** Adds a new button to the pause menu to easily change the sound while playing.
* **Local Files:** Allows you to select a custom audio file directly from your PC using a file browser.
* **Time Limit:** The system automatically checks if the selected sound complies with the maximum limit of 10 seconds.
* **Restore Function:** Clicking "Restore Sound" immediately brings back the original vanilla totem sound.
* **Client-Side Only:** The mod only needs to be installed on the client and works perfectly on any multiplayer server.

## Installation

1. Install the **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Download the mod file (`totemsound.jar`).
3. Place the file into your `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods` folder.
4. Launch the game using the Fabric profile.

## Usage

1. Open the pause menu (ESC) in-game.
2. Click the **Totem Sound** button.
3. Select your desired audio file on your PC **(It has to be a .wav file you can convert your sound on some websites for example https://cloudconvert.com/audio-converter )**.
4. Use a totem in the game to hear the new sound.
5. To get the original sound back, simply press **Restore Sound** in the pause menu.

---

**Author:** Petar  
**Platform:** Fabric (Minecraft 1.21.1)

# **Anti-Chunkban
# **

A lightweight client-side mod that prevents certain forms of NBT-based denial-of-service attacks, such as book bans / chunk bans, from making the game unplayable.

The mod safely handles oversized NBT data that would normally cause disconnects, freezes, or crashes when opening containers, loading items, or joining a server.

Features
Protection against book bans and similar oversized-NBT attacks
Client-side only
Lightweight and simple
Why use this mod?

Some servers or players may use items containing extremely large amounts of NBT data to cause lag, disconnects, or client instability. This mod helps keep your game playable by handling these cases more safely.

title: Named Item Preserver
description: Makes item naming mechanically meaningful by preventing natural despawn of named items, while preserving all vanilla loss mechanics like lava and the void.
body:
# Named Item Preserver

This mod gives mechanical meaning to naming items by bringing them closer to how named mobs behave in vanilla Minecraft.

In vanilla, naming a mob prevents it from despawning. Naming an item does nothing.
Named Item Preserver closes that gap — deliberately, minimally, and with survival parity in mind.

## Current state

Status: Alpha  
Current version: 0.1.2 
Minecraft version: 1.21.10 — 1.21.11 

This mod is ready for testing and is already used on a real server.  
No known bugs at the time of release, but this is an alpha release — expect that issues may exist and that behavior may change between versions. 

## Core behavior

- Items with a custom name do not naturally despawn
- Named items carried or equipped by despawned mobs are dropped instead of disappearing with the mob
- Unnamed items behave exactly like vanilla
- No teleportation, no chunk loading, no item recovery systems

If a player takes the effort and cost to name an item, the game should treat it as intentionally kept.

## Optional behavior

Certain features are available to be enabled in config:

- Displaying the name above the dropped named item
- Container destruction handling (named items released when containers are destroyed)


## What this mod does not protect against

This mod is not an item safety or recovery system.

Named items:  

🔥 still burn in lava  
🕳️ are still lost in the void  
💥 are still destroyed by explosions or other vanilla mechanics 

If vanilla would destroy the item, this mod will not interfere. Only natural despawn is prevented.

## Feedback & visibility

The mod includes optional feedback mechanisms related to named items. It can provide logging or chat messages when a named item is:

- dropped
- destroyed
- picked up

These are intended for administration and debugging, not player tracking or recovery, and are configurable.
By default, only the most important events trigger notifications, and messages are sent only to the server log.

## Planned features

Further features are planned, including:

- Conditional location broadcasting for named items
- Particle or visual indicators tied to named-item events
- Dowsing Pendulum item as a way to use functionality above
- Translations

**Important constraints:**

- All additional features will be fully configurable
- All will be disabled by default

title: Velocity Server Switcher
description: A Velocity plugin that provides a permission-based server switching system .
body:
# Server Switcher
A Velocity plugin that provides a **permission-based server switching system** for your Minecraft network.

## Features
- Fully configurable formatted server list with [MiniMessage](https://docs.papermc.io/adventure/minimessage/format/) support
- Grouping of servers
- Detection of online status of the server
- Permissions to control which servers players can access and see in the server list

## Commands
- `/server` - Lists all servers the player has access to
- `/server <server-name>` - Switches the player to the selected server
- `/server reload` - Reloads the plugin configuration file

> **⚠️ Warning**
> 
> It is strongly advised to avoid naming a server `reload`. Doing so will likely cause a conflict for players with the `serverswitcher.reload` permission.

## Permissions

| Permission                            | Description                                              |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `serverswitcher.list`                 | Access to the `/server` command                          |
| `serverswitcher.reload`               | Access to `/server reload`                               |
| `serverswitcher.server.<server-id>`   | Allows access to the server `<server-id>`                |
| `serverswitcher.group.<group-id>`     | Allows access to all servers in the group `<group-id>`   |

- `serverswitcher.server.<server-id>` and `serverswitcher.group.<group-id>` can *optionally* be overriden with custom permission names in the config file.
- If a player does not have permission to access a server the server will be hidden from them by default. Setting the config value `alwaysShow` to `true` for a group or server, the server will always show up in the listing, but the player will be denied access if they attempt to connect while not having the permissions.

> **⚠️ Warning**
> 
> This plugin **does not prevent a player from being on a server**; it only controls whether they can switch there themselves. If there are other ways to join a server, they may bypass this restriction. You might also want to prevent access to the Velocity server command by setting `velocity.command.server` to `false`.

## Config
See the [config.toml](https://github.com/Evitonative/ServerSwitcher/blob/master/src/main/resources/config.toml) file for available options.

title: WorkstationCommands
description: A minecraft plugin that adds configurable commands to use every workstation.
body:
# WorkstationCommands
This is my first published minecraft plugin!  
With this plugin, you can allow players to open menus for any workstation from anywhere.
You can enable/disable commands in the config, as well as manage the aliases of each command.
Use `/wcreload` to reload the config without restarting.

[![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/workstationcommands)

## SPONGE ISSUES
The current version of the Sponge API does not allow for dynamic unregistration and registration of commands.  This means that /wcreload IS NOT A PART OF THE SPONGE IMPLEMENTATION!!!  

## Configuration
Configuration for this plugin is very simple!  
Commands default to being disabled if their config is not found, so you can remove a command from the config to disable it, or set the "enabled" flag to false.
You can also define a list of aliases for the command.  If this list is not found, it doesn't create any.

To enable only the crafting table, your config may look like this:  
```yml
wccraft:
  enabled: true
```
That's it, just two lines.  

Now let's say you dont want to run `/wccraft`, and you want a different command to open the gui.  
This is where the aliases config comes into play.  Let's add `/craft` as an alias to `/wccraft` (This is in the default config)  
```yml
wccraft:
  enabled: true
  aliases:
    - craft
```
Note that you don't need to include the forward slash when registering the alias.

## Commands  
- `/wcreload`: Reloads the configuration file.
- `/wccraft [target]`: Opens the crafting table GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcstonecutter [target]`: Opens the stonecutter GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcloom [target]`: Opens the loom GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wccartography [target]`: Opens the cartography table GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcfurnace [target]`: Opens the furnace GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcblastfurnace [target]`: Opens the blast furnace GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcsmoker [target]`: Opens the smoker GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcsmithing [target]`: Opens the smithing table GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcanvil [target]`: Opens the anvil GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcenchant [target]`: Opens the enchanting table GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcgrindstone [target]`: Opens the grindstone GUI for the executor or the specified target.
- `/wcbrew [target]`: Opens the brewing stand GUI for the executor or the specified target.

## Player Permissions
**Permissions given to every player**
- `wc.craft`: Allows the player to use `/wccraft`.
- `wc.stonecutter`: Allows the player to use `/wcstonecutter`.
- `wc.loom`: Allows the player to use `/wcloom`.

- `wc.brew`: Allows the player to use `/wcbrew`.

## Operator Permissions
**Permissions given to every operator**
- `wc.reload`: Allows players to use `/wcreload`.
- `wc.craft.other`: Allows the player to use `/craft [target]`.

title: Fancy Hotbar
description: Adds a Lilypad-like hotbar which looks fancy
body:
This texture pack is a small visual change made purely for style. It replaces the default Minecraft hotbar with a custom lilypad-themed design that looks cleaner, softer, and a bit more fancy than vanilla. If you like subtle UI tweaks that don’t mess with gameplay, this pack is made exactly for that.

The idea behind the lilypad hotbar is simple: keep Minecraft’s original feel, but add a calm and aesthetic touch to the screen. The hotbar slots are designed to resemble lilypads floating on water, using smooth shapes, natural green tones, and gentle shading. It doesn’t try to be flashy or distracting — it just makes the UI feel nicer to look at during normal gameplay.

This pack only changes the hotbar, nothing else. No blocks, no items, no sounds. Because of that, it’s very lightweight and performance-friendly. You can use it on low-end PCs, with shaders, or alongside other texture packs without worrying about lag or compatibility issues. It also works well when stacked with other resource packs, since it focuses on just one small part of the UI.

The design keeps visibility and readability in mind. Item slots are still clear, and you won’t struggle to see what you’re holding while fighting, mining, or building. It’s meant to feel natural — like something that could exist in the game, just with a bit more personality.

This texture pack is great for casual players who want a nicer interface, as well as content creators who want their gameplay to look a bit more unique in screenshots or videos. It’s a tiny change, but one you’ll notice every time you play.

If you’re someone who enjoys aesthetic details and clean UI design, this lilypad hotbar is a simple way to make Minecraft feel more personal without changing how the game works at all.

title: More Recipes: Change Wood
description: Increase the output of Wood recipes from 3 to 4.
body:
Recipe downloads have been split into their own projects for better Modrinth App compatibility.\
Links to all recipes in description

This project has all Wood/Bark recipes changed to output 4 instead of 3.


#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

#### For advanced users:
- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change
 - 5.0.0 MC 1.21.2: Recipe Format change - shaped "key" and shapeless "ingredients"
