title: RoyalBattle
description: RoyalBattle is an advanced plugin for organizing large-scale PvP events in the style of "Battle Royale" on the Minecraft server. The plugin automates all stages of the game: from preparing and filling chests to determining the winner and managing the game
body:
_If you don't understand how the plugin works, go to the [WIKI](https://t.me/zdev_wiki)._

_**RoyalBattle is a plugin for conducting royal battles on your Minecraft server**_

**RoyalBattle is an advanced plugin for organizing large-scale PvP events in the style of "Battle Royale" on the Minecraft server. The plugin automates all stages of the game: from preparing and filling chests to determining the winner and managing the game stages.**

**Main functions**

**Full event automation:**

_The plugin itself controls the stages of the game: preparation, banning PvP, the main battle, narrowing the barrier, determining the winner._

**Synchronous filling of chests:**

_Quickly and safely fill chests with loot, taking into account chunks, delays and progress through BossBar. Support for setting the value of items for the center of the map._

**Flexible timer settings:**

_All timings (preparation, PvP ban, main game, barrier compression) are configured in config.yml._

**Barrier Management:**

_The barrier automatically starts to shrink after a set time, forcing the players to get closer._

**The participant system:**

_Only online players become participants at the time of the launch. New players are observers after the start. The Alive status persists even after logging out._

**Restrictions on breaking blocks:**

_Do not break blocks during preparation. After that, only those defined from the config, then any._

**PvP and immortality:**

_After preparing for 30 minutes, you cannot attack the players. After using the totem of immortality, the player becomes vulnerable._

**Localization:**

_All messages are rendered in lang.yml is easy to translate to your server._

**Logging and saving:**

_All information about the state of the game, the participants and the winner is saved between restarts. The winner is recorded in a separate win.yml file._

**How to set up**

Copy the jar file to the plugins folder of your server.
Restart the server and the config.yml, lang.yml, and win files will appear.yml and others.
Configure the parameters in config.yml:
Stage timers (game.timers)

**The list of allowed blocks to be broken**

Barrier Settings
Chest and Loot Settings
Translate or modify the messages in lang.yml if necessary.
Check your rights and grant the necessary permissions to the players/admins.
Use commands to control the game and loot.

**Why choose RoyalBattle?**

**Maximum automation** — does not require manual control of the stages.
**Flexible configuration** — suitable for servers of any size and style.
**Security and performance** — asynchronous processes do not load the server.
****Localization support** — adapts easily to any language.
Transparency** — all information about the winners and the course of the game is preserved.

**_RoyalBattle is an ideal choice for servers that want to host spectacular and honest PvP events with minimal effort on the part of the administration!_**

title: NamedModelData
description: OptiFine-alike item models by name
body:
# NamedModelData
A simple Spigot plugin that allows you to apply CustomModelData tag to an item through anvil by item renaming, just like OptiFine.

![Example usage](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18292506/265445848-501c52cf-d354-443f-9026-51269a5ac911.gif)

NMD **doesn't offer** you any resource packs - you have to provide one to players yourself.
CustomModelData will be applied only if you're renaming an item **through anvil**, so for existing item you have to reapply its name.
Plugin has an option to ignore colors if you have some plugin that allows renaming items through anvil with colors.

### Commands
Currently NMD has only one command - to reload the plugin.
`/namedmodeldata` (alias `/nmd`) - permission `namedmodeldata.admin`

### Configuration
```yaml
# MATERIAL
IRON_SHOVEL:
  # CustomModelData value
  # Required integer
  '1':
    # Item name
    # Required string
    name: 'magic wand'
    # Ignore colors in the name
    # Optional boolean, defaults to false
    ignore-color: true
    # Ignore case in the name
    # Optional boolean, defaults to false
    ignore-case: true
  '5':
    name: '&4Iron Shovel of Doom'
DIAMOND:
  '1':
    name: '&cRuby'
  '2':
    name: 'Unalivemond'
    ignore-color: true
```

title: Beacon Chunk Loading
description: This mod allows beacons to be used as chunkloaders.

# Beacon Chunk Loading

This works by placing a redstone block next to a beacon, this then loads the chunk it is in, with lazy chunks surrounding it.

The reason you want to use this mod as apposed to nether portal chunk loading is as follows.
- It does not load both the nether and overworld saving performance
- It does not interfere with nether portals, and therefore nether travel is easier on a long running server.
- It balances the minecart cost by being a beacon, therefore it is actually overtime around the same cost as a normal chunk loader.

**Because of the change from 1.19 to 1.20 this mod does not work in 1.20.x**

description: BruceWang FPS booster, optimizer modpack attempting to make Minecraft as lightweight performance as possible.
body:
👁👄👁

Hollymeth is a straightforward performance modpack that aims to keep the game running as quickly as possible while maintaining excellent visuals. It is designed to be a sort of "base layer" that you can create your own modpacks and instances on top of or use on its own. It is intended to require the fewest modifications while still providing the best performance. Just optimization; no quality-of-life modifications. Here is a brief video that highlights some of Adrenaline's salient characteristics and contrasts it with Vanilla.

- Optimizer🎮

Hollymeth can significantly enhance the performance of your game by using various optimization mods and configurations. You can expect faster startup times, quicker world loading, and a very high increase in framerates, with some tests showing a boost of up to 10 times the performance with Adrenaline compared to not having any mods installed.

- Complexity🤑

Hollymeth is made to work with a variety of gadgets, even those with very basic specifications. Because of this, it can be used with a variety of hardware setups. Although I can't confirm it because I don't own a Mac, the pack is compatible with Windows, Linux, and probably Mac as well. Due to its more adaptable design and native compatibility with Fabric, Adrenaline is also significantly more mod-compatible than OptiFine.

- Installation guide🧠

If you need help installing the modpack, please refer to this wiki tutorial or the instructions in the Modrinth documentation linked above. In the post-install section of the wiki, you can learn how to adjust things to provide greater optimizations after installing the pack. This covers actions like increasing your allotted memory, adjusting your device's game settings, and some more complex things like modifying your Java runtime and JVM flags.

title: The Castel Experience
description:
A horror mod-pack Aimed towards a phycological experience
(this is also to test out what would be good for my mod and what needs rework)
body:
[!Note!] Thanks for the 270 downloads :)

I built this pack because I missed the feeling of actually being afraid of the dark in Minecraft. It’s called The Castel Experience, and it’s less about "jump scares" and more about that skin-crawling feeling that you’re being watched by something that doesn't follow the rules of the game. It turns a sandbox into a psychological trap where the goal isn't just to build—it's to stay sane.

You might feel the urge to swing your sword at the shadows, but you’ll quickly realize the truth: You can try to strike them, but you can't hit something that isn't really there.

How it works

The "twist" here is that I’ve layered several different "stalker" entities that all behave differently. While From The Fog handles the classic, subtle legend of Herobrine, mods like The Anomaly and The Obsessed focus on messing with your head—distorting your vision, playing tricks on your audio, and appearing just at the edge of your render distance.

I also overhauled the atmosphere. AmbientSounds and Sound Physics Remastered make caves feel massive and echoing, so every footstep sounds like it might not be yours. It’s designed to make you second-guess every shadow.

[!IMPORTANT]
A quick note on performance: To keep this running smoothly with all the lighting and entity scripts, you'll probably need to dive into the Embeddium settings. Depending on your PC, tweaking the "Quality" and "Performance" tabs in the video settings is the difference between a cinematic horror movie and a slideshow.

[Note] This Modpack is designed to identify what elements people find genuinely scary in psychological horror. Based on this feedback, I will create my own horror mod focusing on the aspects that are found to be most frightening, while leaving out what is not effective.

After playing my Mod-Pack, use my Google [form](https://forms.gle/E4F9X6EyMdakka16A) to review, suggest mods, or report bugs.

title: Height Lock
description: A Minecraft mod that eliminates the annoying missclicks when you try to build a platform in the air, by allowing you to lock the Y-Level you can only build on.
body:
## This mod eliminates the annoying missclicks when building.

![Demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ddcc6bfcc3073ea2b1cf4219344ccc81e3817ba.gif)<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Zzuamqc_998" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Height Lock is a client-side lightweight Fabric utility mod that lets you lock block placement to one exact Y-level.

It does not enforce anything server-side, add a HUD overlay, or try to special-case different block types. The rule is intentionally simple: if the final placement position is not on the chosen Y-level, block it.



Compatibility:

**The ONLY requirement for this mod is the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

Unlock **customization features** by installing the [**Mod Menu**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and the **[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)**. (not required)

At the moment, **no incompatibilities with other mods were found**. 

# How to use

By default, **the toggle key is H**. You can use it to toggle the mod function itself, including the grid, that marks the Y-Level.

There are three other keybinds, that are defaulted to Not Bound, which are:

- Decrease Target Y
- Increase Target Y
- Set Target Y To Current Block



Once enabled, the mod works without any need of configuration, though there are opportunities, as mentioned earlier.

title: Sinking Items
description: Makes items sink in water just like they did before the "1.13 Aquatic Update". Intended to be used on 1.14.4+ clients connecting to a 1.12.2 server or below.
body:
# Sinking Items
Reverts the physics changed made to dropped items in water that were introduced in the 1.13 Aquatic Update

![GIF showcasing items in water when the mod is enabled (right) and disabled (left)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b23614b038bcdf86eb27b9293a3aaee28a61c71.gif)

The `WITHOUT` side shows how items behave when a 1.13+ client is connected to a 1.12.2- server running [ViaVersion](https://viaversion.com/) (ViaVersion is what allows modern clients to connect to older servers)  
The `WITH` side shows how items behave when using `Sinking Items`. Items behave exactly the same way as the 1.12.2 server. This prevents the janky teleporting down bug as shown in the `WITHOUT` image.

# Downloading
Modrinth is the ONLY official place to download the .jar files, don't download them from anywhere else, else you risk getting scammed or infected with malware.

[Sinking Items - Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/project/mm3QvfbX/versions)

## Why?
While playing on Wynncraft I noticed that items in water would gradually float only to snap back down to the bottom of the water. This is because the server is running on 1.12.2 while allowing newer clients to connect, as a result items are actually completely sunk and not floating whatsoever. The reason they float is because the client is running its own physics on the item to get an approximation as to where they are predicted to be, once the client recieves a packet containing the locations of each item, they teleport to where they actually are.

This mod fixes this by preventing the client from running the code that was introduced in 1.13 so that items behave the same way as the server.

## Who is this mod for?
This mod is for anyone who wants to fix the jankyness of picking up items which are floating but not floating because of server/client physics differences.

## Can I use this in my modpack?
Yes!

title: MobFarmLimiter
description: A modern and lightweight mob farm limiter.
body:
# Mob Farm Limiter

Mob Farm Limiter was designed to control farms that bypass vanilla mob caps. It provides full flexibility, allowing users to configure and manage specific mob farm limits via `config.yml` according to their needs.

## Features
Unlike other plugins that periodically delete existing mobs, Mob Farm Limiter proactively cancels mob spawn events before they occur. It restricts spawns based on:
- **Entity Types**: Specify exactly which mobs to limit.
- **Radius**: Set the distance (in blocks) to scan for nearby entities.
- **Counts**: Define the maximum number of entities allowed within that radius.
- **Spawn Reasons**: Target specific spawning methods (e.g., `NATURAL`, `NETHER_PORTAL`).

## Configuration
These are default values; you can add as many sections as needed to the configuration.

```
mob-limits:
  # The entity type to apply the limit
  # https://jd.papermc.io/paper/1.21.11/org/bukkit/entity/EntityType.html
  pillager:
    # Radius (in blocks) to check for nearby entities
    radius: 36
    # Maximum number of entities allowed within the radius
    count: 100
    # List of spawn reasons to apply this limit
    # Reference: https://jd.papermc.io/paper/1.21.11/org/bukkit/event/entity/CreatureSpawnEvent.SpawnReason.html
    # Multiple spawn reasons can be specified.
    # If empty [], all spawn reasons are applied.
    reasons:
      - NATURAL
  zombified_piglin:
    radius: 50
    count: 100
    reasons:
      - NETHER_PORTAL

  oak_boat:
    # This section limits manually placed items like Armor Stands, Boats, Minecarts, and End Crystals.
    radius: 16
    count: 10
    # Do not add a "reasons" section here, it is not needed.
```

## Commands
- `/mobfarmlimiter reload`: Reloads the configuration file.

## Permissions
- `mobfarmlimiter.command.reload`: Allows use of the reload command. (Default: OP)

title: Player Disguise
description: Add new profiles with custom names and skins
body:
[![Player Disguise banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise/1.21.1-release/docs/media/playerdisguise-banner.gif)](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise)

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-v1.21.1-blue?style=flat-square)](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us)
[![NeoForge Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-v21.1.219-orange?style=flat-square)](https://neoforged.net/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MPL_2.0-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/)

---

Pick a name. Pick a skin. Step into a new identity *on the server, for everyone, in real time*.

Player Disguise is a custom-alias system for servers, character-driven worlds, and anyone who wants a fresh identity without leaving their account. Build a book of profiles client-side, then present any one of them to the rest of the server: chat, tab, nameplates, F5 self-view, voice icons, map markers, and more.

Runs on **NeoForge 1.21.1**. A Fabric port is planned.


## What's in the box

- **A profile book.** Create profiles with a custom name and skin PNG. Wide and slim model support. Skins are validated against vanilla specs (64×64 or 64×32, ≤64 KB) before they ever touch the server.
- **Server-wide visibility.** Once you join, everyone on the server sees your alias and skin: chat, tab list, nameplates, F5 self-view.
- **Persistent claims.** Your alias and skin stay reserved on the server across logouts. Other players can't snatch a name you're using.
- **Cooldown on release.** When you switch profiles, your previous alias enters a per-player cooldown so a quick rejoin doesn't lose it.
- **Efficient skin transfer.** Two-step handshake: the server only requests data when it doesn't already have the skin saved. No re-uploading on every login.
- **Storage hygiene.** Server-side cleanup routines keep the skin cache bounded.


## For server admins

Aliases exist for fun, not for hiding. Operators always have a real-name lookup:

- `/whois <alias>` — name-anchored. Returns every player who has ever used that alias, with timestamps.
- `/namehistory <player>` — player-anchored. Returns every alias that player has ever held, including their real-name intervals.
- Standard moderation commands (`/ban`, `/kick`, etc.) operate on real names, not aliases.
- **Real-name collision kick.** If a player joins under their real Mojang name and someone else is currently disguised as that name, the disguised player is temporarily kicked. Your real name is always your real name.
- **Reserved-name list.** A player can never claim an alias that matches another player's real Mojang name.


## Compatibility

| Mod | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) | Voice icons follow the disguised identity |
| [BlueMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/bluemap) | Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap) | Map markers reflect the disguise |
| [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads) | Chat avatars match the disguised skin |


## Data & privacy

Skin PNGs and aliases travel only between the modded client and the modded server you're joining. There are no external skin hosts, no third-party APIs, no telemetry. Vanilla servers will still see your real Minecraft identity.


## Credits

By WeaversWorkshop. Licensed under MPL-2.0.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/weaversworkshop/playerdisguise/issues).

# Sanity-Level-MOD A Fabric mod that introduces the concept of sanity to Minecraft. 正気度の概念をマイクラに導入するFabric用Mod --- ## Overview This mod introduces a Sanity (Mental Health) system to Minecraft, adding a sanity gauge and various items to manage your mental state. ### Mechanics - **Sanity Levels** - **Decrease**: Staying in dark areas, hostile dimensions/biomes, or being near monsters. - **Recovery**: Staying in peaceful biomes (e.g., Plains), being in sunlight, or staying near tamed pets (Dogs, Cats). - **Penalties** As Sanity drops, players experience: - Visual distortions (Monochrome shaders, noise) - Auditory hallucinations (Ghostly sounds) - Involuntary item dropping - Taking continuous damage when Sanity reaches 0. --- ## Featured Items - **Caramel**: Restores 1 Hunger point.
- **Milk Caramel**: Eating it slightly restores both Sanity and Hunger, granting a brief "Calm" effect.
- **Knot of Serenity**: A powerful eitem that negates all Sanity loss while held in the inventory.

- **Potion of Sanity**: Provides the "Calm" effect. Brewed with Glowstone Dust and Awkward Potion. ・Strange Potion + Brewing with Glowstone, extended with Redstone --- ## 日本語概要 (Japanese Overview) プレイヤーに正気度ゲージ、調整用アイテムが複数追加されます。 ### 特徴 - **正気度**: 暗闇や敵モブの近くなどで減少し、日光やテイム済みモブの近くで回復します。 - **ペナルティ**: 減少に伴い、視界の悪化（モノクロ化・ノイズ）、幻聴、アイテムの自動ドロップが発生し、0になるとダメージを受けます。 ### アイテム - **キャラメル / ミルクキャラメル**: 満腹度や正気度を回復します。 - **安寧の結び目**: 所持している間、正気度の減少を完全に無効化するアイテムです。 - **精神安定のポーション**: 冷静エフェクトを付与します。 ・奇妙なポーション+グロウストーンで醸造、レッドストーンで延長 --- ## Environment & Credits - **Platform**: Fabric Loader - **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.1 - **License**: [MIT](LICENSE) - **Developed by**: kyonshi ## Dependencies (前提Mod) [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) : Required for the mod to function. # ⛏️ VeinMinerPro
> **High-performance, ore-only vein mining for modern Paper/Spigot servers.**

VeinMinerPro is a lightweight utility designed for server owners who want the efficiency of chain-mining without the performance cost. Built on **Java 21**, it ensures your TPS stays at 20.0 while clearing entire ore veins in a single click.

---

### 🚀 Performance & Logic
* **Queue-Based BFS:** Optimized algorithm prevents server lag during large mining operations.
* **Smart Grouping:** Automatically connects Stone, Deepslate, and Nether ore variants.
* **Metadata Tracking:** Identifies player-placed blocks to prevent "storage mining" exploits.
* **Safety Buffer:** Automatically stops the process before your tool breaks (stops at 1 HP).

### 🛠️ Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/vm toggle` | Turn VeinMiner on/off | `veinminer.toggle` |
| `/vm reload` | Reload config.yml | `veinminer.reload` |

title: Greedy Meshing
description: A mod that adds greedy meshing to Minecraft which should increase performance an reduce draw calls
body:
## GreedyMeshing

GreedyMeshing is a rendering optimization mod for Fabric **1.21.11** that experiments with greedy meshing techniques for chunk geometry generation.

### Overview

In vanilla Minecraft, block faces are typically generated individually during chunk mesh building. GreedyMeshing attempts to merge adjacent faces of the same block type into larger quads during mesh generation. This can reduce the number of faces generated for flat or uniform surfaces.

For example, a flat wall made from many identical blocks may be represented by fewer quads when possible.

### Features

* **Greedy meshing algorithm**
  Uses a sweep-based approach to merge adjacent block faces during chunk mesh generation.

* **Experimental performance optimization**
  In some scenarios, reducing the number of generated faces may decrease geometry complexity and GPU workload.

* **Debug tools**
  Includes a wireframe/debug mode for visualizing generated chunk meshes.

### Compatibility

* Designed for **Fabric 1.21.11**
* Because it modifies parts of the rendering pipeline, it may conflict with other rendering or shader-related mods.

### Status

This project is experimental and intended primarily for testing greedy meshing techniques in Minecraft’s rendering pipeline. Performance improvements may vary depending on hardware, world geometry, and mod combinations.

title: Beacon Boost
description: Beacons done right. Range now scales with **every** block upgraded in your pyramid (counted as configurable groups), designed to feel like it always belonged in Minecraft. Server-side only and singleplayer compatible.
body:
# Beacon Boost

**Beacon Boost** is a Fabric mod that makes beacon range scale with the materials you use to build the pyramid, using only vanilla mechanics. It works in singleplayer, and as a server‑side-only mod.

## Features

### Default behavior

By default, Beacon Boost counts base blocks in small groups and adds extra range based on the material. All of these values (group size, per‑material bonuses, max range, vertical behavior, unloaded‑chunk behavior) can be tuned in config/beaconboost.json. 

The default behavior is set as follows:

- Group size: 2 blocks 

- +0 blocks of range per group of iron blocks  
- +1 block of range per group of gold blocks  
- +2 blocks of range per group of emerald blocks  
- +4 blocks of range per group of diamond blocks  
- +6 blocks of range per group of netherite blocks  

- Maximum horizontal range: 500 blocks (radius)

- Vertical range now extends infinitely downward as well as upward.

### Additional notes

- Beacon Boost is built with servers in mind: it tracks beacons efficiently, continues to apply effects from cached data even when beacon chunks are unloaded (given player is still within the radius), and adds no client‑side UI requirement.

- Target version: Minecraft 1.21.11+ with Fabric. Earlier 1.21.x versions may work but are not officially tested.

- Currently, only valid vanilla beacon base materials are supported.

## Feedback and feature requests

Found a bug, have a suggestion, or want a new config option?

Please feel free to open an issue on the GitHub repository that describes your setup (Minecraft version, Fabric/Loader version, other relevant mods) and what you’d like to see changed. I actively use these issues to plan fixes and new features, so don’t hesitate to file bug reports, balance feedback, or feature requests. :)

## Inspiration

This mod is inspired by the datapack **“Increased Range Beacons”** by brisai:  
https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/increased-range-beacons-multiplayer-compatible/

BeaconBoost is a from‑scratch reimplementation in Java for the Fabric modding ecosystem. Please support the original datapack and its author.

body:
# Bottle Your XP

**Tired of losing your levels upon death? Need a way to trade experience with friends?**

**Better Than XP Bottles** is the ultimate utility for experience management. Simple, intuitive, and perfectly balanced.

---

##  Key Features

###  True Level Storage
Most mods only store experience *points*, which can be inefficient due to how Minecraft's level scaling works. **Bottle Your XP** stores **exact levels**. If you put 10 levels in, you get 10 levels back.

###  Effortless Bottling
No complex machinery needed. Just hold a glass bottle and **Shift + Right-click**. 
- Your levels are instantly transferred.
- The bottle is automatically labeled with the level count.
- Bottles stack naturally in your backpack or chests.

###  Full Configuration
Tailor the mod to your server's needs. Whether you want small 5-level vials or massive 50-level jars, you're in control.

---

##  How to Play

1. **Bottle it up**: Sneak and Right-click with an empty bottle.
2. **Bank it**: Stack your level bottles in a chest for safekeeping.
3. **Use it**: Throw like a normal splash bottle to instantly regain your levels!

---

##  Settings & Compatibility

| Feature | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Default XP per Bottle** | 10 Levels |
| **Configurable Range** | 1 - 100 Levels |
| **Required Dependencies** | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| **Recommended Mods** | [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (for in-game config) |

Download now and never fear losing your precious levels again!

body:
# What it is...
Want to play with _only_ Pokémon from your favorite generation? You've come to the right place!

This datapack manipulates the spawning mechanics for Cobblemon by replacing the spawn files with only Pokémon from this generation.

Fun fact: My brother and I used the Action Replay so much on our copy of Diamond that it became unplayable... RIP. Also, Piplup is the GOAT... and the cutest.

**NOTE**: All regional-form spawns have been moved to their respective generations:
- Alolan = Gen 7
- Galarian = Gen 8
- Hisuian = Gen 8
- Paldean = Gen 9

## Mix and match!

Want to include multiple generations? Just add any of my other spawn-filtering datapacks to include them in the spawn pool. It's that easy!

For example, if you want a special playthrough of generations 1-4 (my favorite ones, by the way), just add all four datapacks to your world and you're all set.

- [Gen 1: Kanto](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-1-kanto)
- [Gen 2: Johto](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-2-johto)
- [Gen 3: Hoenn](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-3-hoenn)
- Gen 4: Sinnoh
- [Gen 5: Unova](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-5-unova)
- [Gen 6: Kalos](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-6-kalos)
- [Gen 7: Alola](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-7-alola)
- [Gen 8: Galar](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-8-galar)
- [Gen 9: Paldea](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cobblemon-spawn-filter-gen-9-paldea)

# How it works...
## What this datapack **DOES** affect:
- All natural spawns (...when they just _pop_ into existence)
- Fishing spawns (via Cobblemon fishing mechanics)

## What this datapack **DOES NOT** affect:
- Cobblemon structures (example: Gimmighouls spawning from the chests in Gimmighoul towers)
- Structure loot tables (example: fossil loot tables from sus sand/gravel in fossil archaeology structures)
- Cross-gen evolutions (example: Pichu > Pikachu, Magneton > Magnezone)

# Setup
1. Add datapack/s to your Modrinth profile or modpack
1. Copy/move the datapack/s to your world's datapack folder
    - NOTE: Datapacks in `./datapacks` (base folder) don't apply globally to all your worlds, this is why you must include it in the world-specific datapack folder (`./saves/<your_world_name>/datapacks`) for this to work. More info on the [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Data_pack#Usage).
1. Join your world and enjoy the filtered spawns!

# Disclaimer
Currently, this is *ONLY* confirmed to work with the base Cobblemon mod. I plan to add support for modpacks that have their own spawning rules, such as Cobbleverse, in the future.

# Contact
Issues or questions?

Reach out to me on the official Cobblemon discord (@TacoSocks) or email me at <tacosocks.gaming@gmail.com>.

# TL;DR
Filters Cobblemon’s natural Pokémon spawns by generation. Stack multiple datapacks to combine generations. :)

body:
**This mod supports `3` mod loaders. Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge. Any file ending in `FAB` is a Fabric file, `NEO` is a NeoForge file, and `FORGE` is a Forge file.**

**This mod supports Bedrock Edition! Bedrock edition can be downloaded on our website!**

Bamboo is kinda useless unless you're building... So we made it useful! This mod lets you do more with bamboo, like make armor, make tools, and make more blocks!

# INFORMATION
BambooTools is a Minecraft: Java Edition, Fabric, 1.21.8 mod that makes the wonderfull bamboo block have more of a use. Yes we have bamboo doors, slabs, etc. But it's not enough! So we made this mod make bamboo actually have a better use.

# HOW IT WORKS
Take your normal bamboo fron the jungle, put it in a crafting grid like planks to a crafting table. Take the compressed bamboo block and smelt it. When you smelt it, you can then make your items.

# WHAT WE MADE
Bamboo Sword, Pickaxe, Ladder, Mace, Core, and more!

# HOW TO INSTALL/DOWNLOAD
Use a client that lets you use Fabric loader. Lunar Client or Feather Client being a good option. Select the version `1.21.8`. After you have your fabric loader all setup and ready, download the latest version of the mod (recommended for the best experience), put it in your mods folder, launch the game (if already launched, close and reopen), then it should be good to go!

# BUG REPORT/SUPPORT
We have a Discord server for you to get help, report bugs, suggest mods, and suggest things to be added into mods. You can join it [here](https://discord.gg/6m8gw3KQQM).

title: The Moonjester
description: When the clock strikes midnight, the curtain rises. Perform the ritual, summon the Lucky Star, and trade for items that twist fate itself.
body:
## The Moonjester Mod

Centered around The Moonjester (also known as The Lucky Star, The Harlequin, or The Performer, depending on where you hail from), this mod rewards curiosity, exploration, and those bold enough to climb the highest peaks or plunder from the deepest of darks. 

Craft the Divination Table and seek out the jagged peaks of the world. When the moon is high and the clock strikes midnight, present your offerings.

### Items

Speak with the curious Moonjester to obtain items that manipulate the fundamental rules of Minecraft:

- **The Enigma Coin:** A gambler's charm. Imbue the tool in your off-hand with powerful luck-based enchantments.

- **The Jester's Bell:** A disorienting tool that swaps your position with your target instantly.

- **Lucky Cards:** Villagers seem to treat you as a friend with a card that gives you a sense of unearned heroism.

- **Getaway Cards:** Disappear from the scene and return straight to your respawn point.

- **The Jester's Mask:** Gamble with fate and receive a random status effect.

Or, you can just play with it! The Moonjester is a curious and fascinated creature, and would love to see what's around your world. Try focusing the stars to your Divination Table elsewhere in your world to give it an opportunity to explore.

You may also find relics of a long forgotten past throughout your world.

- Faded Cards: Sparks of magic from lucky ones of the past. Combine them into a Faded Deck for a true boost.

### Getting Started
Find a Wandering Trader to purchase your first Lore Scrap. They can't always be fully trusted, though.

Decipher the clues to learn the components of the Divination Table. 

Prepare for the Curtain Call.


<details>
<summary>Author's Notes :)</summary>

## Author's Notes :)
Hi I'm plourples I made this mod mainly as a lore showcase for my character. It's cryptic and weird and I adore it. I tried to make this feel Vanilla-plus-ish, trying my best to retain things to what Minecraft is on its own, but still representing my character fairly accurately. 

This is my first mod, so it isn't perfect but I think it's neat! I tried refining this into an experience worth keeping in a pack. It's only got a few additions and it's super easy to generally ignore the deeper part of the mod if you're not interested, while still getting some additions and benefits just on the surface. Generally, I hope this is an enjoyable mod for you however deep you choose to explore. 

Also this hasn't been tested on multiplayer, let me know how it goes!!

</details>

title: tnt tag
description: Explosive survival tag minigame for 20-25 players. Pass the TNT before it explodes! Last player standing wins across 6 intense rounds.
body:
# 💥 TNT TAG - Explosive Survival Tag Game

TNT TAG is an explosive survival-style tag minigame plugin for Minecraft servers, designed for 20-25 players. Get ready for intense 6-round matches where randomly selected players carry TNT and must pass it to others before time runs out!

## 🎮 Game Overview

- **Players:** 20-25 players per game
- **Duration:** Approximately 5 minutes (6 rounds total)
- **Objective:** Survive all 6 rounds without exploding. Last player standing wins!
- **Game Mode:** Survival tag with explosive consequences

## ✨ Key Features

### Dynamic Round System
- **6 Fixed Rounds** with escalating difficulty
- Round-specific TNT holder counts (from 1 player to 50% of survivors)
- Variable round durations (25-50 seconds)
- Special glowing effect in final rounds (Rounds 5-6)

### Balanced Gameplay Mechanics
- **Speed Boost:** TNT holders get Speed II, normal players get Speed I
- **No PVP Damage:** Players can only transfer TNT, no actual damage
- **No Splash Damage:** Only TNT holders explode when time runs out
- **Arena Boundaries:** Automatic teleport-back system prevents players from escaping

### Rich Visual & Audio Feedback
- **Scoreboard:** Real-time game state, round info, and survivor count
- **Action Bar:** Updates 2x per second with status and warnings
- **Boss Bar:** TNT holders see countdown progress bar
- **Title Messages:** Round start, TNT transfer, explosion, and victory announcements
- **Particle Effects:** Explosions, victory fireworks, game start effects
- **Sound Effects:** Countdown beeps, explosions, and atmospheric audio

### Auto-Start System
- Games automatically start when 20 players join
- 10-second countdown with visual and audio cues
- Automatic game creation and cleanup

## 📋 Round Breakdown

| Round | TNT Holders | Duration | Special Effect |
|-------|-------------|----------|----------------|
| 1 | 1 player | 40s | None |
| 2 | 25% of players | 30s | None |
| 3 | 25% of players | 30s | None |
| 4 | 50% of players | 25s | None |
| 5 | 33% of players | 40s | All Glowing ✨ |
| 6 | 33% of players | 50s | All Glowing ✨ |

## 💻 Commands

### Player Commands
- `/tnttag join [arena]` - Join a game
- `/tnttag leave` - Leave current game
- `/tnttag stats [player]` - View statistics
- `/tnttag list` - List available arenas

### Admin Commands
- `/tnttag setpos1` - Set arena corner 1
- `/tnttag setpos2` - Set arena corner 2
- `/tnttag creategame <arena>` - Create new arena
- `/tnttag delete <arena>` - Delete arena
- `/tnttag start <arena>` - Force start game
- `/tnttag stop <arena>` - Force stop game
- `/tnttag reload` - Reload configuration

## 🔧 Configuration

Fully customizable via `config.yml`:
- Minimum/maximum player counts
- Countdown duration
- Round-specific settings (TNT holders, duration, effects)
- Debug mode
- Messages in Japanese and English

## 📊 Statistics System

Tracks player performance:
- Games played
- Wins
- Rounds survived
- TNT tags given/received
- Total survival time

## 🎯 Perfect For

- **Mini-game Servers:** Add variety to your server's game rotation
- **Events:** Host tournaments with built-in statistics
- **Community Servers:** Great for 20+ player gatherings
- **Competition:** Built-in leaderboards via statistics

## 🌐 Multilingual Support

- **Japanese (日本語)** - Full support
- **English** - Full support
- Includes player guide documentation in both languages

## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.5+
- **Server Software:** Paper (recommended)
- **Java Version:** 21+
- **Players:** 20-25 recommended (minimum 4 for testing)

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest JAR file
2. Place in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure arenas using `/tnttag setpos1` and `/tnttag setpos2`
5. Create arena with `/tnttag creategame <arena>`
6. Players can join with `/tnttag join`

## 📖 Documentation

Comprehensive player guide included at `docs/index.html`:
- Game rules and mechanics
- Strategy tips
- Command reference
- HUD explanation
- Available in Japanese and English

## 🎨 Design Philosophy

TNT TAG was designed with these principles:
- **Fast-paced action** - Quick rounds keep energy high
- **Strategic depth** - Speed differential creates cat-and-mouse gameplay
- **Spectator-friendly** - Clear visual feedback for observers
- **Fair randomization** - Equal opportunity for all players
- **Scalable difficulty** - Progressive challenge across rounds

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Support

Found a bug? Have a suggestion?
- GitHub Issues: [Report here](https://github.com/yokmama/tnt_tag/issues)

## 👨‍💻 Credits

**Game Design:** Riku
*Implementation:** TNT TAG Development Team

Licensed under MIT License. See LICENSE file for details.

title: rRPNames
description: A lightweight, powerful, and professional plugin for managing RolePlay names with full API support.
body:
**RRPNames** is a lightweight, high-performance plugin designed to do one thing perfectly: provide your RolePlay server with a robust and professional naming system. Built with performance and ease of use in mind, RRPNames focuses on quality and stability, offering a seamless experience for both players and administrators.
![rrpnames](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82b66826bf11dffc7b9cf1dba1656694b51c54a8.png)
Forget bulky plugins that try to do everything. RRPNames is the foundational block for character identity, providing a clean, powerful, and developer-friendly solution.

# Features
**Intuitive Name Setup:** When a new player joins, they are guided through a simple name setup process directly in chat, using clear on-screen titles. No complex commands to memorize!
**Powerful Validation Engine:** Customize every aspect of name validation through a detailed config.yml:

**Allowed Languages:** Choose between CYRILLIC, LATIN, or ANY character sets.

**Length Control:** Define minimum and maximum lengths for both first and last names.

**Character Rules:** Allow or disallow numbers and hyphens.

**Unique Names:** Prevent players from registering duplicate names.

**Auto-Capitalization:** Automatically format names like jOhN dOE to John Doe.

**Full Administrator Control:** A complete suite of commands for easy management:

/rpn set <nickname> <FirstName> <LastName> — Force-set an RP name for any player, even if they are offline.

/rpn reset <nickname> — Reset a player's name and prompt them to set a new one on their next join.

/rpn reload — Reload the configuration file without restarting the server.

**Seamless PlaceholderAPI Integration:** RRPNames provides a rich set of placeholders for use in any other plugin (TAB, chat managers, scoreboards, etc.):

%rrpnames_fullname% — The player's full RP name.

%rrpnames_firstname% — The first name only.

%rrpnames_lastname% — The last name only.

%rrpnames_initials% — The first name and last initial (e.g., "John D.").

**Automatic Update Checker:** The plugin automatically checks for new versions on GitHub, notifying operators in-game and in the console to ensure you're always running the latest, most stable release.

**Extensive Developer API:** RRPNames is built as a platform. It exposes a powerful and easy-to-use API, allowing other developers to create addons and integrate our naming system into their own plugins (e.g., for ID cards, factions, or acquaintance systems).
RRPNames is more than just a plugin—it's the definitive foundation for character identity on your server. Simple, fast, and done right.

# config.yml
```

# ---------------------------------------------------- #
#                   RRPNames by reallmerry             #
# ---------------------------------------------------- #

# The prefix used in all plugin messages.
plugin-prefix: "&#EA3434&lr&lS&#DD2D35&lt&#D72A36&lu&#D12737&ld&#CA2337&li&#C42038&lo &c»&r"

# ---------------------------------------------------- #
#                  NAME SETUP SETTINGS                 #
# ---------------------------------------------------- #
setup:
  # Should the title asking for name registration be looped until the player sets a name?
  loop-title: true
  # The interval in seconds for resending the title.
  loop-interval-seconds: 5
  # Should player movement and chat be blocked until a name is set?
  block-actions-before-setup: true

# ---------------------------------------------------- #
#                NAME VALIDATION SETTINGS              #
# ---------------------------------------------------- #
validation:
  # The allowed language for names.
  # CYRILLIC - Only Cyrillic letters (e.g., а-я, А-Я)
  # LATIN - Only Latin letters (a-z, A-Z)
  # ANY - Any letters
  language: "LATIN"

  # Allow numbers in the name? (true/false)
  allow-numbers: false

  # Allow hyphens in the name? (e.g., for names like 'Anne-Marie')
  allow-hyphens: true

  # Minimum and maximum length for the first name.
  min-firstname-length: 3
  max-firstname-length: 15

  # Minimum and maximum length for the last name.
  min-lastname-length: 3
  max-lastname-length: 15

  # Prevent different players from using the same RP name?
  prevent-duplicates: true

  # Automatically capitalize the first letter of the first and last name, making others lowercase.
  # For example, "jOHn DOE" -> "John Doe"
  force-capitalization: true

# ---------------------------------------------------- #
#              PLACEHOLDERAPI INTEGRATION              #
# ---------------------------------------------------- #
display:
  placeholders:
    # What to display in placeholders if the RP name is not set.
    # For example, %rrpnames_fullname% will return "Unknown"
    name-not-set-text: "Unknown"

# ---------------------------------------------------- #
#                         MESSAGES                     #
# ---------------------------------------------------- #
messages:
  # Title and subtitle shown when a name needs to be set.
  setup-title: "&fPlease enter your name"
  setup-subtitle: "&fFormat&7: FirstName LastName&f, for example&7: John Doe"

  # Validation error messages.
  error-invalid-format: "&cInvalid format. Use&7: FirstName LastName"
```

title: AutoMessages999
description: AutoMessages999 is a powerful and fully customizable Bukkit plugin that automatically sends dynamic, placeholder-rich messages to players at configurable intervals and when they join the server.
body:
📨 AutoMessages999

AutoMessages999 is a powerful, customizable Bukkit plugin that automatically sends messages to players on your server — on a timed interval and/or when they join. It's built for performance, flexibility, and precision, with full support for permissions, world-specific filtering, per-message configuration, and a wide range of dynamic placeholders.

🔧 Features
⏱️ Timed Interval Messages

Send messages every X seconds to all players, or only to those with specific permissions.

Group multiple messages under shared intervals.

Shuffle/randomize messages if desired.

Per-message world restrictions (e.g. only in world_nether).

Configurable delay before the first message after server start.

Automatically skips broadcasting if no eligible players are online.

Fully throttled debug logging to avoid spam in console.

👋 Player Join Messages

Show one or more welcome messages when a player joins.

Supports global messages or world-specific messages.

Optionally display multiple randomized messages per player join.

Rich placeholder support for personalizing each message.

🎯 Permission System

Global Permission: automessages.use – required to receive any automatic message.

Per-Message Permission: Custom per-message permission tags (optional).

Admin Commands:

/automessages reload – Reloads config and reschedules messages.

/automessages toggle – Enables/disables the auto-message system.

🧩 Rich Placeholder Support

Each message can include any of the following placeholders, which are dynamically replaced before sending:

%playername%      - Player's name
%online%          - Online player count
%maxplayers%      - Maximum allowed players
%server%          - Server name
%motd%            - Server MOTD
%version%         - Server version string
%plugins%         - Comma-separated plugin list
%server_ip%       - Server IP:Port
%uptime%          - Server uptime (HH:mm:ss)
%tps%             - Server TPS (rounded)
%world%           - Player’s world name
%world_time%      - Current tick time in the world
%world_day%       - World age in days
%world_players%   - Players in the current world
%world_weather%   - Weather status (clear, rain, thunder)
%world_seed%      - World seed
%default_world%   - Name of default world
%time%            - Current server time (HH:mm:ss)
%date%            - Current date (yyyy-MM-dd)
%day%             - Day of the month
%month%           - Month (1-12)
%year%            - Year (e.g., 2025)
%hour%            - Hour of day (0-23)
%minute%          - Minute (0-59)
%second%          - Second (0-59)

⚙️ Configuration Highlights

Messages are defined in config.yml under messages.interval, messages.join, and messages.join-per-world.

Each interval message can specify:

interval: in seconds

message: the text

permission: optional permission required to receive

worlds: optional list of world names

Supports Minecraft color codes using & (e.g. &6, &a).

title: Vegan Alternatives
description: Finally a Cruelty Free Minecraft ! A datapack that adds vegan alternatives to all items originally obtained by way of passive mobs. It doesn't remove the original recipes and ways to obtain it
body:
You can find a list of all the new recipes here in the Recipes file on the GitHub (that I linked in the wiki section here), with images of every recipe and texts explaining it if needed.

All recipes can be unlocked organically in the game in the recipe book, mostly the same way the original non-vegan recipe can be unlocked (I have added ways to unlock the recipes for items or blocks that weren't craftable originally, for example ink sacs/coal ink).

No original recipe has been overwritten, so people can play non-veganly even with the datapack installed. The Datapack only gives the option, the possibility of playing without killing animals nor using drops from them that mimic physical-world exploitation of animals (like honey, wool, etc). The idea was that it allows the datapack to be used in SMPs (Survival MultiPlayer servers) where not everyone wants to play vegan.

If you plan on using bundles (an experimental feature), you'll also have to download the Craftable Bundles (Leather) datapack from the [VanillaTweaks website](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/crafting-tweaks/) (to use beetroot leather to craft them).

[Link to the Ressource Pack to modify in-game item and block names](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vegan-names)
(for example changing "honeycomb" into "caramel")

## Download Instructions

- Click on Downloads on the top right corner
- Select the correct version for your Minecraft version (if you don't, there might be compatibility issues and warning by Minecraft)
- Download the .zip file
- Put the Datapack (zip file) in the "datapack" folder of your minecraft world, or use the in-game tool if you're in the world creation panel

title: Keep Default Noteblock
description: Resource pack addon that restores the default noteblock texture.
body:
## Don't like visual notes, but enjoy the rest of a resource pack? This addon might be the solution for you!


Some packs use "visual notes/pitches" as the default for their noteblock texture. However, this serves to be problematic if you use noteblocks in building — an essential part of Minecraft.

While this _cannot_ help with custom packs that have heavily changed textures from the default textures (unless you don't care if it's different), this **_should_** help with vanilla-like packs, or possibly other similar 16-bit resource packs. Your mileage may vary.

_"Why would I not just change this myself?"_, you might ask. Well, if you enjoy using the noteblock's visual notes from a resourcepack, this could serve as an enable/disable switch in your resourcepacks. Hence calling it an "addon." Simply move it over to enable/disable. Like an on/off switch!


Make sure to put this pack **ABOVE** the pack you are trying to change (i.e. the one that uses the visual notes).

### This pack will only be updated periodically. If the red incompatible warning bothers you enough, feel free to change the pack format accordingly. It should work regardless unless Mojang decides to wreck the file structure/formatting like they typically enjoy doing.

title: Villagers stay still
description: Now the villagers can stay still
body:
## How to Use

<details>
<summary>Video Tutorial</summary>
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZH1dPxFptEU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</details>

Use an anvil to rename **any** item in the game to `still`.  
Hold the renamed item and approach a villager. The villager will now be unable to move.

If you want the villager to move again, rename **any** item in the game to `move`.  
Hold the renamed item and approach the villager. The villager will regain movement.

## Notes
- This does not work with wandering traders or zombie villagers.
- If a villager transforms in zombie villager, the zombie villager will be able to move.

Just use [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com) or [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/) and be safe, while you support modders.

This is achieved trough 2 components:

title: Dragon Trail
description: A simple plugin that adds a cool trail to the ender dragon.
body:
# Dragon Trail

![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/dfk4v4Y2?style=for-the-badge&label=Latest%20Version)

## Description

DragonTrailPlugin is a **plugin** that enhances the Minecraft experience by adding an **epic dragon-themed particle trail** behind every dragon in the world. The plugin continuously generates a **dense and extensive particle trail** as the dragon moves, mimicking the breath and energy of a dragon in flight. This creates a dynamic, magical effect that can be seen as the dragon flies through the world.

Additionally, this plugin provides a **command to toggle** the particle trail on or off, allowing server admins or players to manage the effect and optimize server performance. When enabled, the trail creates a constantly flowing pattern of particles following the dragon, ensuring that the action always feels immersive and visually exciting.

## Key Features
- **Dragon Particle Trail**: Adds a continuous, detailed dragon breath particle trail following each dragon in the world.
- **Toggler Command**: Use the `/toggledragontrail` command to turn the particle effect on or off, giving full control over whether the trail is active.
- **Automatic Activation**: The trail automatically activates for any dragon in the world, creating a seamless visual experience.
- **Performance Optimization**: Toggle the trail to reduce lag during high-traffic times on your server.
- **Works on All Dragons**: The plugin works with all dragon entities in Minecraft, creating a consistent effect across your world.

## Commands
- `/toggledragontrail`: Toggle the dragon particle trail effect on or off.  
  - **Usage**: `/toggledragontrail`
  - **Permissions**: Default: all players

## Installation
1. Download the `DragonTrail.jar` file.
2. Place the `.jar` file in your server's `/plugins` directory.
3. Restart or reload the server.
4. The plugin will now automatically generate a particle trail for all dragons in the world.

## Requirements
- Minecraft Server running **Bukkit/Paper/Purpur/Spigot 1.21+** or higher.
- **No additional dependencies** required.

description: Resource pack for a wand with a phoenix feather. (Requires Optifine)
body:
This resource pack allows you to turn an ordinary stick into a Harry Potter wand simply by renaming it on an anvil. At first glance the wand looks shabby and dirty, but this is explained in these lines from the book Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire - *Harry glanced at his wand. She was all covered with gouges and fingerprints. He secretly tried to wipe the wand...*. The resource pack contains two types of wands: a regular version and a wand with the Incendio spell. To get a regular magic wand, take a regular stick and change its name to magic wand with the Incendio spell, take a torch and change its name to Incendio Wand. To get a Incendio Wand !![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/205a73e0b2d92402d2ea3deba020e0be8d3cfe2b.png)(the texture of the torch as a block will remain the same). The second wand goes well with the Dynamic Lighting mod, because then the wand really emits light like a torch. For now, the resource pack requires optifine and cannot work without it. But I'm going to make a version for fabric (you'll need Cit Resevn) and a version that will simply replace the textures of the stick and torch with magic wands. Also, the Incendio Wand has a broken texture, just one black cube, but it's a bit noticeable. If I have time, I'll try to fix the texture. I would be very grateful if you supported the project and me with a donation. Thank you all for your attention.

title: Faithgel's Artificer Experience
description: Artificer Experience is a detailed modpack that combines magical creation with complex crafting. It offers an immersive journey where players explore and master the integration of arcane arts and intricate machinery, emphasizing discovery and invention.
body:
# **Artificer Experience: Mastering the Arcane and the Art of Crafting**


### **Overview**


**Artificer Experience** is a modpack that fuses mystical arts with intricate crafting systems, offering a unique gameplay experience for both aspiring wizards and master crafters. This modpack features a handpicked selection of mods that enhance exploration, magic,combat and building, allowing you to unleash your creativity and magical prowess in a vibrant and diverse world.


### **Featured Mods**


#### **Ars Nouveau**
Dive into the ancient art of spellcasting with Ars Nouveau. This mod offers a flexible magic system that lets you create and customize your own spells. Harness the power of mana, build magical machines, and summon mystical creatures to aid in your adventures.


- **Key Features:** Spell crafting, magical automation, mana management.


#### **Create**
Engineering meets elegance in the Create mod. Build complex contraptions, automate production, and design intricate machines using rotational power. From simple conveyor belts to massive mechanical systems, Create allows you to bring your wildest mechanical dreams to life.


- **Key Features:** Mechanical power, automation, kinetic systems.


#### **Iron’s Spells ‘n Spellbooks**
Enhance your magical capabilities with a diverse array of spells and enchanted books. Iron’s Spells ‘n Spellbooks introduces powerful new spells and enchanting options, providing more tools for your magical arsenal.


- **Key Features:** New spells, enchantments, spellbooks.


#### **Tetra**
Embrace the art of modular crafting with Tetra. This mod allows you to customize your tools and weapons, adding various enhancements and modifications. Discover new materials and upgrade your equipment to suit your playstyle.


- **Key Features:** Modular tools, weapon customization, unique upgrades.


#### **Biomes O' Plenty and new Dimensions (Aether & Undergarden)**
Explore a world teeming with life and diversity. Biomes O' Plenty adds a plethora of new biomes, each with unique flora, fauna, and resources. Venture through lush forests, barren deserts, and mystical swamps as you gather rare materials and uncover hidden treasures.


- **Key Features:** Diverse biomes, unique resources, vibrant world generation.


#### **Quark & Quark Oddities**
Quark and its Oddities extension bring a host of quality-of-life improvements and new content to enhance your gameplay. From new building blocks and decorative items to enhanced redstone mechanics and dungeons, Quark adds depth and variety to every aspect of the game.


- **Key Features:** Building enhancements, new mechanics, quality-of-life features.


#### **Relics**
Discover ancient artifacts and powerful relics scattered across the world. Relics adds a collection of unique items with magical properties, offering new ways to enhance your character and overcome challenges.


- **Key Features:** Unique artifacts, magical enhancements, exploration rewards.


### **Why Play Artificer Experience?**


- **Magic and Engineering:** Seamlessly blend spellcasting with mechanical innovation. Whether you’re crafting intricate machines or weaving complex spells, Artificer Experience provides the tools and freedom to create your own path.
- **Exploration and Discovery:** Venture through a world filled with diverse biomes and hidden treasures. Each new biome brings opportunities for discovery, whether it’s rare resources or ancient relics.
- **Customization and Creativity:** From designing powerful spells to building complex machines, this modpack encourages creativity and experimentation. Customize your tools, craft unique items, and shape your world to your vision.


### Important info
-  I will update this modpack as i see fit cause i use it in my own survival world.
- Recommended RAM 4~6 GB

title: LightAntiGrief
description: LightAntiGrief is a solution that helps prevent large-scale violations such as theft or griefing from players on vanilla servers.
body:
LightAntiGrief is a solution that helps prevent large-scale violations such as theft or griefing from players. It will be useful on servers with a focus on vanilla survival, where plugins like WorldGuard are not used to protect the territory.

LightAntiGrief depends on CoreProtect, so for it to work correctly you need to install it.

Theory

Most violations occur from players with little online time who either do not know the rules or deliberately break the rules, so the plugin is aimed specifically at this group of players.

Also, different players play in different time zones, which can lead to cases where moderators are not online, so the plugin automatically blocks violators who engage in questionable activities. This may be due to the use of triggers that reduce the chance of false positives.

The plugin notifies moderators on the network and the console about the violator, the type of violation and the location of the violation, so that moderators will be notified of violations, and administrators will be able to see special actions (like putItem which triggers when player put items on storage entity) in the logs.

Configuration

Key | Default Value | Action --- | --- | --- trustedTime | 21600 | Time a player needs to be online to become trusted (in seconds) fireCharge | 7 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) getItem | 12 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) putItem | 12 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) breakBlock | 5 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) placeBlock | 6 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) minecart | 3 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) explode | 4 | Number of positives before blocking (If there are no moderators) triggerRandomBonus | true | Responsible for adding a random additional number of triggers banReason | "You have been banned for suspected griefing" | Ban reason

Commands

Command | Permission | Action --- | --- | --- /tpworld {x} {y} {z} {world} | lag.moder | Teleports the moderator to the coordinates of a specific world. /marktrusted {player} | lag.moder | Marks (or remove mark) player as trusted, as if he played trustedTime
Enjoy safe game ;)

title: Thirdcore
description: Turns minecraft into a hardcore mode that gives you three lives, instead of just one!
body:
### Welcome to my first ever semi-complicated datapack, called Third Time's the Charm!

To get started, you'll need to do some things.

You'll need to either use the mod in an existing survival world or server. To begin use the /reload command. **You have to have operator permissions to do this.** If this is a personal singleplayer world that you don't want cheats/commands on for, you can (1) open the pause menu, (2) select Open to LAN, (3) Make sure Commands is turned on, and (4) select Start LAN World. Run the command, and make sure the number three shows up in the player list. After this, you'll have three lives, and after those are up, you'll be set to Spectator mode. **You will be stuck in spectator mode as long as you have less than 1 life.** To reset **EVERYONE'S** lives, run the /reload command. Your lives will show up in the player list, and under your name. (for server use)

It uses custom death messages that tell other players how many lives you have left. 
The person who died gets their own death message. 

If you have any comments or complaints, PLEASE do not hesitate to reach out to me on Discord. My username is soldship.

Thanks for reading this essay, 

_quantumsoldship_

title: StashCache
description: A mod for remembering where you put your items
body:
StashCache remembers items you have seen in storage containers and lets you search for them later with an in-game overlay.

Reqiuirements: [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

After installing, look into some chests. then:

Press `K`, type an item name/id/enchant/lore and StashCache shows where it has seen matching items. Select a result to add a client-side only waypoint so you can find it.

Works in Singleplayer and Muliplayer.

It should support:
- Chests, trapped chests, including double chests
- Barrels
- Shulker boxes
- Ender chests
- Hoppers
- Droppers
- Dispensers

StashCache only knows about containers you have opened while the mod is installed. The cache can get stale if the containers get modified after you look inside them.

This mod does not achieve more than what you could do with a simple pen and paper, but some servers might still consider it a cheat, so be careful. Ye be warned.

**For any requests, troubleshooting, bug reports or suggestions**, please do tag me on [my Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/8T6G8HgM8u).

body:
Tears of Elytra dynamically plays the skydiving music mechanic from The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom when you use an elytra.

The mod also tracks your descent and plays an approach cue as the ground nears, then plays the landing sound from TOTK on touchdown. An on-screen text names the biome you landed in and the distance you covered, acommpanied by the "location discovered" sound effect from TOTK.

Features:

- Dynamic falling music with smooth fade in/out "Landing soon" approach cue triggered by proximity to the ground. 
  
- Touchdown landing sound Landing toast showing biome and horizontal distance flown. 
  
- Fully configurable timings, volumes, and cooldowns via Mod Menu. 
  
- Lightweight; virtually no effect on game performance or FPS.

title: Camp Board
description: A physical project board for tracking shared builds, tasks, suggestions, locations, and materials on Fabric servers.
body:
# Camp Board

A physical project board for camps, towns, SMPs, and community builds.

Camp Board adds a placeable in-world board where players can organize shared projects, track tasks, list needed materials, suggest new builds, and keep completed work archived without relying on Discord pins, signs everywhere, or memory alone.

## What It Does

Camp Board is built for collaborative servers where players are constantly asking:

- What are we building next?
- What materials do we still need?
- Who is helping with this project?
- Where is this build located?
- What ideas have players suggested?

Place a Camp Board, open it, and use it as a shared planning hub.

## Features

### Physical Camp Board

- Placeable Camp Board block
- Freestanding placement
- Wall-mounted placement
- Custom model and texture
- Opens an in-game project board UI

### Project Tracking

- Create official server projects
- Track project descriptions
- Assign project leaders
- Set project status
- Archive completed or inactive projects

Project statuses include:

- Planned
- Active
- Paused
- Back Burner
- Completed
- Archived

### Tasks

Break projects into smaller tasks so players can see what needs doing.

Players can mark that they are helping with a task, and project leaders/admins can mark tasks as complete.

### Materials

Track requested materials for large builds.

Camp Board uses virtual material storage so players can contribute items directly through the board and withdraw them later if needed.

Useful for builds planned with tools like Litematica, where you know exactly how many blocks are needed.

### Suggestions

Players can submit project suggestions separately from official projects.

Admins can review suggestions and decide what should become an official project.

### Locations

Projects can store build coordinates.

Camp Board automatically pairs Overworld and Nether coordinates so players can plan routes from either dimension.

### Archive

Completed and inactive projects can be moved into the archive instead of being deleted.

Keep the board clean without losing the history of what your server has built.

## Server Friendly

Camp Board is designed for small, trust-based servers.

Data is saved as editable JSON inside the world folder:

`serverconfig/campboard/`

Per-board project data is stored in:

`serverconfig/campboard/boards/`

The mod also includes automatic backups and admin maintenance commands.

## Integrations

### JEI

Camp Board includes optional JEI support.

With JEI installed, Camp Board can appear in search with extra info and recipe support.

### Mod Menu

Camp Board includes optional Mod Menu support for basic configuration.

## Crafting Recipe

| Slot | Item |
|---|---|
| Top Left | Spruce Planks |
| Top Middle | Spruce Planks |
| Top Right | Spruce Planks |
| Middle Left | Spruce Planks |
| Center | Book |
| Middle Right | Spruce Planks |
| Bottom Left | Chest |
| Bottom Middle | Birch Sign |
| Bottom Right | Chest |

Recipe layout:

|  |  |  |
|---|---|---|
| Spruce Planks | Spruce Planks | Spruce Planks |
| Spruce Planks | Book | Spruce Planks |
| Chest | Birch Sign | Chest |

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer
- Fabric API 0.150.0+26.1.2 or newer
- Java 25

## Install Info

Camp Board must be installed on both the server and every client joining the server.

- Environment: Client and Server
- Requirement: Required on both

## Good For

- SMP servers
- Town projects
- Community builds
- Build planning
- Material collection
- Shared task boards
- Camp/village coordination

## Notes

This is an early beta release intended for testing before use on a live server.

Back up your world before installing any new mod on a server.

title: Origins Legacy: NeoForged
description: Fork of Origins Legacy, what fork of Origins
body:
# Origins Legacy: NeoForged

This mod is an unofficial NeoForge port of **Origins: Legacy** (BluSpring's Fabric fork of the original **[Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins)** mod by Apace, which updates it to newer versions). Rebuilt for **NeoForge 1.21.1**.

---

## Available Origins

*   **Human:** The vanilla Minecraft experience. No special abilities or drawbacks.
*   **Avian:** Naturally light on their feet. Slow fall, permanent slight speed boost, but cannot eat meat and must sleep at high altitudes.
*   **Arachnid:** Climb walls, trap enemies in webs, and craft cobwebs, but have lower maximum health and can only eat meat.
*   **Shulk:** Extra inventory space (keeps items on death), breaks stones faster, and has natural armor, but cannot use shields and is constantly hungry.
*   **Feline:** Negates fall damage, jumps high, and scares away creepers, but can only mine natural stone blocks when adjacent and has slightly less health.
*   **Blazeborn:** Immune to fire and lava, does extra damage while burning, but starts in the Nether and takes damage from contact with water.
*   **Enderian:** Teleports using Ender Pearls at will, but takes damage in water/rain.
*   **Phantom:** Walk through solid blocks and turn invisible, but burns in daylight and has a lower food capacity.
*   **Merling:** Breathe and see clearly underwater, swim fast, but cannot breathe on land.

---

## Compatibility

*   **Addons & Datapacks:** Supports data packs and custom origins designed for the 1.10 (1.20.1) Origins format, allowing you to use existing legacy addons.

---

## Credits & Licensing
*   **Original Mod:** Created by **Apace** ([Origins Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins)).
*   **Origins: Legacy (Fabric):** Forked and updated to newer versions on Fabric by **BluSpring** ([Origins: Legacy Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-legacy)).
*   **NeoForge Port:** Ported to NeoForge by **Azuban**.
*   **License:** This project is licensed under the **MIT License**.

title: SCP-513, The Cowbell
description: If you hear the bell, you will be able to see him...
body:
The Cowbell adds a new terrifying monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-513, also known as The Cowbell.


SCP-513 is an old, rusted cowbell that can naturally be found on the ground in the world. You can pick it up and carry it, but never ring it. If you do, the sound of a loud bell will emit, and you will be cursed with the Curse of the Bell effect. As a result, you'll start to see SCP-513-1, a tall, thin, gray figure with a sinister face. It watches you from a distance, but when you approach, it disappears, only to reappear elsewhere. The eerie sound of its breathing will alert you to its presence. What’s worse, SCP-513-1 can harm you while you sleep, making it even more relentless. To break the curse, your only option is to die. However, if you want to avoid SCP-513 entirely, you can imprison it in a Gel Block.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-513 spawn?

SCP-513 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-513.

</details>



![SCP-513](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd00d1fec88f8eac43d48ceb4a5e85362f72eea0.png)

SCP-513 is an old, rusted cowbell. When the player sneaks and right-clicks it, they can pick it up. However, if they don’t sneak and right-click, the bell will ring loudly, affecting all nearby players with the "Curse of the Bell" effect. This curse also applies if the bell is used in the player's inventory. If the player sneaks and uses the bell in their inventory, they can place it back down. The "Curse of the Bell" effect causes the player to start seeing SCP-513-1, a tall, slender, gray creature. The more worse the curse becomes, the more frequently SCP-513-1 appears. Whenever the player sees SCP-513-1, it will disappear shortly after, but if the player tries to sleep, SCP-513-1 will attack and cause damage.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: Optimized Mangrove Propagule Models
description: this resource pack optimizes the extremely unoptimized mangrove propagule models, improving performance in mangrove swamps.
body:
all models associated with mangrove propagules range from moderately to grossly unoptimized. this pack aims to fix all of these issues, while keeping the final model visually identical.
## list of changes
- starting with the worst offender, the hanging state for propagules. these models are [comically unoptimized](https://report.bugs.mojang.com/servicedesk/customer/portal/2/MC-262689), due to not removing faces that are impossible to actually see. ![the vanilla mangrove propagule's age 4 hanging true block model, showing that it has 60 faces despite over half of those being unrendered. the left side shows the faces of one of the cross parts.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b120dbdf722d88f9e703ea825bbaa9272c5a24f.png) ![the vanilla model, showing the vanilla texture, and the top and bottom cross elements being seperate.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fcef4c96de027a6a63e3462beb866ef6667ecaaf.png) the hyperlinked bug report contains a fixed pack for these, but this pack goes further. this pack changes the texture so that all previously seperate elements are joined together. ![the modified texture, showing the elements' textures being joined together, so that they can be joined together as one element.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d8e81553a85478de413e335af106a42c0b685c8.png)
- the ground sapling form is alot more simple of an unoptimization. it uses two crosses instead of one, so that it can have the stem be in the middle (causing a mixel, which I am fine with but others may disagree). this pack fixes this by using the standard cross model, and using a 32x32 texture for the block instead. the item form is unaffected.![the modified ground sapling form of the mangrove propagule's model, showing the texture being 32x32 so that the stem can be in the middle.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1cc7b330673df811fe84b83876e76fb784520e2.png)
- the potted form is unoptimized because it's based on the vanilla flower pot, which is similarly extremely unoptimized. this pack uses an all new model (which uses the vanilla texture!) which has a much better face count. it also uses the 32x32 texture mentioned previously.

title: Water Fix
description: This mod fixes a longstanding bug (MC-195271), allowing water to render in block_display entities and enderman. It also allows falling blocks to render block entities.
body:
# Water Fix
This mod fixes the bug [MC-195271](https://bugs-legacy.mojang.com/browse/MC-195271), which is caused by how water's model is not saved in the same way as every other model in the game. Specifically, it's model is generated at runtime based on the water in the world around it. This mod changes how that model is generated, allowing it to be displayed in display entities and in falling blocks.

This mod is required client side, but optional server-side. If enabled, installing it on the server allows blocks with visual data like banners, signs, or campfires to show their data when they are falling blocks.

This is a mod made for a video by Gneiss Name, discussing how weird Minecraft's water is.
> Gneiss Name's channel: https://www.youtube.com/@gneissname
> 
<details>
  <summary>Video this mod was created for</summary>
  
  <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/em2Y4Rm2yiM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  
</details>

### Config

This mod allows you to enable or disable each feature of it. You can reload the config file in game with the client command `reloadWaterFixConfig`. Below is a description of what each option does. 

<details>
  <summary>useSpecialWaterTesselationForNormalWater (default false)</summary>
   This changes the water tesselation for water in the world to the custom tesselation that I built for display entities. It looks a lot like water from the first infdev version that water could flow in.
</details>

<details>
  <summary>renderBackfacesForFluids (default true)</summary>
  enables/disables adding backfaces to the faces in water this mod tesselates. It can look cleaner in certain scenarios.
</details>

<details>
  <summary>renderBlockEntitesInFallingBlocks (default true)</summary>
  This enables/disables rendering block entites in falling blocks, e.g. end gateways, bells, banners.
</details>

<details>
  <summary>replaceFallingBlockRendering (default true)</summary>
  Replaces vanilla's falling block rendering with rendering that accounts for block entities and water.
</details>
