title: CoinlifpXD
description: A simple, robust, bug-free Coinflip wagering plugin for modern Minecraft servers with seamless Geyser support.
body:
# CoinflipXD
### A simple, robust, bug-free Coinflip wagering plugin for modern Minecraft servers.

## Why another Coinflip plugin?
I created **CoinflipXD** out of frustration. Every other coinflip plugin available for modern Minecraft versions was either abandoned, filled with critical duplication glitches, or simply refused to work on 1.21+.

Server owners deserve a wagering plugin that is **stable, reliable, and actively maintained**. No bloat, no bugs, just a clean betting experience for your players.

## Features
*   **Bug-Free & Stable**: Built from the ground up to eliminate common exploits found in older plugins.
*   **Modern GUI**: A clean, intuitive inventory interface for browsing active bets.
*   **Vault Integration**: Seamlessly hooks into your existing economy (EssentialsX, etc.).
*   **1.21+ Native**: Designed specifically for modern Paper servers (Java 21 required).
*   **Geyser Integration**: Native support for Bedrock Edition players through GeyserMC, with custom form interfaces for seamless cross-platform gameplay.
*   **Global & Private Bets**:
    *   `/cf <amount>` - Broadcast a challenge to the whole server.
    *   `/cf <player> <amount>` - Challenge a specific friend (or rival).
*   **Detailed Stats**: Tracks wins, losses, and total profit using a fast SQLite database.
*   **Fully Configurable**: Customize all messages, sounds, tax rates, and bet limits to fit your server's economy.

## Installation
1.  Download the `.jar` file.
2.  Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3.  Make sure you have **Vault** and an economy provider (like EssentialsX) installed.
4.  Restart your server.

## Commands & Permissions
| Command | Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/cf` | `coinflip.use` | Opens the active games GUI. |
| `/cf <amount>` | `coinflip.use` | Creates a public wager. |
| `/cf <player> <amount>` | `coinflip.private` | Challenges a specific player. |
| `/cf help` | `coinflip.use` | Shows the help menu (text format). |
| `/cf cancel` | `coinflip.use` | Cancels your current coinflip (with refund). |
| `/cf reload` | `coinflip.admin` | Reloads the configuration. |

## Supported Versions
*   **Minecraft**: 1.21.x
*   **Java**: Java 21 or newer required
*   **Platform**: Paper (and forks)
*   **Cross-Platform**: Native GeyserMC support for Bedrock Edition players

---
**Source Code**: [GitHub](https://github.com/center2055/CoinflipXD)
**Bug Reports**: [Issues Tracker](https://github.com/center2055/CoinflipXD/issues)

title: LootChest
description: Register any chest as a per-player loot chest. Every player gets their own copy of the loot — the chest never empties, never breaks, and supports cooldowns, holograms, permissions, and more.
body:
# ✦ StarterLootChest

Turn any chest into a **per-player loot chest**. Every player sees their own fresh copy of the loot — the chest never empties and can't be destroyed.

---

## Features

**Loot system**
- Each player gets their own inventory copy when opening
- Three modes: finite (X opens), unlimited, or cooldown-based (e.g. daily)
- Items left in the inventory on close are automatically moved to the player

**Visuals**
- Floating hologram above every chest (name, mode, item count)
- Particle effect + sound on open
- Inventory title shows the chest name

**Protection**
- Chests can't be broken, exploded, moved by pistons, or drained by hoppers
- Zone protection system — mark two corners to protect any area from building/breaking

**Admin tools**
- Graphical overview GUI (`/lootchest admin`) — teleport, edit, or preview any chest
- Live template editor — edit loot directly in an inventory
- Per-chest permission requirement (e.g. VIP-only chests)
- Console commands on open — e.g. `xp add {player} 100 points`
- Open log per chest
- Full `config.yml` — toggle particles, sounds, holograms, customize all messages

---

## Usage

1. Place a chest and fill it with loot
2. Look at the chest → `/lootchest set 1 Starter Kit`
3. Done — locked and ready

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/lootchest set  [name]` | Register chest (n = max opens, -1 = unlimited) |
| `/lootchest edit` | Edit loot template |
| `/lootchest setcooldown ` | Set repeating cooldown (0 = disable) |
| `/lootchest setperm ` | Require a permission to open |
| `/lootchest addcmd ` | Run console command on open |
| `/lootchest protect 1` | Set corner 1 of a protected zone |
| `/lootchest protect 2 [name]` | Set corner 2 and create zone |
| `/lootchest admin` | Graphical chest overview |
| `/lootchest reload` | Reload config |

**Permission:** `starterloot.admin` (default: OP)

---

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.1+
- Java 21+
- No dependencies

# 🌌 Astral Storage

**The ultimate storage solution.** Tired of building massive, laggy rooms filled with hundreds of chests? Astral Storage adds a single, magical, highly advanced storage block to Minecraft capable of holding up to **10,000,000 items**. Designed for players, hoarders, and massive automation networks, this mod provides a sleek, lag-friendly way to store your entire world's worth of blocks in one place.


## ✨ Key Features

* **Massive Capacity:** Store up to 10,000,000 items inside a single block.
* **Deep-Search Bar:** Never lose an item again. The built-in search bar doesn't just search item names—it reads the tooltips! You can search for specific enchantments (e.g., "Protection IV"), potion effects, or custom lore to instantly highlight exactly what you need.
* **Portable (Shulker Box Mechanics):** Moving bases? No problem. When you break the Astral Chest, it keeps all 10 million items safely stored inside. Just pick it up, carry it with you, and place it back down.
* **Custom 3D Model & Audio:** Features a beautiful, custom 3D model that automatically rotates to face you when placed, complete with a unique magical sound effect when opened.
* **Sleek Custom UI:** A highly polished, custom-scrolling interface with a dark astral theme that looks great and runs smoothly.

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipe

Because the Astral Chest is incredibly powerful, it requires some rare materials to craft.

You will need the following items in a Crafting Table:
* **Top Row:** Amethyst Shard | Netherite Ingot | Amethyst Shard
* **Middle Row:** Ghast Tear | Chest | Ghast Tear

* **Modloader:** Fabric

## Login Cooldown
A plugin that prevents players from joining and leaving excessively, with a configurable limit on the number of times allowed within a set time frame.

### Rationale
Originally created to address players spamming chat with repeated leave and join messages, especially as a spam tactic after being muted or a way to circumvent chat spam.

### Usage
`/logincooldown reload` - Reloads the configuration file
`/logincooldown set <joins-per|time-frame> <value>` - Directly modify one of the two config values

Both commands require `logincooldown.admin` permission.

`logincooldown.notify` - Players with this permission will receive the configurable notification message when someone is blocked from joining.

📏 Size Stealer: The Ultimate Growth Challenge
Have you ever felt too small for this blocky world? Well, now you literally are!

Size Stealer is a unique progression mod for Fabric 1.20.1 that turns every combat encounter into a literal growth opportunity. You start your journey as a tiny, vulnerable creature and must fight your way up to become a towering giant.

🧬 How It Works:
The Tiny Beginning: Upon entering the world, your scale is set to 0.25x. You are smaller than a grass block, making the world look massive and dangerous.

Kill to Grow: Every time you defeat a mob (from a simple chicken to the Wither), you "steal" a bit of its essence, increasing your scale by +0.1.

No Limits (Almost): Keep hunting to grow larger and larger. You can reach up to 10x your original size, allowing you to walk over hills and look down upon trees.

✨ Key Features:
🚀 Smooth Scaling: Watch yourself grow in real-time thanks to the powerful Pehkui engine.

🎮 Dynamic Gameplay: Being small makes you faster but harder to reach blocks. Being a giant makes you a powerhouse but watch your head in caves!

🎬 Content Creator Ready: This mod is perfect for "100 Days" challenges, "Can I beat Minecraft as a Giant?" videos, and fun multiplayer sessions.

🛠️ Technical Requirements:
To make this mod work, you MUST install the following dependencies:

Fabric API — The core library for Fabric mods.

Pehkui — The engine that handles all the scaling magic.

📦 Installation:
Install Fabric Loader for 1.20.1.

Download Size Stealer, Fabric API, and Pehkui.

Drop all three .jar files into your mods folder.

Launch the game and start your growth!

title: Create: Petals & Pistons
description: Modpack designed for the whitelisted Petals and Pistons Server
body:
`Create: Petals & Pistons` is a create focused modpack built for our private multiplayer survival server. It focuses on the Create mod, immersive visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and seamless voice communication.

### Key Features

- **Immersive Visuals**: Improved lighting, Fresh Animations, and more.
- **Smooth Performance**: Sodium, FerriteCore, and Iris for a lag-free experience.
- **Enhanced Gameplay**: Tree chopping, inventory sorting, and AppleSkin for better food visualization.
- **Stylized UI**: Custom FancyMenu layout with cute aesthetics and custom buttons.
- **Voice Chat**: Built-in Simple Voice Chat with positional audio and push-to-talk.

### How to Join

1. **Install Modpack**

   - Use Modrinth App or Prism Launcher to install the modpack.

2. **Set Up Voice Chat (Simple Voice Chat)**

   - Go to **Options → Voice Chat Settings**
   - Ensure your input/output devices are correct.
   - Enable push-to-talk or voice activation (your choice).
   - Use the default keybind (`V`) to speak.
   - Adjust volume sliders for individual players if needed.

3. **Log Into the Server**

   - From the main menu, click the **"Join Server"** button.
   - This automatically connects you to the `Create: Petals & Pistons` server.
   - You must be on the allowlist to join. Contact staff if you're new.

4. **Check the Handbook**

   - From the main menu, click the **"Handbook"** button to open the rules, etiquette, and server-specific info.

### Important Notes

- This modpack is exclusively for the `Create: Petals & Pistons` community. Unauthorized access is not permitted.
- Make sure your microphone and permissions are working before your first login.
- If you experience any issues, contact the server moderators via Discord (linked in the main menu).

title: Take to the Skies
description: Take to the Skies reshapes crafting and progression for Tech to the Skies, removing 85 recipes and adding 100+. It enforces balanced automation and skyfaring growth, ensuring every craft fits the pack’s journey toward flight and advanced tech.
body:
If you want a server setup using Take to the Skies with zero effort, get a server with BisectHosting and receive 25% off your first month as a new customer using the code kreezxil

 

Take to the Skies – Core Progression Module

Take to the Skies is the core content mod built exclusively for the modpack Tech to the Skies. This mod reshapes Minecraft’s crafting ecosystem—streamlining early-game clutter, eliminating redundant recipes, and enforcing a deliberate, skyfaring progression. Every crafting decision feeds into a broader technological climb, where resources, automation, and flight must be earned step by step.

 

By rebalancing the recipe tree, Take to the Skies ensures that every achievement—from your first brass mechanism to your final airborne platform—feels earned, meaningful, and integrated into a cohesive journey.

 

This module is not a standalone experience. It is tightly bound to Tech to the Skies and designed for seamless integration within that pack’s balance and automation goals.

Key Adjustments

  • 85 vanilla and modded recipes voided:
        Removed redundant or progression-breaking crafts that allowed premature access to mid- and late-game components.
  • 101 new custom recipes added:
        Introduces tier-gated alternatives emphasizing Create-style mechanics, manual processing, and sky resource loops.
  • Automation pacing:
        Recipes have been realigned to make automation through Create, Immersive Engineering, and related tech mods a deliberate, incremental process.
  • Resource-driven discovery:
        Encourages exploration of alternate materials and processing chains—especially those that align with aerial survival and limited-ground resource play.
  • Integrated progression control:
        Balances all custom recipes with the Tech to the Skies unlock chain, ensuring that mod interdependencies never outpace the intended player tier.

In short:
Take to the Skies is the silent architect behind Tech to the Skies’ progression curve—redefining how players craft, build, and ascend. Every removed, replaced, or introduced recipe exists to reinforce the modpack’s central vision: turning the skies into your new frontier.

title: Mace Roulette Manhunt
description: This plugin select a random player and give him a mace and manhunt plays
body:
## 👑 Mace Manhunt: The Ultimate Chase Begins!

The Minecraft classic **Manhunt** returns with a burst of new energy! Get ready for a cinematic, adrenaline-fueled game of cat-and-mouse centered around the game's newest, most destructive weapon: the **Mace**.

This isn't just a chase—it's the peak of survival artistry!

---

### 🔥 The Core of the Game: Mace Mayhem

Mace Manhunt reinvents the popular game mode by putting Minecraft's newest weapon, the Mace, at the core of an epic chase.

* **The Hunter:** Be the fearsome pursuer wielding the legendary Mace.
* **The Runners:** Be the ones using your wits, collaboration, and speed to survive.

Will you wield the unstoppable force, or will you run for your life until your last breath?

### ✨ Key Features

#### 🛡️ The Hunter's Might
* **The Legendary Mace:** An unbreakable, custom-enchanted Hunter's Mace featuring **Wind Burst II**. Jump high and feel the devastation!
* **Dedicated Tracker:** A special Hunter's Compass always points to the nearest Runner, keeping your prey in constant sight.
* **Wind Power:** Periodically receive **Wind Charges** to quickly close the distance and dominate the battlefield.

#### 🏃 The Runner's Chance
* **Your Only Shield:** You start with one **Totem of Undying**. That's your second chance; after that, you're on your own!
* **The Goal: Survive:** Simple yet challenging: gather resources, set up traps, and outlast the Hunter!

#### 🎬 Cinematic Selection
* **The Choosing:** Every game kicks off with a breathtaking sequence. Players are teleported to a random platform, and as a light cycles through the players around the central Mace, the chosen one is instantly transformed into the Hunter!

#### 🗺️ Dynamic & Replayable
* **Random Arenas:** Each match starts in a **completely new, randomly selected location** in your world. You'll never play the same game twice, ensuring a fresh experience every single time!

#### 🖥️ User-Friendly Experience
* **Spectator on Death:** Don't get left out! When eliminated, Runners automatically switch to spectator mode, allowing them to watch the thrilling remainder of the match unfold.
* **Configurable Head Start:** Give the Runners a critical advantage. A customizable **Grace Period** freezes the Hunter in place, giving the Runners crucial time to escape and strategize.

#### ⚙️ Fully Customizable
* **Tailored to Your Server:** Control the entire experience! Almost all messages, item names, and gameplay settings (like Grace Period duration and Wind Charge cooldown) can be easily configured in the **`config.yml`** file.

---

### 🕹️ How to Play (Simple Commands)

* **Set Lobby:** Set the location where players will return after the game.
    * `/mm setlobby`
* **Add Players:** Add a player to the match.
    * `/mm add <player>`
* **Start the Hunt:** Initiate the cinematic selection and begin the chase!
    * `/mm start`

> For a full list of commands, type: **`/mm`**

**Download Mace Manhunt and jump into the most action-packed chase Minecraft has to offer!**

title: Ghost Gear
description: Go on your very own paranormal adventure using ghost gear!
body:
With the Ghost Gear mod you can go on your very own paranormal adventure! This mod adds new tools that will help you on your adventure.

## Spirit Box

The spirit box is a mysterious device that channels stray whispers from the beyond. When placed in the world it will periodically say random words, offering eerie insights or unsettling nonsense. Right clicking the block will allow you to adjust the frequency or swap out the dictionary of words.

The box currently offers three modes.
- Words - A selection of over 2000 words. This dictionary includes things like items, locations, colors, names, actions, food, and much more. This dictionary focuses on words that are commonly used and does not have a strong bias towards words that are scary or creepy.
- Answers - A small set of answers to yes or no style questions. This dictionary includes words like yes/no/maybe, always/never/sometimes, and try again. It is very similar to a magic 8 ball.
- Alphanumeric - This dictionary only includes the 26 letters of the alphabet, various numbers, and related terms such as hundred, thousand, and dozen.

The box currently offers five scan speeds.
- Rapid - Updates every 5 seconds.
- Frequent - Updates every 10 seconds.
- Steady - Updates every 15 seconds.
- Infrequent - Updates every 30 seconds.
- Occasional - Updates once a minute.

![crafting recipe](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1372359/description_563446b8-322f-437d-b3f1-5d8ce5a96e41.png)

The spirit box taps into the background noise of your game world, using subtle fluctuations in Minecraft's random number generator to select words. Paranormal researchers believe this digital randomness carries echoes of unseen entities trying to communicate through probability itself. This block samples that noise and runs it through an algorithm to produce words from a predefined dictionary. The spirit box is intended for entertainment purposes only. The developers take no responsibility for any messages, coinidences, or alleged hauntings that may result from its use.

Does the spirit box truly let you communicate with the other side? There's still no definitive evidence of that, however a few strange things did happen during development. The first prototype simply spoke random words without any controls for mode or speed. I left it running in the background while coding the rest of the features, and it often felt as though something was trying to guide me. When I made a typo or opened the wrong file it would say things like "this is wrong", "look out", and "be careful". It was as if the box itself wanted to be finished. The oddest moment came later on when it said "kitchen" three times in a row, a near statistical impossibility. I went to check our kitchen, and found that some food my husband was cooking had just started to smoke.

If you encounter anything weird while playing with this mod, please share your story in the comments!

![Spirit Box](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1376/590/screenshot-png.png)

title: Time Sword
description: A sword that lets you control time
body:
# **Time Sword** by JellkaGamez
You can now control **Time** itself, all with one simple minecraft mod!
This mod adds the _Time Sword_, a super powerful tool that will let you
change time however you want.

## What you can do

This mod will let you do many different things with the time sword, such as
- Speed up the game, up to 500x speed!
- Freeze time!
  - Stopping everything but you!
- Unfreeze time!
  - Only works if time is frozen!
- Sprint through time!
  - Let's you specify a time in seconds to sprint through.
  - Runs the game as fast as possible for that desired time.

##  How you can get it in survival!
You can get the time sword in survival with the crafting recipe shown below:

![Crafting recipe for the time sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c619de3c5e5beda8ad1fad19cd355fa204bf81b.png)

## Why would you want to control time?
The Time Sword makes survival more fun and convenient:
- Skip boring tasks like smelting, farming, or waiting for day/night.
- Freeze your enemies mid-battle for an easy win (note: doesn’t affect players).
- Experiment with farms, redstone, and world mechanics in ways you never could before.

title: Havershaw's Survival Modpack
description: This lighter modpack aims to add various building blocks, structures, and QoL features.
body:
Havershaw's Survival Modpack focuses on 3 main aspects of Minecraft to expand upon: Building, Exploring, and Quality of Life.

For **Building**, the main items are Macaw's item mods that add in things like bridges, fences, doors, etc. and the Stonework mod that adds many block variants of already existing blocks. Oh, and vertical slabs.

For **Exploring**, we added Dungeons and Taverns and all its expansions to overhaul a lot of the base structures and add additional structures to explore. Don't forget about Terralith and Tectonic for overhauled world generation. The Waystones mod also allows for easier transport from place to place.

For **Quality of Life**, we added the usual performance enhancing mods such as Sodium and Lithium. Tom's Simple Storage Mod and Storage Drawers for any storage needs. There is also Easy Magic, Elytra Chestplate, and Tool Trims, among others.

Other mods will be added as seems fit.

title: Modrinth Plugin Loader

Modrinth Plugin Loader lets you load plugins directly from Modrinth while your Minecraft server is running—no restart required. Just use the /load <modrinth-url> command and watch your server evolve in real time.
Designed for PaperMC 1.20+, this plugin fetches .jar files from Modrinth, places them in your /plugins folder, and enables them automatically. It filters for Paper-compatible plugins and includes optional auto-reload functionality for seamless integration.
Perfect for server admins who want modular control, live updates, and a streamlined way to expand their server without downtime. Compatible with Paper, Spigot, Purpur, and Folia (experimental). Built with simplicity, speed, and mythic modularity in mind.
Requires Java 17+ and internet access for Modrinth API.

title: Fantasie II - Lite
description: A performance-optimized version of Fantasie II — fewer mods, same legacy.
body:
## Fantasie II (Lite)

**Fantasie II (Lite)** is a streamlined version of the original Fantasie II modpack, created for better compatibility and performance — especially for Modrinth users.

Due to licensing and hosting restrictions, the following mods could not be included in this version:
Mowzie’s Mobs, Astral Sorcery, BiblioCraft, Thaumcraft, Primitive Mobs, BuildCraft, and others.

This results in the removal of some magical systems, complex mobs, and certain decorative or performance-heavy features. However, the core experience of *Fantasie* remains intact — a world in ruins, powerful magic rising once more, and a final hero called to restore balance.

> 🔗 Looking for the **full experience**?  
> 👉 [Play Fantasie II on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/fantasie-ii)  
> 👉 [Or get the full version on Modrinth (Unlisted)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fantasie-ii)

---

### 🧙 What’s still included?

The world of Fantasie lies in ruins.  
Once, mighty heroes ruled the land, building majestic castles and mastering the art of magic. Among them was a powerful mage — a peacemaker — who conquered enemy fortresses not for power, but to bring balance and unity to the realm. For a time, it worked.

But many years have passed since the era of Fantasie I.  
The castles have crumbled, reclaimed by nature or seized by darkness. The mage’s staff is lost. His wisdom, forgotten. The fragile peace he fought for has long since shattered.

But not everything is lost.

A spark of hope still glimmers in the darkness.  
You are the last of a long-forgotten line. The world calls for a new hero — one who can restore the harmony between magic and machine, and defy the growing shadow that now blankets the land.

---

### 🛠️ Technology and Progress

- Harness the power of **Mekanism** to build advanced machines, process resources, and fortify yourself against the chaos.  
- With **Thermal Expansion** and **Immersive Engineering**, engineer vast systems to make survival sustainable — and powerful.

### 🔮 Magic and Mysteries

- Rediscover forgotten spells with **Electroblob’s Wizardry**, and recover ancient tomes lost in time.  
- Use **Botania** to channel the life force of plants, or delve into **Blood Magic** for strength drawn from sacrifice.

### 🗺️ Exploration and Adventure

- Venture through mystical dimensions such as the **Twilight Forest** and the **Aether**, each filled with secrets, challenges, and rewards.  
- Navigate ruins and dangerous strongholds from **Dungeon Tactics** and **Chocolate Quest**, long untouched by mortal hands.

### 🛡️ Gear and Survival

- Arm yourself with unique and powerful items.  
- Through **Artifacts** and **Curios**, discover ancient relics and unlock new abilities to survive what lies beyond the veil of light.

## 📜 Credits

These mods are part of Fantasie II and require attribution. Many thanks to the mod authors!

- [**BiblioCraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bibliocraft) – Adds stylish furniture and functional storage options.
- [**Waddles**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/waddles) – Adds cute penguins to cold biomes for more atmosphere.
- [**Hexxit Gear**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/hexxit-gear) – Brings back classic Hexxit-style armor sets.
- [**Dynamic Trees for Atum 2**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dynamic-trees-atum-2) – Adds dynamic trees to the Atum dimension.
- [**Mowzie’s Mobs**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mowzies-mobs) – Intelligent cinematic mobs with unique behavior and animations.
- [**LunatriusCore**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lunatriuscore) – Required core mod for several utility-based mods.
- [**Astral Sorcery**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/astral-sorcery) – A complex magic system based on starlight and constellations.
- [**MultiMob Library**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/multi-mob-core) – Shared mob dependency library for other creature mods.
- [**Dynamic Trees for Thaumcraft**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dttc) – Adds dynamic magical trees for Thaumcraft.

title: NeON
description:
✨ Customize your join/leave experience. |
📝AUTO-CENTER | 🎨MINI-MESSAGE
body:
✨ NeON ✨

The ultimate player join & leave experience for your Minecraft server

--- ## ✨ What is NeON? **NeON** turns every join and leave into an immersive event... say goodbye to ugly vanilla yellow messages! With just a 'few' edits in the ```NeON\config.yml```, you can: > - Elevate your chat with auto‑centered, MiniMessage & HEX‑coloured messages > - Surprise players with floating holograms (static, tracking or “breathing” animations) on join / leave > - Ignite the sky with custom fireworks (random bursts, hex colours, trails & flicker) > - Stylize join/leave events using particles for subtle ambiance or grand displays > - Get notified via event-correspondant sounds for join/leave (global or per-player) > - Command attention with titles, actionbars and bossbars (global or per‑player) > - Prompt joining players for resource pack usage Born as the spiritual successor to my once popular [☄️ CometWelcome](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%98%84%EF%B8%8F-cometwelcome-%E2%98%84%EF%B8%8F-motd%E2%9C%A8-join-sounds%E2%9C%85-welcome-command%E2%9B%8F%EF%B8%8F-%E2%AD%90join-fireworks%E2%AD%90-%E2%9A%A1auto-center-messages%E2%9A%A1.88264/), now entirely rewritten on modern builds of Paper, **✨ NeON** delivers everything **CometWelcome** could only dream of! From an auto-updating configuration, plug‑and‑play Auto-Centering, HEX, and MiniMessage support, all the way to all‑new join/leave holograms, **✨ NeON** is bound to be the ultimate welcome & farewell experience for your players! ---

--- ## 📦 Feature Matrix | 🚀 Feature | Join | Leave | | ------------------------------------------- | :--: | :---: | | 💬 Custom chat messages

(Proudly featuring AUTO‑CENTER)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 🏷️ Titles / Subtitles

(GLOBAL or PER‑PLAYER)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 📟 ActionBars

(GLOBAL or PER‑PLAYER)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 🚩 BossBars

(GLOBAL or PER‑PLAYER)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 🕹️ Holograms

(**_STATIC_** / **_TRACKING_** / **_BREATHING_**)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 🎶 Sounds

(GLOBAL or PER‑PLAYER)

| ✅ | ✅ | | ✨ Particles

(type, amount, radius, speed)

| ✅ | ✅ | | 🎆 Fireworks

(random bursts / customizable colors, trails, flicker, power)

| ✅ | – | | 📦 Resource‑pack prompt

(custom URL prompt with accept/decline UI)

| ✅ | – |
FULL FEATURE LIST | Click here! # NeON Configuration Key Reference - NOTE: This is a minimized version of the fully-documented config generated by NeON. --- ## 📥 Join Events ### 💬 Chat Announcements (`join.global_message.*`) **Scope:** Global only - **`join.global_message.enabled`** Toggle all custom global‐chat join messages on/off. - **`join.global_message.value`** The text (or list of lines) displayed in global chat. Supports MiniMessage, Legacy §‑codes & PlaceholderAPI. - **`join.global_message.centered`** Center‑align the join text in chat instead of left‑aligned. #### 🎉 First‑Join Override (`join.global_message.first_join.*`) - **`join.global_message.first_join.enabled`** Enable a special message only on a player’s very first join. - **`join.global_message.first_join.value`** Custom text/lines shown exclusively on first join. --- ### 📬 Player MOTD (`join.player_motd.*`) **Scope:** Per‑player only - **`join.player_motd.enabled`** Show a multi‑line “message of the day” to each player on login. - **`join.player_motd.centered`** Automatically center each line of the MOTD for better alignment. - **`join.player_motd.value`** List of MiniMessage strings representing the MOTD content. --- ### 🕹 Holograms (`join.hologram.*`) **Scope:** Per‑player (with optional first‑join) - **`join.hologram.enabled`** Spawn floating text at eye level when a player joins. - **`join.hologram.value`** List of MiniMessage lines displayed as the hologram. - **`join.hologram.duration`** How long (in seconds) the hologram remains visible. - **`join.hologram.distance`** Distance (in blocks) in front of the player’s eyes. #### 🔄 First‑Join Hologram (`join.hologram.first_join.*`) - **`join.hologram.first_join.enabled`** Only show hologram on a player’s first ever join. - **`join.hologram.first_join.value`** Custom lines for the first‑join hologram. #### 🔭 Tracking & Bounce - **`join.hologram.tracking.enabled`** Make the hologram follow the player’s crosshair. - **`join.hologram.bounce.enabled`** Enable a “breathing” up‑and‑down animation (only if tracking is OFF). #### 🎯 Pitch Lock (`join.hologram.pitch_lock.*`) - **`join.hologram.pitch_lock.enabled`** Prevent steep camera angles from making text unreadable. - **`join.hologram.pitch_lock.value`** Two‑float list `[maxPitch, minPitch]` (default `[25.0, -40.0]`). --- ### 🏷 Titles & ActionBars #### ▶️ Player Title (`join.player_title.*`) - **`join.player_title.enabled`** Show a title & optional subtitle to the joining player. - **`join.player_title.title`** Main title text (MiniMessage/PAPI/§‑codes). - **`join.player_title.subtitle`** Subtitle text. - **`join.player_title.time`** Duration (in seconds) the title remains on screen. #### 🌐 Global Title (`join.global_title.*`) - **`join.global_title.enabled`** Broadcast a title to all players when someone joins. - **`join.global_title.title`** Global title text (supports `%joined_player%`). - **`join.global_title.subtitle`** Global subtitle text. - **`join.global_title.time`** Display duration in seconds. #### 📟 Player ActionBar (`join.player_actionbar.*`) - **`join.player_actionbar.enabled`** Show an actionbar to the joining player. - **`join.player_actionbar.value`** Actionbar text (MiniMessage/PAPI). - **`join.player_actionbar.time`** Duration in seconds. #### 📰 Global ActionBar (`join.global_actionbar.*`) - **`join.global_actionbar.enabled`** Broadcast an actionbar to all players. - **`join.global_actionbar.value`** Text (supports `%joined_player%`). - **`join.global_actionbar.time`** Duration (seconds). --- ### 🚩 BossBars #### 👤 Player BossBar (`join.player_bossbar.*`) - **`join.player_bossbar.enabled`** Display a bossbar to the joining player. - **`join.player_bossbar.value`** The MiniMessage/PAPI text shown on the bossbar. - **`join.player_bossbar.color`** Bar color. Valid values: `PINK`, `BLUE`, `RED`, `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `PURPLE`, `WHITE`. - **`join.player_bossbar.style`** Segment style. Valid values: `SOLID`, `SEGMENTED_6`, `SEGMENTED_10`, `SEGMENTED_12`, `SEGMENTED_20`. - **`join.player_bossbar.duration`** How long (in seconds) the bossbar remains visible. - **`join.player_bossbar.direction`** Fill direction & easing curve. Valid values include: - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT` - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT_CUBIC` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT_CUBIC` - `SOLID` #### 🌍 Global BossBar (`join.global_bossbar.*`) - **`join.global_bossbar.enabled`** Broadcast a bossbar to all players when someone joins. - **`join.global_bossbar.value`** Text shown on the global bossbar (supports `%joined_player%`). - **`join.global_bossbar.color`** Bar color. Valid values: `PINK`, `BLUE`, `RED`, `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `PURPLE`, `WHITE`. - **`join.global_bossbar.style`** Segment style. Valid values: `SOLID`, `SEGMENTED_6`, `SEGMENTED_10`, `SEGMENTED_12`, `SEGMENTED_20`. - **`join.global_bossbar.duration`** How many seconds the bossbar remains visible. - **`join.global_bossbar.direction`** Fill direction & easing curve. Valid values include: - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT` - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT_CUBIC` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT_CUBIC` - `SOLID` --- ### 🎶 Audio (`join.sound.*`) #### 🎧 Player Sound (`join.sound.player.*`) - **`join.sound.player.enabled`** Play a sound to the joining player. - **`join.sound.player.value`** Vanilla sound event key (e.g. `ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP`). - **`join.sound.player.pitch_volume`** Two‑float list `[pitch, volume]`. #### 🔊 Global Sound (`join.sound.global.*`) - **`join.sound.global.enabled`** Broadcast a sound to all players. - **`join.sound.global.value`** Sound event key. - **`join.sound.global.pitch_volume`** `[pitch, volume]`. --- ### 🎆 Fireworks (`join.fireworks.*`) - **`join.fireworks.enabled`** Launch fireworks when a player joins. - (These fireworks can not do damage to the player.) #### ✨ Randomized Firework - **`join.fireworks.randomize`** Randomize firework meta per spawn? #### 🎨 Manual Settings (if `randomize: false`) - **`join.fireworks.color`** List of hex colors for explosion. - **`join.fireworks.fade_color`** Hex list for fade colors. - **`join.fireworks.type`** Shape (`BALL|BURST|…`). - **`join.fireworks.flicker`** Enable flicker. - **`join.fireworks.trail`** Enable trail effect. - **`join.fireworks.power`** Rocket flight power. --- ### ✨ Particles (`join.particle.*`) - **`join.particle.enabled`** Spawn particles on join. - **`join.particle.type`** Particle type name. - **`join.particle.amount`** Number of particles. - **`join.particle.radius`** Spread radius. - **`join.particle.speed`** Particle speed. --- ### 📦 Resource‑Pack Prompt (`join.resource_pack.*`) - **`join.resource_pack.enabled`** Prompt players to download a custom resource pack. - **`join.resource_pack.url`** URL to the pack. --- ## 📤 Leave Events ### 💬 Chat Announcements (`leave.global_message.*`) - **`leave.global_message.enabled`** Toggle farewell messages in chat. - **`leave.global_message.value`** List of lines for leave announcements. - **`leave.global_message.centered`** Center‑align the text. --- ### 🕹 Logout Hologram (`leave.hologram.*`) - **`leave.hologram.enabled`** Show floating text where the player logged out. - **`leave.hologram.value`** Lines displayed. - **`leave.hologram.duration`** Duration in seconds. --- ### 🏷 Leave Titles & ActionBars #### 🌍 Global Leave Title (`leave.global_title.*`) - **`leave.global_title.enabled`** Broadcast a leave title to all players. - **`leave.global_title.title`** Main leave title (supports `%left_player%`). - **`leave.global_title.subtitle`** Subtitle text. - **`leave.global_title.time`** Display duration. #### 📰 Global Leave ActionBar (`leave.global_actionbar.*`) - **`leave.global_actionbar.enabled`** Broadcast a leave actionbar. - **`leave.global_actionbar.value`** Text content. - **`leave.global_actionbar.time`** Duration in seconds. --- ### 🚩 Global Leave BossBar (`leave.global_bossbar.*`) - **`leave.global_bossbar.enabled`** Display a bossbar to all players when someone leaves. - **`leave.global_bossbar.value`** Text shown on the leave bossbar (supports `%left_player%`). - **`leave.global_bossbar.color`** Bar color. Valid values: `PINK`, `BLUE`, `RED`, `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `PURPLE`, `WHITE`. - **`leave.global_bossbar.style`** Segment style. Valid values: `SOLID`, `SEGMENTED_6`, `SEGMENTED_10`, `SEGMENTED_12`, `SEGMENTED_20`. - **`leave.global_bossbar.duration`** Duration in seconds before the bossbar disappears. - **`leave.global_bossbar.direction`** Fill direction & easing curve. Valid values include: - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT` - `LEFT_TO_RIGHT_CUBIC` - `RIGHT_TO_LEFT_CUBIC` - `SOLID` --- ### 🎶 Leave Sounds (`leave.sound.*`) #### 🎧 Player‑Only (`leave.sound.player.*`) - **`leave.sound.player.enabled`** Play a sound to the departing player. - **`leave.sound.player.value`** Sound event key. - **`leave.sound.player.pitch_volume`** `[pitch, volume]`. #### 🔊 Global (`leave.sound.global.*`) - **`leave.sound.global.enabled`** Broadcast a sound on leave. - **`leave.sound.global.value`** Sound key. - **`leave.sound.global.pitch_volume`** `[pitch, volume]`. --- ### ✨ Leave Particles (`leave.particle.*`) - **`leave.particle.enabled`** Spawn particles on leave. - **`leave.particle.type`** Particle type. - **`leave.particle.amount`** Number of particles. - **`leave.particle.radius`** Spread radius. - **`leave.particle.speed`** Particle speed.
--- ## 🔧 Quick Start 1. Drop **NeON.jar** and **[PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)** into your `plugins/` folder. 2. Start your server – NeON will create a **fully‑documented** `config.yml`. 3. If you don't already have these **PlaceholderAPI Expansions** installed run: ```mcfunction /papi ecloud download Player /papi ecloud download Server /papi ecloud download Essentials /papi reload ``` 4. Start configuring! - You can use ```/neon reload``` to hot-reload your configuration file. --- > **Tip:** Mix legacy `&` colour codes, MiniMessage formatting, and PlaceholderAPI/NeON placeholders freely – NeON cleverly parses them all! --- ## 🤝 Integrations - **[PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)** – endless placeholders. - **[MiniMessage](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)** – modern formatting tags (``, ``, ``…). - **Vanish Plugins** – [SuperVanish](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/supervanish-be-invisible.1331/) & VanishNoPacket are detected automatically. - (Essentials Vanish not supported.) --- ## ❤️ Support & License Released under **CC BY‑NC‑SA 4.0**. Feel free to open issues or PRs on [GitHub](https://github.com/thelabcorner/NeON). If NeON brightens your server, consider supporting it's development on [☕Ko‑fi](https://ko-fi.com/xhue). ---

Made with love by xHue

title: TierKits
description: Rank-Based Kit System
body:
### TierKits: Higher Ranks Get Better Kits
A straightforward, permission-based kit system that rewards players as they rank up.

TierKits provides a clean, organized kit system where players unlock increasingly powerful kits as they progress through your server's ranks. From basic starter gear to legendary equipment, each tier provides clear progression for your players.

Key Features:
Clean GUI Menu - Intuitive, glass-paned menu with clear indicators for available, locked, and cooldown kits

Rank-Based Access - Control kit access through permission nodes, perfect for rank progression

Tiered Structure - Organize kits in a hierarchy from basic to legendary

Customizable Cooldowns - Set different cooldown times for each kit

Visual Status Indicators - Players can easily see which kits they can claim with color-coding and symbols

Item Preview - Shows players what's included in each kit before claiming

Command Access - Claim kits directly via command or through the GUI
How It Works:
Players type /kit to open the menu

Available kits show with a green checkmark

Rank-locked kits display which rank is required

On-cooldown kits show remaining time

Players can claim kits with a simple click
Simple Setup:
Drop the plugin in your plugins folder

Configure kits in the config.yml file

Set up permissions with your permissions plugin

Ready to use!
Perfect for survival, faction, prison, and RPG servers looking to implement a clear progression system that incentivizes players to rank up.

Permission Structure:
tierkits.command.kit - Access to the /kit command (default: true)

tierkits.rank.vip - Access to VIP tier kits

tierkits.rank.elite - Access to Elite tier kits

tierkits.rank.legend - Access to Legend tier kits
tierkits.admin - Access to admin control of kits
Easy to configure, lightweight, and designed with both admins and players in mind.

title: MT Safe Tools
description: Prevents breaking or damaging with nearly broken tools and weapons, with a toggleable feature.
body:
**Ever been deep in a cave, mining away with your trusty enchanted pickaxe, only to have it break on you at the worst possible moment?** Yeah, we’ve all been there. You were sure it had enough durability left, but suddenly—_bam_—it’s gone. The worst part? You didn’t even see it coming.

Well, now you don’t have to worry about that anymore. **Introducing Safe Tools**, the mod that keeps your tools and weapons safe when they’re on the brink of breaking. You can keep digging, fighting, and adventuring without that nagging fear of losing your gear right when you need it the most.

Here’s how it works: **Safe Tools** knows when your tool or weapon is about to give up, and it stops you from accidentally breaking it. No more throwing your favorite enchanted item in the trash because you didn’t realize it was one hit away from destruction. With **Safe Tools**, you’ll get a heads-up before it’s too late.

**What makes Safe Tools awesome?**

*   **No more surprise tool breaks!** It kicks in when your gear’s durability is low and keeps you from losing it in a critical moment.
*   **Super easy to use.** Just toggle it on or off with a keypress (V by default), and you’re all set.
*   **Focus on the fun.** Whether you're fighting mobs, exploring, or mining, **Safe Tools** keeps your gear intact so you can focus on what really matters.

Next time you’re about to go on a mining spree or tackle a big boss, don’t worry about that durability bar. **Safe Tools** has your back, keeping your favorite tools and weapons safe from the inevitable.

description: Config Presets lets you save and switch between full game configurations. Minecraft options, mod settings, and resource packs as one-click presets.
body:
This mod is the result of countless hours of work and is made possible by players like you. If you wish to express your gratitude for my efforts and support the continued development of Config Presets, consider [donating to me](https://ko-fi.com/).

[![Ko-fi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83b626f277c5869b69a6bce2fe1f40fd291553ca.png)](https://ko-fi.com/) [![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed17662ec38d34d9d83d213f38063ff4dda173be.png)](https://discord.gg/)

![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8c6995e231d4e9dee51c62e7b31b9dfe51efdf7.png)
**Save and switch between your Minecraft configurations instantly!**

Tired of manually tweaking your settings every time you switch between recording, streaming, or casual play? Config Presets lets you save complete snapshots of your game settings and apply them with a single click.

[![Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/727cededb019aacec517e3d25aabead76c55d4ab_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-presets/versions?l=fabric)  [![NeoForge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1ba2ea9a20ef0911c268879c20271438a8827fb.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/config-presets/versions?l=neoforge)  [![GitHub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d6a8891b5526c7425613a9a68f091d92ff39ceb_0.webp)](https://github.com/D3ADK1LLSH0T/config-presets)  [![Curse Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59580d3539ab3a36e1c2c6e56cb83b22c35ed740.png)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/config-presets/)

### 🚧 THIS MOD IS HEAVILY UNDER DEVELOPMENT! SOME FEATURES MAY BE CHANGED, REMOVED, OR ADDED!

## 📦 What Can You Save?
- **Video Settings** - Graphics quality, render distance, FOV, particles, and more
- **Sound Settings** - All volume levels and audio preferences
- **Controls & Keybinds** - Your complete control scheme
- **Resource Packs** - Enabled packs with load order preserved
- **Accessibility & Chat** - Language, narrator, chat settings, and more
- **Mod Configurations** - Third-party mod settings
## 🎯 Quick Access
- **Keybind** - Press P (customizable) to open the preset manager from anywhere
- **Menu Buttons** - Quick-access buttons on the title and pause screens
## 🏷️ Organization
- **Folders** - Organize presets into categories
- **Tags** - Add colored tags for easy filtering
- **Search** - Find presets by name or tag instantly
## 💾 Import/Export
- **Share Presets** - Export as JSON files to share with friends
- **Mod Lists** - Optionally include a list of your installed mods
## 🚀 How to Use
- Install the mod and launch Minecraft
- Press P or click the wrench icon in the pause menu
- Click "Create New" and configure what to save:
- Toggle which categories to include (Video, Sound, Controls, etc.)
- Name your preset and optionally add tags/folders
- Click "Apply" on any preset to switch instantly!
## 🎨 Perfect For...
- **Content Creators** - Separate presets for recording vs. streaming
- **Modpack Players** - Save different configs for different packs
- **Performance Tuning** - Quickly switch between quality and performance
- **Multiplayer** - Different settings for servers vs. singleplayer
- **Testing** - Rapidly test different configurations
## 📋 Requirements
Fabric:
- [Fabric Loader 0.19.2+](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (optional, for easy access to config)

NeoForge:
- [NeoForge Loader](https://neoforged.net)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
## 🔧 Compatibility
Works great with:

- Sodium, Sodium Extra, Reese's Sodium Options
- Iris Shaders
- Performance mods (Lithium, Cull Leaves, More Culling, etc.)
- Most Fabric mods with file-based configs
## 🐛 Found a Bug?
You can report bugs, crashes, and other issues on the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/D3ADK1LLSH0T/config-presets/issues). Make sure you include information about the mods you are using, and attach any crash/log files you have.

title: GuessTheUtils Revived
description: Bug fixes & support for latest versions for a QoL utility mod for Hypixel's Guess The Build.
body:
# GuessTheUtils Revived
GuessTheUtils Revived is a Fabric 1.21.11+ utility mod for the Guess The Build game mode on the Hypixel server.

This is a revival of [aembr's GuessTheUtils mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/guesstheutils), because the original was discontinued. The goal of this project is to port the mod to latest Minecraft versions as well as to fix bugs, no new features are currently planned.

## Features
### Custom Scoreboard
![Custom Scoreboard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/49W6BOju/images/65d5ac748c8bef3105a91258e91b02c059f72b6a_350.webp)

When the mod detects that you're in a GTB game, it will replace the vanilla scoreboard with a custom one, which gives you additional information on each player, such as build state, leaver / inactive state, title, emblem, points gained during round, and total points. Holding the Player List Key (TAB by default) will expand the scoreboard to show even more information.

### Shortcut Reminders
Whenever a theme is revealed, the mod will send a message in chat to remind you of any shortcuts that work for that theme. There is an option to filter out CJK shortcuts, or non-ASCII ones.

The shortcuts list the same one as used in https://gtb.zmh.me/themes, which updates itself automatically and independently of the mod.
### Builder Notifier
If it's your turn to build, but Minecraft is minimized or not in focus, a desktop notification will call you back.
### Name Autocomplete
Now all player's names can be autocompleted with the TAB key, not just the current builder.
### Disallowed Item Hider
Disallowed items from versions 1.9 and above will be hidden from the creative menu, only in Guess The Build.
### Chat Cooldown Timer
If you have a chat cooldown, a timer will appear on your screen, and a bell sound will play when you're allowed to guess again.
### Helper Commands
- `/gettranslation <theme> <language>` displays an approved theme translation and allows you to easily paste it in the chat.
- `/qgtb` queues up for a GTB game.
- `/lrj` leaves, then rejoins (same as `/hub` and `/back`).

## Requirements
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
- (Optional) [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- **Hypixel language MUST be set to English!**

## Configuration
Use [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) or the `/guesstheutils config` command.

## Known Issues
- In very rare cases, multiple people correctly guessing at the same time can cause the order of guesses displayed in chat to be incorrect. As the mod relies on this order to accurately track scores, it will disable tracking as soon as it detects this.
- It's possible for a player with access to the `/nick` command to leave mid-game and rejoin with a different name. Currently, this will disable tracking for that game.
- This mod may not work well with mods that alter the vanilla scoreboard, potentially resulting in both the vanilla scoreboard and the custom scoreboard being drawn at the same time.

title: Reaper's Descendant
description: A mod that focuses on snowballing into Death Incarnate.
body:
# "I will guide you, but you do the work." Sell your soul to the **Cult of Death** and follow the footsteps of the old world to gain god-like strength. This mod centralizes around the _Reaper's Scythes_, they are the primary weapons and tools to your path of death. Reap the souls of innocents and use their souls to empower yourself onward towards **His** status, or use them up to gain tempoary boosts in combat. The Scythes are snowball weapons! They start off bad, and you have to gain power! Patience. Additions:
Spoiler

Scythes

  • Old Reaper's Scythe - "Passed down, generation after generation"
![glowing white purple scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70ebacebe23a0ed3a67807e9f4f2b3a40e54f754.png)

Your first and most important tool in your path! !!You need to get it through the Death Certificate before wielding!! Slay your enemies and innocents to reap their souls for buffs and an ability at 25: Rejuvinate!

Rejuvinate!: Use 10% of your souls to gain Absorption and Saturation. Stacks and resets time, so go wild!

  • Prime Reaper's Scythe - "Trust is bestowed, not bought"
![Glowing white/yellow blue scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7f0ae418d3740e86ea33905c34e2d3fdc2ae6f1.png)

By killing four Withers and using 150 souls - you did it! I'm not going to ask how or even why, but congrats! Buffs are better and an even better ability at 100 souls: Reap!

Reap!: Right-click to use 5% of your souls to afflict all entities in a 7 block radius with Reap effect, slowly reaping their soul and withering them from the inside. For each entity afflicted, gain a level of Absorption and Saturation. And players give two levels, great for PvP!

Tools

  • New World Reaper's Reforger - "Old knowledge stays within footsteps"
![Big hammer with purple and blue detailing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b134ec2f83da6f69b44947b4a0d740f645048b1a.png)

Tool used by the Old World's Cult of Death to forge the first ever Reaper's Scythe! Used to forge the Prime Reaper's Scythe on the Starred Reorger.

  • Bloodletting Knife - "Sacrifices are necessary on the path to the top"
![curvy dagger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d61bcb47359d6b9b441d8bb3360d9bd1a4f99aa.png)

Used on the Death Shrine Confirmation to gain trust with the Cult of Death.

Locations

  • Death Shrine - "Old World is history, and history is never-ending"
![ intricate and detailed block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cab11ea0a2bcdfaae219e7e2b13a1c57af9bb388.png)

The Cult of Death was founded in the Soulsand Valley, and all of their shrines and churces can be found there.

Here lies the Death Shrine Confirmation. Used in tandem with the Bloodletting Knife reveals the Death Certificate, which is used to join into the Cult of Death and receive the Old Reaper's Scythe.

!!This is still in W.I.P. Bugs or unbalance is to be expected!!

title: Zynirium
description: PVP Modpack by Sidirium and Zynex
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96337f16d69a1aca875b23e5759fdd5e7f5046d0_0.webp)

**Zynirium** was built to give PvP players a **clean**, **fast**, and **reliable** client that just works. With MCPVP moving to Minecraft 1.21.11, we wanted a **ready-to-go pack that maximizes FPS**, reduces input latency, and includes **only useful PvP tools — no clutter**, no unnecessary features, and no confusing settings.

**Unlike many other PvP modpacks, Zynirium intentionally avoids unnecessary mods** such as minimaps, chest trackers, or similar utilities. These mods often add visual clutter, provide little value in combat, and are **frequently not allowed on competitive servers.**

Our goal was to keep the pack focused purely on **performance and PvP gameplay.**

✅ All mods included in this pack are **allowed according to the MCPVP Tier List**, so you can use the pack on competitive servers without worrying about disallowed features.
**Please still look up the rules of any Server you want to play on and check if there are any mods not allowed.**

⸻

## ✦ Why choose Zynirium?

⚡️ **Performance-first**

Carefully selected optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and Ixeris improve FPS, reduce stuttering, and make gameplay smoother even during intense fights.

🛡️ **PvP-tuned**

Includes useful combat tools like:
	•	Hit feedback improvements
	•	Totem counters
	•	Status effect timers
	•	Shield fixes
	•	Crosshair and zoom utilities

These features help provide clear combat feedback without changing gameplay mechanics.

🔁 **Stable & compatible**

🧰 **Minimal & focused**

No filler mods. Everything included directly improves PvP gameplay or performance.

⚙️ **Easy setup**

title: SCP-2521, ●●|●●●●●|●●|●
description: A mysterious black figure that appears when its own number is written or spoken.
body:
●●|●●●●●|●●|● adds a new item. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-2521, also known as the ●●|●●●●●|●●|●. 


SCP-2521 is a mysterious entity that appears when its own number is mentioned. This creature is fast, invincible, and able to move through walls and instantly teleporting to its target. Once it reaches a victim, it drags them into the void before disappearing again. Be careful what you type, even writing 2521 accidentally in chat through coordinates or else can summon it.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why are signs and books unaffected by SCP-2521?

Signs and books are unaffected from SCP-2521 due to MCreators limitations. I tried to add this mechanic but wasn't able to make it. At least the chat function works.

► Where does SCP-2521 spawn?

SCP-2521 only spawns if a player writes the numbers "2521" in the chat or has a book called "2521" in it's main hand.

</details>



![SCP-2521](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48c4c16de4a525c24d153b865d1994b291b4f6f8_0.webp)

SCP-2521 is a tall, pitch-black humanoid with long, flowing tentacles and a heart symbol on its head. It manifests whenever the numbers 2521 are written in chat or appears in a signed book’s title, regardless of what surrounds the number. Even coordinates or random messages containing 2521 can summon it. Once spawned, SCP-2521 moves quickly, phases through walls, and cannot be harmed or contained. If its target is more than 15 blocks away, it teleports instantly to them. Upon reaching its victim, it drags them into the void before vanishing.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

title: Screenshot to Clipboard

body:
# Screenshot to Clipboard

> **Press F2. Ctrl + V. Screenshot shared.**

No searching in the `screenshots` folder.  
No drag & drop.  
No “wait, where was the image saved?”

This mod automatically copies every Minecraft screenshot to your clipboard, while Minecraft still saves it normally as a file.

## What happens?

| You do... | The mod does... |
|---|---|
| `F2` screenshot | saves the image normally |
| right after that `Ctrl + V` | instantly pastes the screenshot |
| Discord, browser, chat, bug report | image is ready to share |

## Perfect for

- quickly showing builds
- reporting bugs
- directly posting funny moments
- screenshots without clicking through folders

```text
Screenshot -> Clipboard -> Paste -> Done
