description: 当玩家进入服务器时显示自定义标题|Display custom titles when players enter the server
body:
# **JoinTitle Plugin**  
A simple Minecraft Java Edition server plugin that displays custom titles when players join the server.

---

## **Features**  
- Automatically shows a custom title when players join  
- Supports **main title** and **subtitle**  
- Compatible with **Minecraft color codes**  
- Fully **configurable** content  
- **OP-only** config reload command  
- Complete **command system** with help messages  
- **Multi-language support** (Chinese/English)  
- Dynamic **language switching**  

---

## **Installation**  
1. Place the compiled `JoinTitle-1.0.0.jar` file in the server's `plugins` folder.  
2. Restart the server.  
3. Edit `plugins/JoinTitle/config.yml` to customize title content.  

---

## **Commands**  
### **Basic Commands**  
- `/jointitle` or `/jointitle help` – Show help information  
- `/jointitle reload` – Reload plugin config (**OP-only**)  
- `/jointitle language` – Check current language  
- `/jointitle language [zh|en]` – Switch language (**OP-only**)  

### **Permissions**  
- `jointitle.use` – Allows basic command usage (**default: all players**)  
- `jointitle.reload` – Allows config reloading (**default: OP only**)  
- `jointitle.language` – Allows language switching (**default: OP only**)  

### **Examples**  
```  
/jointitle help          # Show help  
/jointitle reload        # Reload config (OP required)  
/jointitle language      # Check current language  
/jointitle language en   # Switch to English (OP required)  
/jointitle language zh   # Switch to Chinese (OP required)  
```  

---

## **Configuration (`config.yml`)**  
Customize titles and help messages:  

```yaml  
# Language settings (zh = Chinese, en = English)  
language: zh  

# Main title  
title: "&6&lWelcome to the Server!"  

# Subtitle  
subtitle: "&aHave fun playing!"  

# Help message config  
help:  
  header: "&6&l=== JoinTitle Help ==="  
  help-command: "&e/jointitle help &f- Show this help"  
  reload-command: "&e/jointitle reload &f- Reload config"  
  language-command: "&e/jointitle language [zh|en] &f- Switch language"  
  version-info: "&7Plugin version: {version}"  
  author-info: "&7Author: {author}"  
  footer: "&7Use &e/jointitle reload &7to reload config"  

# Multi-language texts  
languages:  
  zh:  
    # Chinese translations...  
  en:  
    # English translations...  
```  

### **Config Options**  
- `language` – Current language (`zh` = Chinese, `en` = English)  
- `title` – Main title shown on join  
- `subtitle` – Subtitle shown on join  
- `help.*` – Help message formatting  
- `languages.zh.*` – Chinese translations  
- `languages.en.*` – English translations  

---

## **Language System**  
- **Chinese (zh)** – Default language  
- **English (en)** – English interface  

All plugin messages (help, errors, etc.) support multi-language display. Switch languages via config or commands.  

---

## **Color & Format Codes**  
### **Colors**  
- `&0` – Black  
- `&1` – Dark Blue  
- `&2` – Dark Green  
- `&3` – Dark Aqua  
- `&4` – Dark Red  
- `&5` – Dark Purple  
- `&6` – Gold  
- `&7` – Gray  
- `&8` – Dark Gray  
- `&9` – Blue  
- `&a` – Green  
- `&b` – Aqua  
- `&c` – Red  
- `&d` – Light Purple  
- `&e` – Yellow  
- `&f` – White  

### **Formats**  
- `&l` – Bold  
- `&o` – Italic  
- `&n` – Underline  
- `&m` – Strikethrough  
- `&k` – Random characters  
- `&r` – Reset formatting  

---

## **Version Info**  
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.x
- **Plugin Version**: 1.0.0  
- **Author**: 114514h  

---

## **License**  
This project is licensed under **MIT**.  

---

Let me know if you'd like any refinements! 🚀

---

# JoinTitle 插件

一个简单的Minecraft Java版服务器插件，当玩家进入服务器时显示自定义标题。

## 功能特性

- 当玩家加入服务器时自动显示自定义标题
- 支持主标题和副标题
- 支持Minecraft颜色代码
- 可配置的显示内容
- 支持OP玩家重载配置
- 完整的命令系统和帮助信息
- 多语言支持（中文/英文）
- 动态语言切换功能

## 安装方法

1. 将编译好的 `JoinTitle-1.0.0.jar` 文件放入服务器的 `plugins` 文件夹
2. 重启服务器
3. 编辑 `plugins/JoinTitle/config.yml` 文件来自定义标题内容

## 命令使用

### 基本命令

- `/jointitle` 或 `/jointitle help` - 显示帮助信息
- `/jointitle reload` - 重载插件配置（需要OP权限）
- `/jointitle language` - 查看当前语言
- `/jointitle language [zh|en]` - 切换语言（需要OP权限）

### 权限说明

- `jointitle.use` - 允许使用基本命令（默认所有玩家）
- `jointitle.reload` - 允许重载配置（默认仅OP）
- `jointitle.language` - 允许切换语言（默认仅OP）

### 使用示例

```
/jointitle help          # 显示帮助信息
/jointitle reload        # 重载配置文件（需要OP权限）
/jointitle language      # 查看当前语言
/jointitle language en   # 切换到英文（需要OP权限）
/jointitle language zh   # 切换到中文（需要OP权限）
```

## 配置说明

编辑 `config.yml` 文件来自定义标题内容和帮助信息：

```yaml
# 语言设置 (zh = 中文, en = 英文)
language: zh

# 主标题内容
title: "&6&l欢迎来到服务器！"

# 副标题内容  
subtitle: "&a祝您游戏愉快！"

# 帮助信息配置
help:
  header: "&6&l=== JoinTitle 插件帮助 ==="
  help-command: "&e/jointitle help &f- 显示此帮助信息"
  reload-command: "&e/jointitle reload &f- 重载插件配置"
  language-command: "&e/jointitle language [zh|en] &f- 切换语言"
  version-info: "&7插件版本: {version}"
  author-info: "&7作者: {author}"
  footer: "&7使用 &e/jointitle reload &7重载配置"

# 多语言文本配置
languages:
  zh:
    # 中文文本配置...
  en:
    # 英文文本配置...
```

### 配置项说明

- `language` - 当前使用的语言（zh = 中文，en = 英文）
- `title` - 玩家加入时显示的主标题

title: PremiumVoucher
description: PremiumVoucher is a comprehensive voucher system that allows servers to create and manage money, experience, and command vouchers.
body:
# PremiumVoucher 🎫

A comprehensive voucher system with player creation support, GUI interface, and advanced management features for Minecraft servers.

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-blue)
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-green)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)

## 🌟 Key Features

- **Multiple Voucher Types** - Money, Experience, and Command vouchers
- **Player Creation** - Allow players to create their own vouchers with fees
- **GUI Interface** - Intuitive graphical interface for voucher management
- **Database Support** - SQLite database with auto-backup functionality
- **Economy Integration** - Full Vault economy support
- **Advanced Management** - Cooldowns, usage limits, and expiration system
- **Permission System** - Fine-grained control over voucher access
- **Admin Tools** - Comprehensive statistics and management commands

## 📋 Commands

```
/voucher create <type> <amount> [uses]    - Create a voucher
/voucher give <player> <voucher_id>       - Give voucher to player
/voucher list                             - List all vouchers
/voucher stats                            - View voucher statistics
/voucher delete <voucher_id>              - Delete a voucher
/voucher info <voucher_id>                - View voucher information
/voucher reload                           - Reload configuration
/voucher gui                              - Open voucher GUI
/vouchergive <player> <type> <amount>     - Quick give voucher
```

**Voucher Types:**
- `money` - Give money to players
- `exp` - Give experience points
- `commands` - Execute custom commands

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# PremiumVoucher Configuration
config-version: 1

# Plugin prefix for messages
prefix: "&8[&6Premium&eVoucher&8] &r"

# Voucher Settings
vouchers:
  cooldown: 30000                    # Cooldown between uses (ms)
  max-uses-per-player: -1            # Max uses per player (-1 = unlimited)
  expire-check-interval: 300         # Check expired vouchers (seconds)
  auto-save-interval: 600            # Auto-save interval (seconds)

# Player Creation Settings
player-creation:
  enabled: true
  money:
    enabled: true
    fee-percentage: 0.1              # 10% fee for money vouchers
  exp:
    enabled: true
    fee-percentage: 0.1              # 10% fee for exp vouchers

# Database Settings
database:
  type: "SQLITE"
  auto-backup: true
  backup-interval: 86400             # 24 hours
  keep-backups: 7

# Security Settings
security:
  prevent-duplication: true
  log-all-redemptions: true
  admin-notifications: true
```

## 🔒 Permissions

```yaml
permissions:
  voucher.*:
    description: "Access to all voucher commands"
    default: false
    
  voucher.admin:
    description: "Full administrative access"
    default: op
    children:
      voucher.use: true
      voucher.create.*: true
      voucher.give: true
      voucher.list: true
      voucher.delete: true
      voucher.stats: true
      voucher.reload: true
      voucher.gui: true
      voucher.bypass: true
      
  voucher.use:
    description: "Basic permission to use vouchers"
    default: true
    
  voucher.create.*:
    description: "Permission to create all voucher types"
    children:
      voucher.create.money: true
      voucher.create.exp: true
      voucher.create.commands: true
    default: false
    
  voucher.create.money:
    description: "Create money vouchers"
    default: true
    
  voucher.create.exp:
    description: "Create experience vouchers"
    default: true
    
  voucher.create.commands:
    description: "Create command vouchers (admin only)"
    default: op
```

## 💻 Requirements

- **Server Type:** Paper, Spigot, or Bukkit
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.16+ (API Version 1.16)
- **Java Version:** 8 or higher
- **Dependencies:** Vault (required for economy features)
- **Database:** SQLite (included)

## 🔧 Installation

1. **Download** PremiumVoucher and ensure **Vault** is installed
2. **Stop** your server
3. **Place** both plugins in your `plugins/` folder
4. **Start** your server
5. **Configure** economy plugin (like EssentialsX)
6. **Customize** `config.yml` as needed
7. **Reload** with `/voucher reload`

## 🎮 Usage Examples

### Creating Vouchers
```
/voucher create money 1000 5    - Create $1000 voucher with 5 uses
/voucher create exp 30 1        - Create 30 levels exp voucher (single use)
/voucher create commands 1 -1   - Create unlimited command voucher
```

### Player Creation (with fees)
Players can create vouchers through GUI or commands, with automatic fee deduction from their balance/experience.

### GUI Interface
- `/voucher gui` - Opens management interface
- Create, manage, and distribute vouchers visually
- Statistics and overview panels
- Admin controls for advanced management

## 📊 Features Overview

### Voucher Management
- **Auto-expiration** - Set expiration dates for vouchers
- **Usage tracking** - Monitor voucher redemptions
- **Cooldown system** - Prevent spam usage
- **Admin notifications** - Real-time usage alerts

### Database Features
- **SQLite storage** - Reliable data persistence
- **Auto-backup** - Regular database backups
- **Statistics tracking** - Detailed usage analytics
- **Data migration** - Easy server transfers

### Security
- **Anti-duplication** - Prevent voucher cloning
- **Permission checks** - Secure access control
- **Audit logging** - Track all voucher activities
- **Validation system** - Prevent invalid vouchers

## 💝 Support Development

If you find PremiumVoucher useful:
- ⭐ **Rate** the plugin on Modrinth
- 💬 **Share** with other server owners  
- 🐛 **Report issues** to help improve
- 💡 **Suggest features** for future updates

## 📞 Support & Community

- **Discord:** [Join our community](https://discord.gg/NJVHMSMR6m)
- **Documentation:** Full setup and usage guides
- **Support:** Bug reports and feature requests
- **Updates:** Regular releases with new features

---

title: EffectsOnJoin
description: A lightweight plugin that gives players potion effects when they join or respawn.
body:
# 🔮 EffectsOnJoin

**EffectsOnJoin** is a lightweight and flexible plugin that gives players potion effects automatically when they **join**, **respawn**, **switch worlds**, or when **day changes to night** (and vice versa).

Perfect for RPG-style servers, lobby buffs, starter perks, and world-specific challenges!

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔁 Automatically apply effects on:
  - Player join
  - Respawn
  - World change
  - Day/night transition
- 🌍 Supports **global** effects and **per-world** customization
- 🎮 Apply effects based on **player gamemode** (Survival, Creative, Adventure, Spectator, or all)
- ⚙️ Reload configuration without restarting: `/effectsreload`
- ⏱️ Fine-tune behavior with conditions:
  - `first_join_only: true`
  - `only_at_time: DAY`, `NIGHT`, or `ANY`
- ❌ Disabled effects are automatically removed from players
- 💯 Works with **Paper**, **Spigot**, **Purpur**, and other Bukkit forks

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Node                    | Description                                  | Default |
|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|---------|
| `effectsonjoin.apply`   | Players with this permission receive effects | `true`  |
| `effectsonjoin.reload`  | Allows using `/effectsreload`                | `op`    |

---

## 📁 Example Configuration with Gamemode Support

```yaml
effects:
  global:
    speed:
      type: SPEED
      amplifier: 1
      duration: 999999
      ambient: true
      particles: false
      enabled: true
      gamemode: ALL  # Options: SURVIVAL, CREATIVE, ADVENTURE, SPECTATOR, ALL

  world_nether:
    fire_resist:
      type: FIRE_RESISTANCE
      amplifier: 1
      duration: 999999
      ambient: true
      particles: false
      enabled: true
      first_join_only: true
      only_at_time: NIGHT
      gamemode: SURVIVAL
```

title: Discord Unleashed
description: Discord Unleashed is a mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that bridges the gap between your Minecraft server and Discord. This mod relays chat messages bidirectionally, announces player join and even broadcasts server start message
body:
# Discord Unleashed

**Discord Unleashed** is a lightweight mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that seamlessly integrates your Minecraft server with Discord via webhooks. Enjoy real-time chat relays, automatic join/leave notifications, and server status updates—all without significant performance overhead.

---

## Features

- **Bidirectional Chat Relay**  
  - **Minecraft → Discord:** Regular in-game chat (excluding commands) is sent directly to your designated Discord channel.  
  - **Discord → Minecraft:** Messages from your Discord channel appear on the Minecraft server console.

- **Player Join/Leave Notifications**  
  - Automatically sends embedded messages to Discord when players join or disconnect from your server.

- **Server Notifications**  
  - Receive alerts when the server starts or stops so your community always stays informed.

- **Fully Configurable**  
  - Customize the server name, avatar, webhook URL, and other settings easily with a simple configuration file.

---

## Installation

1. **Download the Mod**  
   - Grab the latest release from [our releases page](https://github.com/SajmonOriginal/discord-unleashed/releases) or the provided Modrinth download link.
2. **Setup**  
   - Place the mod JAR file into your `mods` folder.
   - Ensure you have Fabric (or Babric for Beta 1.7.3) installed.
3. **Configuration**  
   - Open the `discord_unleashed.json` file found in your config directory.
   - Set `discord_enable` to `true`.
   - Input your:
     - `discord_webhook_url` (Discord webhook URL)
     - `discord_channel` (Channel ID where messages should appear)
     - `discord_token` (Optional: if using advanced features)
     - `discord_serverpfp_url` (Optional: URL for the server's profile picture)
     - `discord_servername`
   - Save your changes and launch the server.

---

## Usage

- **Minecraft Chat → Discord:**  
  Player chat messages (except commands starting with `/`) are relayed to Discord via your webhook.
  
- **Discord Chat → Minecraft:**  
  Discord messages are displayed in the server console, keeping both communities connected.

- **Notifications:**  
  Receive automatic notifications for player join/leave events as well as when the server starts and stops.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Version:** Beta 1.7.3 (using official mappings)  
- **Loader:** Babric  
- **Java Version:** 8

---

## License

Discord Unleashed is distributed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

---

title: Fake Anticheat - Visual AC
description: Another fake anticheat to ward off hackers!
body:
**VACPlugin - Fake Anti-Cheat to Ward Off Hackers**

VACPlugin is a lightweight, non-intrusive plugin designed to deceive potential hackers on your Minecraft server by displaying fake anti-cheat messages. When a suspicious player attempts to run any of the specific `/vac` commands (like `/vac help`, `/vac checks`, `/vac notifs`, `/vac cpu`, or `/vac pdfix`), the plugin responds with a bold and red message stating "Insufficient Permissions". This serves as a deterrent, making hackers believe there is an active anti-cheat system in place when, in reality, the plugin is purely a psychological tool.

**Key Features:**
- Fake anti-cheat messages designed to trick hackers into thinking they're being watched.
- Commands that look like they check for various suspicious activities (like CPU usage, notifications, and checks).
- Simple to install and use—just drop it into your server's `plugins/` directory.

**How It Works:**
VACPlugin doesn’t actually perform any real anti-cheat checks or monitoring. Instead, it generates the illusion of an active anti-cheat system to discourage would-be cheaters from attempting to exploit your server. It can be particularly useful on servers where you want to give the impression of having robust security measures without the overhead of complex anti-cheat systems.

# **Important Note:**

This plugin is **not** a substitute for actual anti-cheat measures. It is purely a psychological deterrent and should be used in conjunction with real anti-cheat software for maximum server security.

title: UnderPressure
description: a realistic underwater experience by simulating the effects of water pressure on players as they dive deeper into the ocean.
body:
Dive into the depths with caution! UnderPressure introduces a realistic underwater experience by simulating the effects of water pressure on players as they dive deeper into the ocean. The deeper you go, the more intense the pressure becomes, dealing damage over time. However, with proper preparation and the right potions, you can mitigate or even avoid the effects of this underwater threat.

## Features:

Realistic Water Pressure Damage: 
Players will take damage based on their depth below the surface, adding a new challenge to underwater exploration.

Customizable Configuration:
Easily adjust the depth at which pressure damage starts, the amount of damage taken per level, the interval between damage ticks, and the warning message displayed to players.

Potion Protection: 
Players can protect themselves from the damaging effects of water pressure by drinking a Water Breathing potion.

Action Bar Warnings: 
Players receive a customizable warning in their action bar when they are at risk of taking damage from water pressure.


Configuration Options:

### depthStart: 
The minimum depth below the water's surface where pressure damage begins.
### damagePerLevel: 
The amount of damage dealt per 5 blocks of depth beyond the starting depth.
### damageInterval: 
The time interval between damage ticks and warning messages, in seconds.
### actionBarMessage: 
A customizable message displayed in the action bar when players are taking damage from water pressure.

## How to Use:

Install the plugin on your server.
Customize the config.yml file to set your desired depth, damage, and messages.
Dive deep, but remember to bring your Water Breathing potions to stay safe from the crushing pressure!

title: Enhanced Endgame
description: Removes elytra, adds warp stones in it's place.
body:
Disclaimer: this is an early beta version, playable but improvements will be made.

 

What is Enhanced Endgame?

 

It aims to improve balance for endgame. Why elytra is removed? Simply because it makes every other method of transport obsolete as soon as you obtain it, and getting it is not so hard anyways. Another reason is that it can cause a lot of lags on servers due to rapid chunk loading when flying.

 

To ease moving around The End dimension, throwing Eye of Ender in The End will teleport you to nearby islands, and this is now the primary way to explore this dimension.

 

Instead of elytra, meet Unstable matter, which can be found the same way as elytra - end ship. But not so easy! You will also need sculk shrieker and heavy core to craft warpstone which will allow you to harness power of black hole and inter dimensional travel. Crafting the warpstone is only the first step though, you will need to make some potions from chorus fruit and ender pearls to activate it.

 

Crafting and usage

 

Warpstone

 

Top item is Unstable matter textures for items are not created yet :)

To activate it, you will need to make Chorus energy. By default, the black hole will jiggle around indicating it does not have any destination set. Entering the black hole in this state will teleport you anywhere in the world, so please be prepared. Also, activated black hole will attract all entities into its center, and will drain 1% of total player's experience every 2 ticks. To set destination for warpstone, you need to craft Empty warp rune. While holding it, right click a warpstone to get Inscribed warp rune with coordinates to clicked warpstone. Next, while holding Inscribed warp rune, right click another warpstone to set its destination to the first warpstone. Will kill/destroy every entity that is not Player.

 

Chorus essence

Brewing recipe - Awkward potion + Chorus fruit

Consuming it gives Displaced effect for 6 seconds. Effect is similar to consuming single chorus fruit, but at greater distance and will trigger multiple times over time.

 

Chorus energy

Brewing recipe - Chorus essence + Ender pearl

Consuming it gives Black hole effect for 6 seconds. Teleports nearby living entities to your location.

 

Unstable matter

Can only be found in end ships. Used to craft Warpstone.

 

Empty warp rune

Crafting recipe - Paper + Chorus energy

Used to obtain Inscribed warp rune with coordinates to chosen Warpstone.

 

Inscribed warp rune

Obtained by using Empty warp rune on Warpstone. Using it on unstable Warpstone will set its destination and stabilize the black hole.

title: LU7 Creative
description: This is a public version of the custom plugin used on the LU7 Creative Minecraft server.
body:
##  About the plugin

This is a public version of the custom plugin used on the LU7 Creative Minecraft server. It has been adapted slightly for public use. I created this plugin as a way for me to get notifications through [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) whenever certain things happened on my Minecraft server. I thought others might find this plugin helpful, so I published an open-source version.

###  Features
- Server Start Notifications
- Server Stop Notifications
- Player Join Notifications
- Player Leave Notifications
- Update Available Notifications
- Player notification bypass permission
- Configure notification preferences in config.yml
- Reload command
- Notification test command
- Automatic update checker

##  Getting Started

To install LU7 Creative on your Minecraft server, download the latest release and upload the included JAR file to your Minecraft server plugins folder. Once you've started your server, head to the lu7creative folder and, edit the default config.yml to include your ntfy server and token details, alter the other settings according to your liking. Either restart your entire server or run the /lu7creativereload command. To test that everything is working as intended, you can use the /lu7creativetest <message> command. You should see a test notification appearing in your [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) instance. You will not receive join or leave notifications for players with the permission `lu7creative.presencebypasss` set to true.

###  Prerequisites

- A Minecraft Java server running either Paper/Spigot/Bukkit Minecraft versions 1.20 from 1.21. We recommend the latest version. The plugin MAY work with other versions; however, this has not been tested.
- An [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh/) server that you have permission to use.

description: Control which Nether portals link together using glazed terracotta corner markers. Place matching patterns on both portal frames and they'll always find each other — no more random portal connections!
body:
**PortalCornerLink by MajinGuil**

Control Nether portal linking with colored glazed terracotta corner markers.

## What It Does
This mod lets you control which Nether portals connect to each other. Instead of relying on unpredictable vanilla portal linking, you create unique "signatures" for your portals using glazed terracotta blocks placed at their corners.

## How It Works
It's really simple:

- Place glazed terracotta at the corners of your portal frame — you don't need all four, even one or two corners work!
- Do the same pattern on the destination portal
- Travel through — the portal with the best matching corner pattern is selected
- No corners at all? The mod defaults to vanilla behavior — fully backward compatible!

## Pattern Matching Rules
- You don't need all 4 corners — partial patterns are supported, more matches = higher priority
- Horizontal orientation doesn't matter — patterns are matched even when mirrored
- Tiebreaker — if multiple portals match equally, vanilla distance priority is used
- All 16 glazed terracotta colors work — mix and match to create unique signatures

![Portals Linking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78aaf1fa524b19f5f9c9f1052a050205625f4602.png)

## Credits
This is an updated and improved fork of the original mods by Starbidou (corner-portal-linking) and Dakes. All credit for the original concept and implementation goes to them.

description: Mine spawn eggs using pickaxes
body:
# DragonMine

## Overview
DragonMine transforms the way players interact with one of Minecraft's most coveted treasures - the dragon egg. This lightweight yet powerful plugin allows players to mine dragon eggs directly with pickaxes, just like any regular block. It completely eliminates the frustrating teleportation mechanic, preventing the egg from moving away when clicked or mined, while maintaining game balance and immersion.

## Features

### 🪨 Natural Mining Experience
- Mine dragon eggs with any pickaxe
- Completely prevents teleportation behavior on click
- Works with both left and right-click interactions
- Customizable drop rates
- Optional silk touch requirement
- Compatible with fortune enchantments

### ✨ Immersive Effects
- Custom sound effects when mining
- Stunning particle animations
- Visual feedback that enhances player satisfaction

### ⚙️ Flexible Configuration
- Simple, well-documented config.yml
- Toggle features on/off based on server needs
- Adjust drop chances to match your economy
- Control permissions for different player groups

### 🔒 Complete Permission System
- Fine-grained access control
- Set who can mine dragon eggs
- Separate permissions for administrative commands

### 🌐 Multi-server Compatibility
- Works seamlessly across server versions
- Compatible with major server types (Spigot, Paper, Purpur)
- No conflicts with other popular plugins
- Minimal performance impact

## Why Choose This Plugin?

### For Server Owners
Your players want a more intuitive way to obtain dragon eggs. After defeating the Ender Dragon, they deserve to collect their trophy without frustration. This plugin provides an elegant solution that maintains game balance while enhancing player experience.

### For Players
No more frustration when trying to collect a dragon egg! The teleportation mechanic can be confusing and time-consuming. Now you can simply use your trusty pickaxe to claim your prize.

### For Survival Servers
Create new economies and trading opportunities around dragon eggs. With configurable drop rates, you can make dragon eggs a renewable yet valuable resource, encouraging End exploration without making them too common.

### For Technical Servers
Automate dragon egg collection in your technical builds. Farm designs that were previously impossible are now within reach, opening new avenues for redstone contraptions and automated systems.

## Technical Excellence

Built with performance in mind, this plugin uses event-driven architecture to minimize resource usage. It hooks directly into Minecraft's event system with no polling or unnecessary processes running in the background.

The codebase follows best practices with clean, well-documented code. Updates are thoroughly tested across multiple server versions to ensure reliability and backward compatibility.

## Getting Started

1. Download and place in your plugins folder
2. Restart your server
3. Configure options in config.yml (optional)
4. Start mining dragon eggs!

Default permissions are automatically granted to all players, but you can restrict access using permission plugins if desired.

---

Download now and give your players the ability to mine dragon eggs the way they should have been able to all along!

title: Mihuco's Modpack
description: The all-in-one modpack for everything without changing the vanilla experience.
body:
# 🌟 Everything, just way better
I put this pack together because I wanted a Minecraft experience that improves basically every single part of the game without losing that classic "Vanilla+" feel.

It started as a personal project so I wouldn't have to spend hours tweaking settings every time I wanted to play, but it turned out so well I figured I’d share it. It’s got everything: it runs like a dream, looks beautiful, and fixes a ton of those tiny "standard" Minecraft headaches.

Here’s the breakdown of what's inside:

## 🚀 No more lag 
I’ve made sure this runs as smoothly as possible, whether you’re on a gaming beast or a literal potato:

- **The Holy Trinity:** Powered by Sodium and Lithium, plus FerriteCore and EntityCulling. Basically: high FPS and very low RAM usage.

- **Infinite Horizons:** With Voxy and Voxy World Gen V2, you can see for miles without your GPU catching fire.

- **Fast & Stable:** Chunks load instantly and the menus won't freeze up on you, thanks to Dynamic FPS.

## ✨ Looks Awesome
The world feels way more alive now, and you don’t even have to touch a config file:

- **In-game Browser:** Thanks to Resourcify, you can browse and download resource packs and shaders directly from the game menu. No more Alt-Tabbing to your browser!

- **Smooth Management:** Packed Packs keeps all those textures and data packs working perfectly together without you having to lift a finger.
  
- **Shader Support:** Iris is built-in. Just drop in your favorite shaders and you're good to go.

- **Immersive Details:** Cool new player animations (NotEnoughAnimations), bushier grass (BetterGrassify) and physical rain (Particle Rain).

- **Dynamic Lights:** Torches and glowing items actually light up the area while you’re holding them or when they're on the ground (LambDynamicLights). It’s a total game-changer for caving.

## 🛠️ Quality of Life
This is where you’ll notice the biggest difference in daily gameplay. Honestly, most of this should be in the base game by now:

- **Useful Info:** AppleSkin shows you exactly how much food heals, and Status Effect Bars keeps your potion timers clear.

- **Easy Inventory:** Sorting is a breeze with Mouse Tweaks, and you can peek inside Shulker Boxes without placing them (Simple Shulker Preview).
  
- **Better Chat:** ChatPlus make the chat way more modern and fun to use. It’s just... cleaner.

- **Less Frustration:** XP orbs clump together to stop lag (Clumps), and if you kick the bucket, Death Finder helps you find exactly where you left your loot.

title: ItemEconomy II
description: Physical economy for VaultUnlocked
body:
# ItemEconomy II
![Player riding a minecart inside a forest holding a Diamond. In the bottom-right corner there's a box mimicking the in-game item tooltip with the title "Item Economy II" and subtitle "Phisical economy for your server!".](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8aaebbfc293287c51b8482c07f175ff7b8dda2ce.jpeg)

ItemEconomy II is a fork of [ItemEconomy](https://modrinth.com/plugin/itemeconomy), keeping it updated to later versions of Minecraft and adding new features.

This PaperMC plugin integrates with VaultUnlocked to provide a unique, item-based economy system for your Minecraft server. Instead of relying solely on virtual balances, players use in-game items as physical currency, adding a layer of immersion and realism to your economy.

ItemEconomy is as powerful as you need and as simple as you want, with every feature being optional.

## Features
- **Item-Based Currency:** Set any Minecraft item as your server's currency (diamonds by default).
- **VaultUnlocked Integration:** Fully compatible with VaultUnlocked, enabling seamless interaction with other economy-based plugins.
- **Simple logic:** Just checks if the user has the item/how many when queried.
- **Customizable Formatting:** Define how your currency is displayed, including singular and plural forms.
- **Ender Chest support:** Items on Ender Chests are counted in the user balance.
- **Built-int optional balance and pay commands** with support for permissions.
- **Translation support** with per-user language and per-language currency name.

## Configuration
An updated example configuration file is available [here](https://github.com/adrianvic/ItemEconomy/blob/main/src/main/resources/config.yml).

## Usage
- Players can earn, trade, and store the configured item as physical currency.
- Once they spend the currency, that amount of the item will be subtracted from their inventory.
- Administrators can customize the item and formatting to match their server's theme.

# EasySprint

  A small status indicator at the top center of your screen:

title: UniLink
description: Allows you to use resources from other directories
body: ## 🔗 UniLink A mod that allows you to use resources from other directories ![preview](https://i.postimg.cc/7hLfZ2TY/0301.gif) ## 💼 Usage This mod works using symbolic links, which can be used like a folder but don't require reusing (copying) resources. Some launchers also use symbolic links, but the mod works independently of them. It's a configuration file. The first field specifies the path to the directory to use, and the second field specifies the path to the folder where the symbolic link should be placed. The final path can be absolute (e.g., ```C:\...\.minecraft\saves```) or abbreviated (```saves```). ![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fde11976eb370b7ad0e335c823529e7eeedc172_0.webp) If you change the directory used for worlds and then revert the change, the game may freeze while searching for and failing to find the required folder. For this purpose, the configuration file has an option to recreate the folders used by the game. ## 🛠️ How it works By default, the mod does nothing. However, you can add data to the configuration to create a link: the path from which resources will be used and the path where the symbolic link will be created. ### What follows from this: * After changing the configuration, new links will be added. Therefore, old, unused links will be deleted. * Since Minecraft creates some folders, the mod will have to delete the existing folder before creating the link. However, since the mod deletes folders without asking, it has a limitation on deleting directories with files inside. This means that if a folder contains any files, it won't be deleted and the link won't be created. Creating symbolic links requires certain permissions. Therefore, some launchers that don't have them won't be able to create links. Solution: Run the launcher as administrator. ## 🤝 Support

title: NG HaProxy Support
description: Adds HAProxy protocol support to Forge servers. See real player IPs behind Velocity, TCPShield, FRP, and Nginx proxies. Features hot-reload config, status command, and connection logging.
body: # NG Proxy Support **Adds HAProxy PROXY protocol support to your Minecraft Forge server.** See real player IP addresses when your server is behind a proxy like **Velocity**, **TCPShield**, **FRP**, **Nginx**, or any other HAProxy-compatible reverse proxy. *** ## Features * **HAProxy PROXY Protocol v1/v2** — Full support for both protocol versions * **Real IP Resolution** — Players connecting through a proxy will show their real IP in server logs, bans, and plugins * **Hybrid Mode** — Supports both proxied and direct connections simultaneously * **Fail-Closed Security** — Connections from unknown IPs are automatically rejected, preventing proxy bypass attacks * **CIDR Notation** — Whitelist entire subnets (e.g. `192.168.0.0/16`) * **TCPShield Integration** — Automatically fetch and whitelist TCPShield server IPs * **Hot-Reload Config** — Reload configuration without restarting the server * **Status Command** — View current configuration and connection stats in-game * **Connection Logging** — Log real player IPs and proxy IPs to a dedicated log file ## Commands | Command |Permission |Description | | --------------------- |---------- |------------------------------------ | | /proxyprotocol reload |OP Level 4 |Reload config without restart | | /proxyprotocol status |OP Level 4 |View current config and active rules | ## Configuration Config file: `config/proxy_protocol_support.json` ``` { "enableProxyProtocol": true, "proxyServerIPs": ["127.0.0.1"], "directAccessIPs": ["127.0.0.1", "192.168.0.0/16"], "whitelistTCPShieldServers": false, "logConnections": true } ``` | Option |Description | | ------------------------- |-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | enableProxyProtocol |Enable/disable the mod entirely | | proxyServerIPs |IPs of your proxy servers (Velocity, HAProxy, etc.) — PROXY headers will only be accepted from these IPs | | directAccessIPs |IPs allowed to connect directly without PROXY headers | | whitelistTCPShieldServers |Auto-fetch TCPShield IPs and add them to proxy whitelist | | logConnections |Log real IP and proxy IP to logs/proxy_connections.log | ## How It Works ``` Player → Proxy (Velocity/HAProxy/FRP) → Forge Server (with NG Proxy Support) ↓ Reads PROXY header Extracts real IP Sets player address ``` 1. Your proxy sends a **PROXY protocol header** with the real client IP 2. NG Proxy Support intercepts incoming connections and reads the header 3. The player's address is set to their **real IP** instead of the proxy IP 4. All server logs, ban systems, and plugins see the correct IP ## Security Model NG Proxy Support uses a **fail-closed** model: * ✅ Connections from `proxyServerIPs` → PROXY header is read, real IP is extracted * ✅ Connections from `directAccessIPs` → Allowed without PROXY header * ❌ Connections from **any other IP** → Automatically **rejected** This prevents players from bypassing your proxy to connect directly and spoof their IP. ## Setup Guide ### With Velocity 1. Install NG Proxy Support on your Forge server 2. Enable PROXY protocol in Velocity's `velocity.toml`: ``` [advanced] haproxy-protocol = true ``` 1. Add your Velocity server IP to `proxyServerIPs` in the mod config 2. Restart both servers ### With HAProxy / Nginx / FRP 1. Configure your reverse proxy to send PROXY protocol headers 2. Add the proxy IP to `proxyServerIPs` 3. Restart the Forge server ## Requirements * Minecraft **1.20.1** * Forge **47.x** * Java **17+** * Server-side only (no client mod needed) ## Credits Made by **xylos** | © 2024-2026 All rights reserved

body:
# Serene Pioneers 3: Cozy Adventures
Explore, gather, build, cook, relax!

The third season of Serene Pioneers, focusing on providing an immersive, cozy, fun and improved Vanilla++ experience.</br>
Whether you want to just build a nice base, make big farms and cook all kinds of different foods, collect all kinds of fish, or go on adventures and explore new structures, dungeons and dimensions, this pack offers something for everyone. Just be cozy, immerse yourself in a world with new biomes and creatures.

The pack includes an ingame guide which purely aims to provide some general explanations and guidance for certain mods, items and mechanics.

## Highlights
- New and interesting world generation and biomes provided by Biomes o' Plenty, Geophilic and Nature's Spirit
- Dozens upon dozens of new structures to explore in the Overworld
- Overhauled combat: New attack patterns, rolling and new critical hit mechanics
- An overhauled End which still stays true to vanilla provided by Enderscape
- Looking for a challenge? Take on the Bosses of Mass Destruction, defeat them and craft amazing items from their loot!
- Explore The Aether, conquer its dungeons and defeat the final boss!
- Lots of new building materials and furniture to build your dream home
- Cook dozens of new food items thanks to Farmer's Delight and its addons or brew all kinds of beverages with Brewin' and Chewin'
- Collect all kinds of new fish and put them on display thanks to Tide 2 and Hybrid Aquatic
- Some recipes have been altered or removed to better suit the pack
- Ships with a handful of optional resource packs that fit the theme of the pack and help increase immersion
- Ships with Complementary Shaders and EuphoriaPatches preconfigured to provide an even more beautiful experience

### Configuration
The pack uses ConfiguredDefaults to handle configuration files. When you launch the pack for the first time it will copy all relevant configuration files into the `config` folder. If a config file already exists in that folder it will **not** be overwritten, unless during an update changes to specific settings have been made that need to be distributed to every client and server.

This also includes the `options.txt` file as well as the shaderpack configurations.

In order to restore a configuration to the pack's default you just have to delete the file and start the pack.

### Notes regarding shaders
As mentioned the pack ships with Complementary Shaders and EuphoriaPatches included and preconfigured to provide a close to vanilla but still visually stunning experience. You are of course free to add and use whichever shaders you like. If you do not like the preconfigured settings for Complementary Shaders you just have to open the shader settings (Alt+F10 by default), edit the shaderpack settings and click on "Reset" in the top. 

### Notes for server owners
- Disable the mod `Mod loading screen` (mod-loading-screen-....jar), otherwise the server will likely not boot
- The pack includes a couple of server specific mods which are not configured and only included for convenience:
  - [MiniMOTD](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minimotd): Lets you fully customize the MOTD and icon, including an automatic message if the server is in maintenance mode
  - [Mainenance Mode](https://modrinth.com/mod/maintenancemode): Lets you put the server into maintenance mode, making it so only select players can join as well as automatically making a backup if configured
  - [Simple Discord Link](https://modrinth.com/mod/sdlink): Lets you link the ingame chat to a Discord server, allowing people to chat with each other even when they're not ingame

title: SpyCord - AntiOP Abuse
description: A lightweight plugin that logs all server commands and gamemode changes to a Discord channel via webhook. Perfect for small servers to prevent or resolve OP abuse accusations.
body:
# SpyCord

A Minecraft plugin that logs OP and console commands, gamemode changes, and sends them to a Discord channel via webhook.

## Features
- Logs OP/Console commands to `commands.log`
- Allows you to customize what commands get logged
- Detects non-command gamemode changes
- Sends logs to Discord via Webhook

## Setup
1. Add your Discord webhook to `config.yml`
2. Place the plugin JAR in your server's plugins folder
3. Start your server and enjoy!

#### Note
Do **not** share your actual `config.yml` with the webhook URL in public.

# Future Plans
- Creative Mode item creation logging
  - Logs any items taken from the creative inventory
  
- Discord Bot Integration
   - Will detect the deletion of spycord's logs(within the discord server)
   - Will notify members in case of deletion
   - Will be a huge pain for anyone attempting to op abuse
- Relayed Command logging
  - Detects commands run by external tools that don't register as typical console commands
  - e.g: discordsrv


`PS: in my own smp, op abuse accusations dropped by 100% after I put this up 😉`

check me out [here](http://myst1cs04p.github.io/Me)

you can read [here](https://myst1cs04p.github.io/articles/minecraft-2#:~:text=before%20they%20started.-,SpyCord%3A%20The%20Transparency%20Plugin,-The%20other%20major) about why I created this plugin.

title: BansystemV1
description: that is a simple bansystem plugin easy to use and to install
body:
BansystemV1 is a professional ban and management system for Minecraft servers (compatible with 1.21–1.21.6). This plugin is designed for server administrators who want full control over player bans, unbans, and kicks, with a focus on reliability, usability, and flexibility. 

✨ **Key features include:**
- 🚫 **Ban, Unban, Kick:** Easily manage player bans with custom reasons and durations, unban players, and kick disruptive users with clear feedback.
- ⏳ **Automatic Unban:** Players are automatically unbanned when their ban duration expires, keeping your ban list clean and up-to-date.
- 🌍 **Multilingual Support:** All messages are configurable via messages.yml, allowing for easy translation and customization for any language.
- 💬 **Help Texts:** Every command provides helpful usage information, making it easy for staff to use the plugin correctly.
- 🔄 **Reload Command:** Instantly reload your messages.yml file in-game with `/bansystem reload`, so you can update texts without restarting the server.
- 🛡️ **Input Validation:** The plugin checks if players exist and validates time formats, preventing mistakes and improving reliability.
- 🧩 **Modular Code Structure:** The code is organized for maintainability and future expansion, with clear separation of logic and configuration.
- 📋 **Logging:** All important actions and errors are logged for admins, making it easy to track what happens on your server.
- 🏷️ **LuckPerms Integration:** Works seamlessly with LuckPerms for permission management.

Whether you run a small community or a large network, BansystemV1 gives you the tools to keep your server safe and well-managed. Designed for Spigot and Paper, it is lightweight, fast, and easy to configure. 

👤 **Author:** Lukas__YT

body:
# 🌀 Mobility Improvements — Fabric 1.20.1

**Mobility Improvements** adds new **movement mechanics** to Minecraft, making gameplay more dynamic and skill-based.  
Perform a **double jump** in mid-air, execute a **dash** with particles and sound, and manage your **hunger** wisely!  

---

## ✨ Features

- 🦘 **Double Jump**:
  - Triggered by pressing jump a second time in the air.
  - Requires enough hunger (½ shank).
  - Balanced: doesn’t cancel fall damage.
- ⚡ **Dash Ability**:
  - Keybind (default: **C**).
  - Short horizontal boost with particles & sound.
  - Consumes ½ shank of hunger.
  - Has a **2 second cooldown**.
- 🍗 **Hunger Integration**:
  - Both moves consume hunger points.
  - Disabled if you’re starving.
- 📊 **Cooldown HUD**:
  - Clean bar above the hotbar.
  - Shows time remaining for Dash.

---

## 🕹️ How to Use

1. **Jump normally** → while in air, press jump again to **Double Jump**.  
2. **Press the Dash key** (default **C**) → dash forward with effects.  
3. Keep an eye on your **hunger** and the **cooldown bar**!  

---

## 📦 Requirements

- 🟢 **Fabric API**  
- 🟢 **Java 17**  

✅ Works in **singleplayer** and on **servers**  
*(must be installed on both client + server for consistency).*

---

body: a resource pack that adds support for the UCSUR's codepoints for standard galactic so you can type in galactic yourself :> # what does absolutely any of that mean UCSUR stands for the [under conscript unicode registry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ConScript_Unicode_Registry), which is a project that coordinates the usage of [codepoints](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_point) in [unicode's private use areas (PUA)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Private_Use_Areas) to include different [artificial writing systems (conscripts)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constructed_writing_system) - namely scripts for [conlangs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constructed_language) - meaning they can be typed and otherwise encoded in text. the UCSUR has [a section](https://www.kreativekorp.com/ucsur/charts/sga.html) for the [standard galactic alphabet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commander_Keen#Standard_Galactic_Alphabet), which is the script minecraft uses in places like the enchantment table. it's hardcoded into the game, though, and you can't determine where galactic is used (for the most part) without adding separate unicode characters to minecraft's font, which is what this pack does! # how do i use this, like, at all? yeah, you can't exactly type it on your keyboard (without third party software, at least), can you? i'd be surprised if you could find a keyboard that lets you type galactic by default so, i've made a [lingojam translator](https://lingojam.com/ucsurgalactic) for this! there's a good chance your browser won't be able to see the result, though - how i've fixed that is i've installed [fairfax hd](http://www.kreativekorp.com/software/fonts/fairfaxhd/) and set it to my browser's default font, so when the site's font can't render the characters, it'll use fairfax hd as a fallback, which can.

# This Mod adds some Vanilla-friendly Ores, Gear and Food:
- This Mod also adds Crafting Recipes for the Enchanted Golden Apple & all Vanilla Horse Armors
## Armors (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Enderite) ![Armors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/2a07663b2787d81226ebca588fa164cd2500835c.png)

- Copper Armor is the **SAME** as it's Vanilla version (Recipes, Attributes etc.) , just ported back to older Minecraft 1.21.X versions.
- Emerald Armor recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Armor.
- Emerald Armor is a little stronger than Iron.
- Ruby Armor recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Armor.
- Ruby Armor is slightly stronger than Emerald.
- You can get Enderite Armor by upgrading your already existing Netherite Armor in the Smithing Table using an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template.
- Enderite Armor is 1.5x stronger than Netherite.

## Tools (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Enderite) ![Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/c597c9968c7a36f57fa95870d065880a1d2ec991.gif)

- Copper Tools are the **SAME** as their Vanilla versions (Recipes, Attributes etc.) , just ported back to older Minecraft 1.21.X versions.
- Emerald Tools recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Tool.
- Emerald Tools are slightly stronger than Iron but can't break items that require Diamond Tools.
- Ruby Tools recipes are the **SAME** as every other Vanilla Minecraft Tool.
- Ruby Tools are slightly stronger than Emerald but can't break items that require Diamond Tools.
- You can get Enderite Tools by upgrading your already existing Netherite Tools in the Smithing Table using an Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template.
- Enderite Tools are 1.5x stronger than Netherite and can Insta-Mine most blocks when fully enchanted.

## Ores & Blocks (Ruby & Enderite) ![Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/a4789f5e929112d05983892c10b6233f751cbbd1.gif)
- Ruby Ore & Deepslate Ruby Ore generates from Y-64 to Y180.
- Ruby Ore & Deepslate Ruby Ore requires at least Iron Tools to be mined.
- Ruby Blocks can be crafted using 9 Rubies.
- Enderite Ore **ONLY** generates inside the End.
- Enderite Ore requires at least Diamond Tools to be mined.
- Enderite Blocks can be crafted using 9 Enderite Ingots.

## Items (Ruby & Enderite) ![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/21e77027efd00560ce99b44afaa493d02f987798.gif)
- Rubies drop from mining Ruby Ores.
- Enderite Shards drop from mining Enderite Ore.
- Enderite Shards are used to craft Enderite Ingots.
- Enderite Upgrade Smithing Templates can only be found inside End City chests.
- Enderite Upgrade Smithing Templates can be duplicated.

## Horse Armors (Copper, Emerald, Ruby, Netherite, Enderite) ![Horse Armors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/608761121ce4992085b6979207b65df7e762c655.png)
- Copper Horse Armor is the same as it's Vanilla version (Attributes etc.).
- Emerald Horse Armor is a little better than Iron Horse Armor.
- Ruby Horse Armor is a little better than Emerald Horse Armor.
- Netherite Horse Armor is a little better than Diamond Horse Armor.
- Enderite Horse Armor is 1.5x stronger than Netherite Horse Armor.
- All Horse Armors have the same Crafting Recipe as Leather Horse Armor just with their respective materials.

## Apples (Ruby & Emerald) ![Apples](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JvnlNEje/images/5c09cb3fe6f6b17a646e30d5cb0266c9c5559193.png)

- Ruby Apples give you effects that make you stronger in fights.
- Emerald Apples give you effects that make you a bit more lucky.
- Ruby & Emerald Apples can be crafted like Golden Apples just with their respective materials
- Enchanted Ruby & Emerald Apples can be crafted with Ruby/Emerald Blocks.
- The recipe for the Enchanted Golden Apple has been reimplemented and remains the same as it's old Vanilla version.

## Fredo's Armor Trim

- Fredo's Armor Trim can only be found inside Dungeon chests.
- Fredo's Armor Trim can be duplicated.

## Coming Soon:

- Advancements
- Custom Sounds & Updated Textures
- Translation for more languages

## Update Schedule:

- Currently, updates are scheduled to drop at least once per week until all planned features are implemented.

## THE WIKI WILL BE UPDATED AND FULLY FINISHED AFTER THE CUSTOM ARMOR TRIM HAS BEEN IMPLEMENTED

## THE MOD WILL BE UPDATED TO NEWER VERSIONS (1.21.3 etc.) ONCE ALL FEATURES HAVE BEEN IMPLEMENTED AND VERSION 1.0.0 HAS BEEN RELEASED

title: Origins: Arcanist
description: Isn't it nice to be a two-trick pony?
body:
*copied from the official Origins discord entry*

**disclaimer:** this pack is made for _fabric_ so it probably won't work so well on forge.

**Impact: (1)**
- Gameplay is mostly the same as vanilla.
- Scaling: Minimal; based on familiarity

### Abilities:

> `[💣︎✌︎☝︎✋︎👍︎]` (Arcana): The source of your power.
> - __Mage's Respite__: Drinking any potion that isnt _harming_ or _poison_ boosts `Arcana` recovery for 15s
> - __Esoterica__: `Using` a book with either hand causes you to channel, boosting `Arcana` recovery and __magic__ resistance

> `[👌︎☹︎✌︎💧︎❄︎]` (Barrage): A bolt of concussive magic that damages foes. **Activate:** `Attack` key
> - __Seeker's Arcana__: Holding the `Use` key while the bolt is midair allows you to control its trajectory
> - __Arcane Artillery__: The bolt grows in power as it flies, and lasts up to 4s

> `[👌︎☹︎⚐︎👍︎😐︎]` (Barrier): A curtain of force that repels enemies and their projectiles. **Activate:** `Use` key
> - __Obsoletion__: Wielding a shield doubles `Barrage` cost
> - __Stasis__: Enable or disable all activated abilities with `Load Toolbar Activator` (default 'X')

### Additional Details:
> - `Barrage` deals greatly reduced self-damage and resets your fall distance if it detonates within the first 0.3s of being launched
> 
> - `Barrier` provides some amount of directional damage resistance, and can counteract the force of gravity if pointed downwards.
> 
> yes i know the namespace is 'test', it started like that and i just got lazy and didnt change it.

### Known Issues:
> - Sometimes, somehow, a perfectly timed `Barrage` explodes multiple times and becomes very loud. It doesn't seem to increase damage dealt, but can dramatically increase knockback.

title: Sleep In Darkness
description: Sunlight? Torches? Forget it. Only pure darkness lets you snooze!
body: # Sleep in Darkness **Sleep in Darkness** is a Minecraft mod that introduces a new survival challenge: players must be in a dark enough environment to sleep. This adds a new strategic element to base building and night-time survival. The mod is designed with maximum compatibility in mind, using Balm for seamless multi-loader support (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge). ## ✨ Features - 🌌 **Sleep Restriction Based on Light Level** Players can only sleep when their current light level is below a configurable threshold. Torches, lanterns, and other light sources must be avoided to find suitable sleeping spots. - 🔧 **Configurable Settings** The light level threshold can be easily customized through the mod's config file. Adjust the challenge to fit your gameplay style. ## 🛠️ Compatible Mods Sleep in Darkness is designed to work well alongside many popular mods that modify sleeping mechanics, world generation, or survival difficulty. It is fully compatible with: - 🔗 **Balm** - Used as the multi-loader foundation. - 🔦 **Mods that adjust world lighting** - Sleep in Darkness reads actual in-game light levels and should not conflict. - 🌌 **Mods that add new dimensions** - Light level checks work in any dimension, as long as beds are functional. If you encounter compatibility issues with a specific mod, please report it via the issue tracker.

description: Mob Vision shows mob attack and view ranges. Press O to customize. Supports Creepers, Zombies, and Spiders.
body:
IF YOU WANT ME TO UPDATE THIS MOD JOIN THE DISCORD SERVER
# 🦠 Mob Vision  

**Mob Vision** is a simple yet powerful mod that allows you to visualize the **attack range** and **view range** of specific hostile mobs in Minecraft. This can help you understand how mobs detect and engage with players, making it a great tool for both survival and technical players.  

## 🌟 Features  
- ✅ **Visualize Mob Ranges** – See the exact **attack range** and **view range** of supported mobs.  
- ✅ **Customizable Display** – Adjust **render distance** and **thickness** for better visibility.  
- ✅ **GUI Control** – Press `O` to open the settings GUI and toggle individual mobs or range types.  
- ✅ **Optimized & Lightweight** – Designed for minimal performance impact.  

## 🔧 Supported Mobs (currently)  
-  **Creeper** – Displays its **detection range** and **explosion trigger range**.  
-  **Zombie** – Shows how far it can see and chase the player.  
-  **Spider** – Visualizes its **jump attack** and **chase range**.  

## 🎮 How to Use  
1. Press `O` to open the **Mob Vision GUI**.  
2. Toggle individual mobs **on/off**.  
3. Enable or disable **attack range** and **view range** separately.  
4. Adjust **render distance** and **line thickness** for better visibility.  

## 🛠 Compatibility  
- 💻 Works in **singleplayer** and **multiplayer (client-side only)**.  
- 🔧 No dependencies required!  

🔹 **Future updates will add support for more mobs and improved customization!**

body:
# OWO? What's this!

Well, weren't we just tired hosting that 2 weeks of Minecraft phase for your friends? lazy to setup the server? just download this modpack and run your fabric jar file!

### Really?!
In all seriousness, this modpack provide essentials needs for hosting a fabric server, designed to keep it as vanilla as possible for bedrock player's support. with the addition of essential quality-of-life mods, whilst also providing smooth upgrades for future versions, preserving existing worlds without corruption. 

### What's in it???
<details>
<summary>Mods</summary>

- [Automatic Doors Opening](https://modrinth.com/mod/automatic-doors/version/1.21.4-4.8-fabric+forge+neo)
- [Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)
- [Diversity](https://modrinth.com/mod/faewufs-diversity)
- [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands/version/0.36.0-mc1.21.3)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)
- [Floodgate](https://modrinth.com/mod/floodgate/version/2.2.4-b43)
- [Geyser](https://modrinth.com/mod/geyser/version/2.6.0-b750)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix)
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports)
- [ Skin Restorer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinrestorer)
- [Sleep Sooner](https://modrinth.com/mod/sleep-sooner)
- [Tree Harvester](https://modrinth.com/mod/tree-harvester)
- [Trees Make Sound (Presence Not Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/trees-make-sound)
- [Vanilla Refresh](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanilla-refresh)
- [Vanish](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanish)
- [Very Many Players (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric)
- [ViaFabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabric)
- [ViaFabricPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus)
- _And their respective API dependencies_
</details>

## 🛠️ Installations
> First, download the fabric server jar file and put it in the profile directory. You can find the jar file here => [Fabric Server](https://fabricmc.net/use/server/)

This profile also contains the start.bat file, open it with your text editor of choice (_like notepad_), and change:

> This line to be the fabric server that you've downloaded!

```
set ServerFileName=fabricserver-mc(version).jar
```
> You can also define the Initial and Maximum ram allocation pool for the server!
```
REM Define ram allocation amount here you can use G for Gigabytes or M for Megabytes
REM Maximum memory allocation pool
set MaxRam=8G
REM Initial memory allocation pool
set IniRam=4G
```
> You can also set if you want a built-in GUI instead of using the good ol' command prompt. (false is cmd)
```
REM Vanilla server GUI (true/false)
set GUI=false
```
> Also, At line 40 (at the bottom) there's a restart timer in case the server has crashed, the default timer is 3.

```
timeout 3 
```
> After that, click the start.bat file to start the server!


## ⚠️ Disclaimer
This modpack is **not intended to be played on a client**, although I have put sodium here for performance. but other than that, you have to fork this modpack and add your own multiplayer mod of choice to host this!

📩 r12azqha+buroserver@gmail.com for suggestions and queries.

title: Time Clicker
description: Time Clicker is an easy-to-install Fabric mod which displays the time spent in your current Minecraft World/Server!
body:
# Time Clicker ⏳

**Time Clicker** is a simple yet useful Minecraft mod that displays the time you've spent playing on your current world or server. Now you can know exactly how much of your life you've wasted— I mean, dedicated... to your Minecraft playtime!

## Features ✨
- Displays the time spent in your current Minecraft Session.
- HUD overlay with a sleek, minimalist design.
- Lightweight and performant.

## Getting Started 🚀

### Prerequisites
- **Minecraft**: Version 1.20.1
- **Fabric Loader**: Version 0.14.9+
- **Fabric API**: Make sure it's installed, or this mod won't work. Really. Trust me. JUST INSTALL THE DAMN MOD!

### Installation
1. **Download the mod** from the [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/time-clicker) page.
2. **Install Fabric Loader** if you haven't already. You can grab it from [here](https://fabricmc.net/use/).
3. **Place the mod JAR file** in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4. **Launch Minecraft** and enjoy!

## Usage 🕹️

Once you’re in-game, the mod automatically starts tracking your time. You’ll see the time spent displayed in the top-left corner of your screen. Now you’ll know exactly how many hours you've put into building that amazing, dirt castle.

## Contributing 🤝

Got a cool idea, or you've found a bug? Contributions are open! Here's how you can help:

(First, open the GitHub repo then you'd probably have an idea of what you're doing.)
1. **Fork** the repository.
2. **Make your changes** and commit them with a nicer message that doesn't tell others to "disable their hardware".
3. **Push** to the branch: `git push origin feature-idea`
4. **Create a Pull Request** on GitHub, and await a response... In 10-20 business weeks of course.

## License 📜

This project is licensed under the **GPLv3** License. See the [LICENSE](https://github.com/SpvceR3ii/time-clicker/blob/main/LICENSE) file for more details.

## Authors ✍️

- **SpvceR3ii** - Owner, coded the entire project.

## Contact & Support 📬

Need help? Want to discuss a feature? Hit us up:

- **GitHub Issues**: [Submit a ticket](https://github.com/SpvceR3ii/time-clicker/issues)
- **Source Homepage**: [Time Clicker](https://github.com/SpvceR3ii/time-clicker)

# Simply Survival Modpack

## Description

The Simply Survival Modpack is designed to enhance your Minecraft survival experience while keeping it straightforward and enjoyable. This carefully curated collection of mods focuses on improving various aspects of the game without changing the game or increasing complexity. Here’s what you can expect:

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

- **Enhanced Visuals**: Enjoy improved graphics with shaders like BSL Shaders, Complementary Shaders, and Solas Shader, which bring vibrant and realistic lighting to your world.
- **Improved User Interface**: Mods such as Better Advancements, Better Mount HUD, Better Statistics Screen, and BetterF3 offer a more intuitive and informative interface, making it easier to manage your gameplay.
- **Performance Boosts**: Experience smoother gameplay with performance-enhancing mods like Lithium, Sodium, and ImmediatelyFast.
- **Quality of Life Enhancements**: Mods like AppleSkin, ItemPhysic Lite, Shulker Box Tooltip, and Zoomify add small yet impactful improvements to your survival experience.
- **Customization Options**: Personalize your game with mods like Cosmetica, CTM Selector and more.
- **Improved user experience**: We use mods that improve the experience inside Minecraft, such as Craftify, a mod that allows you to control your music from a variety of sources all without leaving the game.

- **Balanced Gameplay**: This modpack aims to improve your Minecraft experience without altering the gameplay. It’s perfect for players who want a more polished and refined survival mode.

title: Better Progression
description: Makes early game progression slightly more difficult
body:
**BETTER PROGRESSION**

This mod is intended to slightly draw out Minecraft's early game by making some simple processes slightly harder. Feel free to use this in modpacks and YouTube videos!


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**HOW THE MOD WORKS:**


__________________________________
_Goal #1: Obtain a crafting table_

  Mine many logs, which drop sticks unless broken with an axe.
  
  Craft four sticks into a bundle of sticks.
  
  Craft four bundles of sticks into bundled planks.
  
  Craft four bundled planks into a crafting table.

________________________________________
_Goal #2: Obtain wooden and stone tools_

  Wooden tools are now crafted with bundles of sticks instead of planks.
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with a wooden pickaxe, drop 1-2 rocks.
  
  Craft nine rocks into cobblestone.
  
  Stone tools can be crafted with stone only, meaning cobblestone has to be smelted.
  
  Craft eight cobblestone into a furnace.
  
  Obtain more cobblestone and smelt it.
  
  The resulting stone can be used to make stone tools!
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with a stone pickaxe, drop 3-4 rocks.


____________________________
_Goal #3: Obtain iron tools_

  Iron ore drops 1-2 lumps of iron.
  
  Four lumps of iron can be crafted into raw iron.
  
  When raw iron is smelted in a furnace, the iron output is normal.
  
  When raw iron is smelted in a blast furnace, the iron output is doubled.
  
  This process also applies to gold.
  
  Stone and cobblestone, when mined with an iron pickaxe or better, drop themselves.

</details>

# Mc Server Announcer

Mc server Announcer is a Quilt Mod used to announce your server to the LAN network using the broadcast ip : `255.255.255.255`
  
## Usage

### How to use ?

Download the mod jar and place it in the mods folder of your Quilt server.

### Actual Fonctionalities

 - Auto detect the motd of the server to use it in the server name
 - Auto detect the server port
 - When the motd have a line break it replaces it with three spaces, because the LAN server name can't handle a line break.

title: LitematicaFolia
description: Server-side Litematica for Paper & Folia: native .litematic paste with full NBT fidelity + Direct Paste from vanilla Litematica clients via the Servux protocol. No /fill spam, no kick, no WorldEdit dep.
body:
# LitematicaFolia

**Server-side Litematica for Paper and Folia.** Load `.litematic` schematics directly on your Minecraft server and accept Direct-Paste uploads from vanilla [Litematica](https://github.com/maruohon/litematica) clients via the Servux protocol — no `/fill` spam, no kick-for-spamming, no WorldEdit dependency.

> First Paper/Folia plugin to natively parse and paste `.litematic` files. Replaces Litematica's legacy `/setblock` + `/fill` fallback (lossy, slow, kick-prone) with a real server-side pipeline.

## Why does this exist?

[Litematica](https://github.com/maruohon/litematica) is a **client-only** Fabric mod. Its companion server tooling ([Servux](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/servux), Syncmatica) is Fabric-only. On Paper/Bukkit servers the only available behaviour is Litematica's `/setblock`-spam fallback, which is:

- **lossy** — no tile-entity NBT, no entities, no pending block ticks
- **slow** — chat-command rate limit caps it at ~20 blocks/sec
- **fragile** — Paper kicks for spamming after 30+ commands/second

**LitematicaFolia** is the missing piece for the Paper side of the wall:

1. Reads `.litematic` v6/v7 files server-side via an inline NBT parser (zero external dep)
2. Pastes via Folia's `RegionScheduler` per-chunk dispatch — observers-last, deferred-physics, full TileEntity + Entity + PendingBlockTick NBT preserved
3. Speaks the Servux wire protocol so vanilla Litematica clients can Direct-Paste their in-memory schematics directly to the server — same way it works on a Fabric+Servux server

## Features

- ✅ Native `.litematic` v6/v7 reader and writer (NBT-gzipped, compact cross-word packing, multi-region, palette resolution)
- ✅ Folia-safe paste — per-chunk `RegionScheduler.run`, observers/pistons placed in a second pass, full TileEntity + Entity + PendingBlockTick + PendingFluidTick NBT preserved
- ✅ **Servux Direct Paste** — vanilla Litematica clients paste from their schematic GUI directly to the server (validated against `litematica-fabric-1.21.11-0.27.6`)
- ✅ DataFixerUpper bridge — older `.litematic` files are upgraded to the current MC version at paste time
- ✅ Brigadier commands — `/litematica paste|save|materials|list|info|reload|cancel`
- ✅ Production stress-tested — **4.2 M blocks pasted in 9.5 s**, **870 k blocks + 6,500 tile entities via Direct Paste in 5.6 s**, zero region-file corruption
- ✅ Configurable splitter cap (default 128 MiB) for 40 MiB+ schematics
- ✅ MIT licensed, LGPL-clean (Servux wire format reverse-engineered, no upstream code copied)

## Installation

1. Download `LitematicaFolia-<version>-all.jar`
2. Drop it in your server `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server (or hot-reload)
4. Edit `plugins/LitematicaFolia/config.yml` to flip `protocol.enableServuxBridge: true` if you want Direct Paste from clients
5. Done.

**Requirements:** Paper 26.1.2 build 53+ (or any fork: Folia, Luminol, Purpur 26.1+), Java 25.

## Client setup — Direct Paste

For players to paste directly from their own client, they need: **Fabric Loader 0.16+**, **Fabric API**, **MaLiLib 0.28.6+**, and **Litematica 0.27.6+** (for 1.21.11).

### Critical client config (the one nobody documents)

In Litematica's **Configs → Generic** tab, set:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| **`ENTITY_DATA_SYNC`** | **`true`** ← the hidden gate. Without this, Litematica silently rejects our `S2C_METADATA` packet → falls back to `/setblock` spam → kicked for spamming. |
| **`PASTE_USING_SERVUX`** | `true` |
| `PASTE_USE_FILL_COMMAND` | `false` |
| `PASTE_ALWAYS_USE_FILL` | `false` |
| `ENTITY_DATA_SYNC_BACKUP` | `true` |

Then bind **`executeOperation`** to a free key in **Configs → Hotkeys** (default unbound).

### Player workflow

1. Open Litematica menu (`M`)
2. **Load Schematics** → pick your `.litematic`
3. **Loaded Schematics** → **Create Placement** → position it
4. Hold the Litematica tool (a stick)
5. **Tool Mode: Paste Schematic in world** (cycle if needed)
6. Aim at the placement, press your `executeOperation` keybind

Done — full block-state + TileEntity + Entity fidelity, no command spam, no kick risk.

## Server admin — Velocity proxy tuning

If your players connect through Velocity, set in `velocity.toml`:

```toml
[packet-limiter]
decompressed-bytes-per-second = -1
```

The default 5 MiB/s kicks any Direct Paste burst > 10 MiB schematic. Leave `compression-threshold` at default `256`.

For old `.litematic` files (DataVersion < current), add to your Paper JVM args:
```
-Dpaper.playerconnection.keepalive=120
```

This gives clients 2 min to finish Mojang DataFixer + upload.

## Commands

| Command | Permission |
|---|---|
| `/litematica paste <file> [x y z] [yaw] [--no-entities] [--no-physics]` | `litematica.paste` |
| `/litematica save <name> <x1 y1 z1> <x2 y2 z2>` | `litematica.save` |
| `/litematica materials <file>` | `litematica.materials` |
| `/litematica list [--filter <glob>]` | `litematica.use` |
| `/litematica info <file>` | `litematica.use` |
| `/litematica cancel [ticket]` | `litematica.paste` |
| `/litematica reload` | `litematica.admin` |

## Configuration

```yaml
paste:
  maxBlocksPerChunkTask: 8192
  allowEntities: true
  allowTileEntities: true
  allowPendingTicks: true
  deferredPhysics: true
  observersLast: true
  runDataFixer: true
  minDataVersion: 2586

protocol:
  enableServuxBridge: false        # OFF by default — flip to true to enable Direct Paste
  enableEasyPlace: false
  maxDirectPasteSize: 134217728    # 128 MiB — raise for 32M+ block schematics
```

## How does it compare?

| | LitematicaFolia | Litematica `/fill` fallback | FAWE |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.litematic` support | native | n/a (client-only) | not natively |
| Server-side paste | yes | no | yes (for `.schem`) |
| Direct Paste from client | yes (Servux) | no | no |
| TileEntity preservation | full NBT | none | partial |
| Entity preservation | full NBT | none | partial |
| Pending block ticks | yes | no | no |
| Folia support | native | depends | partial |
| Rate-limit kick risk | none | high | none |

## Tags

`litematica`, `servux`, `schematic`, `litematic`, `paper`, `folia`, `server-side`, `direct-paste`, `nbt`, `paste`, `worldedit-alternative`, `building`

## License

MIT. Format parsing reverse-engineered from the public Litematica spec ([litemapy](https://litemapy.readthedocs.io/), [Lite2Edit](https://github.com/GoldenDelicios/Lite2Edit)). Servux wire format aligned byte-for-byte with upstream `sakura-ryoko/servux 26.1.2-0.10.2` — no upstream code copied; LGPL clean.

Made by **exo** for the [ekaii](https://ekaii.fr) Minecraft network. Built on patterns from [Moulberry/AxiomPaperPlugin](https://github.com/Moulberry/AxiomPaperPlugin). Litematica by [maruohon](https://github.com/maruohon). Servux protocol by [sakura-ryoko](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko).
