body:
![Dark Indigo Black Hole Banner Graphica](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7a7f94f7e6fce91ba48a9fee48173477e3a9e47_0.webp)

This modpack maximizes possible FPS with currently availble optimization mods.

### FPS Comparison:


| **API**          | Vanilla | Remarkably Optimized | Graphica |
|------------------|---------|----------------------|----------|
| Vulkan           | 359 FPS      | 500 FPS (OLD)                  | 503 FPS
| OpenGL           | 363 FPS      | 421 FPS (OLD)                  | 437 FPS
| RAM Usage Vulkan           | 16% / 4096MB      | 31% / 4096MB                  | 27% / 4096MB
| RAM Usage OpenGL           | 21% / 4096MB      | 29% / 4096MB                  | 18% / 4096MB
| Additional           | Fast Better Grass      | Fast Better Grass                  | Fast Better Grass

Map used: GamerPotion's FPS Test

| **API**          | Vanilla | Remarkably Optimized | Graphica |
|------------------|---------|----------------------|----------|
| Vulkan           | NA FPS      | 410 FPS (OLD)                  | 410 FPS
| OpenGL           | NA FPS      | 304 FPS (OLD)                  | 308 FPS
| RAM Usage Vulkan           | NA% / 4096MB      | 16% / 4096MB                  | 15% / 4096MB
| RAM Usage OpenGL           | NA% / 4096MB      | 16% / 4096MB                  | 14% / 4096MB
| Additional           | Fast Better Grass      | Fast Better Grass                  | Fast Better Grass

Map used: Custom Map (Entity Cramming, leaves, etc.)

Note: RAM usage fluctuates highly, so it cannot be measured easily. Expect real RAM usage grounded around 20-23%, yet still, optimizations I have done in mods configurations reduce and improve RAM handling.

Modpack will be updated regulary to the latest versions of mods.

Currently (0.0.7U), modpack able to surpass Remarkably Optimized decisively when using OpenGL API, keeping more FPS and Framerate stability. When using Vulkan API, leap decrease significantly, yet Graphica still wins due to better stability of Framerate (New Remarkably Optimized doesn't support Vulkan API. New Remarkably Optimized would be worse than old one due to in new version appears mods that aren't compatible with Vulkan API).

ULMU (Ultra Low Memory Usage) version reduced RAM usage by the game by ~15-20%, letting game run comfortably even on low-end hardware with 4-6GB of total RAM.
### CRITICAL NOTE: ALL VERSIONS PAST 0.0.5ULMU ARE USING SAME OPTIMIZATIONS, I DIDN'T INCLUDED ULMU IN THEIR NAMES TO NOT MAKE THEM TOO LONG

All options/configs are pre-made. To add mods requiring OpenGL, go to settings and change Prefered API to OpenGL from Vulkan.
Resourcepacks in collection increase average FPS by 3-10%, recommended to use all resourcepacks except Better Faster Textures (I'll be honest their textures are not vanilla-style).


<details>
<summary>Honest issues</summary>

- Chunk Generation issue recently fixed.
- Right hand can sometimes disappear when playing multiplayer (will be fixed in 0.0.7 or 0.0.8).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Planning</summary>

- Compare Graphica to other modpacks & in different situations.
- Create YouTube channel.
- Test Graphica on old laptop (6GB RAM, Intel Core I5-7200U).

</details>


<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

- Do NOT add external performance mods. You will just turn game bloated. It will hurt FPS in 99% situations and cause higher instability.
- Set max framerate to number of hertz of your monitor, unless doing competitive gaming. This saves power consumption and prevents freezing.

</details>


<details>
<summary>PC specs</summary>

Intel Core Ultra 7 265K;
Intel Graphics (Arrow Lake Integrated GPU);
32GB RAM 6800 MHz 36CL;
NVMe 4.0.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Goal</summary>

- My personal goal for this project is to create trustful optimization modpack that will let anyone, from people with 2015 laptops, to people with 2026 PC, play Minecraft using comfortable settings, letting anyone having at least 60 FPS while playing.

- Nutshell: Optimize game for any hardware, reduce power consumption, build people's modpack for everyone to use.

- My modpack is made entirely on motivation, I'm not following goal to turn rich, I wish for slight popularity. My rule #1 is no lying, if I lie at least once, whole my goal is ruined, what lying I can do is increase my modpack FPS by 1-2 at max, or accidentally tell wrong FPS/RAM (if I notice that - it will be fixed immediately), if any modpack surpasses me - I won't lie that my modpack FPS increased, I will actually try to return my rank legitimate, by modifying mod list and configurations. Lie is a sin, which I will never perform when talking about the modpack.

</details>

title: Balanced Crafting Recipes
description: Don't Waste Your Time and Items!
body:
# ⚠️WAIT!!⚠️
This datapack was created by an **_inexperienced, non-English speaking_** developer, so please be aware that there may be oddities in the descriptions here, or that some features in this datapack may not work.

Also, this datapack is licensed [CC-BY](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en), which means you can use this datapack without permission for modpack or unofficial mod support, **_but please leave credit as possible!_**

## 📖 Overview

BalancedCraftingRecipes is a **vanilla-compatible data pack** (no mods required) that reworks dozens of crafting recipes around a single idea: *nothing should be a dead end*. Misplaced a dye? Re-dye the block. Over-built with slabs? Turn them back into planks. Got a worn-out anvil or a low-tier tool? Upgrade it at the smithing table instead of starting over. Found a rare pottery sherd? Duplicate it.

Every change keeps the vanilla feel — recipes stay intuitive and roughly cost-fair — while cutting out the busywork and the resource bleed that vanilla crafting often forces on you.

## ✨ Features

- **♻️ Recycle blocks back into materials** — Turn any copper block variant (waxed, oxidized, cut, chiseled, grate — every state) back into **9 copper ingots**. Smelt iron/gold blocks and other items back into their base resources.
- **🔄 Reverse crafting** — Convert slabs, stairs, walls, fences, doors, buttons, and glass panes back into the block or planks they came from. No more being stuck with the wrong shape.
- **⚒️ Smithing-table gear upgrade tree** — Promote tools and armor through tiers at the smithing table (e.g. **stone → copper → … → diamond**) instead of re-crafting from scratch. Includes **anvil repair** (damaged → chipped → anvil).
- **🪓 Stonecutter, now for wood & more** — Use the stonecutter to cut **logs into planks, slabs, stairs, doors, signs**, and to turn **raw deepslate into bricks/tiles/cobbled** variants. Far less waste than the crafting grid.
- **🎨 Universal dyeing (8× output)** — Re-dye **any** color of wool, carpet, bed, banner, concrete, concrete powder, terracotta, glazed terracotta, stained glass, glass panes, and bundles into another color — 8 at a time. Wrong-colored blocks are never garbage again.
- **📦 One-step & bulk crafting** — Craft **chest boats straight from planks + a chest**, make chest/furnace/hopper/TNT minecarts in one step, and produce colored beds, banners, bundles, and carpets directly. Plus bulk recipes like **16 sticks from logs**, **4 paper from a filled map**, and a **4× beehive**.
- **💎 Duplicate rare items** — Surround a **pottery sherd** with bricks to get **4 copies**, and craft **armor-trim smithing templates** (×2) so you never permanently lose one.
- **🧰 Quality-of-life extras** — Craftable **tinted glass** from any glass + amethyst, a cheaper **lodestone**, a new **stone spear**, ice ⇄ packed ice ⇄ blue ice conversions, and more.

> 💡 The recurring theme: if vanilla makes you re-grind, re-gather, or discard — this pack gives you a sensible recipe instead.

## 🖼️ Screenshots
|Stone Axe Crafting|Iron Pickaxe Smithing Upgrade|
|-------|-------|
|![axe. thats it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d939a7e998737e10da9b9f2e4d66af50c25d792e.gif)|![Smithing table upgrading a copper pickaxe into a iron pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d55962deac7812dc431110619d75952af32f9d9b.gif)|

## 🔧 Installation

This is a **data pack**, not a mod — no loader needed.

**Single world**
1. Download the `.zip` (do **not** unzip it).
2. Place it in your world folder: `saves/<world-name>/datapacks/`.
3. In-game, run `/reload`, or leave and rejoin the world.

**Dedicated server**
1. Drop the `.zip` into `world/datapacks/`.
2. Run `/reload` or restart the server.

**Apply to every new world**
- On the *Create New World* screen, open **Data Packs** and drag the `.zip` in before creating the world.

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** Java Edition **1.21.9+** (pack format 88–95)
- **Environment:** Works on both **single-player and servers**
- **Mods:** None required — fully vanilla. Compatible with most resource/data packs.
- **Heads-up:** Because this pack overrides some vanilla recipe files, it may conflict with **other datapacks that change the same recipes**. If two packs edit the same recipe, **load order** decides which one wins.

## ❓ FAQ

<details>
<summary>Do I need Fabric, Forge, or any mod?</summary>

No. It's a pure data pack and runs on unmodified Minecraft.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Will it break my existing world or recipes?</summary>

It only adds or overrides crafting/smithing/stonecutting recipes — it doesn't touch your blocks, items, or saves. You can remove it at any time with `/datapack disable`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Does it work on older versions like 1.20?</summary>

No. It targets 1.21.9 and newer (it relies on recent items such as copper tools/armor and shelves). Older versions use a different pack format.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I use it in a modpack on Modrinth?</summary>

Yes — you may include this pack in any Modrinth modpack, as long as you credit the original page.

</details>

title: Gigaton Mace
description: Heavy sounds to really emphasize the power of the mace's smash attacks
body:
Have you ever felt that the mace's smash attack sounds just a bit too quiet? Like as if it doesn't have much force behind it, and that the mace feels too rigid. Well, I thought that too, and since I wanted to make resource packs, I decided to start with this.

---

So, about the pack, I tried to make the sounds have a lot more weight behind them, as if the impact of the mace is so powerful that it sends shockwaves into the air itself.

If that sounds like the kind of thing you would like, then give the showcase video a try and see if you like the sounds I came up with.

---

There are a few things to note about the pack:


<details>
<summary>Notable Things (Please Read)</summary>

The pack replaces all of the mace's smash attack sounds only. This means that non-smash attacks will not have different sounds, just like in vanilla minecraft.

---
Normally the mace's smash attack sounds are impossible to hear independently without the playsound command, because of a (probably a bug) that makes the critical hit sound also play when a smash attack happens

---
I don't have much sound design experience, so I ended up just using the features in the /playsound command to (somewhat) achieve the effect I wanted.

Please give suggestions and feedback to my YouTube channel (out of a lack of options, since I don't have any other platform to do this with). Here's the link: [Cauleaf's YT Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@CauleafMark3)

# 💀 Custom Player Death Sound

A simple, lightweight resource pack that gives players a unique, dedicated death sound effect without messing up standard damage sounds.

* **Isolated Death Sound:** Overrides ONLY the `entity.player.death` event via `sounds.json`. Taking fall damage, getting hit by mobs, or starving will still play the normal vanilla hurt sounds!
* **Cross-Version Compatible:** Originally designed for **1.21.11 (1.21.x)**, but fully supports a wide range of older and newer versions. (You can safely ignore the "incompatible" warning in older versions).
* **Multiplayer Friendly:** Completely Client-Side. You can use it on any multiplayer server, realm, or singleplayer world.

### 📦 Installation
1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable it in the game settings! (Load it at the top of your resource pack list to ensure priority).

### 🛠️ Easy to Customize
Want to use your own funny meme sound or dramatic explosion? Simply open the zip file and replace the `death.ogg` file located inside `assets/minecraft/sounds/custom/` with your own Vorbis `.ogg` file!

# G-Lottery

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/g-lottery)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/g-lottery)  ![Supported Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/nzw6wMpS)

## Description

G-Lottery is a feature-rich lottery system for Minecraft Java servers. Players can purchase tickets using various currencies, and periodic raffles distribute the accumulated pot to lucky winners. With support for offline players and multiple currency types.

## Features

- **Ticket System**: Players buy tickets to enter raffles
- **PlaceholderAPI support**
- **Multiple Currencies**: Support for Vault economy and item-based currencies
- **Offline Support**: Claim rewards even if offline during raffle
- **Statistics**: Track winners, pot amounts, and player tickets
- **Highly Configurable**: Customize prices, intervals, and messages
- **Admin Controls**: Automatic raffles, pot management, and settings
- **Automatic** winner anoucement

## Installation

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

    
1. Download G-Lottery.jar from the releases
   
2. Place in your `plugins/` folder
   
3. Restart your server
   
4. Configure in `plugins/G-Lottery/config.yml`

</details>



## Commands


<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

### Player Commands
- `/lottery buy <amount>` - Buy lottery tickets

- `/lottery leaderboard` - View the leadeboard
  
- `/lottery claim` - Claim unclaimed rewards
  
- `/lottery status` - Check pot, next draw, your tickets

- `/lottery help` - Provide the list of commands players can use

### Admin Commands

- `/lottery raffle` - Trigger manual raffle
  
- `/reload` - Reload G-Lottery config

- `/lottery tech-support` - Provide useful info to help you with you issues on Discord
  
- `/lottery donate <amount> <private | public >` - Add to pot

- `/lottery status` (as Operator) - Check pot, next draw, your tickets and more


## Configuration

Edit `config.yml` and `messages.yaml` to customize:

- Ticket prices and raffle intervals
  
- Currency type (Vault or items)
  
- Message templates
  
- Maximum stored draws for claims

</details>

body:
**🎬 Cinematic Events**

Before browsing the gallery, we highly recommend watching our short preview video below — because as the name suggests, this mod is all about cinematic motion and animation, not still images. A single screenshot simply can't do it justice.

Minecraft should feel like an adventure. Now it does.

Cinematic Events is a client-side Forge mod that transforms your Minecraft experience by adding handcrafted cinematic cutscenes to the most iconic moments of the game — and a cinematic camera mode to make every journey feel like a movie.

**👤 Preview**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/HPHboPC4wpo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**✨ Features**
Cinematic Cutscenes
Key moments in your Minecraft journey now come to life with automatic cinematic sequences:

World Load — A cinematic intro plays when you first load into the world (may not trigger if another mod or plugin extends the loading screen)
First Morning — Your very first sunrise gets the cinematic treatment it deserves
First Village — Discovering your first village is now a moment to remember
Every Morning — Each new day begins with a smooth cinematic wake-up sequence
The End Portal — The opening of the End portal and the individual placement of the eyes.
End Dimension Entry — Arriving in The End triggers a breathtaking cinematic
Ender Dragon — The ultimate boss encounter is now a true cinematic event

 **🎥 Cinematic Camera Mode**
A toggleable cinematic camera that puts the world in a whole new perspective:

Smooth, flowing camera movement ideal for exploration and travel
Not designed for combat — if a mob targets you while in cinematic mode, the camera automatically switches back to normal so you're never caught off guard
Perfect for sea voyages, scenic landscapes, and open-world exploration
Full shader support — looks stunning with your favorite shader pack
⚠️ Dense forests may obscure your character's visibility — this is a known limitation outside of our control


**⚙️ Compatibility & Requirements**

Minecraft: 1.20.1
Mod Loader: Forge
Side: Client-side only — no server installation required
Languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (I should point out that language support isn't very effective, at least not right now, because there isn't much written content.)


**🚧 Alpha Notice**
Cinematic Events is currently in alpha. You may encounter bugs or rough edges. We appreciate your patience and any feedback you share with us.

This mod is just getting started. Potential directions for future development include:

_-Pathfinder-style cinematic camera system

-Countless bug fixes and polish_

Have ideas or want to contribute? Reach out to us — we'd love to hear from you.

description: Lightweight Paper plugin that automatically teleports players to random safe locations within a configurable area when they first join a specific world. Perfect for survival servers where you want players to start in random locations rather than at spawn.
body:
# FirstJoinTeleport

FirstJoinTeleport is a lightweight Paper plugin that automatically teleports players to random safe locations within a configurable area when they first join a specific world. Perfect for survival servers where you want players to start in random locations rather than at spawn.

## Features

- **Automatic Teleportation**: Players are automatically teleported when entering a configured world
- **One-Time Teleportation**: Each player is only teleported once per world (prevents repeated teleports)
- **Configurable Area**: Define a square radius where players can be teleported
- **Countdown Timer**: Configurable countdown before teleportation (default 3 seconds)
- **Safe Location Finding**: Automatically finds safe locations with infinite retries
- **Performance Optimized**: Uses async chunk loading to prevent server lag
- **Customizable Messages**: Fully customizable messages (defaults in Spanish)
- **Data Persistence**: Player teleportation status is saved automatically
- **Safety Checks**: Avoids water, lava, void, and cave locations (minimum Y=60)

## Requirements

- **Server Software**: Paper or Spigot 1.20 or higher
- **Java Version**: Java 21 or higher

## Installation

1. Download the latest JAR file from Modrinth
2. Place the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server or use `/reload`
4. The plugin will automatically create a `config.yml` file in `plugins/randomteleport/`

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at `plugins/randomteleport/config.yml`. After making changes, reload the plugin or restart the server.

### Configuration Options

#### `target-world` (default: `"world"`)

The name of the world where teleportation should occur. Players entering this world will be teleported (if they haven't been teleported before).

```yaml
target-world: "world"
```

#### `radius` (default: -1000 to 1000)

Defines the square area where players can be teleported. Coordinates are relative to the world's spawn location.

```yaml
radius:
  min-x: -1000
  max-x: 1000
  min-z: -1000
  max-z: 1000
```

**Example**: With spawn at (0, 64, 0), `min-x: -1000, max-x: 1000` creates a 2000x2000 block area centered at spawn.

#### `countdown-seconds` (default: `3`)

Duration of the countdown before teleportation in seconds. Players see countdown messages during this time.

```yaml
countdown-seconds: 3
```

**Note**: Setting this to 0 will teleport immediately (not recommended as players won't see any warning).

#### `messages` (all configurable)

All messages support Minecraft color codes using the `&` symbol. The placeholder `{seconds}` is replaced with the countdown number.

```yaml
messages:
  countdown-start: "&aSerás teletransportado en {seconds} segundos..."
  countdown-remaining: "&aTeletransporte en {seconds} segundos..."
  teleporting: "&a¡Teletransportando!"
  teleport-failed: "&cBuscando ubicación segura..."
  already-teleported: "&7Ya has sido teletransportado a este mundo anteriormente."
```

**Available Messages:**
- `countdown-start`: Shown when countdown begins
- `countdown-remaining`: Shown each second during countdown
- `teleporting`: Shown when teleportation occurs
- `teleport-failed`: Shown if location finding fails (shouldn't happen in normal operation)
- `already-teleported`: Shown if player has already been teleported to this world

## How It Works

1. When a player enters the configured target world, the plugin checks if they've been teleported before
2. If not teleported before, a countdown starts (default 3 seconds)
3. During the countdown, players see messages indicating when they'll be teleported
4. After the countdown, the plugin finds a random safe location within the configured radius
5. The plugin retries indefinitely until a safe location is found
6. Once found, the player is teleported using async chunk loading
7. The player is marked as teleported for this world (stored in `players.yml`)

## Safety Features

The plugin ensures players are teleported to safe locations by:

- **Solid Ground**: Checking for solid ground below the player
- **Air Space**: Ensuring at least 2 blocks of air above the player
- **Liquid Avoidance**: Avoiding water and lava blocks
- **Void Protection**: Avoiding void locations
- **Cave Avoidance**: Only teleporting to locations above Y=60 (avoids caves)
- **Infinite Retries**: Retrying indefinitely until a safe location is found

## Player Data

Player teleportation status is stored in `plugins/randomteleport/players.yml`. This file:

- Tracks which players have been teleported to which worlds
- Auto-saves every 5 minutes
- Saves immediately when a player is teleported
- Saves on server shutdown

**To reset a player's teleportation status:**
1. Edit `plugins/randomteleport/players.yml`
2. Find the player's UUID entry under `players:`
3. Remove the world name from their `worlds:` list, or remove their entire entry
4. Save the file

**To reset all players:**
- Delete the `players.yml` file (it will be recreated automatically)

## Performance

The plugin is optimized for performance:

- **Async Chunk Loading**: Uses asynchronous chunk loading to prevent server lag
- **Async Location Finding**: Safe location finding runs asynchronously
- **Batched Saves**: Player data saves are batched (every 5 minutes)
- **Minimal Impact**: Designed to have minimal impact on server performance

## Troubleshooting

### Players Not Being Teleported

- Check that `target-world` matches your world name exactly (case-sensitive)
- Verify the world exists and is loaded
- Check server logs for errors
- Ensure the player hasn't been teleported before (check `players.yml`)

### Players Teleported to Unsafe Locations

- This shouldn't happen, but if it does, check that the world has valid terrain
- Ensure the radius area contains valid terrain (not all void/water)
- Verify the world is properly generated

### Countdown Not Showing

- Check that messages are properly configured in `config.yml`
- Verify color codes are using `&` not `§`
- Check server console for any errors

### Reset Player Teleportation Status

- Edit `plugins/randomteleport/players.yml` and remove the player's UUID entry
- Or delete the file to reset all players
- Restart the server or wait for the next auto-save

### Plugin Not Loading

- Ensure you're using Paper or Spigot 1.20 or higher
- Check that Java 21 or higher is installed
- Review server logs for error messages
- Verify the JAR file is not corrupted

## API Version

- Requires Paper API version 1.20 or higher

## Commands & Permissions

This plugin has no commands or permissions - it works automatically based on world changes.

## Integration

The plugin provides public getters for managers if you want to integrate with other plugins:

- `getConfigManager()` - Access configuration
- `getPlayerDataManager()` - Access player data
- `getTeleportManager()` - Access teleportation logic
- `getCountdownManager()` - Access countdown management

Configuration can be reloaded by calling the `reload()` method via other plugins.

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions:

1. Check the troubleshooting section above
2. Review server logs for error messages
3. Verify your configuration matches the examples
4. Ensure you're using a compatible server version

## License

Check the plugin's license file for information about usage and distribution.

title: Mystical Medieval Roleplay [Ultimate Experience]
description: The ultimate modpack experience with the most comprehensive mod selection and features for players who want everything. Includes everything from the base modpack plus extensive additions across all categories for maximum content and customization.
body:
## Mystical Medieval RP — Ultimate Experience

Ultimate Experience is a Fabric-powered “everything feels better” modpack built to make Minecraft look richer, play smoother, and support whatever kind of adventure you want to live in—without losing that vanilla heart. It’s the kind of pack where your character feels real (animations, camera, sound, lighting), your world feels alive (structures, biomes, distant vistas), and the moment-to-moment experience is simply more comfortable (smart QoL, better inventory flow, cleaner UI). It’s not just more content—it’s a more complete Minecraft.

A world that’s bigger, prettier, and actually worth wandering

Exploration is the backbone here. Biomes O’ Plenty adds variety and color to every expedition, while Explorify and Adventure Dungeons keep you bumping into points of interest that feel like “one more detour” moments. Enderscape gives the End real personality, and Distant Horizons lets you see the journey ahead—mountains on the skyline, distant forests, and far-off coastlines that make the world feel massive. 

### RPG flavor, satisfying combat, and build identity

If you want progression that feels like a character sheet—but still fits Minecraft—this pack has you. The RPG Series lineup (Archers, Rogues & Warriors, Paladins & Priests, Wizards, Arsenal, Jewelry, Relics) plus More RPG Classes expansions creates clear roles and playstyles. Magic is real “buildcraft” thanks to Spell Engine + Spell Power Attributes, plus rune-based customization through Runes.

Combat is modern, mobile, and deliberate: Better Combat makes melee flow, Combat Roll and Guarding/Passive Shield make defense and movement feel skillful, and ranged gameplay gets extra love via archer content and compatibility frameworks. And if you want a rare, gritty twist, Musket Mod adds blackpowder flavor without turning the game into modern warfare. 

### Cozy building, expressive towns, and “my base has a vibe” energy

Ultimate Experience is stacked for builders. A full Macaw’s suite (roofs, windows, bridges, fences/walls, paths/pavings, furniture, lights, stairs, doors, trapdoors, paintings, more) pairs perfectly with Stoneworks, Supplementaries, Hearths, and Sooty Chimneys—so your base can go from “box” to “storybook” fast. Add diagonal connections, vertical slabs, and trim/visual upgrades and you can build towns, castles, inns, markets, modern homes—whatever your imagination wants. 

### Farming, trade, and day-to-day life that doesn’t feel shallow

This pack makes survival loops feel meaningful instead of repetitive. Farmer’s Delight Refabricated (plus More Delight, Chef’s Delight integration, knives, compat, and visual crop polish) turns food into a whole lifestyle—great for kitchens, taverns, roleplay, or just better progression. Villagers are improved through smarter farming behavior, trading tweaks, and economy-friendly systems like Pebble’s Chest Shop and Flan Shop, so servers and singleplayer worlds can actually support commerce and community. 

### The “ultimate” part: immersion + performance + QoL that just works

This is where the pack really earns its name. You get a modern-feeling client experience:

Visual immersion: dramatic skies, dynamic surroundings, ambient particles, better models/animations, first-person body, better third person, cleaner glass, item model upgrades, dark UI themes, and more.

Sound immersion: richer ambient audio and detailed footsteps for that “I’m really there” feeling.

Quality-of-life: JourneyMap, Waystones, Lootr, Gravestones, Stack Refill, Jade HUD, inventory upgrades, better enchanting UX, crafting visibility, keybind searching, zoom, controller support, and a long list of friction removers.

Performance: Sodium + Iris + Indium + Lithium + FerriteCore + ModernFix + culling/optimizations so it looks good without running like a slideshow. 

Shaders included, cinematic lighting optional

Want cozy? Dramatic? Fantasy? Ultra-fast? You’ve got options—Iris loader + a whole library of popular shader packs, from lightweight to cinematic, so players can tune the look to their PC and mood.

title: Megalo's AIO - NeoForge Edition
description: Megalo's Metallurgy, Hoplology, Alloys, Nature and Gastronomy all in one mod
body:
**New Update: Re-Imagined Textures for Metallurgy and Hoplology skillfully created by She's_Long**

I have merged my Mods into an All-In-One (AIO); more will be added gradually.

Megalo's Metallurgy/Hoplology: Adds 50 new Ores to the game, from Aluminium to Zirconium and 4 weapon/tool variants.
Megalo's Alloys: Adds over 170 new metals that can be crafted from the base ores.
Megalo's Nature (WIP): This includes Dendrology/Gastonomy/Horticulture, adding Crops, Trees, Fruit, Vegetables, Meats and Drinks, etc.
Megalo's Technology is a long way off from being made yet.
 

Recipes for Alloys are being written, hopefully, by the next update.

Overworld Spawn:

Aluminium, Calcium, Cinnabar (Mercury), Lead, Magnesium, Nickel, Osmium, Platinum, Silicon, Silver, Sodium, Tin, Titanium, Zinc and Zirconium.

 

Deepslate Spawn:

Antimony, Bismuth, Cadmium, Chromium, Cobalt, Gallium, Iridium, Manganese, Molybdenum, Palladium, Potassium, Ruthenium, Thallium and Tungsten.

 

The Nether Spawn:

Arsenic, Barium, Beryllium, Caesium, Germanium, Hafnium, Indium, Niobium, Phosphorus, Rhenium, Rhodium, Selenium, Technetium and Tellurium.

 

The End Spawn:

Lithium, Rubidium, Scandium, Strontium, Tantalum, Vanadium and Yttrium.

 

Fictional Metals (Ultra Rare):

Coming Soon - Adamantium, Orichalcum, Mithril and many more.

 

Coal, Charcoal, Copper, Iron and Gold now have Dust.

Aluminium, Silver and Titanium make tools and armour.

*The way to make them is completely different from vanilla crafting.

 

== User Ideas ==

If you have any ideas / Suggestions on what to add to Megalo's AIO, please use the official Discord via the link at the bottom of the description.

== Videos = 

Mod reviewers - Please review my Mod, as I would love to know what you think about it. Let me know if you have any ideas on what can be reworked or updated.

 

== Permissions and Other Information ==

Megalo's Mod is free to use in any modpack.

If you want to make add-ons for Megalo's AIO, please message your ideas on Discord, as I would love to know about them.

If anyone wants to review my mod on YouTube, be my guest. 

 

== Credits ==

This Mod was created in line with Modding with Kaupenjoe's NeoForge 1.21.1 Tutorials.
All textures within the mod have been made by me since 2012. In talks with someone to update them for 2025/2026.

 

== DISCORD ==

The MegaloCraft Empire

 

==DONATE==

Press To Donate

Only if the Donate Button does not show.

The Megalo's AIO - NeoForge Edition Team

title: Elementary Equipment
description: A modification for Minecraft that adds powerful elemental weapons with unique passive and active abilities, using custom game mechanics.
body:
# Elementary Equipment

**A modification for Minecraft that adds powerful elemental weapons with unique passive and active abilities, using custom game mechanics.**

## 🌟 Features

### 🗡️ Elementary Equipment
|       Weapon       |                 Element                    |                    Passive ability                   |                                       Active ability                                       |
|:------------------:|:------------------------------------------:|:----------------------------------------------------:|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|
| The ancient sword  |                 🌿 Dendro                  |     Causes increased damage in the jungle biomes     |                     Creates blooms around the player, imposes effects                      |
|   Electric sword   |            ⚡ Electro + 🌊 Hydro            | Can summon lightning to a target with a small chance |           Summons a storm into the world, striking lightning at nearby entities            |
|     Fire sword     |                  🔥 Pyro                   |        With a chance, sets fire to the enemy         |                                   Summons a fire charge                                    |
|     Ice sword      | ❄️ Krio / With a chance, freezes the enemy |             Freezes all entities around              |                                Freezes all entities around                                 |
|  Hurricane Sword   |       🌪️ Anemo / Repels the target        |        Repels all entities around the player         |                           Repels all entities around the player                            |
|    Magic Sword     |                 ⚡ Electro                  |          Deals magical damage to the target          | Creates a magic circle, imposing negative effects on opponents and positive ones on allies |
|   Mountain Sword   |                    Geo                     |                Gives a defense bonus                 |        Summons an "earthquake" by throwing enemies up and placing spikes under them        |
|     Sea Sword      |                  🌊 Hydro                  |                Gives a swimming bonus                |                           Allows you to make a dash in the water                           |

### 🔮 Ability system
- **Passive abilities** - permanent bonuses
- **Active abilities** - it is activated by right-clicking

### ⚡ Custom mechanics
- Unique particles and visual effects
- Special sounds for each element
- Rollback system for balancing abilities

## ⚙️ Configuration file

**The mod has a complete configuration system via the file** ```config/elementary-equipment.json```

### Basic settings
```json
"general": {
  "README": "Select entities affected by ability: (all, players, animals, monsters)",
  "entityScopes": [
    "all"
  ]
}
```

### Setting rollback on abilities
```json
"fireSword": {
    "activeCooldown": 45, // Rollback of active ability
    "passiveCooldown": 30, // Rollback of passive ability
    "passiveChance": 0.6, // Chance of activating a passive ability
    "xpPost": 16, // Experience spent to activate an active ability
    "durabilityCost": 2 // Weapon wear for passive ability
},
```

title: Server Swapper
description: Allows portal use between neoforge servers
body:
Are you looking for a portal to switch between Neoforge servers? Well here it is!

**Key Features**

**Customizable Portals:** Create special portals that act as gateways to other server instances or specific IPs/ports. The portals have a distinctive gold appearance with dynamic particle effects.

**Persistent Server Destinations:** Server administrators can easily manage a list of predefined server connections (name, IP, port) using intuitive in-game commands.

**Cross-Server Chat (via RCON):** Connect chat across your entire server network, allowing players on different servers to communicate seamlessly.

**Configurable Message Formats:** Tailor the appearance of cross-server chat messages, player join messages, and player leave messages using placeholders and various color codes.

**How it Enhances Your Server**

**Easy Server Hubs:** Create a central hub that links to your survival, creative, minigame, or resource servers.
**Intuitive Navigation:** Players don't need to disconnect and reconnect; simply walk through a portal.
**Immersive Experience:** The custom visuals make portal travel feel unique and magical.
**Unified Community:** Foster a more connected player base by enabling real-time chat and presence notifications across all linked servers.
**Admin Control:** Commands for adding, removing, and listing server destinations put you in charge of your network's flow.

**Commands OP & LuckPerms Integration**

- `/swp create <name>` – Spawn a portal to a saved server destination.
- `/swp list` – View all saved server destinations.
- `/swp add <name> <ip> <port>` – Add a new server destination to the config.
- `/swp remove <name>` – Remove a saved server destination.
- `/swp reload` – Reload the mod's configuration.
- `/swp help` – Display mod commands.

**Configuration**

There's a ton of config options, basically everything I could think anyone would want to change! This includes particle size, cooldown time, teleport delay, portal frame block, and much more. You can now also extensively customize the cross server chat message formats, including support for Minecraft's native § color codes, the common & format, and Solstice color tags, along with dynamic placeholders for server name, player name, LuckPerms prefix/suffix, and message content.

**Limitations**

- Single Player Incompatibility: The mod does not currently work in single-player mode and is designed specifically for multiplayer Neoforge servers (Work in Progress).
- RCON Dependency for Chat: Cross-server chat functionality requires proper RCON configuration on all linked servers.

title: SocialFire
description: The most feature-complete social announcements plugin for Velocity.
body:
# SocialFire
The most feature-complete social announcements plugin for Velocity.

## What's this plugin? 
Allows network admins to seamlessly fill the gap between automatic social announcements and social commands like /discord and /store

# Features
Single config for both announcements and commands
Example: 
```yml
announcements:
  store: # the name of the command
    link: https://store.xyz.abc # Chat clickable link
    interval: 180 # delay for announcements in seconds
    sound: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
    message: |- # message for chat
      &f
      &e🛒 Server Store

      &fPurchase &eranks, coins, keys &fand much
      &fmore at our &estore & support &fthe server!

      &e➟ &nstore.xyz.abc
      &f
    "action-bar": "§e🛒 &lSTORE §7| §fhttps://store.xyz.abc" # action bar
  discord: # same as before
    link: https://discord.gg/
    interval: 140 # in seconds
    sound: "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP"
    message: |-
      &f
      &9✉ Server Discord

      &fStay up to date with all &9announcements,
      &9gveaways, events &fand much more!

      &9➟ &ndiscord.gg/
      &f
    "action-bar": "§9✉ &lDISCORD §7| §fhttps://discord.gg/"
  # You can add as many of these commands as you want
```

# Usage/Compatibility/Installation
To install this plugin, just download the .jar file and put it in your plugins folder of your velocity and reboot your velocity proxy and to support sounds, put it in paper as well.
Currently the plugin only supports velocity and is tested on version 3.4-build-459+ but looking forward we are going to add support for bungee.

title: Simple Chat Colors
description: A simple Minecraft plugin that adds color to player chat messages based on their username.
body:
# ColorChat Plugin

A simple Minecraft plugin that adds color to player chat messages based on their username.

## Features

- Automatically assigns a unique color to each player based on their username
- Colors persist across server restarts
- Simple and lightweight
- No configuration needed
- Command to randomize your chat color

## Installation

1. Download the latest version of the plugin
2. Place the jar file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server

## How it works

The plugin assigns colors to players based on a hash of their username. This means:
- Each player gets a consistent color
- The same player will always get the same color
- Colors are distributed evenly among players

## Commands

- `/saltcolor` - Randomize your chat color (requires permission)

## Permissions

- `colorchat.salt` - Allows players to use the `/saltcolor` command

### Setting up permissions with LuckPerms

If you're using LuckPerms, you can set up the permissions with the following commands:

```mcfunction
# Give the permission to all players
/lp group default permission set colorchat.salt true

# Or give the permission to a specific group
/lp group vip permission set colorchat.salt true

# Or give the permission to a specific player
/lp user <player> permission set colorchat.salt true
```

## Supported Minecraft Versions

- Tested on 1.20.1
- Should work on most recent versions

## License

title: KubeJS ItemPhysics
description: Dynamic item interactions powered by scripted events.
body:
# KubeJS Item Physics  

**KubeJS Item Physics** is an addon for KubeJS that enhances item interactions by introducing physics-based events. This allows modders to script custom behaviors when players pick up items, enabling more dynamic and immersive mechanics.  

## Features  
- 🎮 **Physics-Based Item Pickup Events** – Modify how items are collected based on scripted interactions.  
- 🔧 **KubeJS Event Integration** – Use JavaScript to define custom physics behaviors.  
- 🛠️ **Access to Player, Hand, and Item Data** – Retrieve essential information for precise control over item interactions.  

## Available Event  
### `KubeJSItemPhysics.playerPhysicsPickupEvent(event => { })`  
This event is triggered when a player picks up an item with physics-based interactions.  

### Event Methods  
| Method | Description |  
|--------|------------|  
| `event.getEntity()` | Returns the `PlayerEntity` who picked up the item. |  
| `event.getHand()` | Returns the `Hand` used to pick up the item. |  
| `event.getItem()` | Returns the `ItemEntity` being picked up. |

description: ✨plugin that allows players to report issues or players directly to a Discord server✨
body:
![UR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e4e71956ca19eb7774e6a84a985f2fd573ee403.png)
**UltimateReport** is a versatile Minecraft plugin that allows players to report issues or problematic players directly to a designated Discord server. This plugin is designed to be highly configurable, enabling server administrators to tailor the reporting process to their specific needs. With support for MiniMessage and legacy color codes, UltimateReport ensures that messages are formatted clearly and attractively, both in-game and in Discord.

## Features:

1. Configurable Reporting: Customize the reporting format, messages, and behavior to suit your server's needs.
2. Discord Integration: Send reports directly to a specified Discord channel for quick and efficient moderation.
3. MiniMessage Support: Utilize advanced text formatting, such as gradients and special effects, for visually appealing messages.
4. Legacy Color Codes: Easily use traditional Minecraft color codes for compatibility with older versions and simple color formatting.

## Commands:

- /report "offender" "report":
> Allows a player to report another player by specifying the offender's username and a brief description of the issue or behavior being reported. This report will be sent to the configured Discord channel for moderators to review.

- /ur (ultimatereport) reload: 
> Reloads the plugin configuration, allowing any changes made to the configuration files to take effect without needing to restart the server.

title: FediLookup
description: A mod which allows players to set their Fediverse address and query those of other players.
body:
# FediLookup A Fabric mod for Minecraft which allows players to set their fediverse address (e.g. `@seercat@example.com`) and query those of other players. ## Commands - `/fedi who ` - Shows the fedi address of a player, if they have one set. - Autocomplete lists all players who have set an address, including offline players. - `/fedi reverse
` - Performs a reverse search to get the Minecraft user with a given fedi address. - Autocomplete lists all known fedi addresses. - `/fedi set
` - Associates your Minecraft account with the given fedi address. - `/fedi set-other
` - Requires OP - Associates a specified Minecraft account with the given fedi address. - `/fedi unset` - Removes any fedi account associations from yourself. - `/fedi unset []` - Requires OP - Removes any fedi account associations from a specified player. - Autocomplete lists all players who have set an address, including offline players. - `/fedi reload-config` - Requires OP - Reloads the configuration file from disk. ## Configuration There is nothing configurable at the moment. The main config file can be reloaded at runtime by an operator using `/fedi reload-config`. An additional file contains the stored data about accounts and players. This file should not be manually modified unless the server is shutdown, or ideally not at all.

title: Subtitle Warning System
description: Sets all subtitles to blank except creeper hisses, wardens spawning, etc
body:
### Note: 
I've been getting burnt from Minecraft, and updating my projects has fallen lower on my priority list. I designed them with forward compatibility in mind, so there's a good chance the old project version will work on newer MC versions. If that doesn't work, and you really want an updated version, shoot me an email at lightningtow.games@gmail.com and I can get it updated for you.

### Subtitle Warning System
No mods required!

Makes all the subtitles blank except for creepers hissing, ghasts shooting fireballs, wardens spawning, sculk shriekers shrieking, etc. In other words, this filters subtitles to provide only useful information, because they're difficult to decipher with a dozen entries for 'footsteps' and 'water flows'. Useful for people who like to play with the game muted or have trouble hearing well, and would like to use the subtitles to alert them of important noises.

This pack works on all older Minecraft versions, and works somewhat on newer versions. If you use it on an older version of Minecraft, it works perfectly because MC just ignores translation keys from newer versions. On newer versions of Minecraft, the subtitles for newly added sounds will still appear as normal.

Ensure your setting for 'Hostile Creatures' is at least 1% volume, or else Minecraft won't display the subtitle for those, including creeper hisses. You can have the master volume at 0% without any issues

Note: this pack only changes the English subtitles by default (`en_us.json`). To use in a different language, change the filename to the locale code as specified [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Language)

title: HttpInfoServer
description: Minecraft HTTP API server that runs locally on the player's computer and hosts in-game player's info
body:
# HttpInfoServer
Minecraft fabric mod that collects and sends in-game information to **Minecraft HTTP API server** (another my repo). The project consists of `Minecraft fabric mod (agent)` and `HTTP API server`. The code of the Minecraft fabric mod is located in this repo and the HTTP API server code is located by this link: [\*link\*](https://github.com/dadencukillia/httpInfoServer). Read the full manual to get everything set up correctly.

# Manual
The full manual you can read here: [read](https://gist.github.com/dadencukillia/006473a91295191963596ab21f9d3b8b)

# Build
I recommend you use IDEAs like `IntelliJ IDEA` or `Eclipse`. But If you would like to generate a `.jar` file without any IDEA you can use the command `gradle build` in the project root (be sure Java version 17 and higher is installed).

# Installing
Be sure that you already installed the Fabric of a needed version of Minecraft. Follow the link with releases [\*link\*](https://github.com/dadencukillia/httpInfoServer-mod/tags). Choose and download the **.jar** file needed version of Minecraft (also check the patch version). Put the downloaded file to the `.mods` folder (it is located by the `%AppData%/.minecraft/mods` path in most cases). Run Minecraft using fabric installation in your launcher.

# Contribution
I will be glad if you can help in the development of this project. What you can do:
- Spelling correction. My English is not good, so you can correct the comments in the code or the text in the files (like [README.md](https://github.com/dadencukillia/httpInfoServer-mod/blob/main/README.md)).
- Code cleanup
- Add new features or improve old ones

## Code structure:
The code files are located in the folder that follows the path:  `src/main/java/com.crocoby`. There are some files in this folder:
- `HttpInfoServer.java` — have an entrance method that is called `onInitialize` and starts when Minecraft loads. We create and run WebSocket instances in the `onInitialize` method.
- `WebSocketDoor.java` — The project uses the [TooTallNate/Java-WebSocket](https://github.com/TooTallNate/Java-WebSocket) library to make a WebSocket client. The WebSocket class describes the behavior of the WebSocket client that connects to the WebSocket server (another repo). When the server sends a message with the text "collectData" the WebSocket client uses `InfoCollector` class (this behavior is described in the `onMessage` method).
- `InfoCollector.java` — Have the `genJson` function that collects data and turns it into JSON string format. This method needs to generate a response for the WebSocket server.
- `mixin/WorldJoinMixin.java` — Have the `init` method that invokes whenever a player joining to any world (server works too). It sends a message in the in-game chat when the WebSocket client is not connected to the WebSocket server.

title: Trading Cards Resource Pack
description: Provides CIT models for Trading Cards plugin items.
body:
This resource pack provides card models and textures for use with the Spigot plugin Trading Cards

#### **[Currently there is a bug in OptiFine 1.21.3+ breaks CIT NBT matching.]**

Requirements:

OptiFine (Tested on 1.17.1 - 1.19.2)
Version 3.0.0+: Trading Cards plugin: https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/trading-cards.105709/

(Version 2.x compatible with older Xen's Trading Cards) https://github.com/Xenoyia/XenTradingCards

 

Client Installation:

Place the zip file inside the minecraft\resourcepacks directory
Set Custom Items: On in Video > Quality
Enable the resource pack in the resource pack menu.

 

Server Installation:

Go to the releases section on GitHub: https://github.com/isaaclepes/TradingCardsResource/releases

Copy the link for the zip file you wish to offer your users as well as the SHA1 listed in the changelog.

With server offline, edit server.properties. This example is for v3.0.1 of this pack:

    resource-pack-prompt="Textures and Models for Trading Cards"

    resource-pack=https://github.com/isaaclepes/TradingCardsResource/releases/download/v3/TradingCardsResource-3.0.1.zip

    resource-pack-sha1=a5dd64e1eb4115e02cce43c163afe52fbd6e8521

Save changes to server.properties

Start your server.

Unless users have disabled server resource packs, they will be offered to download the pack on next join. The pack will be automatically set to active while they are connected to the server, but will not show in their resource packs list when connected to other servers or playing single player.

Users will still need to set Custom Items: On in Video > Quality

 

Discord: https://discord.gg/2kBzNb2cRy

 

Notes:

 

Version 3.0.0 introduces new CIT matching to support the custom-model-data NBT tag added by the newer TradingCards plugin.

This breaks backwards compatibility with Xen's TradingCards, but it is well worth converting to the new one.

 

This pack does not rely on any methods specific to a version of Minecraft. It should work on any version for which the Trading Cards plugin will function.

 

This pack is incredibly small, because almost every texture it uses is referenced from Minecraft internal textures. This means the texture availability is dependent upon the version of Minecraft you run it on.
For example, Amethyst did not exist until 1.17.1. If you wanted all textures to work on older versions of Minecraft, you could open the latest Minecraft JAR as a ZIP file, extract the missing textures, and create a simple resource pack to add them. These are located within the various directories at 'assets\minecraft\textures' inside the JAR file.

 

Huge thanks to DarnComputer. "Xen's Trading Card Resource Pack" heavily inspired this project: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/xens-trading-cards-resource-pack

 

This pack was designed using Photoshop, Blockbench, and Notepad++. Resources for creating custom cards are available on the GitHub in the dev folder.

# **Gems and Crystals**

![Gems and crystals header](https://i.imgur.com/nT9uSDz.png)

### **Expand your Minecraft world with new gems, crystals, tools, armor, and enhanced world generation.**

Gems and Crystals enriches your adventure with new materials, biome‑based ore generation, quartz growth mechanics, and complete equipment sets designed to complement vanilla progression.

---

## **New Materials**

Discover and collect a variety of unique gemstones:

- Ruby  
- Sapphire  
- Topaz  
- Amethyst *(pre‑1.17 progression)*  
- Quartz *(Overworld variant with growth blocks)*  

![Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, Topaz, Amethyst, Quartz](https://i.imgur.com/Qu7hVMt.png)

Each material includes its own items, blocks, and worldgen features.

---

## **Tools, Armor & Horse Armor**

Forge powerful new equipment sets:

- Ruby Tools & Armor  
- Sapphire Tools & Armor  
- Emerald Tools & Armor  
- Topaz Tools & Armor  
- Amethyst Tools & Armor  
- Quartz Tools & Armor  

![Ruby Armor, Sapphire Armor, Emerald Armor, Topaz Armor, Amethyst Armor, Quartz Armor](https://i.imgur.com/IhYKxNr.png)

All materials also include **matching horse armor**.

---

## **Quartz Growth Blocks (1.5.0+)**

Quartz now features a full growth system similar to amethyst:

- Budding Quartz  
- Small Quartz Bud  
- Medium Quartz Bud  
- Large Quartz Bud  
- Quartz Cluster  

These blocks generate naturally inside **Quartz Geodes** and can be harvested normally.

---

## **World Generation**

Explore a richer overworld with biome‑specific ore generation and small/large ore variants.

### Ruby  
- Rare, deep‑underground ore  
- Found across most overworld biomes  

### Sapphire  
- Common in cold and snowy biomes  
- Appears in frozen peaks and mountain ranges  

### Topaz  
- Spawns in warm biomes: deserts, savannas, badlands, meadows, warm oceans  
- Generates higher in the world with occasional deep pockets  

### Amethyst Ore  
- Found in cave‑dense and darker biomes  
- More common in Deep Dark and underground cave systems  

### Quartz Ore  
- Overworld quartz variant  
- More common in mountainous terrain  
- **Does not generate inside geodes**

### Quartz Geodes  
- Generate similarly to vanilla amethyst geodes  
- Contain Budding Quartz, Quartz Buds, and Quartz Clusters  
- Provide renewable quartz‑themed decorative blocks  

![Ruby Ore, Sapphire Ore, Topaz Ore, Amethyst Ore, Quartz Ore](https://i.imgur.com/x73jiQ5.png)

---

## **Equipment Strength Overview**

| Material | Tier | Notes |
|---------|------|-------|
| Quartz | Below Iron | Early‑game option |
| Amethyst | Around Iron | Faster early progression |
| Topaz | Between Iron & Diamond | Mid‑game upgrade |
| Emerald | Between Diamond & Iron | Utility‑focused tier |
| Sapphire | Near Diamond+ | Biome‑specific rarity |
| Ruby | Diamond+ | High‑end gem tier |

---

## **Design Philosophy**

- Enhances — not replaces — vanilla progression  
- Rewards biome exploration  
- Each material offers tradeoffs, not strict upgrades  
- Multiple viable progression paths  

---

title: Jugs' Calories
description: A mod adding a calories based hunger system and a lot more.
body:
## About
Jugs' Calories adds new survival related mechanics like thirst, body-temperature, food-freshness and crop-nutrient system as well as a revamped, caloric based hunger system.

## Gameplay
Instead of the traditional hunger bar, you now have to consume an activity based amount of calories. Food will decay over time, which can be helped with by building a cellar and keeping your food stored in there. When growing crops, they now take much longer to grow and consume nutrients, which will slowly replenish over time when an area of farmland is not being used. You also need to manage your body temperature by utilizing hot and cold blocks and items like a bucket of snow or staying near a campfire. Health now regenerates much more slowly over time, making Golden Apples and Healing Potions much more useful now. Lastly, you need to sleep. Yes, I know. Groundbreaking idea.

## Features
- Ring overlay for water, food, temperature and fatigue with configurable colors
- Spoilage system for food
- Dynamic cellar building to reduce food spoilage
- Body temperature
- Much longer crop growth and farmland nutrients (taking into account chunk unloading)

title: Grippers
description: A horror-comedy mod featuring a custom dimension, cryptic secrets, explore carefully, there's more going on than it seems.
body:
# 🦶 Grippers

**Fabric · Minecraft 1.21.1 · Beta**

```
Gripp first or be gripped
```


Something is wrong with your world and nobody's talking about it. Dig deep enough, explore far enough, and you'll start finding things that don't belong, messages left behind by people who aren't people anymore.

There's a way through. You'll know it when you see it. What's on the other side isn't for the faint of heart.

---

## What is this

Grippers is a horror-comedy mod built around exploration, discovery, and 3 bossfights that will make you want to uhhh, idk tbh. I'm not going to spoil the details here half the fun is figuring out what's going on.

What I will say:

- There is a **custom dimension**. It is grippy.
- There are 3 **bosses**. They are grippy.
- There are **things living there** that shouldn't be there.
- There are items, lore, and secrets scattered everywhere. Explore. Pay attention.
- Killing the bosses will not be the end. Try bringing him back. 

~~There's no going back...~~

---

## Heads up

- ⚠️ **Shaders are not optimized for the custom dimension** - they may cause visual issues or performance drops. The mod will handle this for you, but just know going in.
- 🧪 This is an **beta release**. The core content is fully playable but I have a ton of ideas still in the works. More is coming soon.
- 🐛 Bug reports and feedback are appreciated - this is just the beginning.

**Requires:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) · [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)

title: Extra Steps
description: Discover new production chains for leather, wool and paper while mixing nearly endless color combinations to dye placeable blocks and leather armor
body:
![Extra Steps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4369159f082fc9366078a6d856d6902ada47e2c8_0.webp)

Experience a slow start as animals no longer drop wool or leather in their usual form. Sheep now provide Crumbled or Raw Wool and cows yield Cow Rawhide. Most vanilla animals gain their own version of Rawhide, and if other mods add animals that would drop leather, these drops are replaced with a generic Rawhide, keeping the system consistent. Even Paper can no longer be crafted directly through the vanilla recipe.

Processing leather, wool and paper has never been more involved. Through scriping, washing, drying, brushing, compressing and mixing, every step of the production chain becomes meaningful and engaging. 

![Roadmap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e24ed26bfbd3699f5bd173ffec8d5a95254ff90e.png)
**Note: Version 1.2.0 also introduces a production chain for Sugar Cane -> Paper. The Roadmap will be updated soon**


## Dyeing & Mixing

During the washing process, you can optionally add colors, allowing you to create dyed wool and leather armor. The possibilities are nearly limitless, as colors can be mixed to achieve virtually any shade you imagine. 

![Colorful and Responsive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b351c50fa70838ee6773e2182ad0caf0b8546bfe.png)

Leather armor can be customized with your chosen colors and wool blocks can be placed in the world in your personally crafted shades.

## Customisation

All Recipes (Scraping, Cleaning & Dyeing, Drying, Brushing, Compressing & Mixing) are datapack driven and therefore expandable following this [wiki](https://github.com/FireI3laze/Extra-Steps-Mod/wiki)

## Credits

Extra Steps is officially working together with the [Author](https://modrinth.com/user/Silver20632222) of the [Rawhide](https://modrinth.com/mod/raw-hide) Mod and includes some of its textures and features

### Known Issues

- Placed Lye Water Buckets with dyed lye water lose their color

title: LumenSmith
description: Configurable recipe manager: disable vanilla recipes and add your own
body:
![LumenSmithLogo1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9d096ac6857d987d5080c2a65d40c7510518001.png)

# LumenSmith Configurable Crafting

**LumenSmith** is a lightweight, beginner-friendly plugin that lets you **disable**, **replace**, and **create** crafting recipes on your Paper or Purpur server entirely through an **in-game GUI** or a simple `config.yml`.

No coding. No datapacks. No config editing required, just open the recipe creator and click.

**[Full documentation and guides on the wiki](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/)**

---

## What It Does

* **Block vanilla crafting outputs**, stop items like TNT, TNT Minecart, or Totems from being crafted.
* **Add custom recipes** for **shaped**, **shapeless**, **furnace**, **blasting**, **smoking**, **campfire**, **stonecutting**, **smithing transform**, **adjacent-pair**, and **brewing-stand** recipe types.
* **Custom brewing recipes** with any ingredient, including items vanilla normally refuses like logs, blocks, and tools. A full 20-second brew animation plays, blaze powder is consumed, and the bottles are replaced just like vanilla.
* **In-game recipe creator** with a categorised type selector (Crafting / Cooking / Stonecutting / Smithing / Brewing). Build recipes visually with `/ls create <key>`, click slots, pick items from your inventory, adjust cooking time, fuel restrictions, and more. No config editing needed.
* **Edit & delete recipes in-game**, browse your recipes with `/ls`, then edit or delete them with one click. Quick-action buttons in the browser open the creator, toggle a Delete Mode, or switch to a Blocked Outputs view.
* **Fuel restrictions** for cooking recipes (e.g. only Coal and Lava Bucket).
* **Custom unlock triggers**, pick exactly which items pop the recipe into the recipe book, or leave it on Auto.
* **Adjacent pair direction**, control whether adjacent-pair recipes work horizontally, vertically, or both.
* **Auto-replace vanilla recipes**, your custom ones override automatically, and removed vanilla recipes come back the moment you take a custom one out.
* **Instant auto-unlock**, recipes appear in the recipe book the same tick the trigger item enters the player's inventory.
* **World filter support**, enable or disable crafting rules per world.
* **Instant reloads**, `/ls reload` updates recipes live, no restart needed.
* **Ultra-lightweight**, optimized with O(1) lookups, pre-computed data, and zero per-tick overhead.

---

## Documentation

Everything is on the wiki, organised so you can jump straight to what you need.

| Page | What's on it |
|------|--------------|
| [**Home**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/) | Overview, screenshots, quick start guide |
| [**Commands**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/commands.html) | Every `/ls` command with examples and the in-game GUI explained |
| [**Configuration**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/configuration.html) | Global settings, world filter, blocked outputs, full example `config.yml` |
| [**Recipes**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/recipes.html) | All 10 recipe types with YAML snippets and field reference |
| [**Permissions**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/permissions.html) | Permission nodes for crafting, admin, and GUI access |
| [**Changelog**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/changelog.html) | Version history, what changed, why, and how to migrate |
| [**Terms**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/terms.html) | Licence and usage terms |

New here? Start with the [**Quick Start guide**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/#quick-start) on the home page. Want to build a recipe right now? See [`/ls create`](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/commands.html#ls-create) in the command reference.

---

## Commands at a Glance

| Command              | Description                                | Permission          |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| `/ls`                | Open the recipe browser GUI                 | `lumensmith.gui`    |
| `/ls help`           | Show command overview                       | `lumensmith.gui`    |
| `/ls list`           | List blocked outputs and custom recipes     | `lumensmith.admin`  |
| `/ls reload`         | Reload `config.yml` and recipes live        | `lumensmith.admin`  |
| `/ls rescan`         | Force every player's recipe book to update  | `lumensmith.admin`  |
| `/ls create <key>`   | Open the in-game recipe creator             | `lumensmith.create` |
| `/ls delete <key>`   | Delete a custom recipe from config          | `lumensmith.admin`  |

Full reference with screenshots: [**Commands wiki page**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/commands.html).

---

## Supported Recipe Types

| Type                 | What it covers                                    |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `shaped`             | 3x3 crafting grid with a specific layout          |
| `shapeless`          | Any arrangement, up to 9 ingredients              |
| `adjacent_pair`      | Two blocks placed next to each other on the grid  |
| `furnace`            | Standard furnace smelting                         |
| `blasting`           | Blast furnace                                     |
| `smoking`            | Smoker                                            |
| `campfire`           | Campfire cooking                                  |
| `stonecutting`       | Stonecutter                                       |
| `smithing_transform` | Smithing table (template + base + addition)       |
| `brewing`            | Brewing stand (ingredient + bottle to new bottle) |

Field reference and a YAML example for every type lives on the [**Recipes wiki page**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/recipes.html). A complete annotated `config.yml` is on the [**Configuration page**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/configuration.html#full-example).

---

## Why Use LumenSmith?

* Perfect for **SMP**, **RPG**, or **custom survival** servers.
* Custom **brewing-stand recipes** even with ingredients vanilla refuses.
* Redesigned **in-game creator** with a categorised type selector. You never have to touch `config.yml` if you don't want to.
* 100 % YAML when you do, clean and commented.
* Fully reload-safe with `/ls reload`, no restarts to test new recipes.
* Blocks duplication exploits and crafting abuse by default. Removed vanilla recipes restore automatically when a custom one is taken out.
* Runs on **Paper / Purpur 1.21.x** and the new **26.x** API line.
* Ultra-lightweight, no external dependencies, clean console output.

---

## Example in Action

![HowItWorks1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c68fe1ef2aa88b6e395de43775d8b4b1776fe8fc.png)
![HowItWorks2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ccc78f9734153dc462f7d9f49f998c0334f6927.png)
![HowItWorks5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a8b4bad8bbd00aa0f93344dbe7121ce71da7303.png)
![HowItWorks6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22be112156459030622398b7fe75132ec3f517c4.png)

More screenshots on the [**Home page**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/#screenshots).

---

## Quick Start

1. Drop the matching jar into your `plugins/` folder. Use `lumensmith-0.1.5-mc1.21.11.jar` for classic Paper 1.21.x, or `lumensmith-0.1.5-mc26.1.2.jar` for the new Paper 26.x API line.
2. Start the server. LumenSmith generates a commented `config.yml` on first run.
3. Run `/ls` in-game to open the recipe browser, or `/ls create my_recipe` to build a new recipe visually.
4. Need help? Open the [**wiki**](https://nionx01.github.io/LumenSmith/wiki/) or run `/ls help`.

---

Redistribution or modification without permission is prohibited.

title: EzSeasons
description: Configure advanced resets for your world and other plugins
body:
## Make your server ready for wipe

Standalone season reset scheduler for Minecraft servers - EzSeasons

---

## Summary
EzSeasons schedules and broadcasts season resets for Bukkit and Paper servers. It is a focused reset Minecraft plugin designed for server owners who run periodic wipes, seasons, or server resets.

## Features
- Automatic season reset scheduling (explicit windows or duration-based)
- Explicit scheduling: `season.start` and `season.end`
- Fallback duration scheduling: `season.length-days`
- Optional recurring windows: `season.recurring`
- Reminder broadcasts: `season.reminder-minutes`, `season.reminder-message`
- Reset broadcast: `season.broadcast-message`
- Runtime admin commands and status reporting
- Developer API: `SeasonsApi`, `SeasonsIntegration`, `SeasonResetEvent`

## Quick Install (Bukkit / Paper)
1. Drop the plugin jar into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Start or restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` to set schedule and messages.

## Example configuration (config.yml)
```yaml
season:
  enabled: true
  # Use explicit timestamps (millis) for a specific window, or leave 0 to use length-days
  start: 0
  end: 0
  recurring: false
  length-days: 30
  check-interval-minutes: 5
  broadcast-message: "Season resets in {time}!"
  reminder-minutes: [60, 30, 10, 1]
  reminder-message: "Season resets in {minutes} minute(s)!"
```

## Commands
- `/season` - show current status and next reset
- `/season admin reload` - reload plugin config
- `/season admin reset [reason]` - trigger an immediate reset (admin only)
- `/season admin setnext <unixMillis>` - set next reset time manually
- `/season admin clear-next` - clear next-reset override

## Permissions
- `lifesteal.season` (default: true) - allows `/season`
- `lifesteal.admin` (default: op) - allows all admin commands

## Developer API
Obtain `SeasonsApi` via Bukkit Services Manager. Available methods:
- `registerIntegration(SeasonsIntegration integration)`
- `unregisterIntegration(SeasonsIntegration integration)`
- `getIntegrations()`
- `triggerSeasonReset(String reason)`

Events published:
- `SeasonResetEvent`
- `SeasonsIntegrationRegisteredEvent`
- `SeasonsIntegrationUnregisteredEvent`

## Best Practices for Server Owners
- Always test reset behavior on a staging server before scheduling production wipes.
- Combine EzSeasons with your backup tooling - EzSeasons does not perform backups.
- Use `season.reminder-minutes` to announce the reset early and reduce player frustration.

## Support & License
- Source & docs: https://github.com/ez-plugins/EzSeasons
- Download (Modrinth): https://modrinth.com/plugin/ezseasons
- Report issues: https://github.com/ez-plugins/EzSeasons/issues
- License: MIT

Includes various mods such as Tech Reborn, AE2, Create, Bewitchment, Hexalia, and a lot of mods to change world gen, give decorative blocks, and adds a new dark darker yet darker dimension. **Be sure to set up your simple voice chat even if you don't plan on talking** it is pretty easy all you have to do is go to the mod list, hover over the Simple Voice Chat icon, and then click and it will prompt you on how to set up the mod. You **MUST** manually allocate at least 4GB of RAM to the modpack, people with **4-5GB of RAM allocated** should have the modpack run fine if you aren't having to generate terrain on a solo world but **8GB is best**. Also before joining the server, be sure to go to the mod menu, look up Simple Voice Chat, go to In Game Menu, and then set the speakers and microphone.

title: More Enchantments
description: Add a disenchanting table, an anvil and more enchantments.
body:
This mod adds several enchantments, an anvil that won’t display "Too expensive", and a disenchanting table.

## Enchantments

### Butcher【sword】level 1
Killing certain mobs drops more food.

### Life Steal【sword】level 1~3
Each attack restores health equal to damage × level × 0.1, and consumes hunger based on the amount healed. Incompatible with Steadfastness.

### Steadfastness【sword】level 1~3
Each attack has a 50% chance to restore your health to level ÷ 4 × player.getMaxHealth(), and consumes hunger based on the amount healed. Incompatible with Life Steal.

### Synergy Strike【sword, axe, trident】level 1
Each attack triggers all items with this enchantment in the inventory to attack ( e.g., if both a Netherite Sword and a Diamond Sword have the Synergy Strike enchantment, the total damage dealt by either sword is 8+7=15 ). Each item name is limited to one instance ( if there are two or more Diamond Swords, only one will take effect ). It has a 5-second cooldown, supports the Sharpness, Smite, and Bane of Arthropods enchantments, and the triggered items will consume durability.

### Ore Vein Mining【pickaxe】level 1
Vein mines ores. The maximum range can be set in the config file, with a default value of 16.

### 1×2 Excavation【pickaxe】level 1
Digs a 1×2 area of stone. Incompatible with 3×3 Excavation.

### 3×3 Excavation【pickaxe】level 1
Digs a 3×3 area of stone. Incompatible with 1×2 Excavation.

### Smelting【pickaxe, axe, shovel and so on】level 1
Drops corresponding items based on furnace recipes when breaking blocks.

### Obtaining
Obtained via villager trading, loot chests, etc. Cannot be acquired from the Enchanting Table.

## Anvil
Has no "Too expensive" limit and is unbreakable.

### Obtaining
Crafting.

## Disenchanting Table
Items inside the Disenchanting Table will display their enchantments. Whether text is shown on the Disenchanting Table and the text color can be modified in the config file.

### Usage
Right-click the Disenchanting Table while holding the item, then right-click the Disenchanting Table while holding a book to remove one enchantment and obtain an Enchanted Book, at the cost of 5 levels of experience.

### Obtaining
Crafting.


这个mod添加了一些附魔，一个没有过于昂贵的铁砧以及祛魔台。

## 附魔

### 屠夫【剑】level 1
击杀部分生物掉落更多食物。

### 生命窃取【剑】level 1~3
每次攻击恢复 伤害值 × level × 0.1 点生命值，并根据回复量消耗饱食度。与坚定不兼容。

### 坚定【剑】level 1~3
每次攻击有50%的概率让生命值恢复至 level ÷ 4 × player.getMaxHealth()，并根据回复量消耗饱食度。与生命窃取不兼容。

### 协击【剑、斧、三叉戟】level 1
每次攻击调用物品栏内所有拥有这个附魔的物品攻击（如下界合金剑+钻石剑都具有协击附魔，其中任意一把剑造成的伤害总计为8+7=15），每个物品名限一次（如有两把或多把钻石剑，那么只有一把生效），cd5秒，支持锋利、亡灵杀手、节肢杀手附魔，被调用的物品会消耗耐久。

### 连锁采矿【镐】level 1
连锁挖掘矿物，最远距离可在config文件里设置，默认16。

### 1×2挖掘【镐】level 1
挖掘1×2范围石头。与3×3挖掘不兼容。

### 3×3挖掘【镐】level 1
挖掘3×3范围石头。与1×2挖掘不兼容。

### 冶炼【镐、斧、铲等】level 1

### 获取
村民交易、战利品箱等，不能通过附魔台获取。

## 铁砧
没有过于昂贵的限制，不会损坏。

### 获取

物品在祛魔台内会显示拥有的附魔。祛魔台是否显示文字、文字颜色可在config文件里更改。

### 使用
手持物品右键祛魔台，然后手持书右键祛魔台，可以去掉一个附魔并得到附魔书，消耗五级经验。

title: StatusTag
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that adds customizable status tags to players using Minecraft's scoreboard system.
body:
# Statustag – Fabric Mod

A lightweight Fabric mod that adds customizable status tags to players using Minecraft's scoreboard system.
Below is the English description, followed by the German version.

------------------------------------------------------------
# English
------------------------------------------------------------

## Description

Statustag is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows players and server admins to create custom status tags.
These tags appear as colored prefixes in the player's nametag using Minecraft's scoreboard team system.

All statuses and player assignments are automatically saved in "statustag.json" and restored when the server starts.
The mod supports all Minecraft standard text colors:
black, dark_blue, dark_green, dark_aqua, dark_red, dark_purple, gold, gray, dark_gray, blue, green, aqua, red, light_purple, yellow, white... and more 


## Features

- Create custom status tags
- Assign any tag to yourself or other players
- Choose from all Minecraft formatting colors
- Status tags appear as scoreboard prefixes
- Automatic saving/loading via statustag.json
- Works on servers only
- Fully compatible with other scoreboard systems


## Commands
```
/statusadd <id> <name> <color> - Creates a new status tag (requires permission level 2)
/statusremove <id> - Deletes an existing status (requires permission level 2)
/status <id> - Sets your own status
/status <id> <player> - Sets status for another player (requires permission level 2)
/status reset - Removes your own status
/status reset <player> - Removes another player's status (requires permission level 2)
```

------------------------------------------------------------
# Deutsch
------------------------------------------------------------

## Beschreibung

Statustag ist eine leichte Fabric-Mod, mit der Spieler und Admins eigene Status-Tags erstellen und verwalten können.
Diese Tags erscheinen als farbige Präfixe über dem Spielernamen über das Minecraft-Scoreboard-Team-System.

Alle Status und Spielerzuweisungen werden automatisch in "statustag.json" gespeichert und beim Serverstart geladen.
Die Mod unterstützt alle Minecraft Standardfarben:
black, dark_blue, dark_green, dark_aqua, dark_red, dark_purple, gold, gray, dark_gray, blue, green, aqua, red, light_purple, yellow, white... und mehr


## Funktionen

- Eigene Status-Tags erstellen
- Tags Spielern zuweisen oder entfernen
- Alle Minecraft-Formatierungsfarben verfügbar
- Tags erscheinen als Scoreboard-Präfixe
- Automatisches Speichern/Laden über statustag.json
- Funktioniert nur auf Servern
- Kompatibel mit anderen Scoreboard-Systemen


## Befehle
```
/statusadd <id> <name> <farbe> - Erstellt einen neuen Status (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/statusremove <id> - Löscht einen bestehenden Status (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/status <id> - Setzt deinen eigenen Status
/status <id> <spieler> - Setzt den Status eines anderen Spielers (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
/status reset - Entfernt deinen eigenen Status
/status reset <spieler> - Entfernt den Status eines anderen Spielers (Benötigt Berechtigungsstufe 2)
```
