title: Murcs Zombie Additions - "Apocolypse Structures"
description: New structures, items, and Zombies meant to enhance the gameplay of apocalypse-themed modpacks!
body:
# Murcs Zombie Additions
This mod adds various additions to the world, such as new Zombies, Structures, and two new biomes! This mod is intended to be very compatible with most other mods, (especially apocalypse themed mods) and unintrusive on the gameplay while still adding additional challenges and fun items to obtain.

# Additions

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

## New Zombies
### Stronger Zombie
A stronger, faster, and generally better version of the vanilla zombie in terms of stats, as well as having additional drops.
### Gruesome Zombie
An incredibly strong zombie that can climb walls and does even more damage than the stronger zombie.
### Nether Zombie
For any apocalypse modpack that doesnt ban the dimensions, the End and Nether now have their own zombie varients. The nether zombies spawn somewhat frequently, and are slightly stronger than normal zombies. But, around a second after taking damage, they shoot out a fireball.
### End Zombie
This neutral zombie varient is very easy to get overwhelmed by when inside of the End dimension. They spawn frequently, and teleport to a random location around them when damaged.
### Condemned Infected
These zombies are slow, but tanky floating enemies in the end. They dont take knockback and deal quite a lot of damage. keep these zombies in mind while in the End and dont forget about them!

## New Biomes
### The Barrenlands
The Barrenlands is a large, rubble covered wasteland that spawns exclusively zombies. (See Gallery)

### The Ruins
The Ruins is a somewhat rare biome made of mostly stone based blocks. The entire biome is covered with hostile grey structures and ruined buildings. (See Gallery)

## New Items
### Inhospitable Soil
A new dirt type used in the generation of the Barrenlands.

### Ender Flesh
Dropped by End Zombies and Condemned infected, and can be used in a brewing stand to create Potions of Random Teleporting.

### Empty Syringe
Used as a material for different types of injections.

### Zombie Heart
Occasionally dropped by Stronger Zombies and Gruesome Zombies, the zombie heart can be used in a brewing stand with empty syringes to create the Zombie Blood Injection.

### Nether Flesh
Dropped by Nether Zombies.

### Dusted Flesh
Crafted with Nether Flesh and Blaze Powder

### Potion of Random Teleporting
A potion that randomly teleports you while active, and is crafted with ender flesh

### Potion of Fireball
A potion that allows you to shoot fireballs, and is crafted with Dusted Flesh

### Leather Strip
Created when Rotten Flesh is smelted in a furnace. put 5 in a crafting table to get one piece of leather.

### Glistening Chunk
Used to create Health Injections in the brewing stand.

### Hyperactive Pile
Used to create Adrenaline Injections in the brewing stand.

### Dangerous Mass
Used to create Pure Stimulant in the brewing stand.

### Bandage
Crafted with two paper and one wool, Bandages give you regeneration for a small amount of time.

### Health Injection
When used, gives instant health alongside some regeneration and resistance.

### Adrenaline Injection
Gives multiple positive effects, but when the injection wears off you are inflicted with slowness and weakness for a while.

### Pure Stimulant
Gives dramatic positive effects, alongside random bouts of darkness and nausea. when the effects end, you are inflicted with strong negative effects for a time.

### Zombie Blood Injection
The Zombie Blood injection inflicts the "Infected" effect. This cannot be cured with milk and only goes away once you die. your base attack damage, attack knockback, resistance, speed, and swim speed are increased as well as water breathing and random regeneration. the negatives though, include always having hunger, random moments of weakness, and random moments of slowness. You can never starve or go below 2 hunger bars, but the hunger makes you eat a lot just to be able to run. Also rotten flesh is a somewhat viable food because of this!

</details>

# Comments
This mod was originally just used as a way for me to add more depth to my apocalypse server, so I had a few mods in mind to go well with it.

most of the structures and enemies were made with [Timeless and Classics Zero](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) in mind, but they could work just as well with any other gun mod.

I would also heavily recommend adding mods that give additional mobility such as [ParCool](https://modrinth.com/mod/parcool) due to the speed and aggression of some of the zombies.

Also the mispelling of Apocalypse is there to be charming trust me on this

Enjoy!

title: DragonEgg
description: DragonEgg - Ultimate Dragon Power Plugin
body:
# DragonEgg - Ultimate Dragon Power Plugin

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/DragonEgg/Plugin/releases)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE)

**Transform the iconic Dragon Egg into an artifact of immense power!** DragonEgg is a modern, optimized plugin that grants permanent abilities, extra hearts, and legendary mechanics to players who possess the mythical Dragon Egg.

---

## Visual Effects

DragonEgg includes stunning visual feedback:

| Effect | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Particles** | Dragon breath, end rods, flames around player |
| **Glowing** | Team-based glow effect for bonded players |
| **Custom Item** | Custom name and lore for the Dragon Egg |
| **Sounds** | Unique sounds for each ability activation |

---

## Requirements

| Software | Version |
|----------|---------|
| **Paper/Spigot** | 1.20.4+ (compatible with 1.19-1.20.x) |
| **Java** | 17+ |

**Optional Dependencies:**
- Vault (for permission integration)
- LuckPerms (for permission groups)
- PlaceholderAPI (for placeholders)

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest version
2. Place `DragonEgg.jar` in your `plugins/` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure in `plugins/DragonEgg/config.yml`

---

## Commands

```
/dragonegg                  - Show help
/dragonegg give <player>    - Give Dragon Egg to player
/dragonegg reload           - Reload configuration
/dragonegg info [player]    - Show Dragon Egg statistics
/dragonegg sethearts <amt>  - Set extra hearts
/dragonegg menu             - Open GUI configuration menu
/dragonegg addEffect <effect> <level>  - Add effect
/dragonegg removeEffect <effect>       - Remove effect
/dragonegg setEffectLevel <effect> <level> - Set effect level
/dragonegg clearEffects     - Clear all effects
```

---

## Permissions

```yaml
dragonegg.use                 # Use Dragon Egg features (default: true)
dragonegg.admin               # Full admin access (default: op)
dragonegg.commands.give       # Give Dragon Egg
dragonegg.commands.reload     # Reload config
dragonegg.commands.info       # View info
dragonegg.commands.sethearts  # Set hearts
dragonegg.commands.menu       # Open menu
dragonegg.bypass.limit        # Bypass heart/effect limits
dragonegg.bypass.cooldown     # Bypass ability cooldowns
dragonegg.hearts.vip          # +2 extra hearts
dragonegg.hearts.mvp          # +4 extra hearts
dragonegg.hearts.admin        # +10 extra hearts
```

---

## Configuration

All features are fully configurable in `config.yml`:

```yaml
# Language (en, ua, pl, de, fr, es)
language: en

# Effects
effects:
  STRENGTH:
    enabled: true
    level: 1
    permanent: true

# Hearts
hearts:
  extra: 4
  max-cap: 40

# Mechanics
mechanics:
  aura:
    enabled: true
    radius: 10.0
  fury:
    enabled: true
    hp-threshold: 20.0
  shield:
    negation-chance: 10.0
  revive:
    cooldown-hours: 24
```

---

## Multi-Language Support

DragonEgg includes translations for:

| Language | Code |
|----------|------|
| 🇬🇧 English | en |
| 🇺🇦 Ukrainian | ua |
| 🇵🇱 Polish | pl |
| 🇩🇪 German | de |
| 🇫🇷 French | fr |
| 🇪🇸 Spanish | es |

---

## 📊 Evolution Progression

| Level | Kills | Playtime | Unlocks |
|-------|-------|----------|---------|
| 1 | 0 | 0 min | Base effects |
| 2 | 10 | 1 hour | Strength II |
| 3 | 25 | 3 hours | Speed II, Regen I |
| 4 | 50 | 6 hours | Resistance I |
| 5 | 100 | 12 hours | Absorption II, Fire Resist |

---

## GUI Menu Features

Access `/dragonegg menu` for:

- **Effects Management** - Add, remove, modify effects
- **Hearts Configuration** - Adjust bonus HP
- **Mechanics Toggles** - Enable/disable abilities
- **Visual Settings** - Customize particles and sounds
- **Evolution Progress** - View level and stats

---

## Support

| Platform | Link |
|----------|------|
| **Discord** | [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/mUz2k7X6ju) |
| **Issues** | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/4rubka/DragonEgg/issues) |

---

## License

MIT License - Feel free to use in your server!

---

**DragonEgg** - Unleash the power of the End Dragon!

*Made for Zenith Hub members*

title: xRebirth SMP – Soul System
description: Steal souls, grow stronger, and dominate PvP but death has consequences. Lose all your souls, and you’re banned from the server.
body:
## 🧿 xRebirth SMP – Soul System

**xRebirth SMP – Soul System** is a competitive PvP progression plugin that introduces a unique **Soul-based power mechanic** to your Minecraft server. Every player starts with **5 Souls**, and your strength grows as you defeat others — but death comes with real consequences.

Kill players to steal their souls and permanently increase your damage. Lose all your souls… and you're out.

### 🔮 Default Soul Reviver Recipe ⬇️
![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e130c83dad7cfb917b7bd3fba0186feb6b513335.png)

### ⚔️ Core Features

* 🧍 Every player starts with **5 Souls**
* 💀 Killing a player steals **1 Soul**
* 💥 Each soul gives **+0.5 permanent attack damage**
* ☠️ Dying causes you to **lose 1 Soul**
* 🚫 Reaching **0 Souls results in an automatic ban** (configurable)
* ⏰ **Temporary or permanent ban** - choose ban type in config
* 🛡️ **PvP-only soul loss** - souls only lost on player kills (configurable)
* 🌍 **Natural death protection** - toggle soul loss on natural deaths in config
* 📊 Soul count displayed via **action bar**
* 🛡️ Anti-farming system to prevent soul abuse
* 🎛️ **Toggle anti-farm system** - admins can enable/disable on the fly
* ⏱️ **Configurable anti-farm cooldown** - set wait time between kills in config
* 📜 **Soul Items drop when killer has max souls** - right-click to consume
* 🔒 **Full souls protection** - prevents overconsumption with warning message
* 🔓 **Unban command** - admins can unban players who lost all souls
* 🔧 Fully configurable damage scaling, soul limits & punishments
* 💾 Data saved across restarts
* 🧩 PlaceholderAPI support
* 🧱 Optimized for **Paper / Spigot** servers

### 📋 Commands

* `/souls` - Check your own souls
* `/souls check <player>` - Check another player's souls
* `/souls give soul <player> <amount>` - Give souls to a player (OP only)
* `/souls give reviver <player> [amount]` - Give Soul Reviver item to a player (OP only)
* `/souls remove <player> <amount>` - Remove souls from a player (OP only)
* `/souls set <player> <amount>` - Set a player's souls (OP only)
* `/souls antifarm` - Toggle anti-farm system on/off (OP only)
* `/souls unban <player>` - Unban a player who lost all souls (OP only)
* `/souls recipe` - View Soul Reviver recipe (All players)
* `/souls recipe edit` - Edit Soul Reviver recipe (OP only)
* `/souls reload` - Reload plugin configuration (OP only)

### 🔮 Soul Reviver System

Players can craft a **Soul Reviver** item to bring themselves back from 0 souls!

**Configurable Recipe:**
* Use `/souls recipe` to view the current recipe
* Use `/souls recipe edit` (OP only) to customize the recipe in-game
* Recipe is saved in config and persists across restarts
* Default recipe uses Diamond Blocks, Netherite Ingots, Gold Blocks, and Totem of Undying

**Usage:**
* Right-click the Soul Reviver item to open a GUI
* Select a banned player from the list
* The selected player will be unbanned with **3 souls**
* The Soul Reviver item will be consumed
* Perfect for helping friends who lost all souls!

### 🔥 Risk vs Reward Gameplay

The stronger you become, the bigger the target on your back. Dominate the server… or lose everything.

Perfect for **SMPs**, **competitive factions**, and **high-stakes PvP servers**.

title: WoKPack Vulkan
description: Experimental Vulkan mod variant of the World of Keralis server modpack
body:
# WoKPack Vulkan

**WoKPack Vulkan** is an experimental fork of WOKPack that prioritizes increased framerate and reduced lag. It does this by replacing the game's default renderer with Vulkan, a newer API than openGL, which (on systems that have good vulkan support) can drastically increase performance, and reduce lag spikes. But know that it is incompatible with shaders.

## Focus Areas and Key Dependencies

### 1. Performance optimizations:
- **VulkanMod**: Changes Minecraft's renderer from openGl to Vulkan for vastly improved performance on certain systems
- **FerriteCore**: Reduces memory usage to improve stability.
- **Krypton**: Enhances networking performance and reduces latency.
- **ModernFix**: Addresses common compatibility and optimization issues.
- **Noisium**: Provides sound feedback for in-game events.
- **Better Biome Reblend**: Replaces vanilla's biome blend algorithm with a more efficient one
- **ScalableLux**: Rewrites lighting engine to be more efficient

### 2. Additional Optifine parody features:
- **Polytone**: Enhances the overall aesthetic of your builds.
- **Continuity**: Adds seamless connected textures for a polished look.
- **Capes**: Adds customization options for player visuals.
- **JustZoom**: Offers enhanced zoom functionality.
- **Entity Model Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity model features
- **Entity Texture Features**: Adds Optifinelike entity texture features
- **LambDynamicLights**: Adds Optifinelike dynamic lights

### 3. Quality of life features:
- **WorldEdit**: Provides powerful tools for building and editing large structures.
- **Axiom**: Turns minecraft into 3d modeling software
- **Itemswapper**: Speeds up inventory management by swapping tools automatically.
- **Jade**: Displays helpful block and entity information.
- **Resourcify**: allows you to install and update resourcepacks (including wokflows) and shaderpacks from in game
- **3D-Skin-Layers**: Displays avatar skins layers as 3d
- **BetterF3**: Cleans up the f3 menu and makes it more readable
- **Bigshot**: Allows for higher resolution screenshots
- **Language Reload**: Allows for languages to load faster
- **Model Gap Fix**: Fixes gaps in models
- **More Chat History**: Allows you to scroll further up in chat
- **Remove Loading Screen**: Removes the loading screen, allowing you to get back into game faster
- **No Telemetry**: Removes telemetry
---

**WoKPack** combines cutting-edge performance enhancements with immersive features and user-friendly improvements to provide a seamless Minecraft experience. This pack is designed to keep your game running smoothly while offering tools to expand your creativity whilst building and exploring around the World of Keralis Creative server and beyond.

title: Oath Maker
description: Adds the Oath Maker origin that can create oaths with other players in order to buff them
body:
> **PRIMARY: Select Command**
> - Open a GUI that has right-clickable buttons for each of the commands you can use on your subjects.
> - Commands that have their buff changed based on your selection mode are listed as such, (all/single).
> - Each of your commands have a separate cooldown, two minutes, and a separate duration, (30s/60s).

> **PASSIVE [+]: Available Commands**
> 
> - Fight: (20%/40%) increased damage, (0.5/1) hearts of damage removed every hit
> - Live: (2/4) hearts of damage healed, (2/4) extra hearts
> - Run: (20%/40%) movement speed boost
> - Haste: (20%/40%) mining speed boost
> - Locate: Glowing effect
> - Explode **SINGLE TARGET ONLY**: Explode your selected subject and deal 44 damage--the same as a charged creeper--to everyone, but you, in a 6 block radius.
> - Goto **SINGLE TARGET ONLY**: Teleport to your selected target with a three second cancelable charge
> - Bring: Teleport your selected target(s) to you with a three second cancelable charge
> - Terminate **SINGLE TARGET ONLY**: Remove your oath with your selected targett


> **SECONDARY: Select Target**
> - Get a list of all of your currently alive subjects, alongside their `selection ID`. 
> - This also shows your `Oath Maker ID`
> - You can use the command, `/trigger oathmaker-selection set x`, (replace x is your subjects `selection ID`) to swap your current subject.
> - - Using 0 for a `selection ID` will make you select every subject, some commands do not work with all targeting.

> **PASSIVE [+]: Oath Creation**
> - You can have other players use the command, `/trigger oathmaker-create_oath set x`, (replace x with your `Oath Maker ID`) to create an oath with you.
> - There is no limit to how many oaths you can have.

> **PASSIVE [-]: Connected Soul**
> - When you first spawn in, you suffer from a 80% decrease in stats related to combat. Making oaths lessens this decrease to only 20% at 3 oaths, oaths only count if they are online and alive.
> - You get particle effects and a message whenever your oath count changes.
> - Combat related stats are as follows: armor, armor toughness, attack damage, attack speed.
> - E.g, having only one oath sets the 80% decrease of the above stats to a 60% decrease

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

title: Far From Home
description: This is a mod for world scaling and balanced rewards to go with it.
body:
Far From Home (Neoforge 21.1.215) - The world scales. The deeper you go, the deadlier it becomes. The loot matches the risk. 

A server and client mod that transforms Minecraft into a distance-based progression system. Spawn is safe. Everything beyond becomes increasingly dangerous—and rewarding.

Core Systems:
- Safe Zone -- Configurable spawn radius with PVP disabled. But camping here is punished: ore mining has a 25% chance to yield nothing ("Your skill led you to believe there was ore here, but nothing was recovered"), and diamonds drop at only 1% rate. The message is clear: leave.
- Distance Scaling -- The further from spawn, the stronger the monsters. Level ranges scale dynamically. Mob density adjusts with distance. At 10k blocks, mobs stop burning in daylight. At 100k blocks, you're facing level 500+ enemies. At 1 million blocks, level 2000+.
- Ore Scaling - Mining yields increase in dangerous territories. Risk = reward.
- Loot Bags - Killed monsters drop tiered loot bags (Common → Legendary) containing gear, valuables, and Greater Experience Bottles (50-100 XP per bottle).
- Ancient Enchanting Altar - The ultimate drop. Legendary loot bags have a rare chance to contain this item, which bypasses enchantment slot limits. Stack infinite enchants. This is how you survive the deep zones.

The Goal: Push deeper than anyone else. Prove you can survive where others die. Bring back gear that shouldn't exist.

Part of the Frontier trilogy:
- Far From Home (this mod) -- Creates the world's risk/reward geography
- Sacred Settlements - Allows land claims and creates a village ecosystem
- Frontier Stats - A statistics, leveling, guilds, and rewards mod 

(Passive creatures will receive levels in the first major update.) 

Open Source: MIT licensed.

title: Better Bane Of Arthropods
description: A mod that works to improve Bane of Arthropods for modded play, and give Arthropods more identity!
body:
So we can all agree Bane of Arthropods is awful in vanilla right?

Looking to rehash this pest-squishing enchantment, I asked myself "What would it take for me to start using Bane of Arthropods in a serious capacity? What will make me want to use it over Smite or Sharpness?

And this is what I arrived on - To compensate for the general rarity of spiders (because let's be honest, spiders and cave spiders are what Bane of Arthropods should be used for), the enchantment also gets mild functionality against non-arthropod mobs, like Pillagers and Cows!

 

Below is a full list of the changes made to allow Bane of Arthropods to really find itself having a place in Modded Minecraft's toolkit

(This mod is balanced with the expectation that other mods are included in the mix, you may find this mod to be quite strong in more vanilla-like modpacks!)


**(Arthropods are good against archers! Let's see some melee attackers out there!)**
Arthropods react wildly when hit by ranged attacks, regenerating their health and resisting all damage for 2 seconds (unless they are burning)


**(Most bugs don't wear armor, but if they did, I'd bet it'd be a Myrmex from Ice and Fire!)**
Bane of Arthropods does 1 more damage per level, this damage is magic damage and pierces armor


**(Cave-Spider-Be-Gone!)**
Hitting an Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods removes Poison from the user

**(Silverfish just got a lot scarier!)**
Hitting an Arthropod without Bane of Arthropods gives a very small amount of poison to the attacker, and a little amount of regeneration to the Arthropod

**(We could call it Spider Aspect!)**
Hitting a non-Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods will poison the target for a short duration.

**(The first Life-Steal effect in modded Minecraft that isn't broken!)**
Hitting a poisoned non-Arthropod with Bane of Arthropods will grant a mild regeneration effect to the attacker.





_There is no config, nor will there be one, this mod was made to be plug-and-play._

Still, any feedback is appreciated for this mod! Let's make Bane of Arthropods better together!

 


This small mod was inspired in part by https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/consecration
Go check out their mod!

![Divine Hordes](https://img.shields.io/badge/Divine%20Hordes-v2.6.0-gold?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.18.2--1.21.6-green?style=for-the-badge) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17--21-orange?style=for-the-badge) ![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Production%20Ready-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=for-the-badge) **⚡ Transform your server into an epic battleground where players unite against divine wrath! ⚡** *A divine entity demands offerings from players, spawning enhanced hordes when demands aren't met. Can your players work together to survive the divine judgment?* ### 🚀 **PLUG & PLAY - WORKS INSTANTLY ON ANY SERVER** **🔫 Gun Mod Ready** | **🗡️ Vanilla Perfect** | **👥 Auto-Scaling** | **⚙️ Zero Setup**
![Divine Hordes Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a1c7c30a81990a3bfed08415d5a0706571c7af9.jpeg) --- ## 🌟 Why Choose Divine Hordes? **Divine Hordes** isn't just another mob plugin—it's a complete gameplay transformation that creates unforgettable cooperative experiences. Watch as your players evolve from individual survivors into coordinated teams, working together against an intelligent divine adversary that adapts to their skill level. **Find more plugins, get custom modifications to this plugin (and others), and/or get your dream plugin made by our team on our patreon @ www.patreon.com/wonderfullyevil** ### 🚀 **INSTANT SETUP - WORKS EVERYWHERE** | 🔫 **Gun Mod Ready** | 🗡️ **Vanilla Optimized** | 🚀 **Plug & Play** | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | **One-click toggle** for gun servers | **Perfect balance** for vanilla | **Zero configuration** required | | 75% more mobs, enhanced stats | Progressive difficulty scaling | **Auto-scales** 1-100+ players | | Specialized for powerful weapons | Standard Minecraft weapons | **Works instantly** out-of-box | ### 🎯 **What Makes Us Different** | 🎭 **AI Divine Personality** | 🧠 **Adaptive Intelligence** | 🛡️ **Production Ready** | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | 124+ unique taunting messages | Real-time difficulty scaling | Complete memory management | | 6 distinct personality categories | Equipment & experience aware | Thread-safe operations | | Contextual responses to player actions | Progressive mob enhancement | Zero memory leaks | --- ## ✨ Core Features Overview ### 🏺 **Dynamic Offering System** - **Smart Requirements**: Randomized item demands with history tracking to prevent repetition - **Tier-Based Difficulty**: Easy (logs, stone) → Legendary (diamonds, emeralds) - **💎 Rare Item Protection**: 100+ irreplaceable items protected from offerings - **XP-Based Changes**: Players can negotiate different offerings for experience points - **Variety Guarantee**: Advanced system prevents duplicate offerings between events ### ⚔️ **Enhanced Horde Mechanics** - **Progressive Difficulty**: Mobs spawn 20-40 blocks away with strategic spawn distances - **Real-Time Combat Feedback**: Action bar displays exact damage dealt and remaining HP - **Daylight Immunity**: Divine mobs survive in sunlight with divine protection - **Speed Scaling**: Mobs move 60-70% speed early game, reaching normal speed at Nightmare difficulty - **Smart Restrictions**: Dangerous mobs like ravagers blocked until appropriate difficulty levels - **Sleep Prevention**: Players cannot sleep during events but can still set spawn points with beds - **🏔️ Underground Support**: Cave players can fully participate with intelligent chest spawning ### 📊 **Intelligent Difficulty System** ``` 🕊️ Very Easy (0.4x) → 😈 Nightmare (1.8x) → 💀 Impossible (3.0x) ``` - **Dynamic Calculation**: Based on player equipment, experience, and time progression - **Player Separation**: Player count affects mob quantity, not individual difficulty - **Admin Override**: 9 manual difficulty levels plus automatic dynamic mode - **Real-Time Adaptation**: Difficulty adjusts every 30 seconds based on current conditions ### 🖥️ **Comprehensive GUI System** - **All-in-One Dashboard**: Complete control panel accessible via `/dh` - **Real-Time Statistics**: Live event status, difficulty monitoring, and performance metrics - **Admin Tools**: Instant difficulty overrides, mob spawn controls, and emergency systems - **Player Features**: Teleportation, offering changes, statistics, and interactive tutorials --- ## 🎮 How to Play ### 🚀 **For New Players** 1. **📢 Listen for Divine Demands**: The Divine One announces required offerings every 5-35 minutes 2. **📦 Find the Offering Chest**: Use compass navigation and GUI teleportation to locate the glowing chest 3. **⚔️ Survive the Hordes**: Enhanced mobs spawn immediately—work with your team to survive 4. **🏺 Deliver Items**: Collect and deposit the required materials before time runs out 5. **🎉 Reap Rewards**: Successful completion grants valuable rewards worth more than the offerings ### 📦 **Bounty Box System** Craft a chest to delay the next horde by 30 minutes!: **🛠️ Crafting Recipe:** ``` [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Chest] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] = 1x Bounty Box ``` **⚡ Strategic Mechanics:** - **⏰ Fixed 30-Minute Extension**: Provides exactly 30 minutes of additional time - **🚫 Non-Stackable**: Only one bounty box can be active per event - **📍 Placement Strategy**: Must be placed in loaded chunks to function properly - **✨ Visual Indicators**: Creates unique spiral particle effects when active - **💥 Destruction Fallback**: If destroyed, provides 3-minute emergency timer - **🎯 Optimal Timing**: Best used when 5-10 minutes remain on main timer **💡 Pro Tips:** - Protect with defensive structures to prevent mob destruction - Coordinate with team before placement for maximum effectiveness - Use as last resort when resources are almost complete but time is short - Use to pause horde spawning for long outings (take one with you just in case!) ### 🌙 **Strategic Night Mechanics** - **Sleep Prevention**: Players cannot sleep during active Divine Horde events - **Spawn Point Setting**: Beds still work to set respawn locations during events - **Tactical Pressure**: Teams must survive the full event duration, encouraging cooperation - **Clear Messaging**: Players receive informative explanations when sleep is blocked --- ## 🖥️ Complete Command Reference ### 👤 **Player Commands** | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/dh` | Open comprehensive control panel | `divinehordes.use` | | `/dh status` | Check current event status | `divinehordes.status` | | `/dh help` | Display command help | `divinehordes.help` | ### 👑 **Administrator Commands** | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/dh trigger` | Manually start new event | `divinehordes.admin` | | `/dh override` | Emergency stop current event | `divinehordes.admin` | | `/dh reload` | Hot-reload configuration | `divinehordes.admin` | | `/dh cleanup` | Remove all Divine Horde entities | `divinehordes.admin` | | `/dh memory stats` | View detailed memory usage | `divinehordes.admin` | | `/dh emergency` | Complete system cleanup | `divinehordes.admin` | --- ## 🎛️ Advanced GUI Features ### 📊 **Player Dashboard** - **📈 Live Statistics**: Events participated, completion rate, XP spent, items offered - **🧭 Real-Time Navigation**: Distance and direction to offering chest with compass targeting - **💫 Teleportation System**: Distance-based XP costs (1-5 levels depending on range) - **📚 Interactive Tutorials**: 12+ page comprehensive guide system - **⚙️ Personal Settings**: Notification preferences, particle controls, GUI themes ### 🛠️ **Admin Control Panel** - **🎯 Difficulty Override**: 9 levels + Dynamic mode with instant switching - **🔄 Play Mode Toggle**: Normal vs Gun Mod with specialized mob scaling - **📊 Real-Time Monitoring**: Memory usage, TPS impact, entity counts - **🚨 Emergency Controls**: One-click cleanup, system shutdown, emergency override - **📈 Performance Metrics**: Live server performance and resource utilization --- ## ⚙️ Advanced Configuration ### 🔥 **Dual Intensity Modes - ONE-CLICK TOGGLE** **🔫 Gun Mod Mode** (Instant Switch) - **🎯 Optimized for gun mod servers** - MrCrayfish's Gun Mod, Vic's Modern Warfare, etc. - **⚡ 75% more mobs** with enhanced health and damage scaling - **🔥 Reduced restrictions** for intense ranged combat - **💪 Perfect for powerful weapons** and action-oriented gameplay - **⚙️ Admin GUI toggle** - switch modes instantly without restart **🗡️ Vanilla Mode** (Default - Instant Switch) - **🛡️ Perfectly balanced** for standard Minecraft gameplay - **📈 Progressive difficulty** with safety restrictions for new players - **🏗️ Building-friendly** with strategic combat challenges - **⚙️ Admin GUI toggle** - switch modes instantly without restart **🚀 PLUG & PLAY FEATURES:** - **📦 Zero Setup Required** - Works perfectly out-of-the-box - **👥 Auto-Scaling** - Automatically adjusts for 1-100+ players - **⚙️ Live Configuration** - Change everything via admin GUI or config.yml - **🔄 No Restarts Needed** - All changes apply instantly ### 📦 **Bounty Box System** Craft special delay chests to buy time during events: ``` [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Chest] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] [Iron] ``` - **⏰ 30-Minute Delay**: Purchase additional time when running low - **💎 Strategic Cost**: Valuable items based on server progression - **✨ Visual Effects**: Unique spiral particle effects mark active boxes --- ## 🔌 Integration & Compatibility ### 📋 **System Requirements** - **☕ Java**: 17-21+ (Latest LTS recommended) - **🎮 Minecraft**: 1.18.2 - 1.21.6 - **🖥️ Server**: Bukkit, Spigot, Paper (Paper recommended) - **💾 Memory**: 2GB minimum (4GB+ recommended) ### 🔗 **Dependencies** - **📊 PlaceholderAPI**: 33+ placeholders for external plugin integration ### 🌐 **PlaceholderAPI Support** ```yaml %divinehordes_status% - Current event status %divinehordes_difficulty% - Live difficulty multiplier %divinehordes_timeleft% - Time remaining in event %divinehordes_mobcount% - Active horde mob count %divinehordes_chestdistance% - Distance to offering chest ``` --- ## 🛡️ Production-Grade Performance ### 💾 **Memory Management** - **🔄 Bounded Collections**: LRU eviction prevents memory growth - **🧹 Auto-Cleanup**: Every 30 seconds with configurable thresholds - **📊 Real-Time Monitoring**: GUI-based memory stats and optimization - **🔒 Thread Safety**: All operations properly synchronized - **🚨 Leak Prevention**: Comprehensive cleanup on plugin removal ### ⚡ **Performance Optimization** - **🔀 Async Operations**: Non-blocking file I/O and database operations - **✨ Particle Batching**: Efficient rendering with 5 density levels - **📦 Entity Limits**: Configurable caps prevent server overload - **🎯 Smart Spawning**: Optimized spawn algorithms with distance controls - **📈 TPS Monitoring**: Real-time server performance tracking --- ## 🎉 What's New in v2.6.0 ### 🌟 **Major Features** - ✅ **💎 Rare Item Protection**: 100+ items (dragon eggs, elytras, netherite) protected from offerings - ✅ **🏔️ Underground Player Support**: Full event participation for cave dwellers with smart spawning - ✅ **🖥️ GUI Experience Improvements**: Cleaner layout with better information flow - ✅ **🎲 Smart Fallback System**: Automatic fair alternatives when all tier items are protected - ✅ **😄 New Divine Messages**: 7 humorous responses for underground spawn failures - ✅ **🔄 Auto-Retry System**: Failed spawns retry automatically after 5 minutes - ✅ **⚙️ Enhanced Configuration**: New underground spawning options in config.yml ### 🛠️ **Technical Improvements** - ✅ **New RareItemFilter Class**: Efficient HashSet-based item protection system - ✅ **Enhanced Underground Detection**: Better player position analysis and spawning logic - ✅ **Dynamic Distance Scaling**: Progressive reduction (100→80→60→40→20→10 blocks) - ✅ **100% Backwards Compatible**: No migration needed, drop-in replacement - ✅ **Optimized Performance**: Faster item lookups and spawn location finding - ✅ **Minecraft 1.21.6 Ready**: Forward compatible with upcoming 1.21.6 release --- ## 🏆 Perfect For ### 🎯 **Server Types** - **🏘️ Survival Servers**: Add cooperative challenges without disrupting building - **⚔️ PvP Servers**: Unite players against common threats - **🔫 Gun Mod Servers**: Enhanced difficulty mode for powerful weapons - title: Leashed
description: A silly datapack that allows to leash players to any entity
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/753f0cff01bf4d5266c0743808fe4e5a555ac4d8.png)
# Was inspired by [PeenixSC](https://www.youtube.com/@PhoenixSC)'s [video](https://youtu.be/tp8V0VmHyFU&t=25)
**This datapack was created for my video to play with friends. Found bug / order datapack / other - [Discord](https://discord.gg/dCWyMsE94D).**

**This datapack was intended to add the ability to leash a player to any entity.**

<details>
<summary>Showcase</summary>

## [ 1 ] Leashing

![Leashing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87dba04b7708ada84e06318bc2a4e8c87315ea2.gif)

## [ 2 ] Players to entity

![Two player one pig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/833f1bfa617c215b776224dfda1fc2487064b807.png)

## [ 3 ] [More in gallery](https://modrinth.com/datapack/leashed/gallery)
</details>

# Usage explanation:

Using the command, issue yourself a “Self-Lead”, using it you can leash yourself to any entity. Here are all the notes and commands:

- Give "Self-Lead" - **/function leashed:give_lead**;
- The "Self-Lead" item is not spent when used;
- A leader becomes immortal;
- Visualization of the lead is made by a straight line of particles;
- Which can be switched with - **/function leashed:gamerules/visual**;
- Up to five players can be leashed to a single entity;
- Because of the modifying and calculating motion, when a player is away from his “Leader”, the **game starts to lag** decently;
- You can only be unleashed using the command - **/function leashed:unleash**, it also kills the Leader;
- The current version of the datapack requires the [Modify Player Data](https://modrinth.com/mod/modify-player-data) mod.

<details>
<summary>FAQ about mod:</summary>
  
**Q: Where should I download the mod?**

**A:** If you are playing with friends LAN, **only hosting player** needs to download. If you play on a server, then **only in the server folder**. It's okay if someone also has a mod.

**Q: Why do I need to download this mod?**

**A:** This mod allows you to modify the player's NBT data, and the most important thing is **Motion**.

**Q: What about other alternatives from Minecraft itself?**

**A:** I was shaking my mouth at these alternatives. You can simply push the player only by levitation or invisible slimes, which cannot be normally invisible if summoned for a moment. And in any case, I made this datapack without worrying about optimization, further use after video or about other users, so I think you can accept it.
  
</details>

title: Comprehensive Woodcutter
description: Datapack adding every possible reasonable wood-related recipe to the stonecutter
body:
## Comprehensive Woodcutter
### Feature(s)
~1000 recipes for the stonecutter adding every possible woodshaping-related recipe, generated with included .java file.

### Use guide
Some recipes may not appear as they surpass the stack size limit for certain items

All recipes of wood type `T` from shape `I` to shape `O` look like this:

`stonecut(TI) = roundDown(score(I)/score(O)) TO`

where `score(shape)` is:
```
 logs/stems = 64
 bamboo block = 32
 
 (mosaic) planks = 8
 (mosaic) slab = 4
 (mosaic) stairs = 6
 
 boat/raft = 32
 
 button = 1
 pressure plate = 4
 
 fence = 8
 fence gate = 4
 
 sign = 2
 
 door = 16
 trapdoor = 8

 stick = 2
```

(planks are assumed to be full blocks for generic subdivisions (planks, stairs, slabs) else they're 16px\*2px\*16px)

title: Gateways
description: A vanilla-esque teleport pad mod for both blocks and entities with redstone compatibility
body:
## Gateways

**IMPORTANT NOTE-- Gateways uses the rendering library Veil, which may not be compatible with other rendering libraries like sodium or optifabric.**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/-Oy_6R89u_k" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Gateways is a Minecraft mod which adds gateways you can teleport around with. It adds the following features:

- Gateway hub
    - Crafted with four chorus flowers, four amethyst blocks, and an eye of ender
    - Each hub has a frequency, and stores a destination frequency
    - Hubs are the center of gateways. A gateway is formed by placing a hub in the center of a square of amethyst (or resonant amethyst) blocks. Gateways can be up to a 7x7 square
    - Upon right-clicking, the eye of the block will open if the pad and the pad to be teleported to are both valid. On the next right-click, all the blocks and entities on the pad will be teleported
    - When it teleports, there are some cool particles and a really fancy flash animation on both sides
- Tuning fork
    - Crafted with a copper ingot and iron bars
    - When you shift right-click on a hub, it tunes the tuning fork to that hub's frequency
    - When you right click a hub with a tuned tuning fork, it gives the hub the frequency
- Resonant amethyst
    - Crafted with two amethyst blocks and two glowstone dust
    - Works the same as amethyst, is valid for gateway pads
    - When right-clicked with a tuned tuning fork, propagates the frequency through it to any connected hubs
- Cracked amethyst / cracked resonant amethyst
    - When a gateway teleports, it turns some of its amethyst or resonant amethyst into their cracked variants
    - It can be fixed by either:
        - Right clicking it with an amethyst shard
        - Throwing an amethyst shard on top of it
        - Throwing an amethyst shard on the ground nearby, and throwing a bottle of exp on it. Consumes the exp, but can fix multiple cracked blocks
- Resonance conduit
    - Crafted with two polished basalt and a resonant amethyst
    - Stores a tuning fork
    - When powered from below, propagates a frequency downward (directly to a hub or to a hub connected through resonant amethyst)

title: HJs Chaos Mod
description: A mod for 1.16.5 largely consisting of extra progression and unfunny memes.
body:
# Overview
The HJs Chaos Mod (or just 'Chaos Mod') is a mod focusing on adding more things to do and explore in the progression of the game, via new mobs, biomes, and dimensions. Most of this mod is centered around various meme items, however this mod began production 3 years ago, so much of the content is now dated (and unfunny).

# Features
The Chaos Mod has many features that can be enjoyed by both survival and creative mode players.

### Biomes
Explore the new variety of biomes, such as the Joe Biome, Joe Hills, Chaos Ruins, and Depleted Chaos Biome, each with their own special generation and structures, as well as mobs.

### Mobs
Fight the AmogUs hordes that spawn at night, and beware the mysterious entity that can be seen lurking in the darkness.

### Dimensions
Explore the dangerous joe dimension, or if you afford it, build a portal to the Chaos Dimension, where nothing is as it seems...

### Ores and Armor
Using the new materials found throughout the Chaos Mod, craft powerful armors, each with special effects!

### Weapons
Craft a variety of weapons, some being overpowered, and others being... not so much.

## Creative Mode

### Admin Tools (W.I.P)
The Chaos Mod features some admin tools and items, such as admin weapons and orbital strike launchers.

### Commands (W.I.P)
Want to give yourself exactly 690 amogus items? Theres a command for that!

# Update Plans

### Forward Ports
The Chaos Mod currently only supports 1.16.5. However, a 1.20.1, 1.21, and 1.21.7-8 version is in the works. However, due to large changes between updates (specifically with how biomes generate), not all features will work exactly the same. Once the 1.20.1+ port is stable, production will stop on the 1.16.5 branch.

### New Content?
Progress is slow with the mod, but a new content update is being worked on and should arrive alongside the second version of the 1.20.1 port.

## TLDR
Update 2.2.2 (Current Version) will be updated to 1.20.1, Update 2.3 (next content update) and all future updates will only be on 1.20.1 and above.

title: Soul Spawners
description: Craft and Activate Spawners in New Magical Ways!
body:
# Soul Spawners – Mob Spawners crafted with Soul Rituals!
**Soul Spawners** is a Minecraft 1.21.1 mod that adds a new way to craft and activate mob spawners. Use the energy of Souls to infuse items and take control of mob spawning in your world!

## Features
**🕯️ The Soul Altar**
- A mystical crafting block powered by soul energy.
- Activate the altar with Soul Bottles to light the candles and prepare for infusion rituals.

**🌀 Infuse Items with Soul Energy**
- Insert items into the Soul Altar and watch them levitate as they absorb energy.
- After the ritual, retrieve infused items to activate spawners.

**💀 Spawner Crafting and Activation**
- Mine Regular Spawners and rebuild them into mob-specific spawners.
- Activate spawners by right-clicking with infused items, like an Infused Bone for Skeleton spawners.

**🧟 Vanilla Mob Support**
Supports (almost) all mobs that appear in vanilla spawners:
- **Zombie:** Infused Rotten Flesh
- **Skeleton:** Infused Bones
- **Spider:** Infused Spider Eyes
- **Cave Spider:** Infused Fermented Spider Eyes
- **Blaze:** Infused Blaze Rods
- **Magma Cube:** Infused Magma Cream

**💎 Balanced Gameplay**
- Designed for mid-to-late game mechanics to fit naturally into progression.
- Fortune enchantments enhance fragment drops for better rewards.

**⚔️ A new Enchantment**
- Infuse a sword with souls and get a whole new enchantment, not obtainable any other way.

## How it works
1. **Collect Spawner Fragments** – Break existing spawners to gather these new fragments.
2. **Craft an Inactive Spawner** – Combine fragments to create an inactive spawner.
3. **Craft the Soul Altar** - Construct the magical Soul Altar, essential for infusing mob drops with soul energy.
4. **Gather Souls** - Find new Weeping Soul Sand in the nether and trap their souls in bottles.
5. **Activate the Altar** – Use the Soul Bottle to activate the Soul Altar.
6. **Infuse Items** – Insert specific items (e.g., bones) to infuse them with soul energy.
7. **Activate Your Spawner** – Right-click the inactive spawner with your infused item to complete the process!

## Why Use Soul Spawners?
- Build and control mob farms without relying on random spawns or naturally spawned spawners.
- Customize spawner types to fit your gameplay needs.
- Introduces an immersive crafting mechanic with particle effects and rituals.

## Compatibility
- Fabric 1.21.1 supported!
- Works with vanilla mob drops and mechanics.
- Custom textures and particles add immersive effects without requiring external resource packs.

## Misc.
### Future Ideas
- More mobs - Enabled via the Mod Menu
- Advancements
- Use of XP in infusing

### Shout outs to
- Spawners+: For the textures of the Inactive Spawner and Spawner Fragments
- Sumoning Rituals: For the base idea of the Altar texture
- KaupenJoe: For the tutorial series for Fabric Modding

title: ReportsPlus
description: This is a simple report system for your Minecraft Server!
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb4c0b19ad5de1f7bb4d9539fa91fa03b94b7330.png)
## About ReportsPlus
ReportsPlus is a Minecraft plugin that helps players and server staff keep the game fun and safe. With this plugin, players can report other players who are not following the rules, and the staff can look at all the reports to see what's going on.

## What Can You Do with ReportsPlus?
1. **Report a Player** - If someone is breaking the rules, like being cheating, you can report them. You just type: /report <player> <reason>.
For example, if someone is cheating, you can type: /report Steve Cheating.
2. **See All Reports** - The server staff can see all the reports that players send.
They can open a special menu and see who got reported, why, and when it happened.
This helps the staff decide what to do, like giving warnings or banning players who keep breaking the rules.\
![reports](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/945de13d537c87588e32319923c4f47a15dcd927.png)

3. **Track the Reports** - Staff can check the reports in a list. They can look at them by page if there are a lot of reports.
They can even open menus to handle reports one by one.
![report](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42a109509c8f91c76472522a3f18ee865edf0d66.png)

4. **Clear Reports** - Staff can easily clear reports by running the command: /reports clear OR clicking the in-game item.\
![clear reports](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb99dc27c61683837a4e69462d389540bdb16645.png)

5. **Active Owner** - This project is still being worked on, there are many things I, RedBlackFlamez, would like to add to this!


## Support
If you have any questions, bugs, or any other type of support, feel free to join the [discord server](https://discord.gg/ZnfNDDbnPW)!

Remember how creepers drop music discs when killed by skeletons? Have you ever thought "Wouldn't it be cool if there was more collectibles you could get by making mobs kill each other?" No? Me neither. This datapack came to me in an incredibly strange dream, so I decided, why not make it a reality?

In this datapack, you can get all 15 billiard balls, along with a cue ball, by forcing a skeleton to kill a zombie. They come in slightly varying rarities, with 1-7 and 9-15 being of Rare rarity (Aqua color, higher chance of dropping), and the 8 and cue balls being of Epic rarity (Magenta/Light Purple color, lower chance of dropping).

title: Craft-Payne
description: Adds the time control and movement from Max Payne into Minecraft.
body:
# Craft-payne
(no icon yet **¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯**)

A proof-of-concept mod that messes with the new `tick` systems added in 1.20.3.


This mod adds the **bullet-time** and dodging mechanics from Max-Payne, which goes well with gun mods.
Going into bullet time **will slow down time for every player**, so this **may/may not be viable in multiplayer** situations.

Bullet time by default is controlled by "Z" and "X", and can be bound to other keys.

Bullet time *should* work server-side (meaning everyone has their time correctly slowed down), but in order to activate bullet-time at-will, you must have this mod installed.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask them on the issue tracker.

title: Blockgame Plus
description: A client-side quality-of-life mod for the Blockgame Minecraft server (1.21.4, Fabric). Trackers, HUD widgets, accessibility tools, a shared team map, and party tools, all in one mod.
body:
# Blockgame+

**Everything you wish Blockgame had, in one client-side mod.** A live team map, roll-quality item tooltips, party health bars, an Auction House, a friends-and-forums community hub, emotes, leaderboards, a new-player tutorial, an idle minigame, and a pile of HUD tools - install it yourself, no server access needed.

Built for the Blockgame Minecraft server (`mc.blockgame.info`) - Fabric, Minecraft 1.21.4.

Visit the site at [bgplus.ca](https://bgplus.ca/)

![banner image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b86c0615cf5c20b889dc5e3622628e1d1479d415.png)

> **Client-side only.** Drop it in your mods folder and play - most features work standalone. The team map, party sync, community hub, and leaderboards use an optional self-hosted backend (more on that below).

---

## 💬 Discord chat bridge

Bridge your community's Discord to in-game chat - messages flow both ways, with player heads on the Discord side. It's a bot you add yourself, no hosting required:

- **[Add the Blockgame+ bot to your Discord server](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1451704640759402588&scope=bot+applications.commands&permissions=536947712)**, then a server admin runs `/setup` in the channel you want bridged.
- Players **link their Minecraft account** (`/link` in Discord, then `/bgplus discord link <code>` in game) so every bridged message shows a verified name - unlinked messages are gently nudged to link first.
- One shared bot serves any community that invites it, so there's nothing to host or configure beyond `/setup`.

Turn it on under **Settings → Community** in-game.

## 👥 Community hub

A built-in social layer over your community account - open it with `/bgplus social`:

- **Friends and direct messages**, community **forums** with threads, reactions, and image posts, plus an admin **bulletin board** for announcements.
- **Who's online** across everyone running the mod, with join/leave toasts.
- Everything is opt-in and gated behind your community account.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: the Social hub (friends list / a forum thread) -->

## 🎭 Emotes & chat media

- **Body emotes** - a bindable emote wheel plays full-body animations on your character, with a shared library the community can publish to and moderate, plus a built-in keyframe **animation editor** (`/bgplus anim`) to make your own.
- **GIFs and image emotes in chat** - paste a GIF link or type `:name:` and it renders right in chat, no browser needed.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: an emote playing in-world + a GIF rendered in chat -->

## 🗺️ A real in-game map (and minimap)

No more alt-tabbing. Blockgame+ renders its own **fullscreen map and corner minimap**, drawn from the world as you explore - structures, booty chests, and supply drops all show as live waypoints. Zoom all the way out to the **whole world** thanks to server-built overview tiles, or right-click anywhere to drop a waypoint or a travel destination.

Every player's exploration also merges into one **compounding community map** - a growing, shared web map of everywhere the community has been, with a dark-mode viewer at **bgplus.ca**.

![Community Resource World Map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a0c3ac3018e18e2703b9204f60a8fabc86346af.png)

![World map with lines active](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa671a209706ddda72d8cfb9fc2832c63810bfa1.png)

![active minimap](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56705fb369943b719151679084a8acf0880b370c.png)

## 🧭 Waypoints & exploration routes

- **Custom waypoints** with a right-click menu - name a spot, mark it as your travel destination, or show it as a floating in-world marker you can run toward with no map open.
- **Exploration routes** that draw on the map *and* minimap, with an in-world "go here next" marker, a next-stop readout, and a Focus mode that beelines for a chosen category (e.g. Supply Drops).
- **Booty tracking** auto-clusters nearby chests into structures and labels them, filters by structure type, and hides ones you've already looted. All on the native map - **no Xaero required** (prefer Xaero? One command exports everything to it).

## 🏷️ Item stat tooltips

Blockgame items hide their **true stat rolls** in the item data - the lore only shows rounded numbers. Blockgame+ reveals them:

- A colored **roll-quality `[%]`** on each stat, right on the item.
- Hold **Ctrl** for the full breakdown: exact values, roll-quality bars, and an overall "this item rolled 84% - Great" verdict.
- **Archetype-aware scoring** - the verdict weights stats by how much they matter to *that* piece (weapon damage on a warrior sword, projectile on a bow), so a junk profession roll doesn't drag a good weapon's score down.
- **Rune-aware and corruption-aware** - it shows the item's *true* base roll with rune bonuses and corruption broken out separately, so you always know what the gear actually rolled.
- **Hold Alt to compare** any item against what you've got equipped, with green/red per-stat deltas. Pin an item to compare two arbitrary pieces.
- Ranges ship built-in from the shop catalog and sharpen further from every item the community sees.

![Stat mod screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/378a610e302524af8bd0657a318a6af23c8185aa.png)

![Stats compairing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ce1b41063da4a151ccb6d961ce70ad92e98b937.png)

## 🏛️ Custom menus & Auction House

Blockgame+ swaps the server's plain chest-grid menus for clean, house-style screens:

- **Auction House** - a real Browse / Sell interface with search, sort, pagination, item tooltips, live expiry, your active listings, Purchased + Expired + History tabs, and staged **bulk selling**.
- **Tabbed character profile**, a **Ranks shop** with the full future-tier price list, and dedicated **party management** screens.
- One master **Custom Menus** toggle - turn it off any time to fall back to the vanilla server screens.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: the Auction House browse screen -->

## ⚔️ Talent build manager

The Talents screen becomes a full build manager:

- Save **unlimited** stat builds and switch between them with **one click** - reset and reallocation handled automatically.
- Preview a build client-side, watch your aggregated bonuses update live, then save.
- A small HUD widget shows which build you're running. Press **V** to open Talents any time.

![Talents menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7005362f135b46f46b798075720412a1163e287_0.webp)

## 📊 Stats & trackers

![Stats Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c312e70d688d3b29a9633de3c0dd4c0579d42ae0.png)

- **Loot Stats** - every chest you open, logged and aggregated by dimension and time window.
- **Fishing Tracker** - catches, sizes, personal-best flags, and a leaderboard.
- **XP Tracker** - live profession / proficiency / reputation / class levels with a movable HUD widget and XP-rate display.
- **Coin Counter** - animated balance HUD, spend tracking, and a coins-per-hour rate.
- **Session summary** (`/bgplus session`) - coins, XP, fish, and chests for your play session.

## 🎯 HUD widgets

Every widget is draggable and resizable in the layout editor: cooldown timer, profile-buff timers, booty/supply counters, air/drowning bar, a relocatable action bar, a recent-pickup tracker, and a chat-channel widget.

![Customizable widgets!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/933ed7698dc00672007639ecb3a9beedc9e6fd36.png)

## 📦 Loot & inventory tools

- **Loot All / Loot Some / Deposit All / Deposit Match** buttons on every chest, with a per-item ignore list, so you move stacks in one click instead of dragging. The buttons are individually **moveable and resizable**.
- **Slot Locker** - lock inventory slots so the Deposit buttons skip them and Loot All won't pile loot in; each lock **remembers its item** (or that the slot should stay empty), so coming back from farming keeps your hotbar layout.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: chest with the loot buttons + a locked slot padlock -->

## 🤝 Party tools

Live teammate **health bars** (a healer's dream), low-health sound alerts, buff icons, client-side glow to spot your party, and **in-world pings**.

![Party Pings!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/047969660d60fa1fcd63474c0d4929a327f54ac5_0.webp)

## 👺 Goblin Hoard (idle minigame)

A fully sandboxed idle/incremental game that runs alongside Blockgame - `/bgplus goblins`. Its own currency (**Plunder**) that never touches your coins, items, or the world:

- Hire goblins, buy upgrades, and trigger Frenzy bursts to dig faster.
- Run **expeditions** to collect 51 goblin characters across five rarities, chasing set bonuses.
- Prestige into a branching **Gem Web** of permanent upgrades, then **descend an endless Abyss** that ranks your deepest layer on a public **leaderboard**.
- On by default - turn it off in Settings if it's not your thing.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: the Goblin Hoard screen -->

## 💎 Rune Vault & Shops

- **Rune Vault** - wall in a small altar room and search hundreds of runes in one screen, with best-fit-for-this-item ranking and single-rune withdraw out of a bundle.
- **Rune Shops** - publish your spare runes for sale at a linked altar; customers browse and reserve them, and you fill orders from an in-game order list.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: the Rune Vault search screen -->

## 🗣️ Talking NPCs

Quest-giver NPCs get a dialogue box with an animated puppet, typewriter text, and reply choices - a friendlier face than the plain server menu, with the gear-vendor and daily-quest NPCs written up.

<!-- SCREENSHOT: an NPC dialogue box -->

## 📸 Cosmetic & Photo Mode

Client-side, render-only glamour tools for clean screenshots: a one-key **Photo Mode** (hides HUD, held item, and nametags together), standalone **hide players / mobs / nametags**, **fog** control, and forced **time / weather / sky / biome** looks.

## 🎨 Built-in custom item textures

Blockgame+ reads Blockgame's item data directly, so a modern-format server or community resource pack reskins custom items **and worn armor** with **no separate "Resourcepacks Helper" mod** needed. Just add the pack.

## ♿ Accessibility

- **Spell Cycler** - cast a spell book and auto-advance to the next, with cooldown-aware skipping (tap or hold).
- **Custom sound alerts** for fishing bites, low hydration, loot pings, and party low-health - drop your own `.ogg`/`.wav` files in.

## 🏆 Community & leaderboards

Optional shared leaderboards - class, professions, proficiencies, reputations, coins, fishing, lifetime coins, and the **Goblin Abyss** depth board - plus supply-drop and loot sharing. Browse them in-game or on the public site at **bgplus.ca/leaderboard** (no account needed to look).

![Community Leaderboards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07ce2829a134abe5ddd05b7feba5abf3be759e7f_0.webp)

## 🎓 New-player tutorial

First time on Blockgame? Blockgame+ layers a friendly **Guide** over the server's own tutorial quest - a dialogue box explains each step and waypoints point you to the tricky spots (like that Forge everyone gets lost looking for). It turns itself off once you've finished.

![starter guide](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/856e5e3e986ce52a46a056b2a38ab6ac6930e035.png)

## 📌 Teleport Spots

Make your own command buttons - e.g. "Nation spawn" runs `/n spawn`.

![Teleport Spots Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb1036578d6e90c6f6a68ad6ddb2612f568bbb6d_0.webp)

## 🖥️ Play from the main menu

A **Blockgame+** button on the title screen opens a hub for the community tab, the goblin game, the leaderboards, and the live map - so you can stay connected and keep playing even while the game server is down.

---

## ⚙️ Setup

1. Install **Fabric Loader**, **Fabric API**, **Cloth Config**, and **Mod Menu**.
2. Drop **Blockgame+** in your `mods` folder.
3. All keybinds are unbound by default - set them in **Options → Controls → Blockgame+**.
4. Configure everything in **Mod Menu → Blockgame+**, and browse the built-in guide with `/bgplus guide`.

![Vast settings menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/788553836c216636f92f775185a43fe6c037a8ed_0.webp)

## ⚠️ Notes

- Designed for Blockgame; features are gated to the server by default.
- The team map, live party sync, community hub, and leaderboards use a **self-hosted backend** (provided currently by the mod owner - that's me!). They're not required for the rest of the mod, and they need you to request to join the community so an admin can approve you.
- **Known issue:** party HUD faces currently show the default skin.
- This mod is made with the help of AI. If you don't support that, then don't download! Or do... I don't care.

**Found a bug?** Reach me on Discord: **codyggex** or report it on bgplus.ca

title: Login Music
description: A simple Minecraft mod that can play music when players join in the world.
body:
A simple Minecraft mod that can play music when players join in the world.

> This mod uses AI to assist in development.
>
> Inspired by TartaricAcid's [Net Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/net-music) !

| Milestone | Big changes                                                                                  |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1.1.0     | javafx has given place to `com.googlecode.soundlibs:mp3spi`, which provides MP3 support now. |
| 1.2.0     | the music config has changed to JSON type.                                                   |
| 1.2.1     | Music can be played directly through the Internet without downloading; lyrics support!       |
| 1.2.2     | Audio backend loading, Players can receive audio from other players on the server.           |                                                                                          |

The logo comes from [here](https://www.flaticon.com/free-icon/music_9325026?term=music&page=1&position=87&origin=search&related_id=9325026), designed by juicy_fish.

## Functions

- Play music
- Supported file types: mp3, wav
- Music Downloading screen
- Allow download switch
- Play different musics based on the player's name (uuid)
- Show lyrics while playing music

## File Structure

> **Destructive changes**: 
> 
> Since mod version 1.2.5, the config file's storage has been changed! If you upgrade from previous version, please move them to the new place!

All music files are stored in the `/data/login_music` folder.

```
{version folder}
├── config
│   ├── login_music-music.json      # Specific musics
│   └── login_music-client.toml     # Client config    
│
├── data/login_music        # Store music files
│   ├── MusicsCache
│   │   ├── music_1.mp3
│   │   ├── music_2.wav
│   │   └── ...
│   └── LyricsCache   
│       ├── music_1.lrc
│       ├── music_2.lrc
│       └── ...
└── ...
```

## Configuration

### Music Config JSON

**Since mod version 1.2.0, the music config has changed to JSON type, just as shown below.**

If you enter a server with this mod, the config file on the server has higher priority, which will cover your custom settings.

```json
{
    "musics": [
        {
            "id": "Default",
            "music": "Default.mp3",
            "musicUrl": "https://www.example.com/example.mp3",
            "lyric": "Default.lrc",
            "lyricUrl": "https://www.example.com/example.lrc" 
        }, {
            "id": "Steve",
            "music": "login_music.mp3",
            "musicUrl": "https://www.example.com/login_music.mp3",
            "lyric": "login_music.lrc",
            "lyricUrl": "https://www.example.com/login_music.lrc"
        }
    ]
}
```

> The music will be downloaded if `InternetAccess` is set `true` (the default setting is `false`), otherwise, the music is played through network audio streams, which may cause a short pause when entering a world.

For example, When a player named Steve enters the world, the mod will try to find the music matched the name `Steve` (in this case it's `login_music.mp3` ) in the folder `/LoginMusic` first.
Then try to download it from its related url if it has failed before.

> Tips: If there is a file with the same name in the folder, it will skip the download even if the file does not match the URL.

If more entries need to be configured, please follow the JSON's rule.

Since mod version 1.2.4, you can open Login Music Config from the main menu if `Cloth Config API` has been installed.

### Client Side

`login_music-client.toml` is effective only for the client:

```toml
[Lyrics]
    #Whether to show lyrics while playing music
    ShowLyrics = true
    #Defines the position of the lyrics
    #Allowed Values: UP, MIDDLE, DOWN
    LyricsPosition = "DOWN"
    #Defines the color of the lyrics you want to use
    LyricsColor = 16777215

[Music]
    #Range of music play (a non negative integer)
    # Default: 3
    # Range: 0 ~ 100
    range = 3
    #Whether to allow downloading music from the internet
    InternetAccess = false
    #Whether to play musics from other players
    AllowOthersMusic = true
```

### Server Side

`login_music-server.toml`:

```toml
[Selection]
    #Keywords for music selection (name/uuid)
    #Allowed Values: NAME, UUID
    type = "NAME"
```

## Command

All the commands need permission level 2.

| Command                           | Function                              |
|-----------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| `/loginmusic reload`              | reload config                         |
| `/loginmusic list`                | show music config available currently |
| `/loginmusic show <targetPlayer>` | show targetPlayer's music config      |
| `/loginmusic play`                | replay your login music               |

title: Packet Sniffer Mod
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that captures all C2S/S2C network packets to disk with async I/O. No Fabric API required.
body:
Packet Sniffer is a **client-side Fabric mod** for Minecraft that captures and logs all network packets exchanged between the client and server in real time. Built for developers, modders, and anyone curious about what happens under the hood of Minecraft's network protocol, it intercepts **both C2S (Client-to-Server) and S2C (Server-to-Client) traffic** and outputs human-readable, fully deserialized packet data to the game log.

Packet Sniffer targets **Minecraft 1.21.11+ with Fabric Loader** and requires **no server-side** installation. It serves as a lightweight yet powerful diagnostic tool for protocol analysis, mod debugging, and network education.

body:
Absence of Shark adds a terrifying new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1057, also known as Absence of Shark.


SCP-1057 behaves like a shark but is almost entirely invisible and is only be found in bodies of water, .SCP-1057 is fast, deadly, and highly aggressive toward players, villagers, Squids and other mobs. Despite its unseen nature, its presence can be revealed temporarily by using a special Fluorescent Dye.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-1057 spawn?

SCP-1057 can spawn in bodies of water. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1057

</details>



![SCP-1057](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce0f0762f64047ce55717e16084d3a3fb537879c.png)

Players attacked by SCP-1057 while being under 15 hearts will suffer a bleeding effect. The creature also attacks villagers, squids, glow squids, turtles and dolphins. SCP-1057 also despawns instantly if removed from water. Using a Fluorescent Dye on SCP-1057 gives it a red-orange texture for one minute. The Fluorescent Dye is craftable with 1 glow inc sac, 1 red dye and 1 orange dye.

title: flying-with-sword
description: This project adds a sword-flight enchantment effect to MC, solving the problem of difficult travel in Minecraft.
body:
# FJmode · Sword Flight & Myriad Swords Return 🗡️

> **「Take the sword as wings, ride the wind; With a single thought, myriad swords return to their master」**

[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-62B47A?logo=minecraft)](https://minecraft.net)
[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-0.18.2-DBB68B?logo=java)](https://fabricmc.net)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A Fabric enchantment expansion mod built for Minecraft 1.21.11, transforming swords from mere melee tools into your wings—your legions of thousands.

---

## ✨ Core Gameplay

### 🌪️ Sword Flight
*Ride the sword with the wind, roaming freely between heaven and earth*

| Feature | Description |
|:---|:---|
| **Flight Control** | Hold an enchanted sword to enter custom flight, with speed comparable to vanilla elytra gliding |
| **Visual Presentation** | Player stands on the sword, held sword is hidden; a matching sword model is rendered beneath the feet in real-time, following the player's pitch |
| **Dash Boost** | Press `Ctrl` during flight to trigger sustained acceleration (consumes extra saturation) |
| **Durability Balance** | Flight continuously consumes the sword's durability—plan long journeys carefully |

> ⚠️ Melee attacks against entities are disabled during flight; focus on the path of the sky

---

### ⚔️ Myriad Swords Return
*One sword strikes, myriad swords follow; a thought moves, enemies all fall*

| Feature | Description |
|:---|:---|
| **Charged Launch** | Right-click and hold to charge like a trident, release to launch the main hand sword as a flying sword |
| **Swarm Orbiting** | Multiplie flying swords orbit in three-dimensional space above the player, forming a spectacular sword formation |
| **Smart Target Lock** | Automatically locks onto and tracks targets upon melee or ranged hit |
| **Coordinated Pursuit** | Single sword calculates a guaranteed hit trajectory; the swarm strikes simultaneously, dealing damage equal to total attack power ÷ 3 |
| **Cyclic Combat** | After hitting, flying swords bounce back into formation, immediately ready to lock onto new targets for sustained output |
| **Entity Retention** | After 60 seconds or when the player goes offline, flying swords materialize and stick into the ground, awaiting retrieval |

> Obtained from the enchanting table, max level I, medium-low rarity weight

---

## 🎨 Visual Highlights

- **Sword Flight**: Sword model rotates in real-time following the player's camera angle, with natural pitch movement
- **Myriad Swords Return**: Client-side smooth interpolation combined with velocity vector-based orientation ensures fluid, jitter-free swarm trajectories; each flying sword has a 45° compensation to ensure the tip points forward

---

## 📝 Notes

- Uses **Mojang Official Mappings**; some class names in Fabric tutorials may differ (e.g., `ServerPlayer` instead of `ServerPlayerEntity`)
- Virtual flying swords for Myriad Swords Return are server-side memory objects, not vanilla entities; hit detection and damage calculation are purely server-side

---

## 🛠️ Technical Information

| Item | Version |
|:---|:---|
| Minecraft | `1.21.11` |
| Fabric Loader | `0.18.2` |
| Fabric API | `0.139.4+1.21.11` |
| Java | `21` |
| Mappings | Mojang Official |

---

*May your sword be both a shield of protection and the wind of freedom* 🍃

title: SimpletpPro
description: A simple teleportation mod....
body:
SimpleTP Pro is a lightweight, survival-friendly, cheat-free teleport mod built for vanilla survival and multiplayer servers. All commands are available to every player by default—no cheats, no OP permissions, no extra setup required. It adds safe, fair, and convenient teleportation to make your survival world more enjoyable and cooperative.
Features
# 📌 Player Teleport (TPA System)

/tpa <player>

## Send a teleport request to another player.

/tpaccept

## Accept a pending teleport request.

/tpdeny

Deny a pending teleport request.

Clickable chat buttons – Accept or deny directly from chat.

60-second timeout – Requests expire automatically if ignored.
# 🏠 Home Teleport System (Multi-Home Support)

/sethome <name>

Set a home at your current location.

/home <name>

Teleport to a saved home.

/home list

View all your saved homes.

/delhome <name>

Delete an existing home.
# ⚰️ Death Return

/back

Teleport back to your last death location to retrieve items easily.
# 🌍 Warp Points System

/warp

Open the warp list and click entries to teleport directly.

Sign Teleport Usage: Write warp on the first line of a sign and the warp name on the second line. Left-click the sign to teleport instantly.
# Highlights
✅ Survival-friendly & cheat-free

✅ No OP permissions required

✅ All players can use all commands

✅ Clickable chat interface

✅ Automatic request timeout

✅ Multiplayer & server-ready

✅ Lightweight – no extra items/blocks

✅ Full language file support
# How to Use
Install the mod and launch Minecraft.

Use /tpa <player> to send a teleport request.

Use clickable buttons in chat to accept or deny.

Use /sethome, /home, /delhome to manage homes.

Use /back after death to return to where you died.

Use /warp to open the warp list for one-click teleport. You can also place a sign: put warp on the first line and the warp name on the second line, then left-click the sign to teleport.
# Perfect For
Survival players

Multiplayer servers

Builders & explorers

Anyone who wants QoL teleports without cheats
# Update Log
## 1.0.1

Fixed the issue where Tab completion could not be used after using /tpa

Help has been added, use /help tppor to view help
## 1.0.2

Optimized the execution method and added the /tphere command, now you can use this command to teleport players to your location
## 1.0.3

Fixed the issue where home would be lost after exiting the game

Added /tpa to teleport to coordinates
## 2.0.0

Refactored the mod. Removing MCR made the mod smaller in size.

Routine fixes.
## 2.0.1

Added cross-dimension support for /home and /back

Optimized the code architecture
## 3.0.0

Fixed some bugs

Added multi-version support
## 3.0.1

Added the /warp command, along with click-to-teleport functionality in the list.

Added sign-based warp teleport: Create a sign with warp on the first line and the warp name on the second line, left-click the sign to teleport.
