title: Lotus Mods
description: This is a create and magic modpack with many QoL additions for a fun SMP experience
body:
This modpack is about building, exploration, and automation. The core is the Create mod, which lets you build everything from massive factories to functional trains with Steam 'n' Rails. If you’d rather use magic than machinery, you can master the elements with Ars Nouveau or cast powerful rituals using Occultism.

The world you’ll be playing in is shaped by Continents and Biomes O' Plenty. Traveling these lands is easy and fun whether you're flying or sailing.

You can also cook with Farmer's Delight, craft your backpack to carry your gear while you travel.

Notice: If downloading from Modrinth, use Spigot, Paper, or Bukkit; All three work the same on EaglerHost!

EaglerHost hosting platform: [Click Here](https://www.topeaglerservers.com/)

title: Play Time Limit
description: Per-day player time limits on Spigot/Paper servers
body:
# Play Time Limit

Some of my friends have no life, no job, and spend way too much time playing Minecraft. To solve this, I created a Spigot plugin to limit player time per day. It's configurable and easy to set up. To configure the plugin, modify the YAML file in `plugins/PlayTimeLimit`.

Default configuration:
```yaml
kick-time: 240 # 4 Hours in minutes
kick-message: "You have exceeded your allotted 4 hours on this server today. Try again tomorrow."
kick-broadcast: "{player} has exceeded their allotted 4 hours on this server today."
kick-ignore-users: ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"] # Get this from an actual user
timezone: "Etc/UTC"
```


## Commands

* `/leaderboard`: see all the time played by users in the last day
* `/get-time [all|today]`: see your time played for this session or all time

title: unmannedonlinetickstasis
description: Automatically pause all world activities when there are no players on the monitoring server.
body:
Unmanned Online Tick Stasis

A lightweight server-side mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that automatically freezes the game world when no players are online and resumes seamlessly when a player joins, helping save server resources and maintain consistent gameplay.

Key Features

- Automatic Pause/Resume: Pauses block updates, entity movements, redstone devices, in-game time and more when the last player leaves; resumes instantly on player join.

- Fully Configurable: Toggle pause function, set post-logout pause delay, and whitelist allowed console commands (supports wildcards).

- State Preservation: Records and restores world time, entity positions and motion states (optional).

- Multilingual Support: Includes English (en_us) and Chinese (zh_cn).

- Lightweight & Compatible: Server-side only (no client installation needed); works for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge 47.x.x) and 1.20.x.

How It Works

Uses Mixin to intercept the world tick loop, canceling ticks when no players are online (after configured delay). Monitors player events and filters console commands against the whitelist.

Configuration

Stored in serverconfig/unmannedonlinetickstasis-server.toml (or config/ for dedicated servers); editable manually or via /reload (with permissions).

- enablePause (boolean, default: true): Toggle the pause feature.

- delaySeconds (int, default: 0): Pause delay after last player leaves.

- commandWhitelist (string list): Allowed console commands (supports * wildcard).

Example: enablePause = true; delaySeconds = 30; commandWhitelist = ["say", "list", "stop", "help*"]

Installation

1. Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 (recommended: 47.4.10+).

2. Place the mod .jar in the server’s mods folder.

3. Start the server (no extra setup needed).

Note: Server-side only; clients don’t need installation.

Dependencies

Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 ([47, 48)), Minecraft 1.20.x

title: Inventory Shuffle
description: Every once in a while your inventory is shuffled!
body:
# Inventory Shuffle

**Inventory Shuffle** periodically randomizes player inventories on the server. At fixed intervals, all item slots are shuffled - including main inventory, hotbar, armor, off-hand, ender chest, and the contents of shulker boxes. The mod is designed as a straightforward gameplay modifier that increases difficulty without changing core mechanics. **Yes, you can still beat the game!**

## Features

- **Timed Shuffle Events**: Every 2-5 minutes, all online players have their inventories shuffled.
- **Global Countdown Warning**: A boss bar appears 5 seconds before each shuffle, displaying a numeric countdown and progress indicator.
- **Complete Inventory Coverage**: Shuffles all 41 player inventory slots (main inventory, hotbar, armor, off-hand).
- **Ender Chest Included**: Each player's ender chest inventory is also shuffled.
- **Shulker Box Support**: Shuffles the contents of shulker boxes, including shulker boxes in ender chest.
- **Vanilla-Compatible**: Works seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft and most other mods (which do not change the inventory mechanics).
- **Server-Side**: Only the server (or the player hosting the world) needs the mod installed for multiplayer.

## Why Play?

This mod introduces periodic disruption to inventory management without altering core gameplay systems. Resource organization becomes a strategic challenge, especially during combat, exploration, or automation-heavy setups. It is suitable for challenge runs, multiplayer servers, and content creation scenarios where controlled unpredictability is desired.

**Trident Weathering allows you to control Minecraft's weather using tridents in unique and immersive ways.**
### 🌧️ Summon Rain
Point your trident towards the sky (looking almost straight up) and hold the use button. After a few seconds, you'll see visual rain cues that gradually intensify until it finally starts raining for real. It's like performing a ritual to summon the storm.
### ⚡ Create Thunderstorms
Throw a trident with Channeling enchantment towards the sky while it's raining. If the trident is pointing almost vertically upward, lightning bolts will start striking around it. Once enough bolts have fallen (configurable), the weather will change to a full thunderstorm.
### ☀️ Clear the Skies
Place a trident in an active conduit. The conduit will channel its power through the trident to gradually clear the weather, removing rain and storms. If the chunk is loaded, you can leave the trident in the conduit and will never rain again in the world.

_All mechanics are fully configurable from the server, allowing you to adjust wait times, required lightning bolts, probabilities, and more. The mod is optimized for performance and works in both single player and multiplayer servers._

title: HT-Login
description: Open Source Ultimate Login Plugin
body:
# 🛡️ HT-Login | The Ultimate Lightweight Authentication Solution

Secure your server with **HT-Login**, a high-performance authentication plugin designed for modern Minecraft networks. It balances strict security with a seamless player experience.

---

### ✨ Key Features

* 🔐 **Persistent Session System (Auto-Login):** Recognizes returning players via secure IP-binding. No more re-typing passwords every time you reconnect.
* 🚫 **Full Motion Lockdown:** Prevents all movement, including camera rotation (Yaw/Pitch), until the player is authenticated.
* 🛠️ **Hardened Command Blocker:** Intercepts and cancels all unauthorized commands (e.g., /gamemode, /creative, /tp) before login.
* 📊 **Dynamic Action Bar HUD:** Displays a sleek, real-time countdown timer and instructions directly above the hotbar.
* 🌍 **Universal Compatibility:** Native support for Minecraft versions 1.12 through 1.21.x and Java 8 through 21.
* ⚡ **Zero-Lag Architecture:** Built with optimized event handling to ensure no impact on TPS, even during high join rates.

---

### 📜 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/register <pass> <pass>` | Create a new account. | `htlogin.use` |
| `/login <pass>` | Access your existing account. | `htlogin.use` |
| `/logout` | Manually end session and clear IP cache. | `htlogin.use` |
| `/changepassword` | Update your security credentials. | `htlogin.use` |

---

### 🔧 Installation Guide

1. **Download:** Place the `HT-Login.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder.
2. **Initialize:** Start the server to generate the configuration files.
3. **Configure:** Customize your settings in `plugins/HT-Login/config.yml` (e.g., login timeout, default language).
4. **Localize:** Adjust messages in the `languages/` folder.
5. **Reload:** Run `/reload` or restart the server to apply changes.

---

### 📂 File Structure

* `config.yml`: Core settings and session duration.
* `data.yml`: Encrypted (SHA-256) password storage and session logs.
* `languages/`: Fully customizable `tr.yml` and `en.yml` files.

---

> *Developed with precision by **mustafa8907**. Optimized for Spigot, Paper, and Purpur.*

title: AfkKick
description: AfkKicker is a lightweight plugin that automatically kicks AFK (away from keyboard) players after a configurable number of hours. It also includes a command for admins to manually kick all AFK players.
body:
![apex](https://i.imgur.com/2pvxufW.png)[APEXNODES- Лучший хостинг](https://client.apexnodes.xyz/aff.php?aff=205)



# ENG
 AfkKick – Auto Kick AFK Players from Your Server
AfkKick is a lightweight, no-dependency Spigot plugin that automatically removes AFK (Away From Keyboard) players from your server after a set amount of time. Designed for performance and simplicity, it's perfect for survival, faction, and PvP servers that want to keep player activity high and prevent abuse of idle time.

 # Features
 Automatic AFK Kicking
Kick inactive players every X hours (configurable).

 Manual Kick Command
Use /afkkick to kick all AFK players manually (permission-based).

 Fully Customizable Messages
All messages (kick reason, feedback, broadcast) can be edited in config.yml, with full & color code support.

 Permission System
Players with afkkick.bypass are never kicked. Command use is protected by afkkick.use.

 No Dependencies
Works out of the box on any Spigot-based server (Paper, Purpur, etc.).

# Configuration (config.yml)

```
interval_hours: 5
kick_reason: "&cYou were kicked for being AFK."
manual_kick_message: "&aKicked &e%count% &aAFK players."
auto_kick_message: "&a[Auto] Kicked &e%count% &aAFK players."
show_kick_message: true
no_permission: "&cYou do not have permission."
```
 # Permissions

```
afkkick.use	Allows use of /afkkick
afkkick.bypass	Prevents the player from being kicked
```


 # Compatibility
 Minecraft 1.16 – 1.21+

 Spigot / Paper / Purpur

 No external dependencies required

You can also share your Minecraft build screenshots, send your best memes, talk with the community, and keep up to date with the latest and greatest information about what I'm working on for Minecraft. ## This mod is a semi-port of [Soulbound Enchantment](https://modrinth.com/mod/soulbound-enchantment) by [iMoonDay](https://modrinth.com/user/iMoonDay) kind of unintentionally. I was originally going to make a different type of enchantment, but I ended up using so much code from their original mod to learn how to make enchantments, do configs, Mod Menu support, and set up datagen, I figured it would be pointless to not just port the rest of the code to newer versions as well. If I get time, I'll port the NeoForge version over as well.

title: Soul Judge
description: This mod adds a unique 3D sword that, when right-clicked, randomly gives the player both buffs and debuffs for 10 seconds. Perfect for chaotic gameplay and unpredictable combat!
body:
# 🗡️ Chaos Blade – Random Effects Sword

This mod adds a unique 3D sword that makes every battle unpredictable.

## ⚙️ Features:

On right-click, the sword applies random buffs and debuffs to the player

Effects last for 10 seconds

Perfect for chaotic PvP, minigames, or fun survival

Includes a custom 3D model that makes the weapon stand out


_Each use is a gamble — will you become stronger or weaker? Let the Chaos Blade decide._

## 🔧 About the Project

This is my first mod project, and I’ve put a lot of effort into it.
I plan to create even bigger and better mods in the future — stay tuned!

title: BufoCraft
description: A set of Fabric client-side QOL, performance, functional and aesthetics mods for BufoCraft.
body:
Enhance your Minecraft experience with this Fabric client-side modpack that enriches gameplay while preserving the classic vanilla aesthetics and feel. Streamlined with quality-of-life improvements like inventory sorting, tabs, and moving while your inventory is open. Build efficiently using Litematica for custom schematics, reach-around placement, and step-up as a smoother alternative to auto-jump. Navigate your world effortlessly with an integrated minimap and world map. Boost performance through optimization mods and OptiFine parity. Enjoy subtle aesthetic enhancements—like additional particle effects and informative HUD elements—that enhance immersion without altering the core Minecraft look. Designed specifically for BufoCraft, this modpack elevates your game without straying from the vanilla experience but may not be permitted on other servers.

Mods
Quality-of-Life Mods
  • Accessible Step – Configurable step-height adjustment so you smoothly climb small blocks without jumping.
  • AutoClicker – Automates left-clicking at configurable CPS for mining and combat convenience.
  • AutoTotem – Automatically equips a Totem of Undying to your off-hand when your health is low.
  • BactroMod – Implements a hydration mechanic so you must manage water intake underwater.
  • Better Mount HUD – Displays mount health and status in a clean HUD overlay.
  • Better Ping Display – Improves the tab ping display.
  • Better Third Person – Adds dynamic third-person camera angles like peek and smooth rotation.
  • ChatPatches – Restores legacy chat formatting, colors, and hover events.
  • Chat Heads – Shows player head icons next to their chat messages for quick ID.
  • ChestTracker – Marks looted chests on your minimap so you don’t miss any loot.
  • ClickThrough Plus – Lets you click through signs and item frames to chests and other containers.
  • Client Tweaks – Adds inventory sorting, shift-click filtering, recipe tweaks, and more.
  • Crafting Tweaks – Shift-click to move items in and out of crafting grids instantly.
  • DeathFinder – Automatically traces a breadcrumb path back to your last death point.
  • e4mc – Open LAN server to the public.
  • Held Item Info – Shows additional details (attack speed, tooltips) for the item in your hand.
  • Inventory Profiles Next – Save and quickly switch between multiple inventory layouts.
  • InvMove – Allows walking, sprinting, and jumping while any inventory is open.
  • Jade – In-world tooltips showing block and entity info on hover.
  • Litematica – Blueprint schematics with ghost blocks for efficient building.
  • Litematica Printer – Automatically places schematic blocks from inventory slots.
  • Map-In-Slot – Embeds your map directly into a hotbar slot for continuous viewing.
  • MixinTrace – Developer tool to visualize mixin application order and conflicts.
  • Mod Menu – In-game GUI to view and configure installed Fabric mods.
  • Mouse Tweaks – Drag-and-drop in GUIs and double-click to collect item stacks.
  • Name Visibility – Toggle player nameplates and adjust draw distance.
  • NoChatReports – Disables Mojang’s chat-reporting UI and warning messages.
  • Not Enough Crashes – Improves crash reports with clickable stack traces and copy buttons.
  • Paginated Advancements – Splits long advancement lists into pages for easier navigation.
  • Polytone – Adds spatial audio filters and subtle ambient sounds to blocks.
  • ProPlacer – Enables reach-around and fast block placement
  • Replanting Crops – Automatically re-plants seeds when you harvest crops.
  • SchematicPreview – Shows Litematica schematics in-world before you paste them.
  • Reese’s Sodium Options – Extra graphical toggles layered on top of Sodium settings.
  • Stack-to-Nearby-Chests – Distributes items from your cursor into nearby chests with one key.
  • Suggestion Tweaker – Customizes command suggestion menu.
  • Too Many Binds – Pop-up search box for mod keybinds
  • TweakerMore – Extension pack of extra client tweaks layered on Tweakeroo.
  • Tweakeroo – All-in-one toolkit for GUI, hotbar, and recipe-book tweaks.
  • Xaero’s Map Chest Tracker Integration – Merges chest markers from ChestTracker into Xaero’s World Map.
  • Xaero’s World Map – Full-screen world map that mirrors your in-game position.
  • Xaero’s Minimap – Circular minimap with waypoints, cave mode, and cave mapping.
  • Zoomify – Smooth, adjustable zoom with mouse wheel or key hold.
Immersive Mods
  • 3D Skin Layers – Renders additional skin layers (jacket, sleeves) in full 3D.
  • AmbientSounds – Plays context-sensitive environmental sounds for immersion.
  • BetterGrassify – Smooths grass block edges with blended textures.
  • Bobby – Enable greater render distances than the server's view-distance setting.
  • Capes – Enables OptiFine-style cape rendering on Fabric clients.
  • Chunks Fade In – Smooths chunk loading by fading them in instead of popping.
  • Continuity – Connected textures for glass, snow, and other blocks sans OptiFine.
  • Detail Armor Bar – Breaks down each armor piece’s durability and protection in the HUD.
  • Distant Horizons – Renders distant terrain at low detail to extend view distance.
  • Dynamic Crosshair – Crosshair changes size/color based on movement and status.
  • Enhanced Block Entities – Adds bloom/glow effects to chests, furnaces, and other entities.
  • Entity Model Features – Additional layers like capes, tridents, and elytra multiplexing.
  • Entity Texture Features – Connected textures support on mob skins and overlays.
  • Falling Leaves – Drifts leaf particles from trees in autumn biomes.
  • Highlighter – Highlights blocks you look at with a configurable outline and color.
  • ImmersiveThunder – Realistic thunderbolts and rolling thunder audio-visuals.
  • Iris Shaders – Shader-loader fully compatible with OptiFine packs on Fabric.
  • LambDynamicLights – Real-time light sources follow entities and held items.
  • Model Gap Fix – Eliminates tiny rendering gaps between block and item models.
  • MoreMcMeta – Allows large resource-pack metadata and custom manifest data.
  • Not Enough Animations – Supplements missing vanilla animations for smoother motion.
  • Nuit – Custom skyboxes per biome/dimension without OptiFine.
  • Physics Mod – Adds physics to mobs, particles and dropped items.
  • Presence Footsteps – Plays realistic footstep sounds based on surface type.
  • RSLS – Raises Minecraft sound sources limit in a simple way.
  • Sound Physics Remastered – Spatial audio that reacts to block materials and distance.
  • Sounds – Large library of ambient and environmental effects.
  • Tiny Item Animations – Adds little animations when you pick up or insert items with your mouse.
  • Visuality – A simple client-sided cosmetic mod that adds new particles.
  • Wavey Capes – Cape textures animate in a sine-wave for realistic movement.
Performance Mods
  • Debugify – Expands the F3 screen with extra metrics like FPS graph, memory pools, and network stats.
  • Entity Culling – Hides off-screen entities to reduce render overhead.
  • FerriteCore – Optimizes data structures to reduce memory usage.
  • FastQuit – Speeds up game exit by optimizing save-and-close routines.
  • ImmediatelyFast – Removes GUI animation delays for instant screen transitions.
  • Dynamic FPS – Automatically scales frame rate when idle to save CPU/GPU.
  • Lithium – Comprehensive logic optimizer for faster world ticks.
  • More Culling – Further reduces rendering of off-camera objects beyond base culling.
  • Sodium – Major renderer overhaul for smooth, high-FPS performance.
  • Sodium Extra – Additional performance toggles and utility features on top of Sodium.
  • SodiumExtras – Experimental speed tweaks from the Sodium team.
Library Mods
  • Architecture API – Abstraction layer for cross-platform Fabric/Quilt/Forge mod development.
  • Balm – Common utilities and abstractions for multi-platform mods.
  • CICADA – General helper functions and utilities for Fabric authors.
  • Cloth Config API – Config-screen library for in-game mod settings.
  • Fabric API – Core hooks and interfaces for Fabric modding.
  • Fabric Language Kotlin – Kotlin support and DSLs for writing Fabric mods.
  • Forge Config API Port – Port of Forge’s configuration system to Fabric.
  • Iceberg – Fabric Rendering API reference implementation used by shader mods.
  • libIPN – GUI/config library powering Inventory Profiles Next.
  • MaLiLib – Shared code library for masa’s Fabric mods.
  • M.R.U – Utilities library for performance-focused mods.
  • Puzzle – Unified config framework aimed at OptiFine replacements.
  • YetAnotherConfigLib – Versatile in-game config GUI library.
  • Collective – Shared utilities for multiple Fabric mods (e.g. Better Eating, AppleSkin).
  • CreativeCore – Core library for Creative-mode and recipe mod support.
  • MixinTrace – (Also listed in QoL) developer library for Mixin conflict tracing.
  • ModernFix – Compatibility and stability fixes for modern Fabric versions.
Update Watchlist
  • CIT Resewn – Re-implements OptiFine’s Custom Item Textures system on Fabric.
  • Eating Animation – Adds sprite animations for edible and drinkable items.
  • Inventory Tabs – Allows swapping to other in-world screens blocks, entities, etc via tabs.
Resource Packs
  • Fresh Animations – Smooth, realistic entity animations replacing vanilla mob motions.
    • Fresh Animations Extensions – Extra customization add-ons for Fresh Animations, including additional mob models and tweaks.
  • UltimaCraft – Vanilla-styled pack that adds new textures, animations, random block variations, and OptiFine features.
    • UltimaCraft Enchantments – Unique per-enchantment textures for books, tools, and armor (requires OptiFine/CIT Resewn).
    • UltimaCraft Models – Adds custom 3D models for blocks, items, and entities.
    • UltimaCraft PBR – LabPBR shader support add-on for realistic material effects under OptiFine.
    • BufoCraft Resource Pack Compilation – Curated compilation of textures and assets to provide a cohesive, vanilla-friendly visual style for BufoCraft.
Shader Packs
  • Complementary Shaders – Reimagined – High-quality, performance-tuned shader preserving Minecraft’s visual identity with two default styles and block-specific effects.
Server Plugins
  • EssentialsX – Core suite of over 130 commands and utilities for Spigot/Paper servers.
    • EssentialsX Chat – Chat formatting module requiring the main EssentialsX plugin.
    • EssentialsX Discord – Lightweight bridge syncing in-game chat and events with Discord channels.
    • EssentialsX DiscordLink – Syncs Vault groups with Discord roles and handles account linking.
    • EssentialsX GeoIP – Displays approximate player locations using the MaxMind GeoLite2 database in `/whois`.
  • FreedomChat – Completely disables Mojang’s chat-reporting system server-side for privacy.
  • LuckPerms – Scalable, web-editable permissions manager supporting Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Forge, Fabric, Velocity, and more.
  • Vault – Universal Permissions, Chat & Economy API that gives plugins easy hooks into these systems.

title: TechBound Reborn 2
description:
A Chaotic, Tech-tastic Modpack
Created by SamTheDev and TheFreshB
Focused on Energy and Automation – where high-tech chaos meets powerful machines!
body:
Thanks! Here’s the **updated and final version** of your modpack description for **Techbound Reborn**, now with the correct Minecraft version (1.20.1) and everything polished:

---

# ⚡ Techbound Reborn

### *Created by **SamTheDev** and **TheFreshB***

Welcome to **Techbound Reborn**, a high-voltage modpack built for automation addicts, energy engineers, and endgame gear fanatics. This isn't just a collection of mods—it's a **tech-centric experience** designed to push your builds, systems, and creativity to their absolute limits.

---

## 🔧 What It Adds

**Techbound Reborn** is a tech-heavy modpack built on **Minecraft 1.20.1**, delivering powerful machines, massive energy systems, and over-the-top endgame gear. Whether you're designing factories, fusion reactors, or entire automated crafting universes, this pack gives you the tools to do it all:

* **⚙ Mekanism** – Deep ore processing, high-tier machines, digital mining, and nuclear fusion.
* **🛠 Create + Addons** – Gorgeous kinetic engineering with rotational mechanics and automated contraptions.
* **⚛ Applied Energistics 2 / Refined Storage** – Full control of item and fluid storage with autocrafting and wireless access.
* **🔥 Thermal Series** – Reliable multi-use tech for item processing, automation, and early-to-mid-game power.
* **☢ Draconic Evolution / Re-Avaritia** – Ridiculously powerful tools, armor, and systems for true late-game domination.
* **⚡ Bigger Reactors / NuclearCraft** – Build monstrous fission/fusion reactors and power your megabases.
* **🧪 Extended Crafting / Avaritia** – Multiblock and extreme crafting systems for the most powerful items imaginable.

Whether you're managing a compact factory or automating the entire tech tree, **Techbound Reborn** gives you the complexity, scalability, and raw power to build something truly insane.

---

## 🚀 Why Play It?

This modpack is for players who:

* Love **automation from start to finish**
* Want to **generate massive power** and actually need it
* Enjoy **deep crafting trees** with real payoff
* Want their endgame gear to feel **truly overpowered**
* Like building **insane factories and systems** that scale

**Techbound Reborn** is a modpack about *engineering the impossible*. You’ll go from humble machines to interdimensional storage networks, energy systems spanning continents, and armor that makes you a god.

---

## 🧰 What You Need to Know

* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader:** Forge
* **Performance Mods:** Embeddium, ImmediatelyFast, Distant Horizons, Clumps – optimized for massive builds.
* **Client Enhancements:** Voice Chat, RealCamera, visual upgrades, and UI improvements.
* **Worldgen & Exploration:** YUNG’s Structures, Biomes O’ Plenty, Tectonic – perfect for adventurous engineers.

**Note:** This is a **progression-heavy, long-term modpack**. Expect deep grinds, late-game recipes, and a rewarding sense of scale and achievement.

---

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84dd311624a529a77accb7edeb61a5d22d578dad.png) ### A mod that adds some random things. **Attention! The concept of this mod is very casual and may not be suitable for all play styles!
This mod is currently in Alpha state and may cause unexpected results, Please report any issues you encounter!** This mod was originally intended to add a hard-to-break block for building industrial base foundations, but now it adds some other useful items. ![0.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/99cacc8f9b48c016c59782eac4966214276d49fd.png) ## Getting Started ![WrenchRecipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/68d36f244fbf6c51d1d33c23e968c00aaf2d93f2.png) First, make an **Oblivion Wrench**, which can dismantle most blocks in this mod and some of the vanilla blocks, and restore some ***Exchanged*** blocks. ![BedrockExchange](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/129860658a2088c7371a145b3f2e2f7c58c442e6.png) Right-clicking bedrock with a Netherite Scrap will convert it into a **Bedrock Platform**, which you can then sneak-right-click with the Oblivion Wrench to put it into your inventory. ![EncapsulatedEndPortal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/f026846d02fab7992adc991e0ec28d010630fc5b.png) Craft **Ghast Tear Glass** in the same way, and use it to craft **Encapsulated End Portals**. ![StrongInteractionsExplode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87d9070e11257f672b782d3dacf08253a5ca5c28.png) Use four Encapsulated End Portals and a Bedrock (don't forget you can always use the Wrench to restore the block) to build the structure shown in the picture, then use an End Crystal to right-click the Bedrock, which will cause a violent explosion and produce a large number of **Strong Interaction Block**s. ![StrongInteractionBlocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/0e74030d334794a9265372367b04e140794bb64e.png) The color and functionality of these blocks can be changed by using the corresponding materials. ## Other Contents ![NetherBoat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/a02f14b46ea2a66f34108862d19c9838fe26e412.png) You can now craft boats using two types of wood from the Nether! They allow you to sail across lava quickly and safely. Who needs striders anymore? ![Platform](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/378829e7814ee98254220cb3757163b5fada64ec.png) **Platforms** allow you to place blocks forward without sneaking, and to move up and down easily (Depending on the pitch angle of your view). If you are not holding a Platform, sneaking will allow you to move across it. If you jump high enough, you can also crawl through a Platform and stand on it. ![Geode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/c9d08ee9758b6ceef53f893d18ca77dcc7e2e422.png) Geode Blocks are a cheap and strong building material. They are explosion-proof and difficult to mine, but can be easily destroyed using an Oblivion Wrench. ![Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vsy4CnrM/images/6c8e0b500609aa7db35dc2311b46ad1c6725f2f2.gif) **Precise Nether Portal** can teleport you to the corresponding location in the Overworld or Nether, so you don’t have to worry about visiting other places that you were not expecting! *And much more not mentioned here!*

title: Aggressive Mobs
description: Simply put: all mobs are aggressive towards you now.
body:
# Aggressive Mobs

This Fabric mod makes all creatures in Minecraft aggressive, including passive ones like cows and pigs. Be careful, the world has become a much more dangerous place!

## Features

*   **Universal Aggression:** All creatures that are not normally hostile (except monsters, which already are) will now attack players on sight.
*   **Highly Configurable:** You can adjust the behavior of aggressive creatures using game rules.

## Game Rules

You can modify these game rules using the `/gamerule <ruleName> <value>` command.

*   `aggressiveMobsActivated` (default: `false`)
    *   Activates or deactivates the main functionality of the mod. Set to `true` to make creatures aggressive.
*   `aggressiveMobsSpeedPercentage` (default: `160`)
    *   Modifies the movement speed of aggressive creatures. 100% is normal speed.
*   `aggressiveMobsDamagePercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the damage dealt by aggressive creatures. 100% is normal damage. (for mobs that do not have an attack attribute, it deals, at 100%, 1 heart of damage)
*   `aggressiveMobsKnockbackPercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the knockback dealt by aggressive creatures. 100% is normal knockback.
*   `aggressiveMobsFollowRangePercentage` (default: `100`)
    *   Modifies the distance at which aggressive creatures will detect and pursue you. 100% is the normal range.

## Installation

1.  Make sure you have [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) installed.
2.  Download the mod's `.jar` file.
3.  Place the `.jar` file in your `mods` folder.

Have fun (and try to survive)!

title: RSM [Really Scary Modpack]
description: This is a modpack that scares you with its atmosphere
body:
This modpack is designed to deliver a deeply immersive horror experience within the familiar world of Minecraft—without overwhelming you with overpowered mobs or constant combat. Instead, it builds tension through atmosphere, psychological unease, and enhanced character immersion.

**Key Features**:

**Gradually Escalating Horror**: The world becomes increasingly unnerving as you progress. Subtle changes, eerie audio, and environmental storytelling work together to create a creeping sense of dread.

**Deep Player Immersion**: Feel truly connected to your in-game character. Through carefully chosen mods, your movements, reactions, and surroundings feel more lifelike than ever.

**Enhanced Animations**: Improved animations bring your character—and the world around you—to life in a more realistic and expressive way.

Horror Mods (No Spoilers): We’ve curated a selection of horror-focused mods that heighten suspense and fear without spoiling the experience. Discover the horrors on your own.

Stunning World Atlas: Explore a beautifully crafted world enhanced by shaders and a carefully selected texture pack. Beauty and horror go hand in hand here.


**Recommended Settings:**

Play in singleplayer, with headphones, and lights off for full immersion.

Use shaders and texture packs to bring out the modpack’s full visual potential.


If you're seeking a horror-themed Minecraft experience that leans into psychological tension, immersive visuals, and atmospheric storytelling, this modpack is for you.

title: MPC92
description: Adds a modified MPL85 for Minecraft Transit Railway.
body:
Addon for the [Minecraft Transit Railway](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway) mod:
You must use this mod for the contents of this pack to function, it should
appear on the train sidings once the pack is loaded.

The MPC92 is a variant of the MPL85, included in the base MTR mod. It includes seats based on Japanese commuter trains, both longitudinal and transverse.
It is available in three lengths, 9m, 14m and 20m that fit with the MTR Urban line door spacing.
Half of the cars feature transverse seats and the other features semi-longitudinal seats.

Fictionally introduced in 1992, it was intended to operate on the Coinville project, and was the first **public** train with 3-door 14m cars for the mod.

original MPL85 model by Jonathan Ho included in the base mod.

description: Survival friendly Resource Pack inspired by the Biome Vote and Mob Vote videos. Early work in progress.
body:
Recounted Alpha is a very incomplete early version of the pack, with a focus on block textures. Very few mobs have been retextured, and even fewer items. Try it out, and give your feedback!

![Recounted Alpha logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ce3a86441a4a63d35c4591e3dc65cd871c9e785.png)

Brighten and stylize your world with Recounted, a resource pack inspired by the pixel art of the Minecraft Live Biome Votes and Mob Votes. 

Recounted began as a port of the resource pack used in the official 2023 Mob Vote server on _Minecraft: Bedrock Edition_. Very soon after, I started adding new models and textures to fill in gaps left by the official pack, given it was designed for a particular hand-made Adventure Mode server. Now the pack has grown signifigantly, with cues taken from the existing designs and original Mob Vote videos.

Currently, Recounted is being developed exclusively with vanilla support in mind, and for the latest release version. The addition of modded features such as connected textures and custom entity models may come in the future.

title: Lyftosaurus' KitKat's
description: A mod that adds KitKat's to Minecraft!
body:
This is a Minecraft Mod for Forge 1.20-1.20.6 and 1.16.5 that adds a new craftable KitKat food in both wrapped and unwrapped variants.

# Wrapped KitKat
## Crafting

Craftable via a shape similar to TNT's crafting recipe, consisting of 4 Cocoa Beans and 5 Red Dye, resulting in 1 Wrapped KitKat.

![Wrapped KitKat Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9214a8efc2cf4fe0c9b1351db445b0402af9e66.png)

## Effects

Consuming a Wrapped KitKat give's no saturation and gives the player Hunger II and Poison for 5 seconds due to the ingested plastic.

## Spawning

Wrapped KitKat's can be found naturally spawning in dungeon chests in groups of up to 3.



# Unwrapped KitKat
## Crafting

Craftable via putting an unwrapped KitKat in any crafting grid, resulting in 1 unwrapped KitKat; or it can be crafted via putting 1 KitKat Wrapper and 4 KitKat Bars into a Crafting Table.

![Unwrapped KitKat Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efe005a6444f37fdd8175ee795d260d2be52b3f9.png)

![Unwrapped KitKat Alternative Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cd900f3129da333cf435c676867845fb1553f36_0.webp)

## Effects

Consuming an Unwrapped KitKat fills 4 hunger bars and 8 saturation and gives the player Resistance II and Speed for 5 seconds.



# KitKat Bar
## Crafting

Craftable via putting an unwrapped KitKat in any crafting grid, resulting in 4 KitKat Bars.

![KitKat Bar Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29584955184677dd77242532a16e27399153a96c.png)

## Effects

Consuming a KitKat Bar fills 1 hunger bar and 2 saturation and gives the play Resistance II and Speed for 1/4th the amount of time as the Unwrapped KitKat.



# Moldy KitKat
## Effects

Consuming a Moldy Kitkat results in Poison II and Hunger III for 10 seconds, and Nausea, Weakness, and Slowness for 5 seconds.

## Spawning

Moldy KitKat's can be found naturally spawning in dungeon chests in groups of up to 5.



# KitKat Wrapper
## Obtaining

The KitKat Wrapper is now obtained whenever the player consumes an Unwrapped KitKat.

## Crafting

The KitKat Wrapper can be crafted as a byproduct of crafting the KitKat Bars.



# KInfiniteKat
## Crafting

Craftable via putting an Unwrapped KitKat in the center of a crafting table grid, with 2 Dragon's Breath on the top and bottom, 2 Nether Stars on either side, and 4 Netherite Scrap in each corner.

![KInfiniteKat Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dba80b17c0a085edd7337ecde1f9985ede53789a.png)

## Effects

Consuming an KInfiniteKat fills 4 hunger bars and 8 saturation and gives the player Resistance II and Speed for 5 seconds, same as the Unwrapped KitKat; where the difference lies is that the KInfiniteKat, once crafted or obtained, can be eaten an unlimited number of times without being consumed. The KInfiniteKat has 4 charges, and cannot be eaten once it reaches 0 charges, however it is constantly recharging, taking 10 seconds to recharge each charge, or 40 seconds in total to recharge fully to 4 charges from 0 charges.

![KInfiniteKat Charges](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ff69c3aed02354bc3da857b698aaf4dd3101fcf.png)



# To-Do List
- Add new "Kit the Kat" mob

title: Zombies Evolved
description: Implements many new zombie variants to bring about a greater sense of difficulty and challenge
body:
**The data-pack library [Hit Match](https://github.com/picarrow/hit-match/releases/tag/v2.0.0) is REQUIRED to be installed for Zombies Evolved to function as expected. Please click on the link to download it.**

## 🟧 About

    Zombies Evolved is a data pack that seeks to provide players with a uniquely arduous challenge while also maintaining Minecraft's beloved feel and freedom. Each zombie variant added is intended to bring along new mechanics and a refreshing ambience of horror.

## 🟧 Features

    The data pack is a work in progress. But every release that finds its way here has been tested and is completely functional, just not feature-complete. As of the current version, there are **three evolved zombies added to the game**. Although you can read about them in the spoiler below, why not consider going in blind?

<details>
<summary>Evolved Zombies</summary>
  
These custom mobs can be easily experimented with by using their dedicated spawn eggs. To obtain a spawn egg, type `/function zombies_evolved:_item/_<evolved zombie>_spawn_egg/give/_`. Of course, replace "<evolved zombie>" with the type of evolved zombie that you want to spawn.

**Jacky** - Jackies are characterized by carved pumpkins, impish chuckles, and a distinct whininess. Try not to let them touch you! With a tendency to pilfer the weapons and armor of nearby friends and foes, they can be a rather mischievous variant of zombie. Each new piece of equipment lights them up like a lantern. Despite their innate greediness, postmortem, they do well in returning what they steal. 3 out of 100 zombies spawn as a jacky.

**Shrieker** - The terror of the caves, the embodiment of horror, the shrieker takes the warden anywhere you and your pickaxe go. Be careful about how you whack it, or you might be in for a lot more trouble than you started out with. 1 out of 50 underground zombies spawn as a shrieker.

**Stalac** - Named after what they emulate, stalacs are opportunistic predators that lay strewn across the ceilings of dripstone caves. Be sure to get the drop on them, before they get the drop on you. Roughly 1 out of 5 zombies that spawn in dripstone caves spawn as a stalac. You can spawn a hanging stalac by right clicking the underside of most blocks with its spawn egg.
</details>

    Specific elements of the data pack can be configured in the settings, accessible by the command `/function zombies_evolved:_settings/show/_`.

## 🟧 Installation

    The Zombies Evolved data pack should be installed like any other data pack.
That entails dragging the entire pack (the ZIP) into the `datapacks` folder of a world.
Additionally, Zombies Evolved requires the data-pack library [Hit Match](https://github.com/picarrow/hit-match/releases/tags/v2.0.0) to be installed along with it.

## 🟧 Distribution & Modification & Media 
    If you're going to do anything with my data pack that is apart from simply playing with it, please give credit where credit is due. This includes distributing, modifying, recording footage of, or streaming my data pack. I've spent countless hours on it (including the upcoming features that aren't yet visible in the release version!). Please note the project is under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

## 🟧 Credit

<details>
<summary>Thank You</summary>

[nphhpn](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/nphhpn/) & [Cloud Wolf](https://linktr.ee/CloudWolfMC) for their contributions to entity-hit-matching tech.

[pea_sh0ter](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/pea_sh0ter/) for coming up with the main premise of the stalac.
</details>

title: LimeWhiteList
description: Simple whitelist plugin
body:
# LimeWhiteList

## Why choose this plugin?
- No hassle, players on the whitelist are stored by their nicknames, not UUIDs
- Easy to use

## How do I get started using the plugin?
- Disable Minecraft whitelist in server.properties (white-list=false)
- Place the plugin in the plugins folder
- Start your server
- Add yourself to the whitelist with the /lwl add <name> command.
- Enable whitelisting with /lwl on

## Commands:
- /lwl add/remove <name> - add or remove a player from the whitelist
- /lwl list - show list of whitelisted players
- /lwl on/off - turn plugin on or off
- /lwl reload - Reload plugin
- /lwl help - Display help menu

## Permissions:
- lwl.manage - access to the /lwl add/remove command
- lwl.list - access to /lwl list command
- lwl.toggle - access to the /lwl on/off command
- lwl.reload - access to command /lwl reload
- lwl.help - access to the /lwl help command

**AutoAdPlugin** is a powerful and flexible plugin for automatically sending advertising messages on your Minecraft server. With this plugin, you can create and customize advertisements that will be automatically sent to players on the server at specified intervals.

- Flexible customization of headers, texts, and links for advertisements.

1. Copy the AutoAdPlugin.jar plugin file to the "plugins" folder of your Minecraft server.
2. Restart the server or execute the /reload command to load the plugin.

title: Deep Mob Learning: Backported
description: A 1.18.2 backport of Deep Mob Learning: Refabricated
body:
Deep Mob Learning: Backported is a 1.18.2 backport of the Deep Mob Learning: Refabricated mod for modern versions of Minecraft.

 

The mod is focused in providing an alternative way of acquiring mob loot in Minecraft, putting the player in intense duels with the Matrix Glitches in order to extract some matter out of it.

 

This mod is still in development, any bug reports, contributions, etc are welcome.

 

How to Play

Unfortunately we don't have any ingame tutorial yet, but you can check out the original mod's wiki on GitHub, it will teach you everything you need to know about the mod.

 

I need your help

This is a mod where I take 1.19+ features and slap them into 1.18.2. As such, things may break. If things do break, please let me know and I'll do my best to fix them.

 

It also Features

Roughly Enough Items (REI) Integration

This mod provides integration with REI. If you have it installed you will be able to see all the custom recipes in-game.

 

Highly Customizable

This mod features a highly-customizable environment. If you are a server owner or a modpack creator, most of the mod's behavior can be changed via datapacks and config files. Check this out.

 

If you have ModMenu installed, you can easily access some settings from the ingame esc menu.

 

Easter Eggs (?)

Not sure about this one, you may have to find it out by yourself.

 

Open Source

As most of the Minecraft mods, Deep Mob Learning: Backported is completely open source and accepting every kinds of contributions. Check this out.

 

Special Thanks

I'd like to thank the author of the original Fabric mod, NathanPB and the rest of the CafeteriaGuild for letting me backport this mod. Check out their Discord guild, there are a lot of cool mods and modpacks.

 

This is a beta, there is much more coming

You can check out our issues and milestones to see whats planned. Feel free to leave a feedback there.

 

I will be banning FABRIC vs FORGE comments if it doesn't aggregate to the mod

title: Broken Sandbox
description: Makes the game way too easy.
body:
Ever had difficulty beating the game? This mod is for you.
I originally made this cause my brother was always unable to beat the game,
so he begged me to make a mod that makes it easy.

...

Well...

I made it easy. Way too easy in my opinion.

What it does:

*__Try putting 1 dirt in a crafting table.__*

It will give you full unbreakable netherite gear with lvl 10 plus enchantments,
A stack of enchanted golden apples, totems of undying, and eyes of ender.

As you can see, this breaks the game instantly and makes the player almost unkillable.
It basically functions like a data pack, but in mod form so you don't have to install it
on each world separately. It does require [Quilt](https://quiltmc.org), or [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net) to run however.

No dependencies other than the launcher you are using's respective api? Haven't tested without the api so it might not run without it.

Should be stable. Runs on vanilla functions? It's basically just a data pack that has been reformatted to a mod.

Must be on a server. Optional on client.

description: Want a better golden dandelion? This mod adds the missing villager golden dandelion feature! Feed the item to kids to lock their age and get permanent baby villagers forever.
body:
# Permanent Baby Villagers

Keep your baby villagers young forever! This lightweight mod adds a simple but highly requested interaction: the ability to freeze a baby villager's aging process completely. It is perfect for map makers, builders, or anyone who wants to keep their villages looking lively with these adorable tiny inhabitants. 👶✨

![The Golden Dandelion Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/JYEuQEuL/images/a323b86a18b429459ef7b24b76152f37c81b386a.gif)

## Features

* **Eternal Youth:** Simply right-click any baby villager with a Golden Dandelion to permanently stop their biological clock.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** The interaction uses the official in-game items, sounds, and particles. The baby will consume the flower and emit happy green sparks to confirm the effect! 🌼
* **Seamless Integration:** Built specifically for the newest game version.

## How to Use

1. Obtain a Golden Dandelion in your world.
2. Find a baby villager.
3. Right-click the baby villager with the flower in your hand.
4. Watch the happy sparks fly! The villager will now stay young forever.

title: GTMoreTools
description: Cross-mod tool integration add-on for GregTech CEu.
body:
# GTMoreTools

**GTMoreTools** is an add-on for [GregTech CEu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gregtech-ce-unofficial) that extends the tool system with cross-mod integrations.

By installing the supported mods listed below, you can receive various tool and machine integrations.
All tools use the GregTech material system, meaning they can be crafted from any GT material with full durability and stat scaling.

This mod can be used as part of a ModPack or standalone.

## Features

### Storage Drawers Integration
Requires: [Storage Drawers](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/storage-drawers)

- Add GT material-based Storage Upgrades.

### Chisel Integration
Requires: [Chisel](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chisel)

- Adds **GT material-based Chisel tools** that function as Chisel mod chisels
- Chisel tools inherit GregTech material properties (durability, tier, etc.)
- Adds the **Auto Chisel** machine for automated block chiseling
  - Available from LV tier and above
  - Supports parallel processing that scales with voltage tier

### Better Builder's Wands Integration
Requires: [Better Builder's Wands](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-builders-wands)

- Adds **GT material-based Wand tools** that function as Builder's Wands
- Wand tools inherit GregTech material properties (durability, tier, etc.)

### Tinkers' Construct Integration
Requires: [Tinkers' Antique](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tinkers-antique)

- For full details, see [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/GTModpackTeam/GTMoreTools/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

- CEu tool materials are automatically registered as TiC materials (Head, Handle, Extra, Bow, Arrow Shaft)
- Traits are automatically assigned from GT material properties (Holy, Heat Resistant, Cryogenic, Anti-Corrosion, etc.)
- Molten fluid and smeltery casting/melting support for CEu materials
- Dual-tool mining with GT tool + TiC tool cross-hand combinations

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.12.2
- [GregTech CEu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gregtech-ce-unofficial) (Required)
- [MixinBooter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter) (Required)

## Optional Dependencies
- [Storage Drawers](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/storage-drawers)
- [Chisel](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chisel) — For Chisel integration
- [Better Builder's Wands](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-builders-wands) — For Wand integration
- [Tinkers' Antique](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tinkers-antique) — For Tools integration

title: SCP-372, The Peripheral Jumper
description: Was there something? I saw something moved quickly... or did I?
body:
Peripheral Jumper adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-372, also known as The Peripheral Jumper.


SCP-372 resembles a grasshopper-like insect. It moves at incredible speeds, darting away from the player in unpredictable, fast movements. The creature is most commonly seen when it spawns curled up in front of the player, only to despawn moments later. However, be cautious, contact with SCP-372 results in significant damage. 

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-372 spawn?

SCP-372 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-372.

</details>



![SCP-372](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dba1b07b326ed5b3b9b3d9dade5f0332dca2b7d6.png)

SCP-372 is a grasshopper-like creature that moves extremely fast. It actively avoids players, sprinting away as soon as they get too close. However, because of its incredible speed, colliding with SCP-372 can deal significant damage to the player. Most of the time, SCP-372 appears as a curled-up entity that spawns infront the player before vanishing in an instant.

title: Wildborne - Photorealistic VANILLA Resource Pack
description: This is a specially designed photorealistic VANILLA Minecraft texture/resource pack based on the upcoming Wildborne Modpack!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a4e64adc194eca520d20d19e4baa399db3684c5.png)


## IMPORTANT NOTES - READ FOR AN IDEAL EXPERIENCE:

**This Resource Pack is currently in BETA V81.6! Expect SOME unfinished models & textures, as well as changes to existing ones until the project is fully released!**

**While this pack IS compatible with base game Vanilla - I HIGHLY recommend playing it with your favorite Modloader, such as Forge, NeoForge or Fabric AND AT LEAST the Sodium mod!** 

**This is because this is a 512x512 high resolution resource pack, and Vanilla Minecraft suffers with high resolution pack performance in general - Sodium will at least make the game nicely playable, though other performance mods will help significantly too**

**This Resource Pack WILL have everything complete within it once FULLY released & out of Beta! Nothing locked behind paywalls!**

**Combine this with the new Wildborne - Worldgen & Data Tweaks datapack for even more immersion/realism! Link below:**

[https://modrinth.com/datapack/wildborne-worldgen-data-tweaks](https://modrinth.com/datapack/wildborne-worldgen-data-tweaks)


### RECOMMENDED VANILLA GAMEPLAY SETTINGS:

1. **Graphics MUST be on Fancy or higher - otherwise leaves won't render as see-through**
2. **Framerate should be set to unlimited, regardless of using VSync or not - this helps maximize your FPS either way**
3. **Mipmap levels should be OFF** (You can increase these, but you'll LIKELY experience lag)
4. **Allocate AT LEAST 8GB of RAM/Memory in your launcher Java profiles to use this pack**
5. **I highly recommend installing/adding your favorite font resource pack that installs a higher resolution font for Minecraft, as Minecraft's default font will seem very out of place otherwise XD**


### RECOMMENDED MODDED GAMEPLAY SETTINGS:

1. **Install Sodium or Embeddium or a related Server & Client Performance mod**
2. **Install Lithium or Radium or a related Server Performance Mod**
3. **Install Ferrite Core & Modern Fix - This will optimize Minecraft's RAM/Memory usage, as well as fix many bugs that cause issues in 1.21+ versions of Minecraft**
4. **Install Sodium Leaves Culling or a similar leaves culling mod - This pack uses a lot of fancier leaf block models/textures, and such mods will make a marked improvement in your FPS**
5. **Install MoreCulling, Substrate, Bocchium or related culling mods - these mods will cull the texture faces of blocks you can't see, which frees up Minecraft to render more important things that you can see**
6. **Install Iris or Oculus if using Shader Packs**
7. **Install Sodium Dynamic Lights or a similar dynamic lighting mod for maximum immersion while carrying Torches/Lanterns with this Resource Pack**
8. **I highly recommend installing/adding your favorite font resource pack that installs a higher resolution font for Minecraft, as Minecraft's default font will seem very out of place otherwise XD**


### RECCOMENDED SHADER PACKS FOR IMMERSION & REALISM:

- **Complementary Unbound**
- **Euphoria Patches (If using Complementary Unbound)**
- **Kappa Shaders**
- **Photon Shaders**
- **Bliss Shaders or a variant of it**
- **Any SEUS Shader or variant of it**
- **MakeUp - UltraFast Shaders (Ideal for low end PCs & realism with maximum FPS)**


The Wildborne Photorealistic VANILLA Resource Pack is the Vanilla Minecraft base Resource Pack for the upcoming Wildborne Modpack (Coming Soon!). It adds significantly more immersion, realism & high definition by overhauling Minecraft's base game textures, models, blockstates, GUIs & more - allowing you to become lost in the beautiful worlds you create with minimal intrusion to the gameplay

Transparent GUIs in this pack allow you to manage items, blocks, crafting, smelting, etc without blocking your views of the worlds/biomes/landscapes generated by the game

Torches & Lanterns can now be handheld like an actual torch/lantern (But will not emit light without a dynamic lighting mod or shaders)

Many other blocks & items have customized models to enhance detail and realism as you interact with everything in your worlds

title: minehak&krutosh2's Pompous PepeLand Playground
description: A delightfully over-the-top modpack for PepeLand 10 server
body:
**🇬🇧 English description available below.**

---
![Minecraft Main Menu Screen with Panorama of Trading Zone from PepeLand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0121b0f10c0d1181fc3ab44c476458dbe9333d90.jpeg)
> "Без цели. Зато со вкусом."

![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/mhk2s-pompous-pepeland-playground?logo=modrinth&color=28a745&labelColor=555555)
![Latest version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/mhk2s-pompous-pepeland-playground?color=blue&labelColor=555555&label=latest%20version&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fmodpack%2Fmhk2s-pompous-pepeland-playground%2Fchangelog)

Это тщательно несбалансированный сборник визуальных штучек, уютных звуков, улучшений производительности и специальных модов для PepeLand 10.
Основан на официальной сборке из ТГ-канала PepeLand с дополнениями по собственному вкусу.

🐸 Специальные моды для PepeLand 10:
- 🧩 PepeLand Helper
- 🆙 Action Bar Info (тот самый мод с координатами и информацией о сервере со стрима)

... и ресурспаки:
- 🌿 оф. ресурспак PepeLand
- 🎞️ PepeLand Loading Screen (экран загрузки в стиле PepeLand)
- 📕 PepeSPLASH (сплэши на главном экране Minecraft в стиле PepeLand)
- 🏙️ Pepeland 9 Panorama (панорама спавна PepeLand, в паке стоит ТЗ, доступны также другие варианты - [ссылка](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/panorama-mp1-ppl-9))

Здесь есть все распространённые на PepeLand моды, в том числе (но и не только) следующие:

Для большой прорисовки используется Bobby (сохраняет чанки локально). В сборке есть Simple Voice Chat, Axiom, Litematica, Freecam, а также Stendhal (улучшение редактирования табличек) и ImagineBook (картинки в книгах). Включён мод на динамическое освещение LambDynamicLights, добавлена сортировка инвентаря. В меню креатива поддерживается многоязычный поиск (благодаря моду Language Reload по умолчанию можно искать на русскомъ дореформенномъ, русском и английском (США)). Появление чанков анимировано (возможно отключить в настройках).

Улучшения и исправления производительности включают Sodium, Iris, ModernFix, Entity Culling, FerriteCore, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, FastQuit и другие. Добавлены все необходимые моды для работы сложных ресурспаков (Polytone, Puzzle и т.п.).

### О красивом:

Добавлены различные улучшения чата (длина, плавная анимация, калькулятор), интерфейса (предпросмотр карт, мешочков, шалкербоксов). Для стиля есть красивые курсоры, различные моды на частицы в инвентаре, украшения игрового мира. В меню ресурспаков можно включить/выключить иммерсивные интерфейсы и др., анимации моделей игроков. Количество здоровья мобов отображается на их моделях, добавлены анимации еды, специальные текстуры для книг зачарований.

### О весёлом:
Добавлен TetrisMC, PatPat. В ресурспаках есть ножи из Counter Strike (CStrikify) и звук достижений из Стима. Головы игроков увеличиваются, когда они говорят в голосовой чат.

Предложения по добавлению новых штуковин принимаются в лс в дискорде (@krutosh2). Не стесняйтесь адаптировать сборку под себя. Назначения клавиш по умолчанию могут показаться странными - возможно стоит поменять. Из коробки включён русскiй дореформенный.

### Установка через PrismMC:
Нажмите Добавить экземпляр -> выберите Modrinth -> Найдите этот модпак -> Нажмите ОК.

### Обновление через PrismMC:
Вы также можете легко обновить сборку до новой версии (они выходят чуть реже раза в месяц) через PrismMC. Выберите сборку -> Изменить -> вкладка Modrinth -> Обновить.

### Послесловие и благодарности
Если вы ищете серьёзный и действительно комфортный модпак, советую посмотреть [работы Xleb](https://modrinth.com/user/Xleb/modpacks). В том числе при создании этого чудовища мы подсмотрели несколько модов в его модпаке, а также используем [загрузочный экран](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-loading-screen) его авторства. Также выражаем благодарность авторам всех модов, ресурспаков и шейдерпаков, которые включены в сборку; ссылки на них можно найти в разделе зависимостей версии модпака.

# **🇬🇧 EN**:
> "Exquisitely pointless — because sometimes, that’s the point."

This is a carefully unbalanced collection of visual tweaks, cozy sounds, performance improvements, and special mods for PepeLand 10.
Based on the official build from the PepeLand Telegram channel with some personal additions and adjustments.

🐸 Special mods for PepeLand 10:

- 🧩 PepeLand Helper
- 🆙 Action Bar Info (the one that shows coordinates and server info from the stream)

... and resource packs:
- 🌿 official PepeLand resource pack
- 🎞️ PepeLand Loading Screen (a loading screen in the PepeLand style)
- 📕 PepeSPLASH (main menu splashes in the PepeLand style)
- 🏙️ Pepeland 9 Panorama (PepeLand spawn panorama; the included one is TradeZone, other variants are also available — [link](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/panorama-mp1-ppl-9))

This includes all the popular mods used on PepeLand, including (but not limited to) the following:

For extended render distance it uses Bobby (saves chunks locally). The build includes Simple Voice Chat, Axiom, Litematica, Freecam, as well as Stendhal (improved sign editing) and ImagineBook (images in books). LambDynamicLights (dynamic lighting) is enabled, and inventory sorting has been added. The creative menu supports multilingual search (thanks to the Language Reload mod, you can search in pre-reform Russian, Russian, and English (US) by default). Chunk loading is animated (can be disabled in options).

Performance enhancements and fixes include Sodium, Iris, ModernFix, Entity Culling, FerriteCore, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, FastQuit, and others. All necessary mods for advanced resource packs (Polytone, Puzzle, etc.) are also included.

### About the beautiful:

Various chat improvements have been added (length limit, smooth animation, calculator), as well as interface tweaks (preview for maps, bundles, and shulker boxes).
For style, there are custom cursors, particle mods for the inventory, and world decoration enhancements.
In the resource pack menu, you can toggle immersive interfaces, player model animations, and more.
Mob health is displayed directly on their models, food now has eating animations, and enchanted books have special textures.

### About the fun:

Added TetrisMC and PatPat. The resource packs include Counter-Strike knives (CStrikify) and Steam achievement sounds. Players' heads get bigger when they talk in voice chat.

Suggestions for new additions are welcome via Discord DMs (@krutosh2). Feel free to adapt the pack to your liking - the default keybinds might feel unusual and could use adjusting. By default, pre-reform Russian orthography is enabled.

### To install via PrismMC:
Click Add instance -> select Modrinth -> Search for this modpack -> Click OK.

### Updating via PrismMC:
You can also easily update your build to the latest version (released slightly less than once a month) via PrismMC. Select Build -> Modify -> Modrinth tab -> Update.

### Afterword and acknowledgements
If you are looking for a serious and truly comfortable modpack, I recommend checking out [Xleb's work](https://modrinth.com/user/Xleb/modpacks). When creating this monster, we borrowed several mods from his modpack and also used his [loading screen](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ppl-loading-screen). We would also like to express our gratitude to the authors of all the mods, resource packs, and shader packs included in the build; links to them can be found in the modpack version dependencies section.
