title: Heroes Reborn
description: I am developing my first mod Heroes Reborn. Currently in the process of porting Lucraft Heroes Expansion stuff into my mod as well.
body:
I am trying to make a faithful addition and recreation of Heroes Expansion in my own right under the name Heroes Reborn. I whole heartedly plan on expanding and refining what I already have and I am currently finishing up what I have developed so far. I do hope you enjoy what I have cared for.

Credit - https://gitlab.com/threetag/legacy/LucraftCore

Current How To (W.I.P)

Getting started!
First things first you're going to want to find an Aetherbloom. They can usually be found in meteor crashes (hard to miss) where you can find them at the heart of the crash. If you want up to one with a pair of shears and right click you will get Aetherium!. But I advise finding more. So what do you do with Aetherium? well first you need a Mortar and Pestle. If you put Aetherium in your off hand and hold the Mortar and Pestle in your main hand and right click the ground you get Aetheron!... or not, theres a 50% chance you dont get Aetheron. But lets say you did get Aetheron, going off that you know can progress to your next step.

You will need to craft and find room for the Centrifuge! You should also get your self a Empty Serum! which is crafted by surrounding one quarts in a crafting grid with glass panes. Once you have the Empty Serum you must find yourself a water source, then you need to right click water with the Empty Serum and BOOYA. H20 Serum, now we can move onto the next step!

Go over to your Centrifuge and place the H20 Serum in one input and then place the Aetheron in the other input. Fuel this with Coal on the left hand side of the GUI. After some time you should get Irradiated Serum. Now we are ready to move onto the SUPER stuff.

Next thing you want to do is place the Irradiated Serum in the Centrifuge with 1 Enchanted Golden Apple. You will need that to progress. Now if you do the Centrifuge will mix into the Super Serum! At this point the Centrifuge is no longer needed if you are just one person.

Moving on to the end game portion of Heroes Reborn. 
Once you have the Super Serum you will need ONLY one of the 6 different crafting items needed for your desired Serum. Now you once you have everything good! Now you need to craft a Genesis Engine, which requires a Genesis Core. Once the Genesis Engine is crafted (I recommend JEI) I recommend placing the Genesis Engine far away from your Base of Operations. Once you have placed your Genesis Engine go ahead and peak inside. There you will see two fuel inputs both requiring Ender Pearls. You will also see two inputs, this is where your Super Serum and your Serum Ingredient will go. The Genesis Engine draws a tremendous toll on our Earthly plain causing Electro Magnetic disturbances so I advice leaving the area until you hear the crackling when its finished. At which point you will see your desiginated Serum. Upon drinking this Serum you should feel POWER like no other but weak at the same time.

The Skill Tree!
Right away you will need to craft the Book Of Genesis, this is fairy cheap at this level. Enter your crafting grid with 2 Diamonds and one book and go ahead and grab yourself the BOG! Right click and bomb voyage you are now on your Super Journey.

Each power has their own requirement.
Ender Serum = Consume Ender Orbs
Icarus Serum = Soar through the sky!
WayBig Serum = Hold your form!
Mimic Serum = Kill Mobs!
Spectral Serum = Phase more!
Infernal Serum = Stay in Infernal Form! 

There are Uru Meteor that spawn with Mjölnir as well. These Meteors start spawning 1000 blocks away from spawn! I advise you to do /hrwc before you get your hopes up though.

 
Commands;
/heroesreborn givepoints
/heroesreborn removepoints 
/hrwc (Checks worthiness)

 - Aetherium in off hand with Mortar and Pestal in main hand on right click = 1 Aetheron
 - Empty Serum - Glass panes all around one quarts in the middle.
 - H20 Serum - Right click water with Empty Serum to fill
 - Irradated Serum - Centrifuge H20 Serum + Aetheron
 - Super Serum - Irradiated Serum + Enchanted Golden Apple in centrifuge = Super Serum
 - Ender Orb - Ender pearl in middle of crafting, 1 diamond in each corner and then between                Diamonds put quarts.
 - Reversion Serum - H20 Serum surrounded by quarts.
 - Mortar and Pestle - Plank of any kind and a stick diagonally top left or top right in a crafting grid.
 - Golden Feather - Feather Surrounded by Gold ingots
 - Diamond Feather - Feather Surrounded by Diamonds
 - Mirror - Glass Pane surrounded by Glass blocks
 - Centrifuge - Middle bottom in crafting grid is a culdron and then above that a smoker the rest of the grid surrounded by iron
 - Genesis Core - Corners are glass, outer middle ender perals, inner ender eye.
 - Genesis Engine - Genesis Core in middle top of crafting grid. middle obisdian, bottom middle obisdan, bottem left and bottem right obsidan.
                    Middle Right and Middle Left Diamonds, Top right and Top Left Obsidian.
----------------
I recommend JEI
----------------
Flight Matrix
- Ghast tear in middle 2 golden feathers top and bottom, left and right sides are 3 diamond feathers each side.

 Ender Heart
- 5% drop chance from ender man looting enchantment increases it 12% chance at max level looting.

 Giants Heart
- 9 Human hearts in a crafting grid

 Phantoms Delight
- Made by taking phantom membrane and surrounding it in diamond feathers.

 Faceless Moss
- Sculk Catalyst next to a mirror in any direction in the crafting grid

 Blaze Skull
- 3% drop chance from blaze

 Human Heart
- 35% Drop from villager and pillager

 *Genesis Engine reciepes*
      Fuel via Ender Pearl
Icarus Serum ---> Super Serum + Flight Matrix
Ender Serum ---> Super Serum + Ender Heart
Waybig Serum ---> Super Serum + Giants Heart
Spectral Serum ---> Super Serum + Phantoms Delight
Mimic Serum ---> Super Serum + Faceless Moss
Infernal Serum ---> Super Serum + Blaze Skull

title: FroggyCraft
description: A vanilla+ pack with lots of frog-related mods like Ribbits, tons of fun & useful mods like Create, and mods for those who love to build & decorate! Frogs, toads, & axolotls - this pack is an amphibian's paradise. 𓆏🐸𓆏
body:
This modpack provides a vanilla+ experience that adds new biomes, new and overhauled mobs, powerful tools, quality-of-life improvements, under-the-hood fixes, performance enhancements, and so much more. Oh and I almost forgot, the pack has a whole bunch of mods and other content related to **frogs**! I like frogs, and I hope you do too :] If you have an older or lower power PC that struggles with demanding mods like Create or you want nothing more than frogs and performance optimizations, you might prefer the [**FroggyCraft Lite**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/frogycraft) modpack – all the frog-related content from FroggyCraft with none of the extras! Join the [**FroggyCraft Discord**](https://discord.gg/WBQRfBgQEY) to report bugs, get help, and chat with other FroggyCrafters!
### **Frog-Related Stuff**

![Frog-Related Mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7951b553aea5a3eca3dce5c27253048478109c1a_0.webp) - [**_Bucket of Frog_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bucket-of-frog) (mod): lets you carry frogs in buckets just like axolotls and other aquatics. Warning: this mod is only compatible with the three vanilla variants of frogs, modded frogs from More Frogs 2 will revert to a vanilla variant if placed in a bucket. - [**_Frog Legs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/froglegs) (mod): adds new block variants for froglights and froglight end rods. Also adds a bunch of new food drops, but that's not important, don't look into it. Remember, frogs are friends not food! - [**_Holdable Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/holdable-frogs) (mod): lets you pick up frogs and use than as tools – their tongues can grab stuff from far away and drag them towards you. - [**_More Frogs 2_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs) (mod): this mod adds new frog variants that will spawn and can be breed only in certain places (the nether, the end, the deep dark, above y=250), they have their own drops, with one unique drop, the Light at the End block. - [**_Ribbits_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits) (mod): adds villager-like mobs called Ribbits to the came, frog people with their own villages, trades, special items, and fun behaviors. - [**_SpaceFrog's Forever Young Tadpoles_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-forever-young-tadpoles) (datapack): showing a tadpole a slime ball causes a quantum-superposition/magic allows the tadpole to clone itself into an ageless tadpole – keep your tadpole friends in their cute tadpole form forever! - [**_SpaceFrog's Hungry Hungry Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spacefrogs-hungry-hungry-frogs) (datapack): frogs will eat hostile mobs. Adds a rare frog variant, The ÜberFrog, an immortal, insatiable frog that can one-shot kill any hostile mob, never taking any damage - makes for a great guard-frog for your base. - [**_SpaceFrog's Recolored Frogs_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spacefrogs-recolored-frogs) (resource pack): replaces the skin of the warm variant frogs with something a bit less sickly and pale. So if those pale/whitish frogs ever weirded you out, worry not - they're now a beautiful shade of bright, froggy green. - [**_Villager Frog House_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-frog-house) (mod): now swamp villagers finally have a home, they get to live in a giant frog! Well, more of a frog-shaped communal building, still pretty cool. - **And tons more frog-related customizations and easter eggs implemented through special datapacks and [_KubeJS_](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) scripts.**

### **Fun & Immersive Game Expansions**

- [**_Better End_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend) and [**_Better Nether_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether) (mods): overhauls The End and The Nether adding new biomes, mobs, loot, and structures. The End has never looked better, and The Nether has never been more fun and challenging. - [**_Bosses of Mass Destruction_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction) (mod): adds 4 new bosses to the game, each with unique and challenging battle mechanics and drop loot that can be combined to make incredibly powerful tools like anti-gravity devices and a staff that prevents hostile mobs from spawning in a 64-block radius. - [**_Create_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) (mods): brings the industrial revolution to Minecraft! There's way too much to describe, check out the mod's [wiki](https://wiki.createmod.net/). Several addon mods are also included like [_Create Steam 'n' Rails_](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails), [_Create Copycats+_](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats), [_Create Slice & Dice_](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice), and [_Create Enchantment Industry_](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry-fabric-legacy). - [**_Emotecraft_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/emotecraft) (mod): adds player emotes like in Bedrock edition and allows you to make your own custom emotes. - [**_Explorations_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/explorations) (mod): adds a variety of vanilla-style structures to the world like temples with great loot and other structures that make your world feel lived in. - [**_Immersive Paintings_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-paintings) (mod): adds customizable paintings to your world; use any image and map paints of any size the vanilla paintings come in. - [**_More Axolotl Variants_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mavm) (mod): adds more axolotl variants - the more variants of amphibians, the better! - [**_Mystic's Biomes_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mystics-biomes) (mod): adds brand new biomes to world generation - Strawberry Fields, Lavender Meadow, Bamboo Blossom Forest, Autumnal Grove, Lush Oasis, Lagoon, and Tropics. - [**_Nyctophobia_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nyctophobia) (mod): adds new spooky biomes to world generation - Haunted Forest, Haunted Lakes, Eroded Haunted Forest, Ancient Dead Coral Reef, and Deep Dark Forest. - **_YUNG's mods_**: [Better Desert Temples](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-desert-temples), [Better Dungeons](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-dungeons), [Better Jungle Temples](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-jungle-temples), [Better Mineshafts](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-mineshafts), [Better Nether Fortresses](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-nether-fortresses), [Better Ocean Monuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-ocean-monuments), [Better Strongholds](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-strongholds), [Better Witch Huts](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-witch-huts), [Bridges](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-bridges), [Cave Biomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-cave-biomes), and [YUNG's Extras](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-extras).

### **Quality-of-Life Improvements**

- [**_Beacon Overhaul Reloaded_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beacon-overhaul-reloaded) (mod): upgrades beacons to have additional effect options including the unique effects nourishment and long reach. Beacon pyramids can be built taller and with more type of blocks to extend beacon effects over larger areas. - [**_Carry On_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on) (mod): pick up most of the friendly mobs and transport them anywhere you like. Also lets you pick up chests and barrels and move them without needing to empty them. - [**_Custom Villager Trades_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-villager-trades) (mod): makes wandering traders useful! They'll sell you mini-blocks thanks to Vanilla Tweaks, but this mod also adds lots of useful and powerful, but rare, trades including an easy source for wind charges and some of the loot from Bosses of Mass Destruction. - [**_Inmis_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmis) (mod): adds backpacks to the game, adding dozens of new player inventory slots in a banked configuration. - [**_Music Control_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/music-control) (mod): gives you full control of Minecraft music - reduce or eliminate delays between background music tracks and skip over tracks. - [**_Reinforced Shulker Boxes_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-shulker-boxes) (mod): adds new craftable shulker boxes that can store up to 108 stacks of items. - [**_Simple Voice Chat_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) (mod): does exactly what is says and adds voice chat to Minecraft. - [**_Smarter Farmers_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/smarter-farmers-farmers-replant) (mod): farmers will replant the crops they farm, no more gardens turning into fields of wheat! - [**_Vanilla Tweaks_**](https://vanillatweaks.net) (datapacks): a selection of the available Vanilla Tweaks datapacks that adds new tools and game rules, makes quality of life improvements, and adds new recipes – name tags are now craftable! For more options, see: [vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks) - [**_Vertical Slabs Compat_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/vertical-slabs-compat) (mod): adds vertical slabs to the game, enough said! - [**_Wraith Waystones_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fwaystones) (mod): adds craftable waystones let you instantly teleport to other waystones in the world. It's like having “/tp” but implemented in a very survival vanilla way. - [**_Xaero's World Map_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) and [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) (mods): world map and mini map HUD that shows what areas you've explored in the world, set waypoints, and display players and mobs. - [**_You're in Grave Danger_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/yigd) (mod): adds functional grave stones to the game. When a player dies, a grave stone is left in their place that contains their entire inventory – you never have to worry about your gear despawning before you can get back to it.

### **Visual Enhancments**

- [**_3D Skin Layers_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) (mod): changes the rendering of the top layer of player skins to be 3D and more consistent with the way mobs render in the game. - [**_Better Clouds_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds) (mod): adds amazing looking, customizable clouds that still look Minecrafty. - [**_Bobby_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bobby) (mod): cashes chunks that have rendered in you work and displays them without loading them, making you able to see far beyond your render distance and makes you world feel so much bigger with minimal performance penalties. - [**_Dramatic Skys_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dramatic-skys) (resource pack): makes the skies HD with realistic clouds and lighting. - [**_Fresh Animations_**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) (resource pack): beings new life and expressiveness to vanilla mobs reminiscent to Element Animations' Minecraft shorts. - [**_Iris Shaders_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) (mod): a popular shader pack loader, included are three preinstalled shader options: [Miniature Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/miniature-shader), [Nostalgia Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/nostalgia-shader), and [Rethinking Voxels](https://modrinth.com/shader/rethinking-voxels) - [**_Lamb Dynamic Lights_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) (mod): adds dynamic lighting and emissive lighting from items held by the player like Optifine. - [**_Vanilla Tweaks_**](https://vanillatweaks.net) (resource packs): a selection of the available Vanilla Tweaks resource packs that fix visual bugs in Minecraft and add other visual enhancements that conform to the vanilla aesthetic. For more options, see: [vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs)

### **Technical & Performance Improvements**

- [**_BetterF3_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3) (mod): massively improves the F3 screen with customizable fields and color-coding. - [**_Chunky_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/chunky) (mod): allows you to pre-generate chunks over large definable areas in specific patterns (square, circular, oval, etc.) improving server performance and rendering. - [**_CreateBetterFps_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/createbetterfps) (mod): improves performance around Create mod components that typically trash frame rates like water wheels. - [**_Dynamic FPS_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) (mod): improves client system perfornace by reducing resource usage while Minecraft is in the background, idle, or on battery. - [**_KubeJS_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) (mod): a powerful Javascript-based scripting mod that enables users and server admins to implement customizations that go far beyond the capabilities of datapacks. - [**_Ksyxis_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ksyxis) (mod): speed up world loading and reduce resources utilization by removing the requirement to keep spawn chunks loaded at all times. - [**_Madgique's Tickrate Changer_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/madgique-tickrate-changer) (mod): lets you change the world tickrate to custom values similar to the 1.20.3+ command '/tick'. - [**_Memory Leak Fix_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix) (mod): fixes random memory leaks for both the client and server and includes other performance improvements. - [**_MiniHUD_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/minihud) (mod): adds a 'mini F3' screen and various overlays like light level, spawn chunks, slime chunks, and custom shapes like de-spawn spheres. - [**_Roughly Enough Items (REI)_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei) (mod): similar to JEI, view and search the full registry of blocks and items in the game, view recipes, item tags, etc. - [**_Sodium_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) (mod): Makes massive improvements to performance and give you more control of your video settings. - [**_Tweakeroo_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) (mod): adds an enormous amount of new tools for power users including auto-clickers and freecam.

### **Mods for Builders**

Mods that add tons of custom blocks and items you can use to spruce up your builds: [**_Additional Additions_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/addadd), [**_Adorn_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/adorn), [**_Beautify Refabricated_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/beautify-refabricated), [**_Better Lily Pads_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-lily-pads), [**_BetterEnd Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-cutting-betterend), [**_Chipped_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped), [**_Decorative Blocks_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/decorative-blocks), [**_Ender's Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enders-delight), [**_Every Compat (Wood Good)_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat), [**_Expanded Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/expanded-delight), [**_Farmer's Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), [**_Hearth & Home_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/hearth-and-home), [**_Nethers Delight Refabricated_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nethers-delight-refabricated), [**_Paladin's Furniture Mod_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladins-furniture), [**_Re:Deco_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/redeco), [**_Rustic Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/rustic-delight), [**_Storage Delight_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/storage-delight), [**_Supplementaries_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries), [**_Valhelsia Furniture_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/valhelsia-furniture)

### **Backports for Minecraft 1.20.1** - [**_Autocrafter Early_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/autocrafter-early) (mod): adds the autocrafter, uses the original block texture - [**_Backport Paintings 1.21_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backport-paintings-1.21) (mod): adds the new set of paintings introduced in 1.21 - [**_Backported Spears_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backported-spears) (mod): adds spears and related enchantments - [**_Backpost Wolves_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/backported-wolves) (mod): adds the new wolf variants from 1.20.5 - [**_Bundle Backport-ish_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/bundle-backportish) (mod): adds the bundle scrolling and dyeing mechanics from 1.21.2 - [**_Copper and Tuff Backport_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/copper-and-tuff-backport) (mod): adds the copper and tuff blocks from 1.21 along with copper tools and armor - [**_Faithful Mace_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/faithful-mace) (mod): adds the mace, related enchantments, and the wind charge - [**_Happy Ghast_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/happy-ghast) (mod): adds the Happy Ghast, Ghastling, and Dried Ghast - [**_Pale Garden Backport_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/pale-garden-backport) (mod): adds The Creaking, resin blocks, the Pale Gardens biome, and the rest of the Pale Garden update
### **Mob Overhauls & Additions**

[**_Companion_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/companion), [**_Creeper Overhaul_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/creeper-overhaul), [**_Critters and Companions_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/critters-and-companions), [**_Earth2Java_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/earth2java), [**_Enderman Overhaul_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/enderman-overhaul), [**_Happy Ghast_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/happy-ghast), [**_More Axolotl Variants_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/mavm), [**_More Frogs 2_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/morefrogs), [**_Naturalist_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/naturalist), [**_Promenade_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/promenade), [**_Ribbits_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits).

### **And so much more!**

There are so many more under the hood enhancements and fixes, quality of life improvements, and powerful tools like [**_Axiom_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) and [**_Litematica_**](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) – really, just too many to summarize.

Guide for Installation on Servers The following is a step-by-step guide on how to install FroggyCraft on a server hosted by Modrinth, but the general points should be applicable to other hosting services:

  1. Join the FroggyCraft Discord and download the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file from the pinned comment in the "troubleshooting" chat. Unzip the files to your PC.
  2. Log into your account on the Modrinth website. Start a new server or reset an old server and select the installation type "Modpack base".
  3. In the modpack search bar, enter "FroggyCraft", select the modpack, and set the properties you want for the server (e.g., game mode, difficulty, etc.).
  4. Under the "Options" tab you'll see a button labeled "Platform" – click this button and select the option to "Unlink Modpack".
  5. Under the "Content" tab you'll find the mods and datapacks associated with FroggyCraft. Disable all of the mods with the yellow warning triangle indicating they're client-side only mods with the exception of the mod "Athena" – do not disable this mod. In case you're not installing the modpack on a Modrinth hosted server, a complete list of mods to disable is found in the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file.
    Note: You'll see that some mods have updates ready, but do not update any mods or it will likely break compatibility between the various mods of FroggyCraft.
  6. There are three mods that need to be DELETED and replaced with patched versions – Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify. Make sure you delete these mods, don't just disable them, the original files need to be absent from the server before the patched files are uploaded.
  7. Click the "Upload files" button and upload the patched .jar files Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify found in the folder on your PC where you unzipped the PATCHED_MODS_FOR_SERVERS.zip file. The patched file names end in "FROGGYCRAFT_SERVER.jar" so as to avoid confusion with their unpatched versions.
    Note: Do not replace these mods with their patched version on your local client – FroggyCraft will run perfectly fine on your PC without any modifications and will be able to log into any server running the same version of FroggyCraft so long as the server's mods have been patched.
  8. You're all done setting up the server. Start the server and try logging into it from your PC. You might get an error when first logging in, but just try again, and it should work (this seems to be a sporadic issue related to Modrinth servers). For trouble shooting, join the Discord and ask for help in the troubleshooting chat.
Known Bugs
  • Items in the hotbar might be invisible upon first login; open your backpack once to resolve this.
  • Aquarium from Additional Fishing does not render vanilla fish/aquatics; they still exist and can be retrieved with a bucket but can’t be seen in the aquarium.
  • If you rename an ÜberFrog and place it in a bucket, it will lose its special ÜberFrog traits and become a normal frog. This only affects the ÜberFrog when placed in a bucket; otherwise, renaming an ÜberFrog will not remove its special traits.
  • The mods Bucket of Frog, Re:Deco, and Structurify have bugs that crash servers. To run FroggyCraft on a server, you'll need to use patched versions of these mods – links and instructions are found above in the "Guide for Installation on Modrinth Servers" section.
Future Plans Plans for FroggyCraft v1.2 or later:

  • Pick Your Poison (mod): adds tiny poison dart frogs to the world, and you can lick them and get cool effects! For legal purposes: do not lick poison dart frogs in game or IRL.
  • SpaceFrog's FrogCoin Currency (datapack): pay for villager trades with FrogCoin instead of lousy old emeralds. Your server economy can also run on FrogCoin - FrogCoin for everyone!
  • The modpack won't be updating to a version of Minecraft newer than 1.20.1 until the fabric version of Create Mod updates. Until then, I'll be adding mods that backport features of newer versions of Minecraft when possible.
  • If you have suggestions or features or changes to the next version of FroggyCraft, let me know by joining the FroggyCraft Discord (see the link at the top of the page).
Credits
  • Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
  • All resources that have titles beginning with "SpaceFrog" are written by me, SpaceFrog1984.
  • All other mods and resources are downloadable through Modrinth and have attributions listed on their Modrinth page.

title: StaffUtilsPlus
description: The only staff plugin you'll (hopefully) ever need!
body:
# StaffUtilsPlus

[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-blue.svg)](https://adoptopenjdk.net/) [![Spigot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spigot-1.21+-orange.svg)](https://www.spigotmc.org/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

> **A comprehensive, modern, and highly configurable staff utilities plugin for Minecraft servers.**

### Note that versions 1.1.0+ of StaffUtilsPlus will require [ProtocolLib](https://github.com/dmulloy2/ProtocolLib/releases) to function.

---

## Features

- **Ban, Mute, and IP Ban**: Temporarily or permanently ban/mute players, including IP bans.
- **Player Notes & Warnings**: Add, view, and manage notes and warnings for players.
- **Advanced Staff Menu**: GUI-based staff menu for quick access to moderation tools (coming soon).
- **Database & Local Storage**: Supports MySQL, SQLite, or local YAML storage.
- **WhoIs and CommandSpy:** Lets staff see other players' commands and other info about them.
- **Auto-Expiration**: Automatic expiration for temporary punishments.
- **Notifications**: Broadcast and permission-based notifications for staff actions.
- **Performance & Logging**: Async operations, caching, and detailed logging.
- **Highly Configurable**: Tweak punishments, commands, storage, and more via YAML config.

---

##  Installation

1. **Download** the latest release from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/hexett/StaffUtilsPlus/releases) or [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/staffutilsplus).
2. **Place** the `StaffUtilsPlus.jar` file into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. **Restart** or **reload** your server.
4. **Edit** the configuration files in `plugins/StaffUtilsPlus/` as needed.

---

## ️ Configuration

- **config.yml**: Main plugin configuration (database, punishments, commands, storage, logging, performance).
- **messages.yml**: Customize all plugin messages, including color codes and placeholders.
- **plugin.yml**: Bukkit/Spigot plugin metadata and command registration.

Example `config.yml` snippet:
```yaml
# Debug mode - enables additional logging
debug-mode: false

# Database Configuration
database:
  # Whether to use a database (false = local storage only)
  enabled: false
  
  # Database type: mysql, sqlite
  type: "mysql"
  
  # MySQL Configuration (ignored for SQLite)
  host: "localhost"
  port: 3306
  name: "staffutils"
  user: "root"
  pass: "password"


vanish-fake-messages: true # When a player goes into vanish, broadcasts a fake join/leave message.
```

---

## Usage

- **All commands** can be run from the console or in-game (unless noted).
- **Tab completion** and **aliases** are supported for all commands.
- **Permissions** are required for most commands (see below).

### Main Commands

| Command                                                | Description                                  | Aliases     | Permission              |
|--------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-------------|-------------------------|
| `/ban <player> [reason] [duration]`                    | Ban a player                                 | `/tempban`  | `staffutils.ban`        |
| `/unban <player>`                                      | Unban a player                               |             | `staffutils.unban`      |
| `/kick <player> [reason]`                              | Kick a Player                                |          | `staffutils.kick`       
| `/mute <player> [reason] [duration]`                   | Mute a player                                | `/tempmute` | `staffutils.mute`       |
| `/unmute <player>`                                     | Unmute a player                              |             | `staffutils.unmute`     |
| `/ipban <player> [reason] [duration]`                  | IP ban a player                              | `/tempipban` | `staffutils.ipban`      |
| `/commandSpy`                                          | Spys on a player's commands                  |   | `staffutils.commandspy` |
| `/whois`                                               | Shows info on a player                       |   | `staffutils.whois.*`    |
| `/unbanip <ip-address>`                                | Unban an IP address                          |             | `staffutils.unbanip`    |
| `/vanish`                                              | Makes the sender invisible to other players. |   | `staffutils.vanish`     |
| `/notes <player> [add/remove] [content/id]`            | Manage player notes                          |             | `staffutils.notes`      |
| `/warnings <player> [add/remove] [reason/severity/id]` | Manage player warnings                       | | `staffutils.warnings`   |
| `/help [page]`                                         | Show help information                        | `/h`, `/?`  | `staffutils.help`       |
| `/staffutilsplus`                                      | Plugin base command                          |  | `none`                   |
| `/blame`                                               | Shows punishments issued by a player.        |  | `staffutils.blame` |
| `/history`                                             | Shows a player's punishment history.         |  | `staffutils.history` |
| `/alts`                                                | Lists a player's known alts by IP            |  | `staffutils.alts` |

> **Note:** The advanced staff menu GUI is in development and will be enabled in a future update.

---

## Permissions

- `staffutils.*` — **All plugin permissions** (default: OP)
- `staffutils.ban` — Ban players
- `staffutils.unban` — Unban players
- `staffutils.mute` — Mute players
- `staffutils.unmute` — Unmute players
- `staffutils.ipban` — IP ban players
- `staffutils.unbanip` — Unban IP addresses
- `staffutils.vanish` — Allows players to enter vanish.
- `staffutils.notes` — Manage player notes
- `staffutils.warnings` — Manage player warnings
- `staffutils.menu` — Access staff menu (future)
- `staffutils.reload` — Reload plugin
- `staffutils.whois.*` — Shows player info
- `staffutils.debug` — Debug commands
- `staffutils.notify.*` — Receive notifications for bans, mutes, IP bans
- `staffutils.blame` — Enables access to /blame
- `staffutils.history` — Enables access to /history
- `staffutils.alts` — Enables access to /alts

---

## Dependencies

- [Spigot 1.21+](https://www.spigotmc.org/)
- [ProtocolLib](https://github.com/dmulloy2/ProtocolLib/releases)
- Java 21

---

## Credits

- **Author:** Hexett
- **Contributors:** See [GitHub Contributors](https://github.com/hexett/StaffUtilsPlus/graphs/contributors)
- **License:** MIT

---

## Support & Feedback

- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/hexett/StaffUtilsPlus/issues) for bug reports and suggestions
- [Modrinth Page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/staffutilsplus) for downloads and reviews

---

## License

This project is licensed under the MIT License. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

title: Skyblock: Ramadan Edition
description: A complete Ramadan-themed Skyblock modpack with a custom trader, coin economy, and a ready-to-play world.
body:
# Theyab Skyblock – Ramadan Modpack - English A complete Ramadan-themed Skyblock experience built around the [Theyab Skyblock: Ramadan](https://modrinth.com/mod/theyab-skyblock-ramadan) mod. This modpack is designed to deliver a structured, progression-based Skyblock world with enhanced visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and a fully integrated economy system. ### Pre-Built World Included:
Once installed, the modpack comes with a ready-to-play Skyblock world. - Custom Skyblock island - Pre-configured progression setup - A dedicated Skyblock Trader NPC already placed in the world
You can jump straight into the experience without any setup. ### Economy & Progression:
The modpack revolves around: - A custom Coin currency system - A central Trader NPC for progression - Structured advancement flow
This creates a guided yet open-ended survival experience. ### Enhanced Gameplay:
Alongside the core Ramadan mod, the modpack includes carefully selected supporting mods to improve: - Performance - Visual quality - Animations - Interface & information - Exploration tools
Everything is optimized to feel smooth, immersive, and ready for content creation or community play. Install, load the included world, and start your journey. --- # Theyab Skyblock – Ramadan Modpack - عربي تجربة سكاي بلوك رمضانية متكاملة مبنية حول مود [Theyab Skyblock: Ramadan](https://modrinth.com/mod/theyab-skyblock-ramadan). تم تصميم هذا المودباك ليقدم عالم سكاي بلوك منظم قائم على التقدم المرحلي، مع تحسينات بصرية وأداء عالية ونظام اقتصاد متكامل. ### عالم جاهز مرفق:
عند تحميل المودباك ستجد عالم سكاي بلوك جاهز للعب مباشرة: - جزيرة سكاي بلوك مخصصة - إعداد تقدم مُجهز مسبقًا - وجود قروي Skyblock Trader NPC في العالم
لا تحتاج لأي إعداد — فقط ادخل وابدأ اللعب. ### نظام اقتصاد وتقدم:

title: Mace Limit
description: Limits the Mace to a single server-wide instance with a custom crafting recipe and global announcements
body:
# ⚔ OneMace
### *There can only be one.*

OneMace enforces a hard server-wide limit of exactly **one Mace** in existence at any time. The vanilla smithing table recipe is replaced with a custom crafting recipe — and the moment someone forges it, **the entire server knows.**

---

## ✨ Features

- **Global lock** — Once the Mace is crafted, the recipe is blocked for every player. No second Mace. Ever.
- **Server-wide announcement** — A dramatic broadcast fires in chat the moment it's forged, naming the crafter for all to see.
- **Global sound effect** — The Ender Dragon death cry plays for every online player simultaneously.
- **Full-screen title** — Every player on the server receives a title announcement in their screen.
- **Custom name & lore** — The Mace is permanently marked with the crafter's name via NBT.
- **Auto-reset on destruction** — If the Mace is burned, voided, or lost, the lock resets automatically. The hunt begins again.
- **Dupe-proof** — Tracked by NBT tag. Creative mode copies and untagged items are completely ignored.
- **Persistent across restarts** — The lock survives server restarts and reloads.

---

## 🔨 Crafting Recipe

The vanilla Mace smithing table recipe is **disabled**. Use the crafting table instead:

| | | |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 🟨 Gold Block | ⬛ Netherite Ingot | 🟨 Gold Block |
| ⬛ Netherite Ingot | 🔷 Heavy Core | ⬛ Netherite Ingot |
| 🟨 Gold Block | ⬛ Netherite Ingot | 🟨 Gold Block |

- **4×** Gold Block *(36 gold ingots total)*
- **4×** Netherite Ingot
- **1×** Heavy Core *(Vault drop from Trial Chambers)*

---

## 📢 Broadcast Preview

When the Mace is crafted, every player sees this in chat:

```
---------------------------------------
⚔  THE ONE MACE HAS BEEN FORGED  ⚔
  Crafted by: Steve
  There can only be one. Choose your enemies wisely.
---------------------------------------
```

---

## 🛠 Admin Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/mace status` | `onemace.admin` | Shows whether the Mace exists and who crafted it |
| `/mace reset` | `onemace.admin` | Manually resets the lock — use if Mace was lost offline |
| `/mace locate` | `onemace.admin` | Scans online inventories to find the Mace |

---

## 📦 Installation

Drop the `.jar` into your `/plugins` folder and restart. No configuration required.

**Compatibility:** Paper 1.21.1 · Java 21+

title: LoginX
description: a secure, modern authentication plugin for Minecraft servers that require players to register and log in. It protects accounts with encrypted passwords, persistent sessions, client fingerprinting, and a two-phase Mojang premium verification system
body:
# LoginX — Player Authentication & Session Protection

**LoginX** is a secure, modern authentication plugin for Minecraft servers that require players to register and log in. It protects accounts with encrypted passwords, persistent sessions, client fingerprinting, and a two-phase Mojang premium verification system — all built with async database operations for minimal server impact.

---

## Why LoginX?

LoginX was designed with a clean, layered architecture separating auth, session, security, and premium logic. It goes beyond basic login/register by actively protecting against account takeovers, alt account flooding, brute-force attacks, and replay attacks — out of the box, with zero extra setup.

---

## Core Features

### 🔑 Authentication
- Password hashing with **Argon2** or **bcrypt** (configurable in `config.yml`)
- Configurable **minimum password length**
- **Login timeout** — players who don't authenticate within N seconds are kicked
- `/changepass` command for players to update their own password securely

### 🕐 Session Management
- **Persistent sessions** — authenticated players are remembered across reconnects
- **Rolling sessions** — activity extends the session timer automatically
- Sessions are **invalidated on IP change** to prevent session hijacking
- Sessions are **invalidated on fingerprint change** for extra protection
- Automatic **session cleanup task** runs in the background to purge expired sessions

### 🖐 Client Fingerprinting
- Tracks each player's **client brand** and **protocol version** on join
- Detects when a player's fingerprint changes and can block or flag it
- Configurable **max fingerprint changes per 7 days** to limit suspicious behaviour
- Stricter fingerprint enforcement available for premium-locked accounts

### ⭐ Premium Account Linking (`/premium`) **FIXING IT**
LoginX uses a **two-phase Mojang verification handshake** to let players permanently link their account to their real Mojang/Microsoft identity:

1. Player runs `/premium` → LoginX queries the Mojang Profiles API to confirm the username exists
2. Player is kicked and asked to **reconnect within 60 seconds using the official launcher**
3. On reconnect, LoginX verifies the session against **Mojang's session servers** using a unique token
4. If verified → account is permanently **premium-locked** to the real Mojang UUID
5. Premium-locked players are **auto-logged in** on future joins — no password prompt needed

This prevents name impersonation: anyone can claim a premium username, but only the real account owner can pass the session server check.

### 🛡️ Security
- **Brute-force protection** — account is temporarily locked after too many failed login attempts (configurable threshold and ban duration)
- **Alt account limiting** — max registered accounts per IP address
- **Anti-replay protection** — blocks reuse of intercepted authentication tokens
- **Console log filtering** — sensitive auth details are stripped from server logs

### 🗄️ Database
- Supports **SQLite** (zero-config, default) and **MySQL**
- Fully **async database operations** — no blocking the main thread
- Separate tables for player accounts, sessions, and fingerprint change history

---

## ✦ Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/register <password> <confirm>` | Create a new account | `loginx.player` |
| `/login <password>` | Log in to your account | `loginx.player` |
| `/logout` | End your current session | `loginx.player` |
| `/changepass <old> <new> <confirm>` | Change your password | `loginx.player` |
| `/premium` | Link account to Mojang via 2-phase verification | `loginx.premium` |
| `/loginx reload` | Reload config and messages | `loginx.admin` |
| `/loginx info` | View plugin status and stats | `loginx.admin` |
| `/loginx session <player>` | Inspect a player's session | `loginx.admin` |
| `/loginx forcepremium <player>` | Force-lock an account as premium | `loginx.admin` |

---

## ✦ Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loginx.player` | everyone | Basic auth commands |
| `loginx.premium` | everyone | Access to `/premium` |
| `loginx.admin` | op | All admin commands |
| `loginx.bypass` | false | Skip authentication entirely |

---

## ✦ Configuration Highlights

```yaml
auth:
  min-password-length: 8
  login-timeout-seconds: 30
  password-hash: ARGON2  # or BCRYPT

session:
  enabled: true
  timeout-minutes: 30
  rolling: true
  invalidate-on-ip-change: true
  invalidate-on-fingerprint-change: true

fingerprint:
  enabled: true
  max-changes-per-7d: 1

security:
  max-accounts-per-ip: 3
  brute-force:
    max-attempts: 5
    temp-ban-minutes: 10

database:
  type: sqlite  # or mysql
```

All messages are fully customizable via `messages.yml`.

---

## ✦ Developer API

LoginX exposes a public `LoginXAPI` class for third-party plugin integration. Check session state, listen to auth events, and more. Full documentation is available on the [GitHub repository]([https://github.com/abdoabk/LoginX](https://github.com/AbdelrahmanM1/LoginX)).

---

## ✦ Compatibility

| Platform | Status |
|---|---|
| Paper 1.20+ | ✅ Fully supported |
| Spigot | ✅ Supported |
| Bukkit | ⚠️ May work, not tested |

**Java 17+ required · Minecraft 1.20+**

---

## ✦ Support & Links

- 💻 **Source code** → [GitHub](https://github.com/AbdelrahmanM1/LoginX)

> Please do **not** use Modrinth comments for bug reports.

**NOTE** There is problems with ```/premium``` **I am working on it**

title: Cinema Scope
description: CinemaScope is a simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `1.21.11` that draws cinematic black bars (letterbox) in-game.
body:
# CinemaScope

CinemaScope is a simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft `1.21.11` that draws cinematic black bars (letterbox) in-game.

## Features

- Draws black bars while in-world (including GUI screens like inventory/chat, behind UI)
- Toggle visibility with a keybind (default: `K`)
- ModMenu config screen support
- Persistent config via JSON

## Environment

- Minecraft: `1.21.11` (Java Edition)
- Fabric Loader: `0.18.4`
- Java: `21`

## Build

```bash
gradle clean build
```

Output jar is generated under `build/libs/`.

## Config (ModMenu)

Open `ModMenu -> Cinema Scope -> Configure` and edit:

- `Enabled`
- `Toggle Key`
- `Target Aspect Ratio` (`1.60` to `3.00`)
- `Bar Opacity` (`0` to `100`)
- `Show While HUD Hidden (F1)`

Buttons:

- `Cancel` (left)
- `Reset` (center, restore defaults on the screen)
- `Done` (right, save and close)

## Default Values

- Enabled: `true`
- Toggle Key: `K`
- Target Aspect Ratio: `2.39`
- Bar Opacity: `100`
- Show While HUD Hidden (F1): `true`

Internal runtime toggle state is persisted and restored across restarts.

## Config File

Saved at:

- `config/cinema_scope.json`

If the file is corrupted on load, it is backed up as:

- `config/cinema_scope.json.bak`

title: Dog Modes
description: Enhances tamed wolf utility with switchable behavior modes (Patrol, Peaceful), passive health regeneration, and automated scavenging mechanics to improve combat viability.
body:
DogModes enhances the utility and survivability of tamed wolves in Minecraft. It introduces a mode-switching mechanic, allowing players to toggle between distinct behaviors for their companions, alongside passive regeneration and scavenging mechanics. This plugin transforms wolves from fragile pets into viable combat allies and base guardians.

## Overview

Vanilla wolves often lack the necessary AI to survive complex encounters or effectively guard an area. DogModes addresses this by implementing a lightweight state machine for every tamed wolf. Players can cycle through behavioral modes on the fly without complex commands, simply by interacting with their pet.

All data is stored persistently on the entity, ensuring modes remain active even after server restarts.

## Behavioral Modes

To change a wolf's mode, the owner must **Sneak + Right-Click** on the tamed wolf. The current mode will be displayed in the Action Bar.

### Classic Mode
The default vanilla behavior. The wolf follows the owner and attacks whatever the owner attacks or is attacked by.

### Patrol Mode
Designed for base defense and area denial.
*   The wolf automatically aggressively targets monsters within a configurable radius (default: 16 blocks).
*   It will prioritize threats independently of the player.
*   In this mode, the wolf will ignore players to prevent accidental PvP incidents.

### Peaceful Mode
Designed for exploration and travel.
*   The wolf will follow the owner but will strictly refuse to initiate combat.
*   It will not attack entities the owner strikes.
*   The wolf will only fight back if it is directly damaged itself (self-defense).
*   This prevents wolves from engaging in suicidal attacks against Creepers or large groups of mobs during travel.

## Survivability Mechanics

To ensure wolves remain viable in the late game, DogModes introduces two passive mechanics.

### Passive Regeneration
Tamed wolves will passively regenerate health over time, similar to players.
*   **Configurable:** The amount of health and the time interval are fully adjustable in the configuration.
*   **Default:** 2.0 health (1 heart) every 3 seconds.

### Scavenging (Rotten Flesh)
Wolves will intuitively consume Rotten Flesh dropped on the ground nearby.
*   If a wolf is injured and detects a Rotten Flesh item drop within a configured radius, it will consume the item to restore health.
*   This mechanic allows for automated healing of patrol dogs using mob farm drops or simply cleaning up after a battle.

## Configuration & Localization

 The plugin is designed to be highly configurable to suit different server balance needs.

*   **Modes:** Each mode can be individually enabled or disabled.
*   **Values:** Adjust patrol radii, regeneration rates, and healing amounts.
*   **Localization:** The plugin utilizes the Adventure API and MiniMessage for formatting. All messages are translatable.
*   **Language Files:** English (`en`) and Russian (`ru`) locales are generated by default.

**config.yml snippet:**
```yaml
modes:
  patrol:
    enabled: true
    radius: 16.0
  peaceful:
    enabled: true

regeneration:
  enabled: true
  amount: 2.0
  interval-seconds: 3

rotten-flesh:
  enabled: true
  heal-amount: 6.0
```
![DogModes](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/DogModes.svg)

title: Discord Chat Integration
description: Brings your Minecraft chat into Discord. Send/receive messages/commands to Minecraft from Discord without bots.
body:
Discord Chat Integration

Brings your Minecraft chat into Discord with additional automation features. Send messages/commands and listens to Minecraft from Discord without bots.

## What It Does This mod bridges Discord and Minecraft through a local WebSocket connection, allowing you to send messages and execute commands in Minecraft directly from Discord without any bots. It also includes other advanced features like chat delay and automations. - **Botless Discord Integration** - No Discord bot setup required; uses Vencord or BetterDiscord plugins - **Bidirectional Chat** - Send messages/commands from Discord to Minecraft and receive chat feedback in Discord - **[Multi-Client Support](#multi-client-setup)** - Control multiple Minecraft clients from a single Discord interface - **[Sync Groups](#sync-groups)** - Achieve tick-perfect synchronization across multiple Minecraft clients - **[Chat Delay](#chat-delay)** - Queue and batch-send messages - **[Automations](#automations)** - Create trigger-based rules that execute actions when Minecraft chat events occur ### Installing the Discord Plugin > [IMPORTANT] > Both the Discord plugin and the mod are required to be installed. - [BetterDiscord Plugin Installation](https://github.com/aurickk/Discord-Chat-Integration/blob/main/betterdiscord-plugin/README.md) - [Vencord Plugin Installation](https://github.com/aurickk/Discord-Chat-Integration/blob/main/vencord-plugin/README.md) ## Usage ### Quick Start Guide 1. Start Minecraft with the mod installed 2. Join a world or server 3. Open Discord with the Discord plugin enabled 4. The plugin will automatically connect (if "Auto Connect" is enabled and the port number matches) 5. Send messages/commands in the configured Discord channel, they'll appear/execute in Minecraft chat 6. Recieve messages or command feedback in Discord (If "Forward to Discord" is enabled) ## Setup and Configurations ### Quick Settings Access A **gear icon** appears next to the chat input box when the plugin is enabled. Click it to quickly access the Minecraft Chat settings without navigating through Discord's settings menu. The icon turns **green** when at least one client is connected. --- ### Adding Minecraft Clients 1. Click **"Add Client"** in quick access menu 2. Configure each client: - **Name**: A friendly name for this client - **Port**: WebSocket port - **Channel ID**: The Discord channel ID to bridge with this client - **Enabled**: Toggle to enable/disable this client connection - **Forward to Discord**: Toggle to enable/disable forwarding Minecraft chat to Discord - **Sync Group**: Assign client to a sync group for tick-perfect synchronization 3. **Getting a Channel ID**: - Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode) - Right-click on the channel you want to use - Click "Copy Channel ID" - Paste into the plugin settings --- ### Multi-Client Setup > [IMPORTANT] > Different Minecraft clients cannot share the same port, you can change the port with a [command](#minecraft-mod-configuration). You can run multiple Minecraft clients, each connected to different or shared Discord channels: **Different Channels:** 1. **Client 1**: Port `25580` → Discord Channel `123456789` 2. **Client 2**: Port `25581` → Discord Channel `987654321` 3. **Client 3**: Port `25582` → Discord Channel `555555555` **Shared Channel:** Multiple clients can be assigned to the same Discord channel. When this happens: - Messages from Discord are sent to **all** Minecraft clients assigned to that channel - Messages forwarded to Discord include a `[Client Name]` tag to identify the source - If multiple clients are on the same sync group, the message/command will be sent on the same server tick --- Addional configuration can be found in **User Settings → Vencord/BetterDiscord → Plugins → MinecraftChat** | Setting | Description | Default | |---------|-------------|---------| | **Auto Connect** | Automatically connect to all enabled clients when Discord starts | `true` | | **Advanced Features** | Enable advanced features (Chat Delay, Sync Groups, Automations) | `false` | | **Connection Logging Channel** | Discord channel ID where connection/disconnection events are posted (Leave blank to disable) | Empty | | **Enable Console Logging** | Log plugin debug messages to browser console (DevTools F12) | `true` | --- ### Minecraft Mod Configuration The mod uses a default port of `25580`. You can change this using the in-game command: ``` /discordchat port ``` The port must be between 1024 and 65535 and match the configured client settings in Discord. ## Advanced Features Enable advanced features in the plugin settings to unlock powerful automation and synchronization capabilities. Access these features via the chat bar gear icon. ### Chat Delay Queue messages from Discord and send them at once to Minecraft at the same game tick. **How to use:** 1. Enable "Advanced Features" in plugin settings 2. Click the chat bar gear icon to open settings 3. Toggle "Chat Delay" on to start queuing messages 4. Click "Send Queue" to release all queued messages at once --- ### Sync Groups Assign multiple Minecraft clients to sync groups (A-F) for tick-perfect message execution. When clients in the same sync group receive messages, they execute them on the exact same server game tick when assigned to the same Discord channel or with [Chat Delay](#chat-delay). **How to configure:** 1. Enable "Advanced Features" in plugin settings 2. In client configuration, set each client's "Sync Group" (A-F or None) 3. "None" disables synchronization for that client --- ### Automations Create trigger-based automation rules that execute actions when specific messages appear in Minecraft chat. **How to configure:** 1. Enable "Advanced Features" in plugin settings 2. Click the chat bar gear icon → "Automations" section 3. Click "+ Add Automation" to create a new rule 4. Configure: - **Name**: Identify your automation - **Enabled**: Toggle to activate/deactivate - **Listen to**: Select which Minecraft clients trigger this automation - **Trigger**: Text to match in Minecraft chat - **Absolute Match**: If checked, message must exactly match trigger (case-sensitive) - **Cooldown**: Minimum milliseconds between triggers - **Actions**: What to do when triggered **Available Actions:** - **Send to Minecraft**: Send message/command to selected clients - **Send to Discord**: Post message to configured logging channel - **Enable Chat Delay**: Turn on message queuing - **Disable Chat Delay**: Turn off queuing and send all queued messages - **Wait**: Delay in milliseconds before next action --- ### Commands The mod provides a `/discordchat` command with the following subcommands: #### `/discordchat` or `/discordchat status` Shows the current connection status: - Server status (Running/Stopped) - Current port - Number of connected clients #### `/discordchat port ` Changes the WebSocket server port. Must be between 1024 and 65535. #### `/discordchat reconnect` Restarts the WebSocket server. #### `/discordchat disconnect` Stops the WebSocket server and disconnects all Discord clients. Use `/discordchat reconnect` to reconnect. #### `/discordchat ticktest` Displays tick synchronization diagnostic information. Useful for debugging sync groups and verifying tick-perfect execution. Shows: - Player name - Current server tick - Client time (milliseconds) - Network ping - Current sync group assignment - Last sync execution details (target tick, execution tick, timing) This command is particularly useful when using [Sync Groups](#sync-groups) to verify that messages from multiple clients are executing at the correct game ticks.

description: 🔌 Push your server analytics to MineAds
body:
# MineAds Monitor Plugin

We at MineAds provide this plugin to help Minecraft server owners integrate their servers with our analytics platform. It automatically tracks server activity like player joins, leaves, chat, and commands, then sends this data to us for analysis.

## What We Use It For

As a server analytics platform, we collect data from servers that sign up their networks with us. We use this information to provide detailed analytics to server owners, helping them understand player behavior, optimize their servers, and improve their community's experience. This data also helps us enhance our platform's insights.

## Setup Instructions

1. Download the plugin JAR file that matches your server type (Bukkit/Spigot/Paper, BungeeCord, or Velocity).
2. Place the JAR in your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server to generate the config file.
4. Open the `config.yml` file in your plugins/MineAdsMonitor folder.
5. Add your unique plugin key from the MineAds dashboard (it starts with "pluginkey_").
6. Set a server ID like "survival-main" to identify this server.
7. Save the file and restart the server again.

## Configuration Options

The plugin uses a simple YAML format for its settings. Here's what each option does:

- **pluginKey**: Your special key from MineAds that links your server to their system. You get this from their website.
- **serverId**: A name for your server, like "creative-hub" or "pvp-arena", using only letters, numbers, and dashes.
- **enabledEvents**: Choose which types of player activities to track. By default, it tracks everything: purchases, chat, commands, joins, and leaves.
- **disableChatContent**: Turn this on if you don't want the actual words players type in chat to be sent (only that they chatted).
- **defaultMaxCommandArgs**: How many parts of a command to record. For example, "/warp home" would save 1 part (just "warp") by default.
- **commandArgLimits**: Set different limits for specific commands, like allowing more details for "/warp" commands.
- **debug**: Turn this on to see extra messages in the server console for troubleshooting.

## Commands

The plugin includes commands for server admins (you need the "mineadsmonitor.admin" permission):

- **/mineadsmonitor help**: Shows all available commands.
- **/mineadsmonitor version**: Tells you what version of the plugin you're running.
- **/mineadsmonitor reload**: Reloads the config file without restarting the server.
- **/mineadsmonitor initial/expiry/renewal/chargeback/refund** [details]: Manually record purchase-related events (like when someone buys or loses a rank).

## Performance and Lag Prevention

To keep your server running smoothly, the plugin is designed to be very lightweight:

- It collects data in the background without slowing down gameplay.
- Instead of sending data immediately, it groups events together and sends them in batches every 10 seconds.
- All network requests happen on separate threads, so they never interrupt your server's main operations.
- Data is compressed before sending to use less bandwidth.
- If there are connection problems, it automatically retries with smart delays to avoid overwhelming your server.

title: SLA - Fuel Pellets
description: A little mod that adds Pellet versions of fuel types, to allow you to smelt singular items without wasting fuel.
body:
Have you ever encountered a situation, where you only want to smelt 7 items, but have only Coal as a fuel source? Have you ever felt the dread of *wasting* an eight of a piece of Coal or Charcoal, or maybe even 7 eights? 

Well fear no more! Introducing: 
# Fuel Pellets!
This mod adds 3 new items, 7 new recipes and modifies 1 vanilla items functionality. 
More specifically, it adds the Coal, Charcoal and Blaze Pellet items, that each smelt exactly 1 item. The recipes are as follows: 

![An image showing how to make the different items from the mod. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00e3777bde80ac9635e9d9ce6f1ae49447ff4b11.png)
As you can tell the mod also adds a recipe for turning Blaze Powder back into Blaze Rods - just for completeness sake. All recipes are shapeless. 
I also modified the Blaze Powder to be usable as a fuel source, smelting 6 items. This is the same per-rod efficiency as using Blaze Rods for smelting, since they smelt 12 items each. Also, this of course means you get 6 Blaze Pellets per Blaze Powder. 

## Why does this mod exist? 
This mod is the first part in my Silly Little Additions (SLA) mod series, where I try to create very simple mods that focus around specific concepts in Minecraft Modding, gradually increasing in difficulty and complexity. This is because it's been a while since I last touched Minecraft Modding and I wanna ease into it, while preventing myself from burning out by finishing projects faster than I've done in the past - my other mod on Modrinth, Very Berry, currently has 2 berries actually implemented, while 3 more are WIP in the repo, and 2 more sitting unfinished in unpushed commits. The scope on that project kept getting bigger, so I'm putting it on hold for now, so I can get back to basics and maybe return to Very Berry with a new mindset later on.

description: An Plugin which let player's fly within there claimlands, and much more customizatons etc.
body:
# 🚁 EasyCFly - Advanced Claim-Based Flying Plugin

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.1-blue.svg)](https://github.com/turjo/EasyCFly)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-1.20.4-green.svg)](https://www.spigotmc.org/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-ARR-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/java-17+-orange.svg)](https://www.oracle.com/java/)

> **The most advanced and feature-rich claim-based flying plugin for Minecraft servers**

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Core Features
- **Smart Claim Detection** - Automatically detects claims from multiple plugins
- **Trust System** - Allow specific players to fly in your claims
- **Flight Time Limits** - Configurable flight duration with warnings
- **Cooldown System** - Prevent flight spam with customizable cooldowns
- **Economy Integration** - Charge players for flight with Vault support
- **Multi-World Support** - Per-world flight settings and restrictions

### 🎨 Visual Effects
- **Particle Trails** - Beautiful particle effects while flying
- **Action Bar Messages** - Real-time flight information
- **Boss Bar Timer** - Visual flight time countdown
- **Sound Effects** - Immersive audio feedback
- **Custom GUI** - Intuitive flight management interface

### 🔧 Advanced Features
- **Flight Zones** - Define specific areas for flight
- **Anti-Cheat Integration** - Compatible with major anti-cheat plugins
- **Statistics Tracking** - Track flight time and distance
- **PlaceholderAPI Support** - Rich placeholder integration
- **Discord Integration** - Log flight events to Discord
- **Database Support** - SQLite and MySQL support
- **Performance Optimized** - Async operations and caching

### 🛡️ Claim Plugin Support
- **WorldGuard** - Full region support
- **GriefPrevention** - Complete claim integration
- **Lands** - Advanced land management
- **Towny** - Town and nation support
- **Residence** - Residence area support
- **Auto-Detection** - Automatically finds and integrates

## 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft Version**: 1.20.4+
- **Java Version**: 17+
- **Server Software**: Spigot, Paper, or forks
- **Dependencies**: At least one supported claim plugin
- **Optional**: Vault (for economy), PlaceholderAPI (for placeholders)

## 🚀 Installation

1. **Download** the latest release from [Releases](https://github.com/turjo/EasyCFly/releases)
2. **Place** the JAR file in your server's `plugins` folder
3. **Install** a supported claim plugin (WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, etc.)
4. **Start** your server
5. **Configure** the plugin in `plugins/EasyCFly/config.yml`
6. **Reload** with `/cflyreload`

## 🎮 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/cfly` | Toggle flight on/off | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cfly on` | Enable flight | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cfly off` | Disable flight | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cfly status` | View flight information | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cfly time` | Check remaining flight time | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cflytrust <player>` | Trust a player to fly | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cflyuntrust <player>` | Untrust a player | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cflyinfo` | Detailed flight information | `easycfly.fly` |
| `/cflyreload` | Reload configuration | `easycfly.admin.reload` |

## 🔑 Permissions

### Basic Permissions
- `easycfly.fly` - Basic flying permission
- `easycfly.fly.unlimited` - Unlimited flight time

### Admin Permissions
- `easycfly.admin.*` - All admin permissions
- `easycfly.admin.reload` - Reload configuration
- `easycfly.admin.toggle` - Toggle flight for others

### Bypass Permissions
- `easycfly.bypass.cooldown` - Bypass flight cooldown
- `easycfly.bypass.cost` - Bypass flight cost
- `easycfly.bypass.time` - Bypass time limits

## 📊 PlaceholderAPI Placeholders

| Placeholder | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `%easycfly_flying%` | Flight status (true/false) |
| `%easycfly_can_fly%` | Can fly at current location |
| `%easycfly_time_remaining%` | Remaining flight time |
| `%easycfly_cooldown%` | Remaining cooldown time |
| `%easycfly_trusted_count%` | Number of trusted players |
| `%easycfly_flight_cost%` | Cost to enable flight |

title: VelocityWelcomeX
description: A plugin that welcomes players on your proxy
body:
**VelocityWelcome
Overview**

VelocityWelcome is a comprehensive Minecraft server welcome system that works across both Velocity proxy and Bukkit/Spigot servers. It provides customizable, colorful welcome messages while eliminating the default vanilla join and quit messages for a cleaner, more professional server experience.

**Features**


Custom Welcome Messages: Display personalized, randomized welcome messages when players join your network

Player Join Counter: Show players their unique join number (e.g., "#42") to create a sense of community and history

No Vanilla Messages: Automatically suppresses the default Minecraft join/quit messages

Network-Wide Support: Works seamlessly between Velocity proxy and all connected Bukkit/Spigot servers

Fully Customizable: Change colors, message formats, and welcome text through a simple configuration

Persistent Player Data: Maintains player join rankings across server restarts

**Why Choose VelocityWelcome?**

Clean Server Experience

VelocityWelcome completely eliminates the standard Minecraft join and quit notifications that can clutter your chat, especially on busy servers. Only your custom welcome messages will be displayed, giving your server a professional and polished feel.

Enhanced First Impressions

First impressions matter. When new players join your server, they'll be greeted with a colorful, personalized welcome message that stands out from the standard Minecraft experience. This small touch can significantly improve how players perceive your server's quality.

Community Building

The unique join counter feature shows players their position in your server's history (e.g., "Welcome PlayerName! (#137)"). This creates a sense of belonging and community, making players feel like they're part of something established and significant.

Network Efficiency

VelocityWelcome is designed specifically for proxy-based server networks. It efficiently communicates between your Velocity proxy and backend servers to ensure consistent behavior and prevent duplicate welcome messages when players move between servers in your network.

Technical Excellence

VelocityWelcome is built with performance in mind:

Lightweight with minimal resource usage

Uses efficient plugin messaging channels

Thread-safe concurrent collections for player tracking

Early-priority event handling to prevent conflicts with other plugins


**Setup and Installation**

**Prerequisites**

Velocity proxy server (latest version recommended)

Bukkit/Spigot/Paper servers (latest version recommended)

Installation Steps


**Download the Plugin Files**


VelocityWelcome.jar (for Velocity proxy)

VelocityWelcomeBukkit.jar (for each Bukkit/Spigot server)

Both from here.


**Install on Velocity**


Place VelocityWelcome.jar in your Velocity plugins folder

Restart your proxy server

A default configuration will be generated



**Install on Backend Servers**


Place VelocityWelcomeBukkit.jar in the plugins folder of each backend server

Restart each server

No additional configuration needed on backend servers

**
Configuration (Optional)**


Edit the config.json file in the VelocityWelcome folder

Customize welcome messages, colors, and other options

title: A Few Effects
description: Brew 4 new potion effects that can help you out
body:
![logo for the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c963897377a8478af76281947dc5b208f3012e6.png)
A Few Effects is a mod that adds 4 new potion effects to the game (3 positive, 1 negative): Largestep, Antigravity, Vulnerability, and Reaching. These can all be brewed in game, using specific items. The mod also adds brewable resistance potions, and a new mob found in the soul sand valley.

###  **Potions and Effects**
Starting with largestep, its potions can be brewed using a saddle, and when a player drinks the potion, they gain the largestep effect, letting them walk up 1-block high walls like a horse would or like they would walk up slabs or stairs. This is useful for quick transport, or if you are tired of jumping.

Antigravity potions can be brewed using shulker shells, and when a player drinks its potion, their gravity is reduced by 15% per level of antigravity. Potions can go up to antigravity III, letting players jump at 55% of normal gravity and being able to jump up two blocks. Antigravity is different than jump boost, as it affects gravity in general instead of increasing jump height. The two can be stacked, too, letting players jump up four blocks with ease.

Vulnerability is the mod's only negative potion effect. It is practically the opposite of resistance, reducing the player's armor by 20% per level. Vulnerability potions can be brewed by corrupting resistance potions (brewed using golden apples), and can go up to vulnerability II. Vulnerability can also be inflicted by the a new mob, the decay, which will be talked about more later.

Reaching is the last effect added, and can be brewed using scaffolding (I genuinely did not know what to use, so I just used scaffolding since I think it fits the best). Reaching increases the player's block and entity reach by one block per level, and potions can go up to reaching II, letting players place block from 5 blocks in the air or hit enemies from very far away.

(Effect icons in game are completely opaque, instead of having some transparent parts.)

![The icon for largestep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87086bfd4009e4c188718763ee6225df35d8d522.png) ![The icon for antigravity.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c95d42b77c4985239e3f8be294efaa3d4358efc.png) ![The icon for vulnerability.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29b725335e14eb95006422ad5f52284e34e5e9d3.png) ![The icon for reaching.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c3d8c643f160885c3b0aa43bbb4794afef3c16c.png)

### **The Decay**
The decay is a new mob found in the soul sand valley. It is another zombie variant, similar to that of the drowned or husk. They are slightly stronger than zombies (12 hp instead of 10, 4 dmg per hit instead of 3.5), and, like mentioned before, will inflict Vulnerability when players are hit, reducing the power of their armor. When killed, it drops experience and soul sand, and are overall a good addition to the nether (in my humble opinion!).

Overall, A Few Effects is designed to add new potions effects and expand on the concept of hostile mobs that inflict effects. I tried to keep the mod vanilla+, and I feel like it is a good addition to modded minecraft if you want to keep a fairly vanilla feel to the game.

Made with MCreator (waow!)

title: Ancient
description: Ancient lets you embark on a new adventure adding biomes, structures, mobs and more!
body:
The named "Ancient Scouter" can be a unique creature that adds a playful twist to exploration. When defeated, it drops Palacine Wood and an interesting lore piece about its origins or a mystical eye, adding depth to the gameplay. The ability to shear the Scouter to collect Palacine Leaves introduces an element of resource gathering, while its quirky behavior of chasing players adds a fun challenge. This combination expands both the narrative and mechanics of your mod, enhancing the overall player experience!


The addition of a blue mush mushroom biome with glowshroom entities adds a unique twist to gameplay, enhancing the exploration experience. The glowshrune's wandering behavior and the glowing mushrooms it drops can create intriguing mechanics or aesthetic opportunities for players. Furthermore, the incorporation of giant mushmushroom trees adds a striking visual element to the biome, enriching the overall atmosphere and providing new building materials.


Shintra is an intriguing concept for a late-game material that balances power with accessibility—its unique look and speed enhancement on boots introduce exciting gameplay dynamics. By having players craft it from Serene Diamonds and requiring upgrades to improve their Netherite tools and armor, Shintra offers a fresh twist that can encourage exploration and resource gathering while ensuring it's not overwhelmingly powerful compared to existing materials. This design could create a rewarding progression system and enhance the overall gameplay experience.

description: Run Python on Spigot/PaperMC Servers
body:
![Logo](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/blob/main/logo.png?raw=true)
![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/v-0.6-blue.svg) [![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) ![Spigot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spigot-1.20-orange.svg) ![Paper](https://img.shields.io/badge/PaperMC-1.20-34eba4.svg)
## Overview
The **Spython** plugin allows you to run Python scripts on Spigot and PaperMC Servers
### Development Note:
Please be aware that Spython is actively being developed to enhance its features and address any existing imperfections. While the plugin is functional, it may not be considered flawless. We appreciate your understanding and welcome feedback as we work to make Spython even better.​
## Usage
### Commands
- **/executepython scriptpath**: Executes a Python script on the server.
  - Permission: **spython.executepython**
  - The Tab Completer will list all python scripts that are not in a "libs" folder
### Installation
1. Standalone Usage
- Download the latest version of the Spython.jar file from the releases page.
- Place it in the plugins folder of your Spigot server.
- Start or restart your Spigot server.
2. [Using Spython as a Dependency](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/wiki/Using-Spython-as-a-Dependency)
3. [Adding additional libaries](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/wiki/Integrated-Libaries)
4. [Using the Data Bridge](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/wiki/Data-Bridge-(WIP))

### Running Python Scripts in standalone usage
1. Place your Python scripts in the server's directory where the Spigot plugins are located.
2. In-game, execute the **/executepython** command to run a Python script.

## Notes

This plugin is currently not very performant. We'll do our best to fix this.

## Support and Issues:

For support or reporting issues, please visit the [Spython GitHub repository](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/) and open a new [issue.](https://github.com/CptGummiball/Spython/issues)

title: TDaily
description: A simple, light weight daily plugin to give your players rewards everyday!
body:
# TDaily - Claim Your Daily Rewards! Welcome to TDaily, a lightweight and user-friendly Paper plugin that brings daily rewards to your server. Keep your players engaged and excited by offering them incentives to return every 24 hours. TDaily makes it easy to configure and customize rewards, messages, and permissions, making your server more engaging than ever. ## Installation Getting started with TDaily is a breeze! Just follow these simple steps: 1. **Download**: Grab the latest version of TDaily from our [downloads page](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tdaily/versions). 2. **Installation**: Place the downloaded TDaily file into your server's "plugins" folder. 3. **Restart**: Restart your server to activate the plugin. No dependencies required! ## Configuration TDaily puts you in control with its user-friendly configuration options. Tailor the plugin to your server's needs by customizing rewards, associated commands, and permissions. You can even adjust the messages players receive. Here's a glimpse of what you can configure:
Default Configuration (YML) ```yaml # The commands to run when a player executes /daily # Placeholders: commands: - name: tell1 permission: true # Optional. Default: false commands: - "tell Hello " - "tell You can run this command once a day if you have tdaily.claim.tell1" - name: tell2 permission: false # Optional. Default: false commands: - "tell Hello " - "tell You can run this command once a day without any permissions" messages: claimed: "You have claimed your keys for today! Check back in 24 hours to claim them again." cooldown: "You cannot execute this command until hours minutes seconds have passed since the last execution." # Placeholders, , , no-rewards: "There are no rewards for you to claim today." ```
