body:
![The Title of the modpack along with a few renders of items it adds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78f9e5acc8a9a5e1e53e105e65ad71e8ef5be625.png)

# Permits and Diplomas
Have you ever wanted to manage who gets to produce and sell which items on your server?
Then look no further!

Permits and Diplomas (Diplomas are still WIP) provides an easy way to do just that.
It offers a simple List where players can look at who is allowed to do what and who is already done with their stuff.

Draw a random Permit from an unopened letter, claim it and get to work.
And if you decide that you dont want it anymore, just unclaim it with [Shift] + [RMB].

## Content
**All Items can only be obtained via the creative Menu!**
- Permits -> The main content of this Mod. You can open Permit Envelopes of different Tiers to draw from a Pool of Titles from the config. The associated items with this Title can also be changed there.
- Permit Editor Item -> A simple creative Tool which lets you edit the Title and Content of a Permit in your offhand. Does **not** change the contents of the config
- Data Delete Item -> This item lets you reset all the permit data in this save (not the other ones) in case anything goes wrong.

- The survival Inventory has gotten a new Permit-Button. This window lets you see all the Permits, who they belong to and which ones are finished. You can also look at which items belong to which permit.

**This mod does not keep track of item-counts! It is based on trust alone**

## Future Plans
- Diplomas -> Simple Items which display a custom text to a person
- Contracts -> A more complex Item which lets players write a Contract that both parties can sign. Once signed it will be sealed and cannot be changed. Like a book and quill, but with two signatures.

## FAQ
- Where do I install this mod? - This mod needs to be on both Client- and Server Side!
- Does it work with other mods? - Yes! The config is just based on text and accepts every kind of item. If it cannot find your item it will simply skip it. Just make sure you get the correct Item-ID

title: elYEETra
description: Min/Max Your Rocket Stack! A Minecraft mod that both enhances and nerfs Elytra rocket boosting by allowing multiple rockets to be used at once but also makes single rockets barely enough to get you off the ground.
body:
# Elyeetra

Min/Max Your Rocket Stack! A Minecraft mod that both enhances and nerfs Elytra rocket boosting by allowing multiple rockets to be used at once but also makes single rockets barely enough to get you off the ground.

## Features

- **Multi-Rocket Boost**: Hold shift and right-click to use entire stack of rockets at once for massive speed boost
- **Detailed HUD**: Shows important flight metrics including:
  - Current and max speed
  - Maximum acceleration
  - G-forces
  - Current coordinates
  - Distance traveled
  - Flight direction
- **Physics-Based Boost**: Uses enhanced physics for better flight mechanics

## Usage

1. Equip an Elytra and get some firework rockets
2. Take off and start gliding
3. For normal boost: Right-click with rockets (single rocket provides gentle lift)
4. For super boost: Hold shift + right-click to use entire stack at once!

## Rocket Stack Mechanics

The mod uses an exponential boost system:
- **1-7 rockets**: Provides modest speed boosts, 2-3 m/s
- **8+ rockets**: Physics manipulation kicks in, dramatically increasing your speed
- **32 rockets**: Achieve speeds over 150 m/s!
- **64 rockets**: Prepare for extreme velocities exceeding 200 m/s!

Pro tip: Start with smaller stacks (8-16 rockets) to get a feel for the boost mechanics before attempting full stack launches.

## Flight HUD

The included HUD provides real-time flight metrics with a semi-transparent background for better visibility. Track your:
- Current and maximum speeds
- Maximum acceleration achieved
- G-forces experienced during flight
- Exact coordinates
- Total distance traveled from launch point
- Cardinal direction

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader >=0.15.0
- Fabric API
- Java 21 or higher

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API
2. Download the mod from Modrinth
3. Place the .jar file in your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## Safety Notes

- At high speeds, make sure your render distance is high enough to let chunks load
- Watch your altitude when testing large rocket stacks
- Keep an eye on the Distance Traveled metric to avoid getting lost

title: Block of Raw Ore - Smelting
description: Allows you to smelt all three Raw Ore Block variants exclusively in the Blast Furnace, with the same smelting time & xp yield as nine Raw Ore would have.
body:
Allows you to smelt all three Raw Ore Block variants exclusively in the Blast Furnace.
- Smelting one Raw Ore Block takes 45s, which is equal to the time it takes to smelt 9 Raw Ore (assuming you also smelt it in a Blast Furnace).
- as a result of this, the fuel cost also stays the same.
- Smelting one Raw Ore Block yields 6.3 xp-Points, 9x the 0.7 you get from smelting one Raw Ore (more on how experience from Smelting is calculated [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Smelting#Recipes)).
- Recipes for the respective processed Block are granted when the Raw Ore Block Variant is obtained.

title: Simple Positions
description: Using chat commands you can save and retrieve coordinates in your world.
body:
# Simple Positions
## Saving and Loading Positions [Client or Server]

This mod lets you save the coordinates of your current position and retrieve them later on via commands. You can give your positions names and even add them to a custom list!

If you want to get a previously saved position, simply search for its _name_, _list_ and _dimension_ and retrieve its coordinates in your chat.

All positions are saved to a JSON file, so you have total control over your data.

For usage instructions please consult the [wiki](https://github.com/marcbeat/simple-positions/wiki).

**TLDR:**

Saving position:
```
/pos set <dimension>.<list>.<name>
```
Retrieving position:
```
/pos get <dimension>.<list>.<name>
```

title: BasicQuests
description: A plugin for Spigot servers that implements randomly generated basic quests with rewards for players.
body:
# BasicQuests
Randomly generated basic quests with rewards for players.
No initial configuration needed!

I would be very happy about any feedback, recommendations and new ideas. Reviews are very much appreciated!


## How it works
Every player receives an initial number of quests (default: 3).
You can view your active quests by using `/quests list` or `/quests list rewards`.
When a player completes a quest, the reward can be received by clicking the reward button in the chat or by using `/quests reward`.
As soon as a quest's reward has been collected, the quest disappears from the list, and a newly generated quest will be added.  
By default, a player is allowed to skip one quest every 24h by using `/quests skip`.
Some quests require the player to complete an advancement before they can be generated. Quests in the nether, for example, require the player to have completed the ***"Diamonds!"*** advancement.  
Also, newly generated quests will increase in their quantities proportional to the players' playtime on the server: While a new player might receive a quest like ***"Mine 32 Iron Ore"*** a player with lots of playtime on the server would rather receive a quest like this ***"Mine 512 Iron Ore"***.
This feature can be precisely adjusted in the `config.yml` or be turned off entirely.  
Some quests are incredibly rare but promise very high rewards once completed. Each quest is assigned a number of stars (⭐) based on its difficulty. Collect stars by completing quests and compete with others on the leaderboard which can be viewed using `/quests leaderboard`.


## Quests
Quests are randomly generated in Basic Quests. 
Currently available quest types along with some examples are listed below:

* Mine Block
* Kill Entity
* Harvest Block
* Chop Wood
* Enchant Item
* Find Structure
* Trade with Villager
* Gain Level
* Reach Level
* Break Block
* **Fish Item (new)**
* **Increase Stat (new)**

Quest ideas I am thinking about implementing in the future:

* Breed Animal
* Tame Animal
* Smelt Item
* Brew Potion


## Rewards
Possible Rewards are either ***Items***, ***Money*** or ***XP***. You can enable or disable each of these reward types in the `config.yml`.
By default, only item-rewards are enabled. In order to use money-rewards you need to have an ***economy plugin*** connected via ***Vault***.
If multiple reward types are enabled one will be chosen at random when a new quest is generated - at least one reward type must be enabled or BasicQuests will not work.  
The value of a reward is proportional to the value of the quest and is multiplied by the `reward-factor` which can also be adjusted in the `config.yml`.
The value of a given quest is determined by a number of factors along its generation process.  
While money and xp-rewards are self-explanatory I'll list some examples for item-rewards below:

* Tools (Iron - Netherite) (Maybe enchanted)
* Armor (Chainmail - Netherite) (Maybe enchanted)
* Smithing Templates
* Enchanted Books
* Potions (Only positive effects - extended (+) and upgraded (II) variants)
* Food
* Resources (Most of the valuable things you can find underground - From Flint to Netherite)
* Rare Items (Enchanted Golden Apple, Music Disks, Saddle, ...)


## Quest Generation Customization
BasicQuest allows admins to fine-tune the quest generation on their servers using a bunch of yaml files in the `quest_generation` directory.  
This allows for:
- adjusting or removing the probability of quest types
- adjusting or removing the probability of specific quests within a quest type
- making certain quests more or less valuable. This will be reflected in the value of the reward.
- adjusting the amounts that appear in quests.

For further information about how to fine tune the generation process check out the readme file at `plugins/BasicQuests/quest_generation/README.md`


## Example Quests
You now know what type of Quests and Rewards are available.
Here are some examples of randomly generated Quests along with their Rewards.  
Remember that there are a lot of possibilities to tweak the Quest and Reward generation in the `config.yml` and in the `quest_generation` files.

## Placeholder
BasicQuests supports the following placeholders:

`%bquests%`				A (multiline) list of the players quests (same output as /quests list)  
`%bquests_detail%`			A (multiline) list of the players quests and rewards (same output as /quests list reward)  
`%bquests_count%` 			The amount of quests the player has  
`%bquests_completed%` 	The amount of quests the player has completed  
`%bquests_top_<index>%` The leaderboard of players with most completed quests (line by line)  
`%bquests_<index>%`			The players quest at the given index  
`%bquests_<index>_title%`	    The title of the players quest at the given index  
`%bquests_<index>_progress%`		The progress of the players quest at the given index: "1/16" or "Completed!"  
`%bquests_<index>_left%`			The amount left of the players quest at the given index: "15 left"  
`%bquests_<index>_<linenumber>%`		The title of a given quest split into 4 lines that fit on a sign. (linenumber can be 1 - 4, Check the example below)  
`%bquests_<index>_reward_<linenumber>%`	The reward of a given quest split into 2 lines. Handy for Scoreboards. (linenumber can be 1 - 2, Check the example below)

## Config


<details>
<summary>Show config.yml</summary>

```
# This is the config file for BasicQuests.
# This config was generated for version 0.5

# You can delete this file to regenerate the default config on server reload.



# GENERAL

# amount of quests a player holds at a time
# recommended values: min = 3, max = 6
quest-amount: 3

# times a player is allowed to skip a quest. (resets every day)
skips-per-day: 1

# broadcasts a message to everyone if a player completes a quest
broadcast-on-quest-complete: true

# plays a sound when a quest has been completed (only for the player)
sound-on-quest-complete: true

# disable the inbuilt scoreboard (/quests scoreboard)
# should only be set to true if the scoreboard does not work correctly because of another plugin using it.
# quests can always be displayed on custom scoreboards using the PlaceholderAPI.
disable-scoreboard: false

# show the scoreboard per default for new players
show-scoreboard-per-default: true

# set the locale for the plugin.
# contact me if you would like to have your language supported. you might need to help with translations.
# available locales:
# en: English, de: German, es: Spanish, ru: Russian
locale: en

# whether new updates should be announced to admins and in the console.
# updating to the newest version is always recommended unless the new version is not compatible with your server.
check-for-updates: true

# save interval for player data in minutes
# the saving process can cause lag on large servers. Increase this parameter to make savings less frequent.
# recommended values: min = 10
save-interval: 10

# edit the following list to prevent quest progress in worlds with the given names.
# watch out to not mess up the list's format.
banned-worlds:
  - world_creative
  - world_without_quest_progress

# an alternative character the plugin should use to display stars earned by quests
# replaces the default character. should be a valid unicode character.
# uncomment the following line to enable alternative character.
# star-character: "*"


# QUEST GENERATION

# factor for the value of rewards
# recommended values: min = 0.5, max = 3.0
reward-factor: 1.0

# factor for the quantities in a quest - e.g., the numbers of zombies to kill
# recommended values: min = 0.5, max = 3.0
quantity-factor: 1.0

# Increase the quantities in quests according to a players play time.
increase-quantity-by-playtime: true

# factor when a player joins the game
start-factor: 0.4

# factor when a player reaches <max-amount-hours> hours of playtime
max-factor: 3.0

# hours of play time at which a player receives quests with max quantities
max-amount-hours: 100

# chance of duplicate quests [0.0 - 1.0]
# 0.0: no duplicate quests will appear (not recommended when quest-amount is above 4)
# 1.0: players active quests have no influence on the generation of new quests
duplicate-quest-chance: 0.3



# REWARDS
# choose what type of reward you would like to be generated for quests
# if multiple types are set to true new quests will have a reward type chosen randomly

# enable items as rewards
item-rewards: true

# enable xp as a reward
xp-rewards: false

# enable money as a reward (requires an economy plugin to be hooked up via Vault)
money-rewards: false



# ECONOMY

# factor for money rewards
# adjusts this to the value of money on your server.
money-factor: 1.0
```

</details>

title: NulaCore
description: A library containing shared code for my mods
body:
# NulaCore

A library containing shared code for my mods

Documentation can be found at [https://sidgames5.github.io/javadocs/nulacore/1.0/](https://sidgames5.github.io/javadocs/nulacore/1.0/)

## Versioning

This library follows the SemVer 2 specification. The format is `major.minor.patch`.

Jar name format: `nulacore-<minecraft version>-<mod version>`

### Example

A mod requires NulaCore v1.3. You can use any version that starts with 1.3 or greater. You cannot use 1.2.

## Using NulaCore in your project

### Gradle

In the repositories section of your `build.gradle` file, add my repository:
```groovy
repositories {
    maven {
        url "https://repo.repsy.io/mvn/sidgames5/sidgames5"
    }
}
```

Add the package to the dependencies section:
```groovy
dependencies {
    modImplementation("dev.sidgames:nulacore:1.0.0")
}
```

title: Wire's Crafting Table
description: The small tweak that the crafting table has always needed.
body:
# WIRE'S CRAFTING TABLE

A small tweak for a big difference.

## LORE

For as long as I can remember, I have absolutely despised that one texture on the crafting table. You know the one... 

This texture takes up 2 of the 4 available textures that make up the sides of the Crafting Table. This texture has acted as a plague on my brain for nearly countless years. Even with the updates of the Crafting Table's texture in previous versions of the game that made it match more closely to the look of planks, the haunting texture on those 2 sides have remained the same.

Something had to be done. 

Too many of the world's most creative builders, designers, crafters, imagine..ers, have had to live with this texture and be restricted by the placement of the Crafting Table, the most useful block in the most popular game. Limited by the choice of the Crafting Table's placement, left to play their cards against fate to see if their creations would be utterly ruined depending on if this simple texture was visible. In some cases, the worst possible outcome, having BOTH sides of the crafting table showing this texture, could cause these creators to reside to the shameful and punishing act of hiding their Crafting Tableṡ in elaborate redstone contraptions.

It had to be stopped.

### AND SO WIRE'S CRAFTING TABLE WAS BORN

-  A wonderful alteration of a massively-beloved block.

-  A tweak of true witt.

- A new texture to end the world's suffering of the plaguing texture.


##### This is obviously a joke but I do really think that the Crafting Table sides that have that one small shear on them really needed to be tweaked and it has kinda bugged me for years. So here ya go.

title: ComputerCraft Pastebin Patch
description: Fix the `pastebin` program on legacy versions of ComputerCraft
body:
# ComputerCraft patch for Pastebin

This fixes Pastebin on legacy versions of ComputerCraft.

This resource pack has been confirmed to work on Tekkit main.

## The problem

When executing `pastebin get` or `pastebin put`, the program tries to access `http://pastebin.com`. This fails due to the `http` part, because Pastebin no longer serves content over HTTP (which is a good thing from a security standpoint, but it's bad in this particular context).

## The solution

The fix is really simple: Replace `http` with `https`. This restores standard functionality.

## Credits and licensing

Two people have made videos and tutorials explaining the problem and showing how to fix it by modifying ComputerCraft directly:

- [Krakaen](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MkloBnl-W8s)
- ["Dylan"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nqs8m-39TnI)

**This is a "trivial change," so this goes under the ComputerCraft Public License, the same license as ComputerCraft.**

Arcadia Pets

 

Support the project on ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/aminoquiz

📺 Mod Showcase & Trailer

English

You collect pets. They have stats, skills, a level, and they actually do things. Skills proc in combat: a Wolf calls reinforcements when hit, a Bee poisons attackers, a Magmacube luckifies drops. You can also duel other players' pets in a turn-based PvP arena.

The basics

  • 6 rarities, Common to Mythic. Each pet rolls 6 stats (Power / Endurance / Agility / Wit / Charisma / Luck) on a 1 to 5★ scale.
  • ~30 skills tied to mob species. Feed treats to level up to Lv 10, higher rarity unlocks more slots.
  • Two summon modes: Follow (real entity at your side) or Pocket (rendered on your shoulder, zero server cost).
  • Fusion: combine 5 same-rarity pets to guarantee a higher tier.
  • World drops: dungeon and structure chests can contain crates, vanilla bosses (Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian) drop endgame ones, and mobs can drop their own pet on kill.
  • Duels: roster of 3 pets, turn-based PvP, ELO leaderboard, optional coin bets.
  • Pet pedestal: deco block displaying a pet floating above it. Adjacent pedestals chain their rotation.
  • Pet book: shift+scroll cycles modes (Collection / Panel / Bestiary / Duel). In Duel mode, sneak right-click a player to challenge.

Items

  • arcadia_pets:*_pet_bag: 5 crate tiers (common to legendary).
  • arcadia_pets:pet_treat / pet_snack: feed for skill XP (+10 / +50).
  • arcadia_pets:star_essence: anvil it onto a pet to bump one stat by +1★.
  • arcadia_pets:pet_collection_book: your hub item. Right-click opens the collection, shift+scroll switches mode.

/arcadia_pets duel <player> [bet]Challenge someone to a duel

To play it as part of a curated pack: our Industry, Magic & Exploration modpack.

Français

Tu collectionnes des familiers, chacun avec ses stats, ses compétences et son niveau. Et ils ne sont pas juste décoratifs : leurs compétences se déclenchent en combat. Un Loup appelle des renforts quand il se fait taper, une Abeille empoisonne ses agresseurs, un Magmacube fait dropper plus de loot. Tu peux aussi affronter les familiers d'autres joueurs dans une arène au tour par tour.

Les bases

  • 6 raretés, du Commun au Mythique. Chaque pet tire 6 stats (Puissance / Endurance / Agilité / Esprit / Charisme / Chance) sur une échelle de 1 à 5★.
  • ~30 compétences liées à l'espèce. Nourris ton pet avec des friandises pour le monter jusqu'au niveau 10, et plus la rareté est haute, plus il débloque de slots de compétence.

title: Bin Slot
description: Delete items directly from your inventory
body:
This mod adds a convenient trash bin slot to your inventory for easy item disposal.

It is **required** on the server, but **optional** on the client, meaning only the players that want to use it should install it.

## Features

### 🗑️ Trash Bin Slot
- Adds a dedicated trash bin slot to your inventory interface
- Items placed in this slot are **permanently deleted**
- Seamlessly integrates with **survival mode**, **creative mode**, and **all container interfaces**
  - Since `v1.1.0`, the creative inventory built-in deletion slot mechanics now match the mod's trash bin slot functionalities

![Inventory Preview with Bin Slot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8601389d0e373764baa4669058f39dd90ab6c7aa.png)

### 🎯 Slot Highlighting
- **Shift + Hover**: When you hold Shift and hover over the bin slot while holding an item, the mod highlights all matching items (based on ID) in your inventory with a red overlay
- This feature helps you quickly identify which items will be deleted

![Shift+Hover example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15dbe50fb5e13830bb2bd913eb464fe191f77c89.png)

### 🖱️ Intuitive Controls
- **Left Click**: Delete items from your cursor stack
- **Right Click**: Delete a single item from your cursor stack
- **Shift + Hover**: Preview which items will be highlighted for deletion
- **Shift + Click**: Delete items from your cursor stack and all matching items from your inventory
- **Shift + Click with empty cursor stack**: Deletes every item from your **creative** inventory (`v1.1.0+`)

### 🌐 Translations
- Built-in translations for all the languages in the game

## Customization

### 🖼️ **Bin Slot Texture**
- The trash bin slot texture is automatically generated using built-in game textures and adapts to match your active resource pack's inventory GUI style
- Alternatively, you can customize the slot texture by using a resource pack that supports this mod


---


_**Note**: This mod is designed to work seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft and most other mods. If you encounter any compatibility issues, please report them on the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/Pemiridosa/bin-slot/issues)._

description: Combine two absorbed blocks and inherit both behaviors.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b418363bbb059093ca402bfa793ca83f7b40a114.png)

Sulfur Cube: Combinations expands Sulfur Cubes with a new combination system. Instead of being limited to one absorbed block, a Sulfur Cube can now hold two different blocks at once, creating new mixed properties and special interactions.

# Interactions
Players can place, replace and remove each side of the Sulfur Cube separately. This makes combinations easy to control. Duplicate blocks are ignored, so the same block cannot be used twice to stack the same effect.
## Same Attributes
Combining blocks with the same attribute _(like Oak Planks with Spruce Planks)_ creates a stronger version of that attribute.
## Different Attributes
Different attributes _(like Stone with Wood)_ are blended into one shared result.
## Shared Abilities
Special abilities from both blocks _(like TNT, Magma Block, ...)_ can work together.

title: Sky World
description: The overworld becomes a vertical sea of floating islands — an Aether-style sky archipelago. Powered by Isekai API.
body:
**The overworld becomes a vertical sea of floating islands.** Aether-style continents scattered across a 150-block-tall band — explore up, down, and across a sky archipelago instead of solid ground. Powered by Isekai API.

## What it does

Sky World overlays the overworld's terrain with scattered floating islands distributed through a tall vertical band (active roughly Y 50–200), so the world reads as a true 3D archipelago — islands above you, below you, and off into the distance, with cloud layers between them. Every vanilla biome, ore, structure, and mob is remapped into the island volume by [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api), so the world still feels like Minecraft — just airborne.

It also ships a standalone **Sky Realm dimension** (`/execute in sky_world:skyrealm`) — the same island generation as its own world you can travel to, leaving the overworld free for other mods if you prefer.

## Features

**Vertical floating-island overworld** — continents across a wide Y band, not a thin shell. Curved island undersides, varied biomes, real depth.

**Vanilla content preserved** — ores, structures, and mobs are remapped into the islands (no empty void worlds).

**Ocean / cliff cleanup** — ocean monuments, shipwrecks, ocean ruins, and edge-leaking springs are excluded so islands stay clean.

**Sky Realm dimension** — a separate dimension with the same island generation, for packs that want a normal overworld.

## Requirements

**Isekai API is required** — Sky World is a datapack-style worldshape built entirely on Isekai's worldgen primitives.

## Compatibility

Coexists with TerraBlender, YUNG's structure mods, map mods (Journeymap etc.), and dimension mods like Nullscape — tested in-game.

Mutually exclusive with other overworld-overhaul mods (Terralith, William Wythers') — only one mod can own `overworld.json`. No crash; last-loaded wins. To run alongside another overworld overhaul, use Sky World's **Sky Realm dimension** instead and let the other mod own the overworld.

## License & links

**Related projects**

- [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api) — required worldgen framework these worlds are built on
- [Mountain World](https://modrinth.com/mod/mountain-world) — sister world: the overworld reforged as endless mountains
- [Tropical World](https://modrinth.com/mod/tropical-world) — sister world: the overworld as a sunlit tropical sea with sandy islets
- [Tundra World](https://modrinth.com/mod/tundra-world) — sister world: the overworld frozen end to end

MIT. Source & issues: https://github.com/KURONAMI333/sky-world

Built on [Isekai API](https://modrinth.com/mod/isekai-api).

title: ExcaMate
description: Mining companion with different mining modes for efficiency, with auto-collection of drops and XP.
body:
# ⛏️ ExcaMate

ExcaMate is an efficient mining companion that enhances how you mine in Minecraft. With a single key, you can vein mine, create clean branch tunnels, or excavate 3×3 areas, with optional auto-pickup for drops and direct XP collection - now with full control over what gets mined and picked up.

---

## ✨ Features

- Hold-to-activate mining - no toggle state  
Tool-aware behaviour:
  - Pickaxes: stone & ores
  - Axes: logs & wood
  - Shovels: dirt, sand, gravel, clay, etc.
  - Hoes: hay bales, sponges, leaves, crops, etc.
- Smart durability handling (won’t break your tool)
- Supports Unbreaking & respects Silk Touch & Fortune
- Direct XP collection (optional)
- Auto-pickup drops (optional)
- Auto torch placement when torches are in off-hand (Branch mode only - optional)
- Configurable block limits per mode
- Customisable allow & block lists for mining and auto-pickup

---

## 🧾 Custom Allow & Block Lists

ExcaMate now gives you full control over what it can mine and what it picks up.

By default, ExcaMate supports:
- ores  
- logs and wood  
- stone-type blocks  
- shovel blocks (dirt, sand, gravel, etc.)  

You can extend or restrict this behaviour using the config:

- **extraVeinMineAllowList**  
  Adds extra blocks to ExcaMate’s supported mining list.  
  Example: `minecraft:obsidian`, `minecraft:hay_block`

- **veinMineBlockList**  
  Prevents specific blocks from being mass-mined.  
  Example: `minecraft:glass`, `minecraft:glass_pane`

- **extraAutoPickupAllowList**  
  Adds extra blocks whose drops will be auto-picked up.

- **autoPickupBlockList**  
  Prevents drops from specific blocks from being auto-picked up.  
  Example: `minecraft:gravel` to avoid inventory clutter

### Behaviour Rules
- Default ExcaMate-supported blocks always work  
- Extra allowlists **add to** default behaviour (they do not replace it)  
- Blocklists always override allowlists  
- Tool rules still apply - no bypassing vanilla mechanics  
- Safety rules still apply - protected blocks remain blocked  

This lets you customise ExcaMate without breaking balance or risking accidental destruction.

---

## 🧲 Auto Pickup Blocks & XP

ExcaMate can automatically collect drops and XP while mining, keeping your inventory tidy and reducing clutter.

**Item Auto Pickup:**  
Mined drops go directly into your inventory. If your inventory is full, excess items will drop normally.  

**Direct XP Collection:**  
XP is awarded instantly without spawning orbs, making mining smoother and eliminating the need to wait for XP to reach you.

Both features are fully configurable and now support fine-tuned control using the allowlists and blocklists.

![Auto pickup ores & XP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04f7beab19aa83193b93439d24826016fc433c92.gif)

---

## 🔄 Mining Modes

ExcaMate includes three mining modes, each designed for a different use case. Cycle between them using the in-game keybind.

**Vein**  
Mines connected blocks of the same type. Ideal for ores, logs, and loose materials.  

**Branch**  
Creates a clean 1-wide, 2-tall, 16-depth tunnel in front of you. Perfect for strip mining.  

**Excavate**  
Mines a 3-wide, 3-tall, 3-depth area based on where you're looking. Great for clearing large spaces quickly.

![Changing mining mode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dc2f2ed9bca20837513c05c821b6478690774b1.gif)

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

ExcaMate includes a config file where you can tweak:

- Max block limit per mode  
- Auto-pickup behaviour  
- XP handling  
- Auto torch placement  
- Extra blocks that can be mass-mined  
- Blocks that should never be mass-mined  
- Extra blocks whose drops can be auto-picked up  
- Blocks whose drops should not be auto-picked up  

All new configuration options are designed to extend ExcaMate’s default behaviour without disrupting it.

---

## ⚖️ Balanced Gameplay

ExcaMate is designed to feel like vanilla Minecraft:

- No boosted drops  
- No bonus XP  
- Uses normal durability  
- Applies exhaustion/hunger  
- Respects all vanilla mechanics  

You gain efficiency and control without sacrificing balance.

---

## 🔒 Safety

ExcaMate will never mass-break protected or sensitive blocks such as:

- Containers (chests, barrels, shulker boxes, etc.)
- Spawners  
- Bedrock  
- Command blocks and structure blocks  

These protections remain in place regardless of configuration.

---

## 💬 Suggestions & Feedback

I’m open to suggestions for future ExcaMate features, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements.

If you have an idea or find an issue, please add it on the GitHub issue page:
https://github.com/SkellyX/ExcaMate/issues

title: Enchanted Loom
description: A plugin for 1.21.11 that adds an Enchanted Loom to Minecraft. This can be configured for survival but allows easier banner creation.
body:
# EnchantedLoom

**EnchantedLoom** adds a craftable magical loom block that lets players apply any banner pattern and dye colour through a clean wizard-style GUI — no pattern items required.

Designed for survival servers that want banner design to feel rewarding without the tedious material grind.

![Enchanted Loom GUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%201%20-%20GUI.png)

---

## Features

- **Wizard-style GUI** — step through base colour → pattern → pattern colour, one screen at a time
- **Survival-friendly** — players trade in a matching blank banner to receive the finished design (configurable)
- **Creative bypass** — creative mode players are never required to supply a blank banner
- **Save & retrieve designs** — name and save banner designs per player, persisted across restarts
- **Global banners** — optionally let all players (or only creative players) browse everyone's saved designs
- **Admin banner command** — generate any patterned banner via command and give it to any player
- **Vanilla loom untouched** — only the crafted Enchanted Loom opens the custom GUI; regular looms work normally
- **Fully configurable** — messages, GUI title, item appearance, layer limits, and survival settings
- **Live reload** — apply config changes with `/elreload`, no restart needed

---

## Crafting

**Step 1 — Diamond String** — place four diamonds around a piece of string

![Diamond String recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%206%20-%20Diamond%20String.png)

**Step 2 — Enchanted Loom** — two Diamond Strings on top, two planks on the bottom

![Enchanted Loom recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%207%20-%20Crafting.png)

---

## GUI

Right-clicking the Enchanted Loom opens a three-step wizard:

1. **Base Colour** — choose the colour of the blank banner
2. **Add Pattern** — browse every available Minecraft banner pattern; hover for a tooltip preview
3. **Pattern Colour** — pick the colour for that pattern layer, then click to add it

Repeat steps 2–3 to layer up to six patterns, then take the finished banner.

![Step 2: Add Pattern](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%202%20-%20Border%20Select.png)
![Step 3: Pattern Colour](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%203%20-%20Colour%20Select.png)

---

## Saving Designs

Click **Save Design** (the book icon) in the pattern picker to name and save your current design via chat. Open the Saved Banners screen at any time — left-click to get a copy, shift-click to delete.

![Save Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%204%20-%20Save%20Banners.png)
![Saved Banners list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom/main/images/Enchanted%20Loom%20-%205%20-%20Saved%20Banners.png)

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/eloom open [player]` | Open the Enchanted Loom GUI | `enchantedloom.open` |
| `/eloom give [player] [amount]` | Give an Enchanted Loom block | `enchantedloom.give` |
| `/eloom banner <base> [pattern:color ...]` | Create a patterned banner | `enchantedloom.banner` |
| `/eloom reload` | Reload the configuration | `enchantedloom.admin` |
| `/elopen`, `/elgive`, `/elbanner`, `/elreload` | Shorthand aliases | *(same as above)* |

**`/elbanner` examples**
```
/elbanner red stripe_top:white creeper:gold
/elbanner white gradient:purple gradient_up:light_blue Steve
```

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|------------|-------------|---------|
| `enchantedloom.use` | Interact with the Enchanted Loom block | everyone |
| `enchantedloom.open` | Open the GUI | everyone |
| `enchantedloom.give` | Give Enchanted Loom blocks | op |
| `enchantedloom.banner` | Generate banners via command | op |
| `enchantedloom.admin` | All of the above + reload + admin delete | op |

---

## Configuration Highlights

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `require-blank-banner` | `true` | Survival players must trade a matching blank banner |
| `max-banner-layers` | `6` | Maximum layers on a banner |
| `global-banners` | `false` | All players can browse every saved design |
| `global-creative-banners` | `false` | Creative players can browse every saved design |
| `allow-admin-delete-banners` | `false` | Admins can delete any player's saved design |
| `item-glow` | `true` | Enchantment glint on the Enchanted Loom item |
| `patterns-per-page` | `27` | Patterns shown per GUI page |

Full source and documentation on [GitHub](https://github.com/MattTheHuman/EnchantedLoom).

---

## Requirements

- **Paper** 1.21.x
- **Java** 21+

title: Tree Chopper Pro
description: Break trees effortlessly. Ideal for those who want to break a tree with a single blow.
body:
## ENGLISH 🇬🇧

## 📌 General Purpose

Tree Chopper Pro is a plugin designed to make tree cutting faster and more efficient on Minecraft servers. When players meet certain conditions, they can chop down an entire tree at once, and the system will automatically replant saplings.

## ⚙️ How It Works

The plugin operates through the BlockBreakEvent and checks the following conditions when a player breaks a block:

## ✅ Activation Conditions

For the tree-chopping system to activate:

- The broken block must be a log
- The player must be sneaking (holding shift)
- The player must be holding an axe

If these conditions are not met, the plugin will not activate and normal Minecraft behavior will continue.

## 🪓 Axe Durability System

The plugin handles axe durability in a realistic way:

- Durability decreases based on the number of logs broken
- If the axe does not have enough durability:
    - The tree will not be fully chopped
    - The process will be cancelled
 
## 🌱 Automatic Sapling Replanting

After the tree is cut down, the plugin:

- Detects the lowest (base) log blocks of the tree
- Waits for 2 ticks before executing
- Replants saplings if the ground is suitable (except for azalea, crimson, and warped trees)

## 🌳 Supported Trees:

- Oak
- Birch
- Spruce
- Jungle
- Acacia
- Dark Oak
- Cherry
- Mangrove
- Azalea
- Crimson Tree
- Warped Tree

## 💬 **You can join my Discord server for suggestions and complaints.**

## TÜRKÇE 🇹🇷

## 📌 Genel Amaç 

Tree Chopper Pro, Minecraft sunucularında ağaç kesme işlemini daha hızlı ve pratik hale getiren bir plugindir. Oyuncular belirli şartları sağladığında bir ağacı tek seferde kesebilir ve sistem otomatik olarak fidan dikimi yapar.

## ⚙️ Nasıl Çalışır? 

Plugin, BlockBreakEvent üzerinden çalışır ve oyuncu bir blok kırdığında aşağıdaki şartları kontrol eder: 

## ✅ Aktivasyon Şartları 

Ağaç kırma sisteminin devreye girmesi için: 

- Kırılan blok bir odun olmalı 
- Oyuncu shift (eğilme) basıyor olmalı 
- Oyuncunun elinde bir balta olmalı 

Bu şartlar sağlanmazsa plugin devreye girmez ve normal Minecraft davranışı devam eder. 

## 🪓 Balta Dayanıklılığı Sistemi 

Plugin, baltanın dayanıklılığını gerçekçi şekilde hesaplar: 

- Kesilen odun sayısı kadar dayanıklılık düşer 
- Eğer baltanın dayanıklılığı yetmezse: 
    - Ağaç tamamen kırılmaz 
    - İşlem iptal edilir 
    
## 🌱 Otomatik Fidan Dikme 

Ağaç kesildikten sonra plugin: 

- Ağacın en alt (taban) odun bloklarını tespit eder 
- 2 tick gecikme ile işlem yapar 
- Uygun zemin varsa fidan diker (açelya, kızıl ve çarpık ağaçlar hariç)

## 🌳 Desteklenen Ağaçlar: 

- Meşe
- Huş 
- Ladin 
- Yağmur Ormanı 
- Akasya 
- Koyu Meşe
- Kiraz 
- Mangrov

body:
# 🧨 Creeper Apocalypse Escalation
(BETA! SOME DON"T WORK AND SOME WORK!)
**Every mob spawn becomes a creeper. Every day, more spawn. Can you survive?**

This mod turns your Minecraft world into a chaotic challenge run. It features a sophisticated replacement system that swaps normal mobs for Creepers, slowly ramping up the difficulty day by day until you are facing swarms of explosive enemies.

---

## 📋 Features

### 🔄 Mob Replacement System
*   **ALL mobs spawn as Creepers!**
*   **Safe exceptions:** Blazes, Villagers, and the Ender Dragon remain normal so the game is still beatable.
*   **Configurable:** Choose which mobs get replaced in the config menu.

### 📈 Auto-Escalation System
*   **Day 1:** Normal spawn rates (1x)
*   **Day 10:** Chaos (10x spawns!)
*   Spawn multiplier increases automatically every day.

### 🧬 9 Special Creeper Variants
New variants spawn starting from Day 3, each with unique abilities:

| Variant | Special Ability |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🐁 **Mini Creeper** | Tiny, super fast, hard to hit |
| 🦖 **Giant Creeper** | Massive size, slow, huge explosion radius |
| 🕷️ **Spider Creeper** | Climbs walls like a spider |
| 🥷 **Ninja Creeper** | Turns invisible when standing still |
| 🌈 **Rainbow Creeper** | Drops random loot when killed |
| 🏀 **Bouncy Creeper** | Jumps incredibly high |
| 🤠 **Jockey Creeper** | Rides other creepers into battle |
| 💖 **Happy Creeper** | Friendly! Buffs players instead of hurting them |
| ⚡ **Lightning Creeper** | Boss-tier, always charged, extreme speed |

**Unique Feature:** The **Super Charged Lightning Creeper** (Day 7+) features a custom PURPLE energy aura!

### 🎯 Milestone Events
*   **Day 5 - Blood Moon:** All creepers glow red and can be seen through walls.
*   **Day 7 - Charged Day:** 25% of all creepers spawn naturally charged.
*   **Day 10 - The Swarm:** Spawn rates gain a massive +50% bonus.

### 📊 Full Statistics & GUI
*   **In-Game Menu:** Press `K` (or use Pause Menu) to configure spawn limits, disable "No Day" mode, or adjust variant chances.
*   **Stats Overlay:** Press `J` to see your kills, death count, and survived explosions in real-time.
*   **Streamer Ready:** Features auto-screenshots on death and chat commands.

---

## 🔧 Installation

1.  Requires **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft 1.21.11
2.  Requires **Fabric API**
3.  Drop `creeper-apocalypse-escalation-1.0.0.jar` into your `mods` folder.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Press `ESC` -> `Creeper Challenge Settings` to configure everything in-game!
*   Adjust spawn rate caps
*   Toggle specific variants
*   Enable/Disable the entire mod
*   Set "No Day Mode" for a randomized challenge

title: HTools
description: HTools adds hybrid pickaxes that combine the best properties of multiple materials, culminating in the ultimate Vein Miner Pickaxe!

# ⚒️ HTools - Hybrid Tools Revolution

Tired of choosing between speed, durability, and efficiency? **HTools** breaks the boundaries of traditional Minecraft tooling by introducing hybrid crafting technology. Combine the best properties of multiple materials into revolutionary super-tools that redefine what's possible.

## ✨ Features

- **💎 Hybrid Materials**: Forge powerful Diamond-Gold and Netherite-Diamond-Gold ingots
- **⚡ Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxes**: Merge gold's mining speed with diamond's durability
- **🔥 Netherite-Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxes**: Merge gold's mining speed with netherite's durability
- **🌋 Vein Miner System**: Mine entire ore veins in one swing with the **Vein Miner Pickaxe**
- **📈 Progressive Upgrades**: Find smithing templates in **Bastion Treasures** to unlock the Vein Miner

## 🔨 Crafting Progression

1. Create **Diamond-Gold Ingots** by combining a diamond and a gold ingot
   ![Recipe diamond-gold ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21ac76f6863ea0d4a8012633f574899b057af988.png)

   ![Recipe netherite-diamond-gold ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e93aaac00339ce8ee083faddb9a31a25aa586150.png)
4. Forge a **Netherite-Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxe** for better durability
   ![Recipe netherite-diamond-gold pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e14382827d549e4bed6b6c3492332ac164aec2d.png)
5. Find the **Vein Miner Upgrade** in bastion treasure chests (50% spawn chance)
   ![Vein-Miner Upgrade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e8a4d04b85a43c994b77d4877a6304a7a96fa5a.png)
   ![Bastion Treasure Chest Loot Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ecf087c4556281e483006362a265e0feadcc8ba9.png)
6. Apply the **Vein Miner Upgrade** to the Netherite-Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxe
   ![Recipe Vein Miner Pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fc8826a8033eb2d645b865f86136027b81472f9.png)
7. Dominate mining with the ultimate **Vein Miner Pickaxe**
   
## 📊 Stats

**Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxe:**
- 1561 Durability (diamond)
- 12 Mining Speed (gold)
- 22 Enchantment Value (gold)

**Netherite-Diamond-Plated Golden Pickaxe:**
- 2031 Durability (netherite)
- 12 Mining Speed (gold)
- 22 Enchantment Value (gold)

**Vein Miner Pickaxe:**
- 4062 Durability (2× netherite)
- 15 Mining Speed
- 30 Enchantment Value
- **Mines whole ore veins**

## 🌍 Language Support

HTools is fully localized in multiple languages:
- 🇬🇧 **English**
- 🇩🇪 **German** (Deutsch)
- 🇮🇹 **Italian** (Italiano)

## 🚀 Coming Soon

This is just the beginning! More hybrid tools are in development:
- **Shovels, Axes, and Hoes** with the same hybrid technology
- **New material combinations** and upgrade paths
- **Additional enchantments** designed specifically for hybrid tools
- **More vein mining capabilities** for different block types

## 💪 Why HTools?

No more compromises. No more tool swapping. Just pure, efficient mining power that scales with your progression. Whether you're strip-mining for diamonds or clearing out massive ore deposits, HTools has the perfect tool for the job.

title: MyVillager
description: A plugin allowing players to claim villagers as their owns
body:
# MyVillager
This is a simple plugin allowing the players to claim villagers as their own.

The owners can also modify permission group letting their friends to use the villager(s).  
Other players are not permmited to damage the claimed villager.

This project has the dye 8 of any color stained glass or stained glass pane to 8 of any other color stained glass or stained glass pane.


#### Installation:
- Put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/saves/[Your World Here]/datapack" folder.
- ***DO NOT put the datapack in your "/AppData/Roaming/.minecraft/resourcepacks" folder.***
- If you changed where Minecraft loads from, find that location and use that "saves" folder.
- For servers, put it in your world folder that matches where your server.properties file says.

#### For advanced users:
- IF you want to store it in your ".minecraft" folder, CREATE a folder called "datapack" and put it there.
- From there, when you create a world and go to add datapacks, you can simply go to this folder and grab what you need.
- For identical recipes in multiple data packs, load desired recipes AFTER their duplicates

Datapack version is formatted as A.B.C
- A marks breaking changes to how the data pack is written
- B marks changes in either the "Pack Format" version or the game version itself (major update)
  - Special Note: as of 5.5.0 (1.21.9), pack formating now has minor versions. All minor versions for any given major versions are intended to fully compatible (i.e. - 88.0, 88.1, etc.) and listed as only the major version (i.e. - 88).
- C marks minor changes or fixes

The different release versions of "More Recipes by Selah":
- More Recipes: A balance of Quality of Life recipes while still feeling Vanilla
- Mini-Collections: Every recipe in "More Recipes" sub-divided into seven (7) categories
  - Additional, Change, Color, New, Smelting, Stonecutting, Undo
- Alpha: Every recipe divided into sub-categories based on the Mini-Collection categories
  - This is effectively the test version of all recipes
  - This is where recipes not in the Mini-Collection or comprehensive releases are
  - Feedback encouraged to bring as many recipes into the comprehensive release as possible

Datapacks were not a thing before 1.13. There is no way to make these compatible older than 1.13.

There are special cases where breaking changes that are not backwards compatible don't have the "A" value incremented:
- Item names are changed
  - ex: 1.1.x changes "rose_red" to "red_dye"
- A non-breaking functionality is added
  - ex: 2.6.x in 1.19.3 adds categories while anything before ignores them
- A change is made that doesn't stop the previous method from working
  - ex: "crafting_shapeless" works in all versions, "minecraft:crafting_shapeless" starting in 1.1.x
- Changes to the way "pack.mcmeta" is read
  - ex: see changes in 25w31a

Major breaking changes to each version:
 - 2.0.0 MC 1.17: Advancement Format change - custom recipe "condition" ("items")
 - 3.0.0 MC 1.20.5: Recipe Format change - recipe "result"
 - 4.0.0 MC 1.21: Folder Name change
 - 5.0.0 MC 1.21.2: Recipe Format change - shaped "key" and shapeless "ingredients"

This is what they're meant for.\

title: PRIDuels
description: Duels plugin with arenas and variety of customizable restrictions.
body:
Duels is a restrictions orientated plugin. I developed this plugin for my Minecraft server to address a player request for controlled, one-on-one battles. Players were looking for a way to duel each other without specific advantages, like using totems, golden apples, bows, shields, potions, ender pearls, elytras and etc. Previously, they had to rely on moderators to enforce these restrictions, which caused additional issues, so I created this plugin to solve that issue.


/duel <player> opens the GUI below. You can toggle some of restrictions by clicking on them. When you are done click Start and duel request with the same Restriction properties will be sent to the target.
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e99dfa32e4390910b68a03af0bc08060e168c815.png)

Target POV:

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ce0522eb49ecc9c41c4fe5cf55f7891cc4ae329.png)

The DENY/ACCEPT messages are clickable.

When you accept the request it teleports you to the arena and starts counting down from 5 to 0
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fbd4f881ed8e579bfbfa21bddbfb2d3498547ac.png)


After one of the player is dead:

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4e4d40abfef7584328703a20a0f25705538b884a.png)

This plugin also has spectating system. Just do /duels spectate player.
You can also turn off the unwanted restrictions/features.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
```
#here you can toggle which modules will be enabled/disabled in the server.
#if you turn off any, it will not show up in the duels GUI, so players
#won't be able to turn on/off that restriction.
modules:
  arena-selector: true
  #Disabling this will disable restriction GUI and request will be directly sent without specifying duel restrictions.
  #Use this to disable ALL restrictions.
  GUI: true
  keep-inventory:
    enabled: true
    toggled-by-default: true
  #Inventory Saving feature. when request receiver accepts the duel, if this is enabled, both players items will be
  #taken away and stored. whenever duel ends we give them their items back. You can use this if you want to give
  #players some kits in game.commands.start
  inventory-saving:
    enabled: false
    toggled-by-default: false
  restrictions:
    bow:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    totem:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    golden-apple:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    enchanted-golden-apple:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    potion:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    shield:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    elytra:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true
    ender-pearl:
      enabled: true
      toggled-by-default: true```
</details>

You are not permitted to claim this resource as your own creation.

That's it. Please use discord link below to get support.

https://discord.gg/2zZChX9AEN

- Psychological Horror Experience – Mods like Nyctophobia, The Man from the Fog, Cave Dweller, and From the Fog create a constant sense of dread and paranoia.

/svrestart

Starts the restart timer and announces the countdown in chat.

description: Team chat fully client-sided without needing server install any plugin or mod
body:
# Client-Side Teams Chat

Basic mod adding a few client-side commands to send whispers (/tell) to all your teammates at once without needing to manually send messages to each player.

`/cteam [text]` - send message to team.

`/cteamadd [username]` - adds player to team (trusted players).

`/cteamremove [username]` - removes player from team (trusted players).

`/cteamlist` - lists UUID of all members of the team (trusted players).

# Why would you ever need this mod?

Basically some servers might not have team plugin/mod making it not possible to quickly send messages to whole team so this mod comes in our place and sends messages for us to each of our teammate in less than second plus doesn't flood chat

# Do other players need the mod installed?

No. The only time they would need this mod is to also quickly send messages and see correct formatting; make sure to add each other to the team (trusted players list).

title: Rage Lifesteal
description: RageLifesteal is a customizable Lifesteal SMP plugin for Paper, developed by Perplexed Studios. It brings the popular Lifesteal mechanics to your SMP while keeping it lightweight, simple, and fully configurable.
body:
RageLifesteal is a powerful and customizable Lifesteal SMP plugin built for Paper. It adds the popular Lifesteal mechanics to your survival server, making every fight more intense and rewarding. Players gain hearts when they kill others, and lose hearts when they die. If a player’s hearts reach 0, they are permanently banned until revived with a Revive Beacon or the /pardon command.

The plugin includes custom items like Heart Fragments, Hearts, and Revive Beacons, all craftable in a normal crafting table. Players can view recipes with /lsrecipe and manage hearts with /lswithdraw or /lsdonate. Admins have access to extra commands like /lsgive, /ban, and /tempban.

With a fully editable config.yml, RageLifesteal is easy to set up, lightweight, and works out-of-the-box with GeyserMC, ViaVersion, and ViaBackwards.

Bring the Lifesteal SMP experience to your friends with RageLifesteal by Perplexed Studios!

title: Feathers Actions
description: A highly configurable lightweight mod that uses the Feathers mod API. It causes actions like sprinting, jumping, swimming, blocking, attacking, climbing, etc.
body:
This is a server and client side mod that uses the existing Feathers mod for minecraft 1.20.1. It reduces stamina to the following actions:
Climbing
Jumping
Mining
Spriting
Charging weapons (E.g. Bow, Crossbow, Trident)
Rowing a boat
Swimming
Swinging tools
Hitting entities with a tool

There are negative effects when all stamina is exhasted like mining fatigue, slowness, and weakness. 

The regeneration system of the Feathers mod has also been reworked to wait a certain number of ticks, then will regenerate feathers, while depleeting a small amount of the player's hunger.

All editions, costs, and effects are configurable and compatible with the configured mod. 

Let me know of any bugs or issues.

title: Egdog 8
description: Egdog 8 (don't ask about the first 7) is designed to organically simulate the technological development of human civilisation. It is intended to be used in its current version as the simplest way to share the mods with friends.
body:
Egdog 8 (Don't ask about the first 7) is a modpack that is designed to organically simulate the techonological development of human civilisation, from the stone age, to the space age. If you enjoy modpacks like RLCraft and Aged, but wished it was more realistic or had too many fantasy elements, then this modpack is for you.

This is an idea that I've wanted to do for ages, and I've finally gotten the opportunity to do this properly. I'd really like feedback from players about gameplay and how to improve it.


The early game is rather difficult, with [No Tree Punching](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-tree-punching) which will slow down your progression, [Tough as Nails](https://modrinth.com/mod/tough-as-nails) which introduces temperature and thirst so that you have more systems to manage, and [Body Health System](https://modrinth.com/mod/body-health-system), which makes nighttime more dangerous because one shot to the head, and your dead. You only have 10 lives by the way (courtesy of [Limited Lives](https://modrinth.com/mod/limited-lives)). Overworld structures have also been removed, which makes the game even harder.

If you survive the early game, you will hopefully settle down and start farming, with the help of [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons) and [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), which will give you reasons to pay more attention to farming. But beware of [Flowing Fluids](https://modrinth.com/mod/flowing-fluids) and [Immersive Weathering](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-weathering), as they can really put a dampener on your progress if you don't know how to deal with them. Farming will also be helpful due to the addition of [Carts](https://modrinth.com/mod/niftycarts), which finally adds use for horses as they will help you to farm.

Explore with the help of [An Atlas](https://modrinth.com/mod/antique-atlas-4) and [Valkyrien Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/valkyrien-skies) and [Eureka](https://modrinth.com/mod/eureka) aided by [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) if your CPU can handle it. (This is the most tricky stage to implement as there isn't that much incentive for you to explore so I'd like feedback on this)

Hopefully your exploration has provided you with enough resources to industrialise using [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) and several addons, such as [Steam and Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails) and [Diesel generators](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-diesel-generators-fabric). Use this newfound rotational power to make cars and planes, added by [Trackwork](https://modrinth.com/mod/trackwork-refabricated) and [Clockwork](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-clockwork) respectively.

Take your factories to the next level with [Create New Age](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-new-age) and [Create Crafts and Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition), which will mean you can use forge energy and really supercharge your technology. There are also [mailboxes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/mailboxes) as well.

Then, use the forge energy provided to you to use the technology from [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra) and several of its addons to explore the Stars.

To help with multiplayer, [Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential) and [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) have been installed to easy communicate.

Obviously, there is no easy way to encourage the player to do any of these things in this order; you may even skip a few steps! But I hope that I have made the modpack challenging enough to be enjoyable but not rage inducingly hard, and I hope you have fun immersiving yourself in the huge tech-tree of these mods.

title: Drinks and Draughts
description: A datapack that adds 44 new drink recipes to the game, each with special effects and uses, as well as an extra recipe for sugar.
body:
Drinks and Draughts is a simple datapack that adds 44 drinks to the game, as well as 1 alternate recipe for sugar using sweet berries. It also adds new mechanics involving the drinks, depending on the type. This datapack is built for performance and should have basically zero impact on the game when the mechanics are not active. To get the recipes besides the sugar, which is 2 sweet berries, craft a recipe book using 8 bottles surrounding a book and then consume it.

# Drinks:

There are three types of drinks in this datapack. Generally, the more powerful the drink, the more varied and harder the ingredients are to collect.

Normal Drinks:
- Sweet juices have low nutrition and zero saturation, but give a temporary speed boost, as well as raising sugar levels by 1 when consumed.
- Vegetable juices have higher nutrition and saturation, but no special effects when consumed. both sweet and vegetable juices are stackable to 32.
- Blends are stronger versions of juices that cost more to make. Both kinds give more nutrition and saturation, and sweet blends give a longer speed and haste boost as well as raising sugar levels by 1 when consumed. Both are stackable to 16
- Teas are drinks that use dripleafs as an ingredient. They give 1 nutrition and 1 saturation as well as 2 positive effects when consumed. They are stackable to 16

Alcohols:
- Beer gives strength temporarily as well as increasing drunkenness by 1 level when consumed. It is stackable to 32.
- Wines give 2 different effects temporarily as well as increasing drunkenness by 3 levels when consumed. They are stackable to 8.
- Liquors give 2-3 different effects for a longer time as well as increasing drunkenness by 8 levels when consumed. They are stackable to 8.

Supernatural Drinks:
- Supernatural drinks come in 5 different categories, with each corresponding to a type of hazard, giving moderate to powerful themed effects as well as having related drawbacks.
- Deep Drinks are themed after the deep dark and increase your 'deep' level when consumed.
- Sea Drinks are themed after the oceans and increase your 'sea' level when consumed.
- Golden Drinks are themed after golden foods and increase your 'golden' level when consumed.
- Nether Drinks are themed after the nether and increase your 'nether' level when consumed.
- End Drinks are themed after the end and increase your 'end' level when consumed.

# Mechanics:

There are three main types of delayed effects that can impact players: sugar crashes, drunkenness, and supernatural contamination. These delayed effects come from drinking certain kinds of drinks that give effects. 

- Sugar crashes occur 2 minutes and 30 seconds after drinking your first sweet drink. This can be delayed once by drinking 2 more sweet drinks, and then delayed again for a shorter time by drinking 4 more sweet drinks. However, the more you delay the effects the worse the resulting crash, with each delay increasing the time of the negative effects as well as the amount. Once the sugar crash is over your sugar level is reset.
- Drunkenness starts impacting a player 1 minute after they have drunk alcohol. Your level of drunkenness will increase for every drink, with stronger drinks increasing drunkenness more than weaker drinks, in the order of beer<wine<liquor. Drunkenness will decrease every minute until it reaches zero. The minimum level of drunkenness required is 3, which is equivalent to 3 beers, or 1 of any wine type. There are five levels of drunkenness that correspond to different severities of drunkenness. A high enough level of drunkenness will become toxic. 
- Supernatural contamination starts impacting a player 3 minutes after their first superantural drink of that type, and will decrease in level each minute after they are first impacted. For each theme of drink there are four levels of severity. All supernatural drinks provide only 1 level of their contamination at the start, but stronger supernatural drinks can also have negative effects, and are also more expensive. However, once you drink a supernatural drink of a type, you will be forever affected, making any drinks from that type provide 2 levels of contamination afterward. 

# Specific Levels:
Sugar crashes have 3 levels.
- Level 1 is 30 seconds of mild effects and happens if you drink less than 3 drinks in a short timeframe.
- Level 2 is 45 seconds of mild effects and happens if you drink less than 7 drinks in a short timeframe.
- Level 3 is 60 seconds of moderate effects and happens if you drink 7 or more sweet drinks in a short timeframe.

Drunkenness has 5 levels.
- Level 1: Tipsy is 2 seconds of moderate effects every 5 seconds and happens if your drunkenness level is between 3 and 7.
- Level 2: Drunk is 3 seconds of moderate effects every 5 seconds and happens if your drunkenness level is between 8 and 13.
- Level 3: Blackout is 4 seconds of moderate effects every 5 seconds and happens if your drunkenness level is between 14 and 19. 
- Level 4: Poisoned is 5 seconds of moderate effects every 5 seconds and happens if your drunkenness level is between 20 and 23.
- Level 5: Dealthy is 5 seconds of severe effects every 5 seconds and happens if your drunkenness level is 24 or greater.

Supernatural contamination has 4 levels.
- Level 1 is generally 30 seconds of mild effects every 180 seconds, and happens if your contamination level is between 1 and 3
- Level 2 is generally 60 seconds of moderate effects every 180 seconds, and happens if your contamination level is between 4 and 6 
- Level 3 is generally 90 seconds of moderate effects every 180 seconds, and happens if your contamination level is between 7 and 8
- Level 4 is generally 120 seconds of severe effects every 180 seconds, and happens if your contamination level is 9 and above

title: RapidLeaves
description:
Automatic Detection: Detects when a tree has been fully chopped down
Realistic Falling: Leaves fall gradually and randomly
Highly Configurable: All parameters are adjustable
body:
# Welcome to RapidLeaves!
This revolutionary plugin enhances the tree-cutting experience in Minecraft, making it more immersive and exciting. Say goodbye to chopping logs one by one—cutting down a tree now feels natural and dynamic with this plugin.

## Installation
Place the RapidLeaves.jar file in your server's plugins/ folder
Restart your server

Edit the configuration file at plugins/RapidLeaves/config.yml if needed
Use /rapidleaves reload to apply changes without restarting

## Plugin Features
Automatic Detection: Recognizes when a tree has been fully chopped down
Realistic Falling: Leaves fall gradually and randomly
Highly Configurable: Every setting can be adjusted to your liking
Full Compatibility: Works with all tree types in Minecraft 1.21.5
Optimized: Includes safety limits to prevent lag
Natural Drops: Falling leaves can drop items as usual

## Main Configuration
leaf-decay-delay: Time (in ticks) before leaves start to fall
leaf-decay-interval: Time between each wave of falling leaves
max-leaf-search-radius: Maximum radius to search for leaves
max-leaves-per-wave: Maximum number of leaves falling per wave
enable-leaf-drops: Whether falling leaves should drop items

## Permissions
rapidleaves.admin: Allows use of admin commands (default: OP)

## Commands
/rapidleaves: Displays plugin information
/rapidleaves reload: Reloads the configuration

description: A Cross-Server Shout and Invite plugin for BungeeCord/Velocity/Bukkit
body:
# ServerShout 2 ServerShout is a Cross-Server Shout and Invite plugin for Bukkit/BungeeCord/Velocity. It features high performance and a high degree of customization, and it is compatible with PlaceholderAPI and LuckPerms. ## Screenshots Cross-Server Shout ![Cross-Server Shout](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b5c99928078acbeeb9d4cf228a5cb54ab44d3ed.png)
Cross-Server Invite ![Cross-Server Invite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5543762ddc54381271f94d751b6f8bf9a69555d0.png)
Message Mute ![Message Mute](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a49d8c2afeb809698893110fbfbc2bddf454528f.png)
## Commands & Permissions `/ss help` - Get help `/ss reload` - Reload configuration `/ss token list` - List all tokens `/ss token create ` - Create new token `/ss token delete ` - Delete token `/ss balance get ` - Check player token balance `/ss balance set ` - Set player token balance `/ss balance give ` - Give tokens to player `/ss balance take ` - Take tokens from player
`servershout.help` - Allows use of /ss help `servershout.reload` - Allows use of /ss reload `servershout.token.list` - Allows use of /ss token list `servershout.token.create` - Allows use of /ss token create `servershout.token.delete` - Allows use of /ss token delete `servershout.balance.get` - Allows use of /ss balance get `servershout.balance.set` - Allows use of /ss balance set `servershout.balance.give` - Allows use of /ss balance give `servershout.balance.take` - Allows use of /ss balance take `servershout.update.notify` - Allows receiving update notifications
BungeeCord Command: `/ssb` | Velocity Command: `/ssv`
**⭐ Default Shout format:** `!` **⭐ Default Invite format:** `/invite` or `/invite `
## PlaceholderAPI Placeholders `%servershout_balance_%` the player's token amount
## LuckPerms Meta Placeholders In shout.yml, you can configure the show of a player's LuckPerms Meta value in messages. **For example:** `{luckperms_meta_prefix}` displays the prefix Meta value, i.e., the player's prefix. Other Meta values can be managed via `/lp user meta`
## Usage 1. Download the jar file and place it in the plugins directory of the proxy (BungeeCord/Velocity) **(required)** 2. Place the jar file in the plugins directory of Bukkit as the management end of ServerShout (optional). 3. Restart the server. 4. Edit config.yml to configure the database and reload the plugin (optional). If the database is not configured, player tokens will not be deducted, and players can send messages without restrictions. ## Stats BungeeCord ![Bungee Status](https://bstats.org/signatures/bungeecord/ServerShout.svg)
Velocity ![Velocity Status](https://bstats.org/signatures/velocity/ServerShout.svg)
Bukkit ![Bukkit Status](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/ServerShout.svg)

title: Spectre
description: Spectre is a Minecraft plugin that allows the player to control the visibility (hidden, hide-partially, show) of nearby players.
body:
<center>
  
![Spectre](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsadriel/spectre/main/.github/logo.png)

</center>

----


## Spectre is a Minecraft plugin that allows the player to control the visibility of nearby players.

Tested on: 1.21, 1.20.6, 1.20, 1.19.4, 1.18.2


> This plugin is still in development and may contain bugs. Use at your own risk. The performance impact of this plugin when used with a large number of players is still unknown.
> This plugin is dependent on [PacketEvents v2.4](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents/releases/tag/v2.4.0) to intercept packets and modify the player's visibility.


## Features
- Three visibility modes: **Vanish**, **Ghost**, and **Invisible**
- Three armor visibility modes: **Visible**, **Hidden**, and **Boots**
- Custom hiding radius per player
- Toggle the visibility of nearby players
- Bypass the visibility restrictions
- Admin commands to set the visibility mode, armor visibility, and hiding radius for other players
- Permissions for each command and feature to control access
- Customizable messages


### Demo
<details>

> Visibility mode: **Ghost**, Armor: **Boots**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsadriel/spectre/main/.github/1.webp)

> Visibility mode: **Ghost**, Armor: **Visible**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsadriel/spectre/main/.github/2.webp)

> Visibility mode: **Ghost**, Armor: **Hidden**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsadriel/spectre/main/.github/3.webp)

> Visibility mode: **Invisible**, Armor: **Boots**

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dsadriel/spectre/main/.github/4.webp)

</details>


## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/spectre [help]` | Display the help message | `spectre.use` |
| `/spectre set mode <vanish\|ghost\|invisible>` | Change the visibility mode | `spectre.mode` |
| `/spectre set armor <visible\|hidden\|boots>` | Change the visibility of armor | `spectre.armor` |
| `/spectre set radius <radius>` | Set the hiding radius | `spectre.radius` |
| `/spectre set <mode\|armor\|radius> <value> [player]` | Set a value for yourself or another player | `spectre.admin` |
| `/spectre version` | Display the plugin version and check for updates | `spectre.admin` |
| `/spectre info [player]` | Display information about the players configuration | `spectre.admin` |



## Permissions

| Permission | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spectre.use` | Allows the player to use spectre command |
| `spectre.toggle` | Allows the player to toggle the visibility of nearby players |
| `spectre.mode` | Allows the player to change the visibility mode |
| `spectre.armor` | Allows the player to change the visibility of armor |
| `spectre.radius` | Allows the player to change the hiding radius |
| `spectre.bypass` | Allows the player to bypass the visibility restrictions |
| `spectre.admin` | Allows the to use admin commands |

## Installation
To install the plugin, download the latest release from the [releases page](https://github.com/dsadriel/spectre/releases) and place it in the `plugins` folder of your server. Also, make sure to install [PacketEvents](https://github.com/retrooper/packetevents/releases) in the `plugins` folder.

## Configuration

All messages can be customized in the `config.yml` file.  The default configuration can be found [here](/src/main/resources/config.yml).

## bStats
This plugin uses bStats to collect anonymous data about the server to help the development process. You can disable this feature in the `plugins/bStats/config.yml` file or by setting `enabled` to `false` in the `config.yml` file.

title: OctoComputing
description: A mod that adds realistic amounts of leaves when breaking leaf blocks, and "related" items
body:
# Leaf Mod
## The modifications to leaves
This mod makes it so that breaking a leaf block drops on average 125 leaves of that leaf type (so don't break too many leaves at one as that will cause lag). These leaves can be crafted into an armour/tool set which has very low durability, but the tools are fast. The leaves can also be crafted in a 3x3 with each other to make a compressed leaf, which is the same as the regular leaf but the tools are slightly better. The compressed leaf can also be used to craft saplings of that tree type. Compressed leaves can also be crafted in a 3x3 to make double compressed leaves.

When breaking any leaf block there is a 0.1% change that it drops a mystery leaf, these behave the same as regular leaves and can be used to make a mystery sapling using the sapling recipe.
The mystery tree grown from the mystery sapling currently does not do anything special and just provides a new wood type.

Crafting all 9 types of vanilla leaf items together in a crafting table gives a mixed leaf, which behaves the same as regular leaves but has some more recipes. This does not have a tree varient.

All regular leaves work as a furnace fuel for 1 tick, all compressed leaves work for 10 ticks, and all double compressed leaves work for 100 ticks.

## Why this is marked as cursed

This mod also adds a new ore called leaf ore which exists in a stone and deepslate varient. This ore can be mined to yeild a new resource called leafstone.

This mod also adds a new mob called the leaf monster which will spawn at night, it is neutral so does not attack unless attacked. This mob will drop one varient of mystery leaf and has a 1% chance to drop a leafite upgrade template, this template is used to upgrade netherite to leafite and can be duplicated with the vanilla recipe with a double compressed mystery leaf as its item

Taking an enchanted golden apple, 4 leafstone blocks, and 4 double compressed mixed leaves you can craft a token of the leaf god, an item used to summon the leaf god

The leaf god is a powerful boss based on the wither but more powerful that when killed will drop a broken leaf core

This broken leaf core can be repaired with 4 leafstone blocks and 4 double compressed mixed leaves.

The leaf core is used with the leafite upgrade template to upgrade netherite to leafite

## Enchantments
This mod adds 2 new enchantments; Garden Shears is a weapon enchantment which goes up to level 5, is incompatabile with other damage enchantments, and works like smite but deals extra damage to leaf type enemies.
The other enchantment is Leaf Protection, which is an armour enchantment which goes up to level 4, is incompatable with other protection enchantments, and worked like blast protection but protects from leaf damage instead.

# Mod Integration:
If geckolib is installed the leaf core will have a spinning animation

title: Ethereal Tomes
description: Ethereal Tomes is a mod that introduces a mana system and magical tomes into your game. These tomes offer various magical abilities and effects.
body:
# Ethereal Tomes

Ethereal Tomes is a mystical mod that weaves the very essence of magic into your gameplay experience. Step into your Minecraft world with these magical tomes that prove invaluable in many situations, including combat.

This mod introduces a Mana System with two variants: **Mana** and **Ethereal Mana**. While Mana is self-explanatory, Ethereal Mana is an advanced type of mana that regenerates exclusively near Ethereal Crystals. When it starts to regenerate, brace yourself for the influx of massive amounts of Ethereal Mana, accompanied by increased normal mana regeneration. Ethereal Mana has a remarkably high cap, so you can collect abundant amounts without the worry of it randomly draining during battles!

As the name suggests, Ethereal Tomes take center stage alongside the regular tomes. These extraordinary books are mostly upgraded or completely new and powerful versions of existing tomes. Ethereal Tomes can utilize both your normal mana and ethereal mana, or solely rely on the ethereal mana's potent energy.

In addition, the mod introduces a few more items:

- **Ambrosia**: Increases your Max Mana.
- **Ethereal Stone**: Enhances the Mana Regeneration Bonus. (both Normal and Ethereal Mana.)
- **Mana Orb**: Replenishes a small amount of mana, proving handy when your mana supply is low.

<sub>This mod is exclusive to my Modrinth profile.</sub>

title: DK RTP
description: DK RTP is a simple random teleport plugin with a GUI for easy world management.
body:
**DK_RTP** is a simple and configurable random teleport plugin for Spigot servers. It allows players to teleport to a safe and random location within their current world, featuring a cooldown to prevent overuse.
The plugin's key feature is its graphical user interface (GUI), which allows administrators to easily enable or disable the RTP function in each server world with just a few clicks, without needing to manually edit configuration files.
### Commands
*   `/rtp`
    *   **Function:** Teleports the player to a random coordinate in the current world.
    *   **Permission:** None (available to all players).
*   `/dkrtp`
    *   **Function:** An alternative command (alias) for `/rtp`. It performs the exact same action.
    *   **Permission:** None.
*   `/dkrtpconfig`
    *   **Function:** Opens a graphical interface (GUI) that lists all server worlds. Clicking on a world's icon enables or disables RTP for that world.
    *   **Permission:** `dkrtp.admin`
### Permissions
*   `dkrtp.admin`
    *   **Description:** Grants access to the `/dkrtpconfig` command to manage the plugin's settings. Essential for server administrators.
* 
file where you can adjust the cooldown time:
*   **`rtp-cooldown-seconds`**: Sets the time in seconds a player must wait between each use of the `/rtp` command. The default value is `60` seconds.
