title: Satisfactory Planner
description: A client-side utility mod that adds a fully interactive, Satisfactory-style project planner. See a complete crafting tree, track required resources against your inventory, and manage your building goals directly in-game.
body:
Tired of alt-tabbing to a wiki or scribbling notes for complex recipes from your favorite tech mods? **Satisfactory Planner** brings the powerful and intuitive project management UI from Satisfactory directly into Minecraft!

This is a client-side mod that adds a dynamic, on-screen HUD to help you plan, track, and execute your crafting projects, from a single piston to an entire factory.

## ✨ Features
*   **Dynamic Crafting Tree HUD:** An elegant, on-screen display shows you a complete, multi-level tree of all ingredients required for your chosen item.
*   **Real-Time Tracking:** The HUD automatically checks your inventory and updates in real-time, showing you exactly what you have and what you still need (`11/64 Cobblestone`). Completed items are marked with a green check!
*   **Interactive Planning Manager:** Press a key (`K` by default) to open a dedicated screen where you can:
    *   Change the target amount of items to craft using `[+]` and `[-]` buttons.
    *   Manually type in the exact number you need (e.g., `1024`).
    *   Remove projects you no longer need.
*   **Seamless EMI Integration:** Simply hover over any item in the EMI item list and press `P` to add it to your plan. It also works with items in your inventory!
*   **Persistence:** Your project list is automatically saved when you close the game and reloaded when you join a world.
*   **Broad Recipe Support:** Supports standard crafting table recipes as well as Furnace, Blast Furnace, and Smoker recipes.

## 🎮 How to Use
*   **Adding a Recipe:** Hover over an item in your inventory or the EMI list and press **P**.
*   **Managing Your List:** Press **K** to open the Planning Manager. Here you can change amounts or delete projects.
*   **Clearing the List:** Press **O** to remove all active projects from the HUD.

## ⚙️ Dependencies
*   **Required:** **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.1.
*   **Highly Recommended:** **EMI** (to add recipes directly from the item list).

---
*This mod was created with the help of an AI assistant. It's a journey from a simple idea to a fully functional tool. We hope you find it useful!*

title: 🕑Waiting Screen🕒
description: Player Waiting Screen Plugin
body:
# 🕒 Waiting Screen Plugin – BossBar & Titles! 🏆

Give your server a professional touch with a waiting screen system that is fully customizable! This plugin manages player waiting before a game or event, featuring an attractive and configurable visual interface.

---

## ✨ Features  

- **📊 Custom BossBar** – Personalize the BossBar with colors, styles, and custom messages.  
- **🏆 Titles & Subtitles** – Display customizable messages with adjustable timing.  
- **⬆️ Dynamic BossBar** – The BossBar updates as players join (only counts non-OP players).  
- **💫 Effects** – Apply potion effects to players while they wait, configurable in `config.yml`.  
- **🔊 Sounds** – Play sound effects when players join or leave the waiting list.  
- **🚷 Movement Restriction** – Enable or disable player movement while in the waiting screen.  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration  

The plugin includes a `config.yml` file where you can customize:  

- 🎨 **BossBar colors and styles**  
- 🏆 **Title and Subtitle messages**  
- ⏳ **Potion effects and duration**  
- 🔊 **Entry and exit sounds**  
- 🚷 **Allow or block player movement** 

---

## 🛠️ Commands

This plugin includes the following commands to help you manage the waiting screen system:

---

### **/waitingscreen**

- **Description**: Shows the list of available commands.  
- **Usage**:  
  - `/waitingscreen` – Displays all the available commands for managing the waiting screen.

---

### **/toggleWaitScreen**

- **Description**: Toggles the waiting screen on or off.  
- **Usage**:  
  - `/toggleWaitScreen` – Activates or deactivates the waiting screen manually.

---

## 🎃 Carved Pumpkin Feature
You can customize the carved pumpkin by adding a custom image. Supported resolutions: 16x16, 32x32, 64x64, 128x128, and 256x256.
We recommend using 64x64, 128x128, or 256x256 for better quality. 🖼️

## 🛠️ How to Use the Texture Pack?
Go to the misc folder inside your texture pack.

Replace the default image with your own custom image.

Rename your image to: pumpkinblur.png 🏷️

You can send the texture pack to your friends so they can install it manually, or set it up directly on your server. 🌍

title: Ru - AutoTranslate | АвтоПереводчик

body:
Говори с Minecraft по-русски!

Представьте: вы запускаете любимый модпак на старенькой 1.7.10, полный крутых машин, предметов, книг, оружий, но весь текст — сплошной английский.
Знакомьтесь — Мод Ru - Автопереводчик! Это ваш личный интерпретатор для Minecraft, который делает игру с модами доступной и удобной.

~ Он не просто переводит слова — он учитывает цвета, переносы и помогает вам, если вы плохо разбираетесь в английском языке.

- GUI-окно мода: В вашем мире нажмите F6 — откроется главное меню мода, где вы можете включить то, что вам нужно!
  ![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a36c34b84e93430946f04acd2edd3de6a9ca2db_0.webp)
- Умные переводы GUI, предметов и чата: Кнопки, чат, названия блоков, подсказки — всё на русском языке.
- Мод запоминает переводы в кеш, так что повторно не дергает API.
- Мгновенный перевод экрана: Нужен экранный переводчик без GUI? Нажмите F7 — и весь текст в игре (от меню до чата) превратится в русский. Цвета, отступы и рамки тултипов подстроятся идеально. Индикатор [RU] в правом верхнем углу напомнит, что магия работает!
- Суперподдержка HBM/NTM: Полные мануалы великого HBM/NTM переводятся целиком. Руководства HBM подхватываются сразу при запуске игры и переводятся один за одним в фоне, не мешая вам, а при входе в игру вы получаете супер-классные русские мануалы HBM. Такая реализация была сделана из-за особенностей рендера мода.

Факт: в старых модпаках вроде тех, что на 1.7.10, 80% контента на английском, и Ru помогает с этим.

Примеры работы мода:
![Original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64c3fd009967856f14f5418ebfa33109296fdf47.jpeg)![Translated](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33ccae24224ee3a5d72d0b62fdc12038d04bb8b8.jpeg)![Original HBM](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ec281985ed73efbffe5bc2c261b507951acd9ce_0.webp)![Translated HBM](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56cd8c310924cbfe342eca1322030f123da51f55_0.webp)![Tooltip Original](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4ade7a9e639d359a93204afaecb58a820f8f4fc_0.webp)![Tooltip Translated](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ce5acf8e87f0c63e0d648600de5c1fd8c843b6a_0.webp)


##
- Использует Google API
- Зависимостей нет
- Поддерживает все моды, никаких конфликтов!
- Переводит ТОЛЬКО с Английского на Русский
- Вы можете сами отредактировать готовый перевод в файлах кеша, если вам нужно, при перезапуске Майнкрафта мод подтянет кеш.
##

Настройки сохраняются в конфиге — при следующем запуске всё как было.
Кеш переводов: появляется в папке AutoTranslation в главной директории вашего Minecraft.

English:

Speak Minecraft in Russian!

Imagine: you launch your favorite 1.7.10 modpack full of awesome machines, items, books, weapons—and all the text is English only.

Meet Ru – AutoTranslator! Your personal interpreter for Minecraft that makes modded gameplay accessible and convenient.

~ It doesn’t just swap words—it preserves colors, line breaks, and helps when your English is rusty.

- Mod GUI: In your world press F6 to open the main menu and enable exactly what you need.
- Smart GUI/item translations: Buttons, block names, tooltips—everything in Russian.
- Caching: It remembers translations, so it doesn’t hit the API repeatedly.
- Instant screen translation: Need on-the-fly translating without a GUI? Press F7—every bit of text (menus, chat) turns Russian. Colors, spacing, and tooltip boxes adjust perfectly. The [RU] indicator in the top-right reminds you the magic is on!
- HBM/NTM super-support: Full manuals are translated end-to-end. HBM guides load at game start and get translated one by one in the background; when you jump in, you have fully Russian HBM manuals. This is tailored to HBM’s rendering quirks.

Fact: In legacy modpacks like 1.7.10, ~80% of content is English—Ru helps with that.

##

- Uses Google API
- No dependencies
- Compatible with all mods—no conflicts!
- Translates ONLY from English to Russian
- You can edit cached translations yourself; on the next launch the mod will pick them up.

##

Settings persist in the config—next launch stays as you left it.

Translation cache: stored in the AutoTranslation folder in your Minecraft root.

Adds a new **Adrenaline** status effect that automatically triggers when your health drops to low HP, giving you a brief burst of power with a built-in cooldown.

![A screenshot showing the adrenaline effect.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5345ecc838a8d497d88e075734eff6dae0ca9407.png)

## Features

When Adrenaline activates, the player temporarily:

* Moves faster
* Jumps slightly higher
* Attacks and mines more quickly

After Adrenaline wears off, a **cooldown** prevents it from triggering again immediately, so it cannot be abused in continuous combat.

## Why use this mod?

* Adds a simple, intuitive “last chance” mechanic for combat and exploration
* Makes low-health situations more dynamic and skill-based
* Fits naturally into vanilla gameplay without adding new items or complicated systems
* I recommend using this mod in an ultra hardcore world!

## Important details

* Adrenaline only activates at low health
* The effect is temporary and controlled by a cooldown
* Designed as a lightweight gameplay tweak that can be dropped into most modpacks without major changes to progression

title: Extreme Lives
description: This mod is based on the Minecraft Extremo series, bringing everything you need to recreate that intense experience in your own world or server.
body:
# Extreme Lives – Fully Customizable Lives, Timer and PVP System

---

## Overview
Extreme Lives adds a complete system to manage player lives, daily time limits, and PVP toggling, all displayed through scoreboards or HUD elements that are fully customizable.  
Perfect for hardcore servers, PVP events, or survival challenges, this mod combines management, aesthetics, and total control for both players and administrators.

![Vista previa del scoreboard a la derecha](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ab85b5ebad48e1df8c91ea6dc95e54ef46e2159.jpeg)

---

## Main Features

### Lives System
Each player has a visible life counter.  
You can manage it using:
```
/lives (add | reset | resetall | set) (player)
```
Fully compatible with multiplayer servers.

![command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f638cbc5f19bfc654a1909a729611948a254fd11.jpeg)
![command2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12b5e1d7f837f27a9f86529cb84f78bb4a8ea726.jpeg)

---

### Daily Time Limit
Adds a daily configurable timer controlled through the `config.json` file.  
When the timer reaches 0, the player is not kicked, but a global message is sent announcing that their time has expired for the day.  
It resets automatically every new day.  
Ideal for daily-limited events or hardcore worlds.

---

### PVP Control (Admin Feature)
Administrators can enable or disable PVP globally with a single command.  
Useful for tournaments or special events.  
Includes custom sound feedback when the PVP state changes.

![command3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da24c8f8814f81372484cf07d3be8683167f511a_0.webp)


---

### Death Animation and Global Sound
When a player dies:
- A death animation plays on that player (soon to be customizable).
- A death sound is broadcasted to all players in the world.

Recommended gamerule for best experience:
```
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
```
to skip the death screen and see the full animation.  
The global death message is fully customizable.

![deathAnimation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23aff2df9bf86211947e63496da7389d7b382b94.jpeg)


---

## Configuration Example (mcextremo/config.json)

All HUD and visual display options can be customized inside `config.json`.  
Default configuration:

```json
"display": {
  "useScoreboard": true,
  "useBossBarVisual": false,
  "useTimeHud": false,
  "useLivesHud": false,
  "useTextShadow": true,
  "useHudBackground": true
}
```



---

# Extreme Lives – Sistema de Vidas, Tiempo y PVP Personalizable

---

## Descripción General
Extreme Lives añade un sistema completo para gestionar vidas, tiempo límite diario y activación o desactivación del PVP, todo visible mediante scoreboards o HUD personalizables.  
Perfecto para servidores hardcore, eventos PVP o retos de supervivencia, este mod combina gestión, estética y control total para jugadores y administradores.

![Vista previa del scoreboard a la derecha](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ab85b5ebad48e1df8c91ea6dc95e54ef46e2159.jpeg)

---

## Características Principales

### Sistema de Vidas
Cada jugador tiene un contador visible de vidas.  
Puedes gestionarlo usando:
```
/lives (add | reset | resetall | set) (jugador)
```
Totalmente compatible con servidores multijugador.

![command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f638cbc5f19bfc654a1909a729611948a254fd11.jpeg)
![command2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12b5e1d7f837f27a9f86529cb84f78bb4a8ea726.jpeg)!

---

### Límite de Tiempo Diario
Incluye un temporizador configurable diario que puede activarse o desactivarse desde el archivo `config.json`.  
Al llegar a 0, el jugador no es expulsado, pero se envía un mensaje global indicando que su tiempo ha terminado por hoy.  
El tiempo se reinicia automáticamente al iniciar un nuevo día.  
Ideal para servidores hardcore o desafíos por tiempo.

---

### Control de PVP (para Administradores)
Permite activar o desactivar el PVP globalmente con un solo comando.  
Útil para torneos o eventos controlados.  
Incluye efectos de sonido personalizados al cambiar el estado del PVP.

[command3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da24c8f8814f81372484cf07d3be8683167f511a_0.webp)

---

### Animación de Muerte y Sonido Global
Cuando un jugador muere:
- Se activa una animación visual de muerte (próximamente customizable).
- Se reproduce un sonido de muerte para todos los jugadores en el mundo.

Recomendado usar:
```
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
```
para saltar la pantalla de muerte y ver la animación completa.  
El mensaje de muerte es global y totalmente editable.

![deathAnimation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23aff2df9bf86211947e63496da7389d7b382b94.jpeg)

---

## Configuración (mcextremo/config.json)

Todas las opciones visuales se configuran dentro del archivo `config.json`.  
Configuración por defecto:

```json
"display": {
  "useScoreboard": true,
  "useBossBarVisual": false,
  "useTimeHud": false,
  "useLivesHud": false,
  "useTextShadow": true,
  "useHudBackground": true
}
```

title: Dypsis
description: Targeted, effective optimizations for 1.12.2
body:
# Dypsis

Dypsis is an optimization mod with a focus on improving client-side rendering performance. It contains both improvements for vanilla and targeted optimizations for mods.

### Vanilla

- **Framebuffer Optimization Strategy**
  - **Conservative** mode optimizes framebuffer blitting with a more efficient method.
  - **Aggressive** mode makes the game directly render to the default framebuffer to skip the blitting process altogether.
- **HUD Batching**: Draw HUD elements in batches to improve performance.
- **Smart Entity Outline Rendering**: Skips entity outline (a.k.a. glowing effect) rendering when there is no entity visible with outline.

### Mods

- **Ender IO**: Batched rendering for conduits, significantly improves performance when you have a handful of conduits in the world.
- **The One Probe**: Skips redundant GL calls.

### Advanced

- **(WIP) Modern Rendering Pipeline**: Very experimental and immature replacement of the vertex array usage in Tessellator. Utilizes VAO and DSA to improve performance.

title: MinuteMessage
description: A multi-language Minecraft scheduled messaging plugin。
body:
# MinuteMessage

A multilingual timed message plugin for Minecraft servers.

## Features

- 🌏 Multi-language support
- ⏰ Custom message intervals
- 🎯 Multiple message types (Console, Chat, Broadcast, World)
- 🔄 Version update checker
- 🎨 Color codes and line breaks support
- 👋 Player join/quit messages
- 🌍 Dimension change notifications

## Status

- Under development
- If you want to submit more language translations, please submit a PR.

## Usage

### Commands

- `/mm reload` - Reload configuration
- `/mm list` - View all message groups
- `/mm interval <group> <minutes>` - Set message interval
- `/mm toggle join` - Toggle join messages
- `/mm toggle quit` - Toggle quit messages
- `/mm toggle dimension` - Toggle dimension change messages

### Permissions

- `minutemessage.admin` - Admin permission

### Configuration 
```yml
# MinuteMessage Configuration File
# Plugin Version: 1.0.0
# Author: 柠枺

# ========================
# Basic Settings
# ========================
settings:
  # Whether to check for updates
  check-update: true
  # Default language (currently supports: zh_CN)
  language: 'zh_CN'
  # Player-related message settings
  player:
    # Player join message
    join:
      enabled: false
      # Whether to broadcast to other players
      broadcast: true
      message: '&aWelcome &f%player_name% &a to the server!'
    # Player quit message
    quit:
      enabled: false
      # Whether to broadcast to other players
      broadcast: true
      message: '&ePlayer &f%player_name% &e has left the server'
    # Dimension switch message
    dimension:
      enabled: false
      # Whether to broadcast to other players
      broadcast: false
      messages:
        to_nether: '&c>> You have entered the Nether'
        to_end: '&5>> You have entered the End'
        to_overworld: '&2>> You have returned to the Overworld'

# ========================
# Message Group Configuration
# ========================
# Configuration format description:
# messages:
#   <message group name>:
#     interval: <send interval (minutes)>
#     type: <message type>
#     worlds: [list of world names]  # Only needed when type: WORLD
#     content: [list of message content]
#
# Message type (type) description:
# - CONSOLE: Displayed only in the console
# - CHAT: Sent to all players
# - BROADCAST: Server-wide broadcast
# - WORLD: Specific world broadcast
#
# Supported formats:
# - Color codes: &a, &b, &c, etc.
# - New line character: \n
# - PlaceholderAPI variables: %player_name%, etc.
# ========================

messages:
  # Welcome message example
  welcome:
    interval: 15  # Sent every 15 minutes
    type: BROADCAST
    content:
      - '&aWelcome to the server!\n&bCurrent online players: %server_online%'
      - '&eThank you for playing on our server!'
  
  # Rules reminder example
  rules:
    interval: 30  # Sent every 30 minutes
    type: CHAT
    content:
      - '&6=== Server Rules ===\n&f1. No cheating clients\n&f2. No malicious destruction\n&f3. Please get along with other players'
  
  # World notice example
  world_notice:
    interval: 45  # Sent every 45 minutes
    type: WORLD
    worlds: 
      - 'world'
      - 'world_nether'
    content:
      - '&bThis message is only displayed in the Overworld and the Nether'

# ========================
# Command Description
# ========================
# /mm reload - Reload configuration
# /mm list - View all message groups
# /mm interval <group name> <minutes> - Set message interval
#
# Permission nodes:
# minutemessage.admin - Admin permissions
# ========================

# ========================
# PlaceholderAPI Variable Examples
# ========================
# %server_online% - Number of online players
# %server_max_players% - Maximum number of players
# %player_name% - Player name
# %player_world% - Player's current world
# For more variables, please visit: https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/wiki/Placeholders
# ========================

```

## Installation

1. Download the latest version
2. Place the plugin in your server's plugins folder
3. Restart server or reload plugin

## Dependencies

- Spigot/Paper 1.20.1+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional)

## Roadmap

- [x] Basic message system
- [x] Multi-language support
- [x] Player event messages
- [ ] PlaceholderAPI support fix
- [ ] More message types
- [ ] Message template system

## Contributing

Issues and Pull Requests are welcome!

title: Drop In
description: A modpack with the aim of being a drop-in replacement for Vanilla minecraft.
body: # Drop In ![Affiliate](https://i.imgur.com/1O8Piaf.png)\ A modpack with the aim of being a drop-in replacement for Vanilla minecraft, in a similar way to OptiFine. Drop In significantly enhances the performance of the game (including the stuttering), adds almost all of OptiFine's features, fixes some aspects of the game (bugs, for example), and makes some things overall prettier! ### Features - Almost all of OptiFine's features (CIT, capes, zoom, etc...) - Stuttering highly dampened - FPS significantly increased - Loading times / memory usage significantly decreased - Blink-and-you'll-miss-it fast chunk generation - Network performance increased - Shader support (Drop In comes pre-installed with [Miniature Shader](https://modrinth.com/shader/miniature-shader) as an optional low-impact shader) - Highly customizable LAN that can be shared to anyone inside/outside your network - Bug fixes / General fixes - Dynamic Lights - Bushy Leaves (that are highly performant - the performance impact is negligible) - Some aspects have been prettied up (leaves / animations) ### Upcoming features: - Huge performance increase on Nvdia GPUs (thanks to Nvidium) - Perfect biome blend with no performance impact (using something like [Better Biome Reblend](https://modrinth.com/mod/bbrb)) [Mod list](https://modrinth.com/modpack/drop-in/version/ALPHA-1) Basically, the aim of this is to have a drop-in (hence the name) replacement for vanilla minecraft that keeps the game like it is now, while simply trying to fixing all of it's shortcomings.

description: Spellcasting In Minecraft (Created for the Magic PvP event on PlanetMinecraft)
body:
This Datapack was made for the PMC Magic PvP Event, and requires the most recent version of the Magic PvP Framework by Bertiecrafter﻿

This Datapack adds 9 Spells to be used in the Magic PvP Event!

Icon Name Description
Fireball Damages hit enemy target with fire damage.
Snowball Damages hit enemy target with ice damage.
Toxic Fangs Damages hit enemy target with toxic damage.
Zap Damages hit enemy target with electric damage.
Noxious Cyclone Summons a cyclone that pulls any enemies within range towards it for a short time. Enemies within the cyclone slowly take toxic damage.
Magnetic Pull Pulls hit target towards the user. If the hit location is a block, it pulls the user towards it.
Thunderclap Teleports the user to the target location, dealing electric damage to pierced enemy targets and resets cooldowns on the user's other spells.
Meteor Summons a meteor that lands on the executed area dealing fire damage to enemy targets within range. Hit targets are ignited.
Lightning Bolt Summons a lightning bolt that lands on the executed area dealing electric damage to enemy targets within range twice. On first hit, targets are stunned.

  1. Use /loot give @s loot bertiecrafter:mpp/wand to obtain a wand (It's called a Spell Book in Magicka).
  2. Place the wand in the offhand slot.
  3. Use /function bertiecrafter:mpp/items/spawn_chest to spawn a chest with all the loaded spells in the direction you're looking.
  4. Take spells from the chest and place them in your Hotbar.
  5. Right-click while a spell is selected in your Hotbar to use it.

DanMizu©

title: Body Health
description: Life in every part of the body.
body:
# 🫀 Body Health System

**NeoForge 1.21.1 · v12.3.4**

Tired of a single health bar? **Body Health System** replaces Minecraft's vanilla health with a full localized injury system — every part of your body can be wounded, fractured, or destroyed independently.

---

## ⚙️ How it works

Each attack targets a specific body part based on impact height and trajectory. An arrow to the head deals 1.5× damage and counts against head HP — not a shared pool. Every part has its own hearts, its own fracture state, and its own consequences.

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| Body parts | 6 |
| Fracture states | 4 |
| Medical items | 3 |
| Version | 12.0.3 |

---

## 🦴 Fracture system

Parts move through four states:

**Healthy → Sprained → Broken → Shattered**

Each state brings real consequences. Broken legs slow you down, a shattered torso is immediately lethal. Fractures heal naturally over time or faster with the right items.

---

## ⚡ Consequences per part

| Part | Effect when damaged |
|---|---|
| **Head** | Nausea (vision trouble) |
| **Torso** | Death at 0 HP |
| **Right arm** | Cannot break or place blocks |
| **Left arm** | Drops offhand item when destroyed |
| **Legs** | Slowness — worse as fracture progresses |

> All debuffs are silent — no visible effect icons, only action bar messages so your HUD stays clean.

---

## 💊 Medical items

### 🩹 Bandage
**Craft:** White Wool + String (×4)

Heals the most injured part and improves its fracture state by one level. Works on Sprained and Broken — not on Shattered.

### 🏥 Medical Kit
**Craft:** Bandages + Chest + Gold Ingots

Heals all parts and can fix even Shattered bones. The only way to recover from a destroyed limb.

### 💉 Morphine Syringe
**Craft:** Glass + Blaze Powder + Iron Ingot (×2)

Suppresses all pain effects for 30 seconds. Use sparingly — overdose triggers after 3 doses and causes blindness, nausea and poison.

---

## ❤️ Absorption hearts

Golden apples and Enchanted golden apples grant yellow absorption hearts on the most injured part. The Totem of Undying grants 2 extra hearts on the torso when it activates. Absorption is consumed before HP when that part takes damage.

---

## 🛡️ Enchantment support

Since the vanilla health bar is hidden and health is managed separately, all protection enchantments are applied manually per hit:

- **Protection** — 4% reduction per level (all damage)
- **Fire Protection** — 8% per level (fire/lava)
- **Blast Protection** — 8% per level (explosions)
- **Projectile Protection** — 8% per level (arrows)
- **Feather Falling** — 12% per level on legs only
- **Slow Falling** (potion) — cancels all fall damage on legs
- **Resistance** (potion) — 20% per level, level 5 = immunity

---

## 🖥️ HUD

A custom pixel-art panel in the **bottom-right corner** displays:

- Your character assembled from 6 individual sprites, each colored independently:
  - 🟢 Green = healthy (>65%)
  - 🟠 Orange = injured (35–65%)
  - 🔴 Red = critical (1–34%)
  - ⚫ Black = destroyed (0%)
- Each part's hearts next to its label
- Fracture icons next to the hearts when applicable
- Yellow absorption hearts shown in surplus after the red hearts

---

## 🧰 Admin commands

```
/bodyhealth heal <player> [part]      — Heals a part or all parts
/bodyhealth set <player> <part> <hp>  — Sets HP directly
/bodyhealth setmax <player> <part> <hp> — Sets max HP
/bodyhealth addhearts <player> <n>    — Adds n hearts everywhere
/bodyhealth fracture <player> <part> <state> — Sets fracture state
/bodyhealth status <player>           — Shows full health status
/bodyhealth reset <player>            — Resets to default
```

---

## 👨‍💻 Developer API

Full Java API available via `BodyHealthAPI`:

```java
// Read
float hp  = BodyHealthAPI.getHealth(player, BodyPart.HEAD);
boolean dead = BodyHealthAPI.isDead(player, BodyPart.TORSO);
FractureState fr = BodyHealthAPI.getFracture(player, BodyPart.LEG_LEFT);

// Write
BodyHealthAPI.heal(player, BodyPart.HEAD, 4f);
BodyHealthAPI.damage(player, BodyPart.TORSO, 2f);
BodyHealthAPI.fullHeal(player);
BodyHealthAPI.addMaxHealthAll(player, 4f); // +2 hearts everywhere
BodyHealthAPI.setFracture(player, BodyPart.ARM_RIGHT, FractureState.BROKEN);
```

A **MCreator plugin** is also available with 13 visual procedure blocks — no Java required.

---

## ✅ Compatibility

- Works with any mod using standard NeoForge damage events
- Food from third-party mods heals via `FoodProperties` automatically
- The Totem of Undying is fully supported
- **Requires:** NeoForge 21.1.172+ · Minecraft 1.21.1

title: Project - New Wind
description: A comprehensive gameplay overhaul featuring dynamic enemy AI, role-based daily routines for villagers, overhauled health regeneration, and new materials to counter the revamped undead mechanics.
body:
# **Project — New Wind**

Breathe life back into your survival experience.

Hey there! If you're looking for a mod that just makes mobs hit harder and inflates their health, this isn't it. New Wind is a systemic overhaul born from a simple idea: Minecraft's world should feel logical, reactive, and alive.

Instead of artificial difficulty, this mod reimagines familiar mechanics to make you think differently about how you survive, fight, and interact with the world.

### **A World That Makes Sense**

The rules of the night have changed. The Overworld surface is entirely safe from monsters — until the pitch-black sky of a New Moon allows them to rise. During these dark nights, the world becomes even more reactive to its environment: you'll encounter Husks wandering the scorching deserts and Strays haunting the frozen tundras, with these regional variants even trickling down into the caverns below. Even the animals follow logic now, forming herds in their native biomes and wandering alone elsewhere.

### **The Undead & Tactical Foes**

Combat requires preparation, not just clicking. The undead finally live up to their name: striking them down only forces them into a regenerative "Stasis." To grant them a true death, you must exploit their weaknesses using fire, _holy_ magic, or newly forged Silver weaponry, and specific alchemical items.

Your enemies are also smarter. Skeletons, Piglins, and Illagers will dynamically swap between swords and bows depending on how close you are. They will retreat, drink potions to heal or buff themselves, and use actual tactics to survive your encounters. You will also face a creeping Infestation—a parasitic blight dropped by diseased zombies that will actively spread and summon reinforcements if left unchecked.

Illagers take this a step further, fighting as a highly coordinated army. Vindicators will gulp down buff potions before charging, Pillagers use invisibility to retreat when sniped, and Evokers will seamlessly teleport to swap places with their allies if you get too close. Raid Captains now sound their horns to empower nearby troops, Ravagers enter a frenzied rage when near death, and the forgotten Illusioner finally joins the later waves of village raids. Even outside of combat, you’ll catch injured Illagers actively treating their wounds to prepare for your next strike.

### **Thriving Communities**

Villages are no longer just lifeless trading hubs. Villagers are active participants in their society. Clerics act as true healers, patching up the wounded and performing exorcisms to purge the Infestation from their borders. Blacksmiths physically repair damaged Iron Golems at their anvils. Fishermen actually fish. They eat, they sleep, and if their community thrives, they’ll reward you with daily economic buffs.

### **Alchemy, Salt, and Survival**

Survival feels more grounded. You can mine Silver to forge anti-undead gear, or harvest Fossil Salt and corrosive Brine geysers. Salt is incredibly versatile: use it to cook highly saturating meals, or pour lines of it on the ground to create physical, invisible barriers that the undead simply cannot cross.

Your survival kit has expanded with new alchemical concoctions, including specialized potions to resist the most lethal toxins or harness the decaying power of the Wither. These additions, coupled with a completely reworked health regeneration system, ensure that every choice matters.

Resting is no longer a simple way to skip the night. Your environment dictates your safety. Attempting to sleep in pitch-black darkness will leave you uneasy, while sleeping under the open stars is a gamble that may draw the attention of Phantoms from the sky. During a New Moon, the presence of monsters is felt much more keenly, making finding a truly secure, well-lit shelter a necessity rather than a suggestion.

Endgame survival and village defenses have also been entirely rebalanced. Totems of Undying are no longer handed out as standard raid loot, forcing you to earn your second chances elsewhere. Exploring End Ships will reward you with Corrupted Elytra, which are broken and unusable until you find a way to properly cleanse them. The classic pattern for building an Iron Golem no longer works. You'll have to experiment to discover the new method, but here's a hint — pay close attention to the core block right beneath the carved pumpkin.

### **Seamlessly Integrated**

I wanted this mod to feel native to your game. You won't need to read a wiki to understand it. A custom advancement tree guides you through the mechanics naturally, items have helpful tooltips, and the mod is fully integrated with **EMI** (featuring custom recipe types and guides). Plus, it is completely configurable and natively translated into 18 languages right out of the box _(English, Ukrainian, Polish, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, and many more)_.

This mod is free to use in modpacks and non-commercial projects.

body:
# 🌌 SquareIO Companion Pack | Official Client Modpack

[![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90f4d768b2404c60605d6755831c8403e0460dac_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/server/squareio-skyblock-infinit-server)

Welcome to the official client-side companion modpack for **SquareIO**, the ultimate unlimited, open-world Skyblock Infinite server! 

While SquareIO is built natively on a heavily customized server architecture that allows 100% vanilla clients to connect, using this official modpack unlocks the definitive multiplayer experience. It features seamless proximity voice chat, jaw-dropping performance optimizations, fluid animations, and vital client-side quality-of-life utilities.

---

## 🚀 Key Features of this Pack

### 🎙️ Immersive Proximity Voice Chat
* **Plasmo Voice:** Fully configured to hook straight into the server's dedicated voice ports. Talk seamlessly with your neighbors across the open void without needing third-party software. Press **`V`** in-game to set up your microphone!

### ⚡ Next-Gen Performance Suite (No OptiFine Needed)
* **Sodium:** Massive FPS multiplication using a completely rewritten modern rendering engine.
* **ImmediatelyFast & Entity Culling:** Drastically speeds up rendering for menus, text, HUD elements, particles, and hidden chests/mobs. Perfect for massive skyblock automated farms.
* **Dynamic FPS:** Automatically lowers resource usage when you alt-tab to check Discord or guides.

### 🎭 Visual & Animation Overhauls
* **Iris Shaders:** Full, seamless support for your favorite modern shader packs.
* **Not Enough Animations:** Syncs perfectly with the server to show smooth, realistic 3rd-person animations for eating, drinking, rowing, and more.
* **LambDynamicLights:** Items like torches and lanterns emit actual light in real-time while held in your hand or dropped on the floor.
* **Zoomify:** Smooth, customizable cinematic zoom transitions (replicates the classic `C` key feel).

### 🛠️ Quality of Life Utilities
* **Shulker Box Tooltip:** Preview Shulker box contents instantly by hovering and pressing `Shift`.
* **AppleSkin:** Visualizes exact hunger and saturation values directly on your food bar.
* **Inventory Profiles Next:** Sleek client-side inventory and chest sorting mechanics.
* **Axolotl Client Side:** Allows you to safely walk and navigate while looking in your inventory.

---

## 🌌 About the Server: SquareIO

SquareIO is a borderless, multiplayer world driven by Modrinth's revolutionary **Skyblock Infinite** progression mechanics. Instead of traditional bedrock box islands, travel across an endless void, build massive bridges, meet neighbors, and team up naturally.

* **♾️ Open-World Skyblock:** Fully seamless, infinite void exploration.
* **🏝️ 17 Unique Starter Islands:** Choose carefully from 17 distinct layouts to start your sky empire.
* **🌾 Dedicated Resource World:** A resettable `/resources` world so you never run out of blocks.
* **📈 Free In-Game Rankups:** 8 distinct, completely free gameplay tiers to unlock powerful utilities.
* **🤝 Vanilla Friendly:** Powered by Patbox's server-side mods, meaning un-modded vanilla friends can still join you any time.

---

## 🎮 How to Get Started

1. Click **Install** on this modpack inside the Modrinth App.
2. Launch the profile.
3. Head to **Multiplayer** -> **Add Server**, paste the SquareIO server IP, and connect!
4. Once inside, press **`V`** to configure your proximity chat settings, and type `/island` to start your Skyblock adventure!

# Overview
This mod adds Dynamic Trees compatibility for Still Life 1.0+.
This is a compatibility addon for Dynamic Trees, which adds dynamically growing trees to Minecraft. This addon adds dynamically growing trees from Dynamic Trees to another mod, Still Life, a mod that uses trees in new biomes. As it says in the title.
This mod does not add new content in any meaningful form. It adds compatibility between another mod, Dynamic Trees, that adds new content; and Still Life, a mod that uses that new content.
This is an addon for configuring Dynamic Trees so that Dynamic Tree's dynamic trees will grow in Still Life biomes.

title: Peekaboo!
description: Disguise as a mob, another player - or maybe just wear a Creeper on your head!
body:
# Peekaboo!
Disguise as a mob, another player - or maybe just wear a Creeper on your head! So stylish!

This mod is **creative-only** right now. 

## Items

### Disguise

Equippable in the head slot, this item replaces the wearer's player model with that of the Disguise item.

A player wearing a Pig Disguise looks just like a normal Pig, but with a player name tag.

![Player inventory menu, but the player has equipped a Chicken Disguise item in their head slot. The player appears to be a Chicken.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dac237477e8b2e694cb8bdefaef8fd4da465c48.png)

### Mob Hat

Equippable in the head slot, this item renders an entity model on the player's head.

![Player inventory menu, but the player has equipped a Frog Hat item in their head slot. The player has a Frog model on top of their head.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d3632a48715ec71e0338691cf17700d7dc7f098.png)

### Plushie

Just like a Mob Hat, but cannot be equipped.

## Commands

The only command added by _Peekaboo!_ is `/disguise`. This command modifies the Disguise of the source entity.

### `/disguise as <entity> [<nbt>]`

Disguises the source entity (`@s`) as the specified `entity` type argument, with optional additional entity data.

For example:

- `/disguise as minecraft:pig` - disguises as a plain Pig
- `/disguise as minecraft:creeper {powered:true}` - disguises as a Charged Creeper

### `/disguise skin as <player>`

Disguises the source player with the skin of the specified player name.

For example:

- `/disguise skin as Cojomax99` - replaces the source player's skin with that of Cojomax99
    - Note: this will only be visible if the source player is not already disguised as another entity

### `/disguise skin clear`

Clears the current skin disguise of the source player, if any is set.

### `/disguise name as <name>`

Replaces the source entity's custom name with the specified `name` Text Component.

For example:

- `/disguise name as "Dwight Schrute"`

### `/disguise name clear`

Clears the current custom name disguise of the source entity, if any is set.

### `/disguise scale <scale>`

Sets the scale modifier for the current disguise of the source entity.
`scale` is a float between `0.1` and `20.0`.

For example:

- `/disguise scale 0.5` - sized to 50% of normal scale
- `/disguise scale 1` - resets scale to normal

### `/disguise hideShadow <value>`

If `value` is `true`, the source entity will cast no shadow.

For example:

- `/disguise hideShadow true` - hides the source entity's shadow

### `/disguise clear`

Clears all currently applied disguise properties on the source entity, if any are set.

### Applying disguises to other entities

Any Living Entity (generally: entities with AI, Players, and Armor Stands) can be disguised.
`/execute as` can be used to disguise another entity.

For example:

- `/execute as @n[type=wolf] run disguise as sheep` - disguises the nearest Wolf as a Sheep

## Item Components

### `peekaboo:disguise`

A specification of the Disguise to be applied when equipping an item.

Format: object with fields:

- `entity` - optional entity data (same format as the `minecraft:entity_data` component), the entity disguise to apply
    - If not present, no entity disguise will be applied
- `scale` - optional float between `0.1` and `20.0`, the scale modifier to apply
    - Default: `1.0`
- `changes_size` - optional boolean, `true` if the disguise entity's bounding box should be inherited
    - Default: `true`
- `custom_name` - optional Text Component, the display name override (both in-world and in the Tab List) 
- `skin_profile` - optional profile data (same format as the `minecraft:profile` component), the player skin disguise to use
- `hide_shadow` - optional boolean, `true` if the entity's shadow should be hidden
    - Default: `false`
- e.g. `peekaboo:disguise={entity:{id:'minecraft:creeper',powered:true}}`
- e.g. `peekaboo:disguise={skin_profile:{name:'Cojomax99'},scale:1.5}`

### `peekaboo:entity`

A specification of the entity to be rendered for the Mob Hat and Plushie items.

Format: same as the `minecraft:entity_data` component

- e.g. `peekaboo:entity={id:'minecraft:creeper',powered:true}`

### `peekaboo:size`

A scale modifier for the rendering of Disguise, Mob Hat, or Plushie items.

Format: positive float
e.g. `peekaboo:size=1.5`

title: PotionEffects
description: This project improves the vanilla potion display.
body:
**PotionEffects**
PotionEffects replaces the default Minecraft status effect display with a cleaner, more informative HUD designed to keep you aware of your active effects at a glance.
Features

Clean icon boxes displayed on the left side of your screen, vertically centred
Timer displayed directly on the icon so you always know how long an effect lasts
Roman numerals on the icon for effects above level I, just like vanilla but better integrated
Low-time warning: the border, timer, and numerals all flash red when an effect is about to expire
Infinite effects show a ∞ symbol instead of a countdown
Replaces the vanilla effect display entirely for a distraction-free experience

**Customisation**
Open the settings screen at any time with the configurable keybind (default: K) to adjust:

Opacity — control how transparent the entire HUD is
Timer position — show the timer inside the icon box or to the right of it
Roman numerals — toggle effect level numerals on or off
Flash warning time — set how many seconds before expiry the flashing starts, or set it to 0 to disable flashing entirely

Settings are saved automatically and persist across sessions.

**Compatibility:**

Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Fabric API required

title: Restricted Inventory
description: Restrict player inventory slots to specific items or item tags. Configure which slots accept which items via JSON config — server-wide or per-client. Restricted slots display a visual preview of what belongs there.
body:
# Restricted Inventory

**Lock player inventory slots to specific items or item tags.**

Ever wanted to keep a dedicated slot for your sword, always have slot 0 as your torch, or enforce item organization across your server? Restricted Inventory lets you do exactly that — configure any inventory slot (0–35) to only accept a specific item or item tag, server-wide or per player.

## Features

- **Slot restrictions** — Lock any hotbar or inventory slot to a specific item (e.g. `minecraft:torch`) or an entire item tag (e.g. `#minecraft:swords`)
- **Server or per-client mode** — Apply the same rules to all players from the server config, or let each player define their own restrictions in their client config
- **Visual feedback** — Restricted slots display a ghost preview of the required item so players always know what goes where
- **Slot index overlay** — Hold **Tab** in any inventory screen to reveal each slot's index number, making config setup a breeze
- **Smart item routing** — Picked-up items automatically go to their designated slots first before filling unrestricted ones

## Commands

All commands use the `/restrictedinventory` prefix.

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/restrictedinventory config` | Opens the Restriction Config Screen | Admin (OP level 4), or any player when `useClientRestriction` is enabled |

### Permission rules

- When `useClientRestriction` is **false** (server-wide mode): only server operators (OP level 4) can open the config screen.
- When `useClientRestriction` is **true** (per-client mode): every player can open their own config screen.

## Restriction Config Screen

The config screen is the in-game GUI for editing slot restrictions. Open it with `/restrictedinventory config`.

### Item / Tag picker (top panel)

- **Items tab** — lists every registered item at ¾ scale. Hover for the item name and registry ID. Click to select.
- **Tags tab** — lists every registered item tag. Each tag cycles through its members as a live preview. Hover for the tag ID. Click to select.
- Scroll with the mouse wheel or drag the scrollbar on the right.

### Slot grid (middle panel)

- Displays all 36 player inventory slots (0–35) laid out in the standard inventory arrangement.
- Each slot shows a cycling preview of its current restriction, or is empty if unrestricted.
- Left-Click a slot to **select** it (highlighted in white). The selected slot will receive the item or tag chosen in the picker.
- Right-Click a slot to remove the item or tag chosen.
- Hover a slot to see its current restriction value as a tooltip.

## Configuration

Restrictions are defined in a simple JSON config file. Both specific items and item tags are supported.

```json
{
  "useClientRestriction": false,
  "restrictedSlots": {
    "0": "minecraft:torch",
    "1": "#minecraft:swords",
    "8": "minecraft:totem_of_undying"
  }
}
```

| Slot range | Location |
|------------|----------|
| 0–8 | Hotbar (survival mode only) |
| 9–35 | Main inventory |

> **Note:** Slot indices 0–8 correspond to the hotbar in survival mode. In creative mode, the hotbar uses a different inventory layout and slot restrictions will **not** apply there.

## Compatibility Note

This mod hooks into vanilla's slot placement and item pickup logic via Mixin. Mods or block entities that insert items directly into the player inventory (bypassing standard slot logic) may not respect the restrictions. Mods that also modify `Slot`, `Inventory`, or `AbstractContainerScreen` may conflict.

title: Vanilla Trees
description: Adds gamerules to enable vanilla tree growth
body:
Adds two gamerules to enable and control vanilla sapling growth.
This mod is only intended to be used to restore vanilla sapling growth when playing with other mods or datapacks that override the default `minecraft/worldgen/configured_feature`s for trees.

## Gamerules
- `/gamerule doVanillaTreeGrowthAlways [true/false]`
  - Default Value: `false`
  - if `true`, all saplings will use the vanilla tree generators when growing
- `/gamerule doDispensersForceVanillaTreeGrowth [true/false]`
  - Default Value: `true`
  - if `true`, if there is a Dispenser block adjacent to a sapling when it grows, it will use the vanilla tree generator. If there is not a dispenser, it will use the behavior defined in gamerule `doVanillaTreeGrowthAlways`


## Known Compatibility
- [Still Life](https://modrinth.com/datapack/still-life)
  - Still life has several custom tree generators that override the vanilla tree generator.

## Not Needed
The following datapacks do not require this mod
- [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith)
- [Blooming Biosphere](https://modrinth.com/datapack/blooming-biosphere)

title: SCP-027, The Vermin God
description: An anomalous effect that spreads an infestation of vermin.
body:
The Vermin God adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-027, also known as the Vermin God.


SCP-027 is a phenomenon bound to a single host. Those afflicted by the effect become surrounded by swarms of insects and vermin that grow increasingly dangerous over time. The infestation progresses through three stages, each summoning more aggressive creatures. The curse can spread to nearby players or villagers upon death, ensuring that the plague of vermin never truly ends.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

● Visit my Discord Server!
[https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ](https://discord.gg/akP56NtmVQ)



● Important FaQ

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-027 spawn?

SCP-027 does not spawn naturally. Instead, you have to find a corpse that can spawn in caves like a normal monster. However, there can only be one host for SCP-027.

► Can I contain SCP-027

Yes, you can contain SCP-027. You will need a host for SCP-027 to contain it.

Build a 3x3 wide room with a large hole at the bottom which is filled with magma blocks, fire or lava to kill the vermin that spawns from the host. 3 blocks above the deadly trap should be a single glass pane or iron bar in the middle of the room, with no connection to the walls.

Place a boat on the block and trap a villager in it. Move the boat a bit to the side, so that it kinda floats above the trap, but is still on the block. The Villager needs to be the new SCP-027 host. To make that villager the next host, you will need to have the SCP-027 effect and die next to the villager, so that the effect spreads to the villager.

Now the upcoming vermin and insects from the SCP-027 should fall into the trap without attacking the current host. 

</details>



![SCP-027](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfef6b23a94f5698b274d735fd72061d19ff379.png)

SCP-027 is an anomalous effect that progresses through three stages. In Stage one, SCP-027 will cover the host in flies and dust particles. Sometimes, it will spawn cockroaches and maggots. In Stage two, it will also spawn worms and centepedes. The Host will also noticed a slowness effect within Stage two. In the final stage, rats and spiders will also appear, while the host gets a slowness, weakness and mining fatique effect. The vermin spawned by SCP-027 will only attack the host of SCP-027 within a 20 block range. If a host dies, the SCP-027 effect spreads to the nearest player or villager within 20 blocks, continuing the infestation.

 

- Config File not inculed.
- You are all allowed to use this mod in your modpacks!
- Do not port my mods without permission!

body:
# 🛡️ AWAWA’s Clan – The Official Clan Modpack

**AWAWA’s Clan** is the custom modpack created especially for members of the clan on *diosesmc.net*. Designed for smooth performance, clear communication, and clan unity, it enhances the gameplay experience while fully respecting the server’s rules.

⚡ **Optimized Performance**: Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Krypton, and ModernFix keep FPS high and gameplay stable.  

🎨 **Improved Visuals**: *Iris shaders (defaulted to Complementary Reimagined with custom settings)*, *Continuity*, *Enhanced Block Entities*, and *Chunks Fade In* make the world sharper, smoother, and more immersive.  

💬 **Focused Communication**: Blaze Chat enables better communication by filtering messages with whitelisted keywords. Toggle with **Z** to hide clutter and show only clan chat, private whispers, or important server messages.  

🗺️ **Exploration Tools**: Journeymap and Zoomify make navigation simple and precise.  

🛠️ **Interface Improvements**: BetterF3, Shulker Box Tooltip, More Chat History, and Debugify streamline your adventure.  

🔧 **Technical Minecraft**: The included **Redstone Tweaks** resource pack improves visibility and understanding of redstone and components, making technical builds easier to construct and master.  

✅ **Server-Friendly**: Every mod and adjustment has been carefully chosen to comply with *diosesmc.net* rules, ensuring fair play and stability.  

This pack is designed to strengthen clan unity, improve communication, and ensure every member enjoys a smooth, immersive, and rule-respecting journey on *diosesmc.net*.  


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🛡️ AWAWA’s Clan – El Modpack Oficial del Clan

**AWAWA’s Clan** es el modpack personalizado creado especialmente para los miembros del clan en *diosesmc.net*. Diseñado para un rendimiento fluido, una comunicación clara y unidad del clan, mejora la experiencia de juego respetando plenamente las reglas del servidor.

⚡ **Rendimiento Optimizado**: Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Krypton y ModernFix mantienen los FPS altos y el juego estable.  

🎨 **Visuales Mejorados**: *Iris shaders (por defecto Complementary Reimagined con configuraciones personalizadas)*, *Continuity*, *Enhanced Block Entities* y *Chunks Fade In* hacen que el mundo sea más nítido, fluido e inmersivo.  

💬 **Comunicación Enfocada**: Blaze Chat permite una mejor comunicación al filtrar mensajes con palabras clave autorizadas. Activa con **Z** para ocultar el ruido y mostrar solo el chat del clan, mensajes privados o información importante dentro del servidor.  

🗺️ **Herramientas de Exploración**: Journeymap y Zoomify hacen que la navegación sea sencilla y precisa.  

🛠️ **Mejoras de Interfaz**: BetterF3, Shulker Box Tooltip, More Chat History y Debugify agilizan tu aventura.  

🔧 **Minecraft Técnico**: El paquete de recursos **Redstone Tweaks** es incluido para mejorar la visibilidad y comprensión del redstone y componentes, facilitando la construcción.  

✅ **Compatible con el Servidor**: Cada mod y ajuste ha sido cuidadosamente elegido para cumplir con las reglas de *diosesmc.net*, garantizando un juego justo y estable.  

Este pack está diseñado para fortalecer la unidad del clan, mejorar la comunicación y asegurar que cada miembro disfrute de una experiencia fluida, inmersiva y respetuosa con las normas en *diosesmc.net*.

title: Simple Deathban
description: Simple Plugin that will Ban you if you Die
body:
# ☠️ DeathBan


DeathBan is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that **automatically bans players when they die** — perfect for hardcore events, UHC sessions, or any server where death should actually mean something.

---

## 🔥 What does it do?

When a player dies, they are **automatically kicked and banned Permament**. While banned, they see a clear message on the login screen telling them they died and must wait until an Admin unbans all Players.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic death bans** — Players are kicked after dying, then blocked from rejoining
- **Custom ban screen** — Banned players see a clear message explaining why they can't connect
- **Whitelist system** — Protect specific players (like admins or event staff) from ever getting banned on death
- **Manual unban** — Instantly unban a specific player with one command
- **Unban everyone at once** — Reset the entire event with a single `/deathban unbanall` — great for starting a new round
- **Toggle on/off** — Enable or disable the whole system at any time without restarting the server
- **Persistent bans** — Bans survive server restarts.

---

## 🛠️ Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/deathban toggle` | Turn the death ban system on or off |
| `/deathban whitelist add <player>` | Protect a player from death bans |
| `/deathban whitelist remove <player>` | Remove a player from the whitelist |
| `/deathban unban <player>` | Manually unban one specific player |
| `/deathban unbanall` | Instantly unban **all** currently banned players |

> All commands support **tab completion**, including auto-suggesting currently banned players for `/unban`.

---

## 🔒 Permissions

| Permission | Who needs it |
|---|---|
| `deathban.admin` | Required to use any `/deathban` command |

---

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download `Deathban-1.0..jar`
2. Place it in your `plugins/` folder
3. **Start the server**

## ⚙️ Configuration

The plugin generates a simple `config.yml` on first launch. It stores the on/off state, the whitelist, and all active bans. You don't need to edit it manually — everything can be managed in-game.

---

## 💡 Perfect for...

- **Hardcore events** — Run a weekend event where death means elimination
- **UHC servers** — Add real stakes to every encounter
- **SMP seasons** — Give your season a hardcore twist without switching game modes
- **Tournaments** — Automatically eliminate players who die, then reset the whole field for the next round with `unbanall`

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21+**
- A **Bukkit / Spigot / Paper** server

---

## 📝 Notes

- The whitelist is **UUID-based**, so players can't bypass it by changing their username
- No external dependencies — drop the `.jar` in and you're done

body:
# AntiLavaCast

![Anti](https://i.imgur.com/p9mElIQ.png)

Prevents high altitude lava placement to stop lava casting on Paper 1.21.x.

## Features
- Cancels lava bucket placement, flow or both if it is more than the configured height above natural ground.
- Uses CoreProtect history (when available) to identify player-placed blocks for accurate ground detection.
- Logs a server alert when a placement is blocked.
- Supports live config reload and runtime toggling.
- Lava casting attribution, optional logs will tell you who tried to place lava and where.
- Maintains natural world lava flow.

```[AntiLavaCast] Blocked lava placement by CevAPI at -85,164,-29 (heightAboveGround=96, groundY=68)```

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21+

## Install
1. Download the jar.
2. Drop the jar into your server `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server to generate the config.

## Commands
- `/lavacast reload`
- `/lavacast enable`
- `/lavacast disable`
- `/lavacast setheight <blocks>`
- `/lavacast drop <on|off>` on allows dropping
- `/lavacast flow <on|off>` on allows flowing
- `/lavacast logs <on|off>` on logs blocked placements
- `/lavacast coreprotect <on|off>` toggles CoreProtect integration
- `/lavacast coreprotectlookback <seconds|1m|2h|7d|4w>` sets how far back CoreProtect history is searched
- `/lavacast mark <radius>` marks nearby blocks as player-placed for height checks (max radius 100)

## Permissions
`lavacast.admin` (default: op)

## Config
`plugins/AntiLavaCast/config.yml`
```yaml
max-height-above-ground: 20
enabled: true
allow-lava-drop: false
allow-lava-flow: false
log-blocked-placements: true
coreprotect-enabled: true
coreprotect-lookback-seconds: 31536000
```

## Notes
- The ground scan ignores player-placed blocks; when CoreProtect is available it will also treat historical placements as player-placed.
- Use `/lavacast mark <radius>` around old builds to mark them as player-placed if CoreProtect is not available.
- Marked blocks are stored on disk in `plugins/AntiLavaCast/marks` and persist across restarts.
- When CoreProtect is enabled and detected, mark storage is disabled and lookups rely on CoreProtect instead.

title: BetterLAN
description: Seamless intra-group networking for Minecraft. Connects players via any BetterLAN node service with military-grade End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) and real-time host approval.
body:
_BetterLAN - Play "LAN" with friends anywhere, securely._

## Introduction
BetterLAN is a networking mod that completely redefines how you play Minecraft with your friends. Say goodbye to complex port forwarding, router settings, or heavy third-party VPNs like Hamachi. BetterLAN connects players via a lightweight central relay node, making remote worlds appear directly in your Vanilla Multiplayer server list as if you were sitting in the same room.

## Key Features

**Zero Configuration Networking:** Just publish your single-player world to LAN. Friends in your configured "Group" will instantly see your world in their Multiplayer menu.

**End-to-End Encryption (E2EE):** All game traffic is encrypted locally before leaving your computer. The relay node only forwards encrypted bytes and cannot read your game data.

**Host Control:** Whenever someone tries to join your world, you get a clickable prompt in your chat to [Accept] or [Reject] their connection.

**Presence System:** See who in your friend group is currently online and check their ping to the node in real-time via the in-game Node Config UI.

**Offline UUID Fixes:** Built-in support to fix UUIDs for offline-mode auth, ensuring player inventories and stats remain consistent.

## How to Use

**Configure:** Click the [Node Config] button on the Main Menu. Enter the Node IP/Port, and agree on a secret Group name and Password with your friends.

**Host:** Open your single-player world and click "Open to LAN". The mod will automatically sync your room to the cloud.

**Join:** Your friends go to the standard "Multiplayer" menu. Your world will magically appear in their list.

**Verify & Play:** When a friend double-clicks to join, both of you will see a 6-digit Security Fingerprint. Verify it via voice chat, and the host clicks [Accept] in the game chat to let them in!

## Details & Security Architecture
_BetterLAN is built with a zero-trust architecture to ensure your gameplay and data remain strictly private:_

**ECDH Key Exchange:** When a connection is established, the Host and Guest generate temporary Elliptic-Curve (EC) key pairs and exchange public keys to derive a shared secret.

**AES-CTR Encryption:** All Minecraft packets are wrapped in an AES-CTR encryption layer using the derived shared secret.

**MITM Protection (Fingerprinting):** To prevent malicious relay nodes or network hijackers from performing Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks, the mod displays a 6-digit hex fingerprint (a SHA-256 hash of the final AES session key) to both the Host and the Guest. If the fingerprints match on both screens, the mathematical guarantee is that the connection is absolutely secure and untampered with.

title: ItemCooldown
description: A simple and lightweight ItemCooldown plugin!
body:
# ItemCooldown

**ItemCooldown** is a lightweight and highly configurable Minecraft plugin that allows server owners to apply cooldown restrictions to specific items during PvP combat.
It prevents players from abusing powerful items such as **Totems, Elytra, Ender Pearls, Golden Apples, etc.** by temporarily blocking their usage when combat starts.

The plugin is designed to be **fully configurable**, **lightweight**, and **safe**, with support for multiple item actions and automatic inventory handling.

---

# Key Features

### ⚔️ Combat-Based Cooldowns

Cooldowns begin **immediately when a player enters PvP combat**.
Both the attacker and the victim receive cooldowns for all configured items.

Combat detection includes:

* Direct player hits
* Projectiles shot by players
* Creative attackers
* Area-effect damage from players

Ignored damage sources:

* Self damage
* Ender pearl damage
* Non-player attackers

---

### 🧩 Configurable Item Actions

Each item can restrict different types of interactions:

| Action        | Description                                                   |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `pickup`      | Prevents players from picking up the item                     |
| `equip`       | Prevents players from equipping the item                      |
| `use`         | Prevents players from using the item                          |
| `containers`  | Prevents players from moving the item into or out of containers and bundles |

Example config:

```json
{
  "TOTEM_OF_UNDYING": {
    "cooldown": 60,
    "action": ["pickup", "use"]
  },
  "ELYTRA": {
    "cooldown": 120,
    "action": ["equip"]
  }
}
```

Cooldown values are in **seconds**.

---

### 🪂 Smart Equipment Handling

If a player **already has a restricted item equipped when combat begins**, the plugin will automatically:

1. **Unequip the item**
2. **Move it to the player's inventory**

If the inventory is full:

* the item is temporarily stored in a **virtual buffer**
* it will automatically return to the inventory when space becomes available

This prevents bypassing cooldowns with already-equipped items such as **Elytra or armor pieces**.

---

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable

The plugin uses **Bukkit material names** and JSON configuration.

Structure:

```
plugins/ItemCooldown/

config.json
config-examples.txt

translations/
  messages.json
```

Features include:

* Editable messages
* Configurable cooldowns
* Configurable actions per item
* Built-in documentation examples

---

### 🔄 Hot Reload Support

You can reload the configuration and translation files without restarting the server.

```
/itemcooldown reload
```

If configuration files are missing, the plugin will **automatically recreate them**.

---

# Commands

| Command                                              | Description                               |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `/itemcooldown help`                                 | Displays all plugin commands              |
| `/itemcooldown list [page]`                          | Lists configured cooldown items           |
| `/itemcooldown info <material>`                      | Shows information about a configured item |
| `/itemcooldown add <material> <cooldown> <actions>`  | Adds a new item cooldown                  |
| `/itemcooldown edit <material> <cooldown> <actions>` | Edits an existing item                    |
| `/itemcooldown remove <material>`                    | Removes an item cooldown                  |
| `/itemcooldown reload`                               | Reloads the plugin configuration          |

---

# Permissions

| Permission                    | Description                                   | Default |
|--------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|--------|
| `itemcooldown.help`            | Allows `/itemcooldown help`                   | true   |
| `itemcooldown.info`            | Allows `/itemcooldown info`                   | op     |
| `itemcooldown.list`            | Allows `/itemcooldown list`                   | op     |
| `itemcooldown.reload`          | Allows `/itemcooldown reload`                 | op     |
| `itemcooldown.add`             | Allows adding new cooldown items              | op     |
| `itemcooldown.edit`            | Allows editing cooldown items                 | op     |
| `itemcooldown.remove`          | Allows removing cooldown items                | op     |
| `itemcooldown.update.notify`   | Allows receiving in-game update notifications | op     |

---

# Why Use ItemCooldown?

Many PvP servers suffer from **item abuse during combat**, such as:

* Elytra escaping
* Totem stacking
* Infinite ender pearl usage
* Golden apple spam

ItemCooldown provides a **clean and configurable solution** to balance PvP while keeping gameplay fair.

---

# Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.20+**
* Spigot / Paper
* Lightweight with minimal performance impact

---

# Example Use Cases

Common items servers restrict:

```
TOTEM_OF_UNDYING
ENDER_PEARL
ELYTRA
GOLDEN_APPLE
ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_APPLE
SHIELD
TRIDENT
```

---

# Configuration Philosophy

ItemCooldown is designed to be:

* **Simple**
* **Flexible**
* **Server-friendly**

You decide **which items**, **which actions**, and **how long** the cooldown lasts.

---

title: Old Vein Miner
description:
The only VeinMiner for Minecraft 1.4.7
Old VeinMiner brings chain-mining to Minecraft 1.4.7 — a version no other VeinMiner mod supports.
body:
# The only VeinMiner for Minecraft 1.4.7

**Old VeinMiner** brings chain-mining to Minecraft 1.4.7 — a version no other VeinMiner mod supports.

Hold the activation key (`` ` `` by default) and break a block. The entire connected vein is mined instantly, with drops delivered straight to your inventory.

## Features

- **26-directional flood fill** — mines diagonally connected blocks, closest first
- **All mineable blocks** — ores, leaves (with shears), and any connected block type
- **Smart drops** — compacted into stacks, delivered to inventory (overflow drops at feet)
- **Tool durability** — consumed per block, stops if your tool breaks
- **Hunger cost** — proportional to blocks mined (configurable, or disable it)
- **Redstone-aware** — lit and unlit redstone ore treated as the same vein
- **Fully configurable** — max blocks, hunger cost, activation key, drop behavior

## Configuration

Edit `config/ovm.cfg` after first launch:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `maxBlocks` | 64 | Max blocks mined per operation |
| `hungerPerBlocks` | 32 | Blocks per hunger point (0 = free) |
| `dropsToInventory` | true | Drops go to inventory vs. drop in world |
| `activationKey` | 41 | LWJGL keycode (41 = `` ` ``) |

## Install

1. Install [Minecraft Forge for 1.4.7](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/index_1.4.7.html)
2. Drop `ovm-*.jar` into your `mods/` folder
3. Launch the game

![Kuvankaunis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/369a9eef53e3fe42d27addc2d77c545eb4c91900.png)

Kuvankaunis is a modern modpack focused on visuals and exploration. It's optimized, heavily customizable, and offers a considerable upgrade to the vanilla Minecraft experience.

# Features

## Graphics

The modpack employs Solas Shader by default to provide stunning graphical fidelity, though still maintaining the Minecraft asthetic. It also makes use of Distant Horizons to allow you to appreciate the vastness of your world, while the framerate remains smooth.

![The vastness of a world in Kuvankaunis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19ecfbae15faf6733975b7bf59d156e809384647.jpeg)

## World

The world in Kuvankaunis is vibrant and refreshing, with all three dimesions getting a new coat of paint. Terrain generation is much more complex and interesting, and there are many new materials and wood types to be harvested and used in your builds. It also adds seasons, and each one brings it's own advantages and challenges.

![A Forest in Kuvankaunis](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/247c02bc13dcbe2a39016a569931653df32b4442.jpeg)

There are many Quality of Life features included in Kuvankaunis, such as teleportation waystones, full controller support, container sorting, and character customization, just to name a few.

## Performance

Out of the box, the modpack should perform well on an NVIDIA RTX 4060 or AMD Radeon 7600 XT or better. If you have a less powerful system, you can turn the Solas Shader preset to a lower setting in the Iris menu.

You may also want to allocate 8 GB or more of RAM for the best experience.

For reference, I use an Intel i7-11700F CPU, and an AMD Radeon 9060 XT 16GB GPU and I get between 80-100 Avg. FPS in most situations with the default settings on Fedora Linux 43.

Controller support is included out of the box, including for Steam Deck and other handhelds.

description: CropCycle is a Minecraft Fabric mod for version 1.21.11 that automatically harvests and replants fully grown crops when you right click them, using seeds from your inventory. It streamlines farming, saving time while keeping gameplay balance.
body:
# CropCycle

A simple quality-of-life mod that automatically replants crops when you harvest them. No more tedious replanting after every harvest!

## How It Works

Right-click any fully grown crop with an empty hand, and CropCycle will automatically:
- Harvest the crop (with all drops, including Fortune bonuses)
- Consume one seed from your inventory
- Instantly replant the crop

## Supported Crops

- Wheat
- Carrots
- Potatoes
- Beetroots
- Nether Wart

## Features

- **Server-side only** - Works with vanilla clients, no client installation needed
- **Smart detection** - Only triggers on fully grown crops
- **Shift to disable** - Hold shift while harvesting to disable auto-replant
- **Creative friendly** - Seeds aren't consumed in creative mode
- **Fortune compatible** - Respects Fortune enchantments for bonus drops
- **Multiplayer safe** - No duplication exploits
- **Configurable** - Toggle individual crops and effects via config file

## Configuration

After first launch, edit `config/autoreplant.json` to customize:
- Enable/disable specific crops
- Toggle particle effects
- Toggle sound effects

## Perfect For

- Large-scale farming operations
- Reducing farming tedium
- Server owners wanting to improve farming QoL
- Players who value efficiency

No complicated mechanics, just simple automatic replanting that works exactly how you'd expect.

title: Iron Watch
description: IronWatch is a modular anti-cheat for Paper servers with ProtocolLib integration, per-player state tracking, and configurable thresholds.
body:
IronWatch is a modular anti-cheat for Paper servers with ProtocolLib integration, per-player state tracking, and configurable thresholds. Designed for low false-positives and easy tuning.

Features
- 55+ detections across Combat, Movement, Player
- Combat: Aim (A–E), Kill Aura (A–F), Reach (A), Auto Clicker (A–B), Hitbox (stubs)
- Movement: Speed (A–D), Flight (A–E), Jesus (A), Step (A), VClip (A), Strafe (A), Wall Climb (A), Fast Climb (A), Entity Speed (A)
- Player: Bad Packets (A–D), No Slow (A), Timer (A–D), Inventory (A–B), Invalid (A–C), Ground Spoof (A–C), Scaffold (A)
- ProtocolLib packet processing (USE_ENTITY, POSITION, POSITION_LOOK, LOOK, ARM_ANIMATION, CLIENT_COMMAND, BLOCK_DIG/PLACE)
- Violation decay service to reduce false positives
- Configurable limits/thresholds via `config.yml`

Requirements
- Paper 1.20.1+ (Java 17)
- ProtocolLib 4.8.0 (recommended)

Installation
- Place `IronWatch-1.0.0.jar` in your server `plugins/` folder
- Ensure ProtocolLib is installed
- Start the server to generate `config.yml`
- Run `/ironwatch` to view version and loaded detections

Configuration
```yaml
violation:
  decay_per_second: 0.5
checks:
  flight:
    air_time_ms: 1500
  speed:
    base_limit: 0.35
    ice_bonus: 0.15
    liquid_bonus: 0.25
```

Usage
- Command: `/ironwatch` shows plugin version and detection count
- Tuning: adjust `checks.*` values to your server’s movement/combat balance
- Logs: violations are logged with player name, check key, and current VL

body:
This mod introduces three core items: the Artillery Designator, the Artillery Launcher, and the Missile. Together, they form a tactical artillery system that allows players to coordinate remote explosive strikes with precision and strategy.

The Artillery Designator serves as the targeting device, guiding the Artillery Launcher to a specific location. The Artillery Launcher functions as an automated launch platform, capable of delivering Missiles to designated coordinates. The Missile acts as both ammunition for the launcher and a handheld explosive that can be thrown manually.

To set up the system, first place the Artillery Launcher and load it with Missiles. Then, while holding the Artillery Designator, press Shift + Right-Click to bind it to the launcher. Once linked, simply throw the Designator anywhere within render distance. The launcher will automatically calculate trajectory and launch Missiles toward the target point.

Upon throwing the Designator, detailed strike information will appear in the chat, including the target coordinates, distance from the launcher, artillery spread radius, and estimated time of impact. When a Missile lands—whether launched or thrown—it detonates immediately upon contact with any surface.

Crafting these items is straightforward:
- The Artillery Designator is made by combining a Redstone Torch and White Dye in any arrangement.
- The Missile requires two Sand and two Gunpowder placed diagonally in a 2×2 crafting grid.
- The Artillery Launcher is crafted with a Redstone Block in the center, the space above it left empty, and all remaining slots filled with Cobblestone.
